Bekhorot 49a:12-49b:9: Gemara ittemar: happode et beno betoch sheloshim yom, rav amar: beno paduy, ushemuel amar: en beno paduy. dechulle alma "meachshav" — en beno paduy, leachar sheloshim yom veitanhu lemaot — vadday beno paduy.
Ki peligi leachar sheloshim yom, venitakkelu hammaot, rav amar: beno paduy, midde dehave akkiddushe ishsha, hatam lav af al gav denitakkelu hammaot — havu kiddushe,

Ushemuel amar lach: hatam — beyado lekaddeshah meachshav, hacha — en beyado lifdoto meachshav. veaf al gav dekayyma lan, dechol hecha difligi rav ushemuel — hilcheta kerav beissure vechishmuel bedine, hacha hilcheta kevavteh dishmuel.
Tenan: met betoch sheloshim yom, af al pi shennatan lakkohen — yachzir lo chamesh selaim. tama demet, ha lo met — beno paduy! hacha bemay askinan? deitanhu lemaot.
Ta shema: bechezkat shello nifda ad sheyyomru lo shennifda! hatam name deitanhu lemaot beenayyhu.

Tane tanna kammeh derav yehuda: happode et beno betoch sheloshim yom — beno paduy. amar leh: shemuel amar en beno paduy, veat amrat beno paduy?! veaf al gav dekayyma lan kerav beissure vechishmuel bedine, hacha hilcheta kevateh dishmuel.
Hu lifdot uveno lifdot — hu kodem livno vechulei. tanu rabbanan: hu lifdot uveno lifdot — hu kodem livno. rabbi yehuda omer: beno kodmo, shemmitzvato al aviv, umitzvat beno alav.
Amar rabbi yirmeya: hakkol modim hecha delekka ella chamesh selaim — hu kodem livno, may tama? demitzva dideh adif. ki peligi hecha deikka chamesh meshuebadot vechamesh bene chorin.
Rabbi yehuda savar: milva hakketuva battora — kichtuva bishtar damya, vedideh azel vetaref mimmeshabedi, uvehane chamesh bene chorin — parek leh livreh.
Verabbanan savri: milva hakketuva battora — lav kichtuva bishtar damya, hilkach mitzva dideh adif.
Berakhot 54b:21-55a:3: Amar rav yehuda: shelosha tzerichin shimmur, veellu hen — chole, chatan, vechalla. bematnita tana: chole, chayya, chatan, vechalla. veyesh omrim: af avel. veyesh omrim: af talmide chachamim ballayla.
Veamar rav yehuda: shelosha devarim hammaarich bahen maarichin yamav ushenotav shel adam. hammaarich bitfillato, vehammaarich al shulchano, vehammaarich bevet hakkisse.
Vehammaarich bitfillato mealleyuta hi? vehaamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan:

Kol hammaarich bitfillato umeayyen bah — sof ba lide keev lev, shenneemar: "tochelet memushshacha machala lev". veamar rabbi yitzchak: shelosha devarim mazkirim avonotav shel adam, veellu hen: kir natuy, veiyyun tefilla, umoser din al chavero lashshamayim!
Ha la kashya: ha dimayyen ba, ha dela meayyen ba. vehechi aved? — demappesh berachame.

Vehammaarich al shulchano: dilma ate anya veyahev leh. dichtiv: "hammizbeach etz shalosh ammot gavoah", uchetiv: "vaydabber elay ze hashshulchan asher lifne Adonai", patach bemizbeach vesiyyem beshulchan! rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar deamri tarvayyhu: kol zeman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym — mizbeach mechapper al yisrael, veachshav, shulchano shel adam mechapper alav.
Chagigah 27a:4-8: Vachachamim omrim: mippene shehen metzuppin. adderabba: kevan dimtzuppin ninhu — mittammeu! ema, vachachamim: metammein, mippene shehen metzuppin.
Veibbaet ema: rabbanan lerabbi eliezer kaamri: may dataych, mishshum dimtzuppin —

Amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi elazar: talmide chachamim en ur shel gehinnam sholetet bahen, kal vachomer missalamandera: uma salamandera shettoledet esh hi — hassach middamah en ur sholetet bo, talmide chachamim shekkol gufan esh, dichtiv: "halo cho devari kaesh neum Adonai" — al achat kamma vechamma.

Amar resh lakish: en ur shel gehinnam sholetet befoshe yisrael, kal vachomer mimmizbach hazzahav: ma mizbach hazzahav sheen alav ella keovi dinar zahav — kamma shanim en haur sholetet bo, poshe yisrael shemmelein mitzvot kerimmon, dichtiv: "kefelach harimmon rakkatech", al tikre "rakkatech", ella: rekanin shebbach — al achat kamma vechamma.
Isaiah 54:11-16: Aniyya soara lo nuchama hinne anochi marbitz bappuch avanayich visadtich bassappirim
Vesamti kadchod shimshotayich ushearayich leavne ekdach vechol-gevulech leavne-chefetz
Vechol-banayich limmude Adonai verav shelom banayich
Bitzdaka tikkonani rachaki meoshek ki-lo tirai umimmechitta ki lo-tikrav elayich
Hen gor yagur efes meoti mi-gar ittach alayich yippol
(Hen) [hinne] anochi barati charash nofeach beesh pecham umotzi cheli lemaasehu veanochi barati mashchit lechabbel
Isaiah 54:17-55:3: Kol-keli yutzar alayich lo yitzlach vechol-lashon takum-ittach lammishpat tarshii zot nachalat avde Adonai vetzidkatam meitti neum-Adonai {s}
Hoy kol-tzame lechu lammayim vaasher en-lo kasef lechu shivru veecholu ulechu shivru belo-chesef uvelo mechir yayin vechalav
Lamma tishkelu-chesef belo-lechem vigiachem belo lesova shimu shamoa elay veichlu-tov vetitannag baddeshen nafshechem
Hattu oznechem ulechu elay shimu utechi nafshechem veechreta lachem berit olam chasde david hanneemanim
Isaiah 55:4-8: Hen ed leummim netattiv nagid umetzavve leummim
Hen goy lo-teda tikra vegoy lo-yedaucha elecha yarutzu lemaan Adonai elohecha velikdosh yisrael ki fearach {s}
Dirshu Adonai behimmatzo kerauhu bihyoto karov
Yaazov rasha darko veish aven machshevotav veyashov el-Adonai virachamehu veel-elohenu ki-yarbe lisloach
Ki lo machshevotay machshevotechem velo darchechem derachay neum Adonai
Isaiah 55:9-56:1: Ki-gavhu shamayim mearetz ken gavhu derachay middarchechem umachshevotay mimmachshevotechem
Ki kaasher yered haggeshem vehashsheleg min-hashshamayim veshamma lo yashuv ki im-hirva et-haaretz veholidah vehitzmichah venatan zera lazzorea velechem laochel
Ken yihye devari asher yetze mippi lo-yashuv elay rekam ki im-asa et-asher chafatzti vehitzliach asher shelachtiv
Ki-vesimcha tetzeu uveshalom tuvalun heharim vehaggevaot yiftzechu lifnechem rinna vechol-atze hassade yimchau-chaf
Tachat hannaatzutz yaale verosh (tachat) [vetachat] hassirpad yaale hadas vehaya laAdonai leshem leot olam lo yikkaret {p}
Ko amar Adonai shimru mishpat vaasu tzedaka ki-kerova yeshuati lavo vetzidkati lehiggalot
Isaiah 56:2-6: Ashre enosh yaase-zot uven-adam yachazik bah shomer shabbat mechallelo veshomer yado measot kol-ra {s}
Veal-yomar ben-hannechar hannilva el-Adonai lemor havedel yavdilani Adonai meal ammo veal-yomar hassaris hen ani etz yavesh {p}
Ki-cho ׀ amar Adonai lassarisim asher yishmeru et-shabbetotay uvacharu baasher chafatzti umachazikim bivriti
Venatatti lahem beveti uvechomotay yad vashem tov mibbanim umibbanot shem olam etten-lo asher lo yikkaret {s}
Uvene hannechar hannilvim al-Adonai lesharto uleahava et-shem Adonai lihyot lo laavadim kol-shomer shabbat mechallelo umachazikim bivriti
Mishnah Horayot 2:4-7:
En chayyavin al ase veal lo taase shebbammikdash, veen meviin asham taluy al ase veal lo taase shebbammikdash. aval chayyavin al ase veal lo taase shebbannidda, umeviin asham taluy al ase veal lo taase shebbannidda. ezo hi mitzvat ase shebbannidda, perosh min hannidda. umitzvat lo taase, lo tavo el hannidda: 
En chayyavin al shemiat hakkol, veal bittuy sefatayim, veal tumat mikdash vekadashav. vehannasi kayyotze vahem, divre rabbi yose haggelili. rabbi akiva omer, hannasi chayyav bechullan chutz mishshemiat hakkol, shehammelech lo dan velo danin oto, lo meid velo meidin oto: 
Kol hammitzvot shebbattora shechayyavin al zedonan karet veal shiggatan chattat, hayyachid mevi chisba useira, vehannasi sair, umashiach uvet din meviin par. uvaavoda zara, hayyachid vehannasi vehammashiach meviin seira, uvet din par vesair, par leola vesair lechattat: 
Asham taluy, hayyachid vehannasi chayyavin, umashiach uvet din peturim. asham vadday, hayyachid vehannasi vehammashiach chayyavin, uvet din peturin. al shemiat hakkol veal bittuy sefatayim veal tumat mikdash vekadashav, bet din peturin, vehayyachid vehannasi vehammashiach chayyavin, ella sheen kohen gadol chayyav al tumat mikdash vekadashav, divre rabbi shimon. uma hen meviin, karban ole veyored. rabbi eliezer omer, hannasi mevi sair:
Mishnah Horayot 3:1-5:
Kohen mashiach shechata veachar kach avar mimmeshichuto, vechen nasi shechata veachar kach avar miggedullato, kohen mashiach mevi far, vehannasi mevi sair: 
Kohen mashiach sheavar mimmeshichuto veachar kach chata, vechen hannasi sheavar miggedullato veachar kach chata, kohen mashiach mevi far, vehannasi chehedyot: 
Chatu ad shello nitmannu veachar kach nitmannu, hare ellu chehedyot. rabbi shimon omer, im noda lahem ad shello nitmannu, chayyavin. umishshennitmannu, peturin. veezehu hannasi, ze hammelech, shenneemar (Vayikra 4) veasa achat mikkol mitzvot Adonai elohav, nasi sheen al gabbav ella Adonai elohav: 
Veezehu hammashiach, hammashuach beshemen hammishcha, lo hamerubbe vivgadim. en ben kohen hammashuach beshemen hammishcha limrubbe vegadim ella far habba al kol hammitzvot. veen ben kohen meshammesh lechohen sheavar, ella far yom hakkippurim vaasirit haefa. ze vaze shavin baavodat yom hakkippurim, umetzuvvin al habbetula, vaasurin al haalmana, veenan mittammein bikrovehen, velo forin, velo formin, umachazirin et harotzeach: 
Kohen gadol porem millematta, vehahedyot milmala. kohen gadol makriv onen velo ochel, vehahedyot lo makriv velo ochel:
Mishnah Horayot 3:6-8:
Kol hattadir mechavero, kodem et chavero. vechol hamekuddash mechavero, kodem et chavero. par hammashiach ufar haeda omdim, par hammashiach kodem lefar haeda bechol maasav: 
Haish kodem laishsha lehachayot ulehashiv aveda. vehaishsha kodemet laish lichsut, ulehotziah mibbet hashshevi. bizman sheshshenehem omdim lekalkala, haish kodem laishsha: 
Kohen kodem lelevi, levi leyisrael, yisrael lemamzer, umamzer lenatin, venatin leger, veger leeved meshuchrar. ematay, bizman shekkullan shavin. aval im haya mamzer talmid chacham vechohen gadol am haaretz, mamzer talmid chacham kodem lechohen gadol am haaretz:
Mishnah Niddah 5:6-6:1: Bat achat esre shana veyom echad, nedareha nivdakin. bat shetem esre shana veyom echad, nedareha kayyamin. uvodkin kol shetem esre. ben shetem esre shana veyom echad, nedarav nivdakim. ben shelosh esre shana veyom echad, nedarav kayyamin. uvodkin kol shelosh esre. kodem lazzeman hazze, af al pi sheamru yodin anu leshem mi nadarnu, leshem mi hikdashnu, en nidrehem neder veen hekdeshan hekdesh. leachar hazzeman hazze, af al pi sheamru en anu yodin leshem mi nadarnu, leshem mi hikdashnu, nidran neder vehekdeshan hekdesh:

Mashal mashlu chachamim baishsha. pagga, bochal vetzemel. pagga, odah tinoket. bochal, ellu yeme neureha. bazo uvazo, aviha zakkay bimtziatah uvemaase yadeha uvahafarat nedareha. tzemel, kevan shebbagra, shuv en leaviha reshut bah:

Ezehu simaneha. rabbi yose haggelili omer, mishsheyyaale hakkemet tachat haddad. rabbi akiva omer, mishsheyyattu haddaddim. ben azzay omer, mishshettashchir happittomet. rabbi yose omer, kede sheyyehe noten yado al haoketz vehu shokea veshohe lachazor:

Bat esrim shana shello hevia shete searot, tavi reaya shehi vat esrim shana, vehi aylonit, lo choletzet velo mityabbemet. ben esrim shana shello hevi shete searot, yavi reaya shehu ven esrim shana, vehu saris, lo choletz velo meyabbem, ellu divre vet hillel. bet shammay omrim, ze vaze bene shemone esre. rabbi eliezer omer, hazzachar kedivre vet hillel, vehannekeva kedivre vet shammay, shehaishsha memaheret lavo lifne haish:

Ba siman hattachton ad shello va haelyon, o choletzet o mityyabbemet. ba haelyon ad shello va hattachton, af al pi shei efshar, rabbi meir omer, lo choletzet velo mityabbemet. vachachamim omrim, o choletzet o mityabbemet. mippene sheamru, efshar lattachton lavo ad shello va haelyon, aval i efshar laelyon lavo ad shello va hattachton:
Mishnah Niddah 6:10-14:
Kol hattaun beracha leacharav, taun beracha lefanav. veyesh taun beracha lefanav veen taun beracha leacharav: 
Tinoket shehevia shete searot, o choletzet o mityabbemet, vechayyevet bechol mitzvot haamurot battora. vechen tinok shehevi shete searot, chayyav bechol mitzvot haamurot battora. verauy lihyot ben sorer umore, mishsheyyavi shete searot ad sheyyakkif zakan, hattachton velo haelyon, ella sheddibberu chachamim belashon nekiyya. tinoket shehevia shete searot, enah yechola lemaen. rabbi yehuda omer, ad sheyyirbe hashshachor: 
Shete searot haamurot bappara uvannegaim, vehaamurot bechol makom, kede lachof roshan leikkaran, divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi elazar omer, kede likrotz batztzipporen. rabbi akiva omer, kede sheyyehu nittalot bezug: 
Haroa chetem, hare zo mekulkelet, vechosheshet mishshum zov, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, en bakketamim mishshum zov: 
Haroa yom achad asar ben hashshemashot, techillat nidda vesof nidda, techillat ziva vesof ziva, yom arbaim lazzachar veyom shemonim lannekeva, ben hashshemashot lechullan, hare ellu toot. amar rabbi yehoshua, ad sheattem metakkenim et hashshotot, takkenu et happikchot:
Mishnah Niddah 6:2-5:
Kayyotze vo, kol keli cheres shehu machnis, motzi. veyesh shemmotzi veeno machnis. kol evar sheyyesh bo tzipporen, yesh bo etzem, veyesh sheyyesh bo etzem veen bo tzipporen: 
Kol hammittamme midras, mittamme teme met. veyesh shemmittamme teme met veeno mittamme midras: 
Kol harauy ladun dine nefashot, rauy ladun dine mamonot. veyesh sherauy ladun dine mamonot veeno rauy ladun dine nefashot. kol hakkasher ladun, kasher lehaid. veyesh shekkasher lehaid veeno chasher ladun: 
Kol shechayyav bammaasrot, mittamme tumat ochalim. veyesh shemmittamme tumat ochalin veeno chayyav bammaasrot:
Mishnah Niddah 6:6-9:
Kol shechayyav bappea, chayyav bammaasrot. veyesh shechayyav bammaasrot veeno chayyav bappea: 
Kol shechayyav bereshit haggez, chayyav bammattanot. veyesh shechayyav bammattanot veeno chayyav bereshit haggez: 
Kol sheyyesh lo viur, yesh lo sheviit. veyesh sheyyesh lo sheviit veen lo viur: 
Kol sheyyesh lo kaskeset, yesh lo senappir. veyesh sheyyesh lo senappir veen lo kaskeset. kol sheyyesh lo karnayim, yesh lo telafayim. veyesh sheyyesh lo telafayim veen lo karnayim:
Mishnah Niddah 7:1-4:
Dam hannidda uvesar hammet, metammein lachin umetammein yeveshin. aval hazzov vehannia veharok vehashsheretz vehannevela vehashshichvat zera, metammein lachin veen metammein yeveshin. veim yecholin lehishsharot velachazor lichmot shehen, metammein lachin umetammein yeveshin. vechamma hi sheriyyatan. befoshrin, meet leet. rabbi yose omer, besar hammet yavesh veeno yachol lehishsharot velachazor lichmot shehaya, tahor: 
Hashsheretz shennimtza bammavoy, metamme lemafrea, ad sheyyomar badakti et hammavoy hazze velo haya vo sheretz, o ad sheat kibbud. vechen ketem shennimtza vechaluk, metamme lemafrea, ad sheyyomar badakti et hechaluk hazze velo haya vo chetem, o ad sheat hakkibbus. umetamme ben lach ben yavesh. rabbi shimon omer, hayyavesh metamme lemafrea, vehallach eno metamme ella ad shaa shehu yachol lachazor velihyot lach: 
Kol hakketamin habbaim merekem, tehorin. rabbi yehuda metamme, mippene shehem gerim vetoin. habbain mibben haggoyim, tehorin. mibben yisrael umibben hakkutim, rabbi meir metamme. vachachamim metaharin, mippene shello nechshedu al kitmehen: 
Kol hakketamim hannimtzeim bechol makom, tehorin, chutz min hannimtzeim bachadarim uvisvivot bet hattumot. bet hattumot shel kutim metammein beohel, mippene shehem kovrin sham et hannefalim. rabbi yehuda omer, lo hayu kovrin ella mashlichin, vechayya gorartan:
Mishnah Niddah 7:5-8:3:
Neemanim lomar, kavarnu sham et hannefalim, o, lo kavarnu. neemanim lomar al habbehema im bikkera, im lo vikkera. neemanim al tziyyun kevarot, veen neemanin lo al hassechachot velo al happeraot velo al bet happeras. ze hakkelal, davar shechashudim bo, en neemanim alav: 
Haroa chetem al besarah keneged bet hatturpa temea. veshello cheneged bet hatturpa, tehora. al akevah veal rosh gudalah, temea. al shokah veal parsoteha, mibbifnim, temea. mibbachutz, tehora. veal hatztzedadin mikkan umikkan, tehora. raata al chalukah, min hachagor ulematta, temea. min hachagor ulemala, tehora. raata al bet yad shel chaluk, im maggia keneged bet hatturpa, temea. veim lav, tehora. hayta foshatto umitkassa vo ballayla, kol makom shennimtza vo chetem, temea, mippene shehu chozer. vechen bappalyom: 
Vetola vechol davar shehi yechola litlot. shachata vehema, chayya vaof, nitasseka vichtamim o sheyyashva vetzad haasukim bahen, harga maacholet, hare zo tola vah. ad kamma hi tola. rabbi chanina ven antignos omer, ad kaggeris shel pol, veaf al pi shello harga. vetola vivnah o bevalah. im yesh bah makka vehi yechola lehiggala ulehotzi dam, hare zo tola vah: 
Maase veishsha achat shebbat lifne rabbi akiva, amra lo, raiti chatem. amar lah, shemma makka hayta vich. amra lo, hen, vechayta. amar lah, shemma yechola lehiggala ulehotzi dam. amra lo, hen. vetiharah rabbi akiva. raa talmidav mistakkelin ze vaze. amar lahem, ma haddavar kashe veenechem. shello amru chachamim haddavar lehachemir ella lehakel, shenneemar (Vayikra 15), veishsha ki tihye zava dam yihye zovah bivsarah, dam velo chatem:
Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 1:4-7:
Al shene chodashim mechallelin et hashshabbat, al nisan veal tishre, shebbahen hashsheluchin yotzin lesureya, uvahen metakkenin et hammoadot. ucheshehaya vet hammikdash kayyam, mechallelin af al kullan mippene takkanat hakkarban: 
Ben shennira vaalil ben shello nira vaalil, mechallelin alav et hashshabbat, rabbi yose omer, im nira vaalil, en mechallelin alav et hashshabbat: 
Maase sheavru yoter mearbaim zug, veikkevan rabbi akiva velud. shalach lo rabban gamliel, im meakkev atta et harabbim, nimtzeta machshilan leatid lavo: 
Av uveno sherau et hachodesh, yelchu. lo shemmitztarfin ze im ze, ella sheim yippasel echad mehen, yitztaref hashsheni im acher. rabbi shimon omer, av uveno vechol hakkerovin, kesherin leedut hachodesh. amar rabbi yose, maase vetoviyya harofe, sheraa et hachodesh birushalayim, hu uveno veavdo meshuchrar, vekibbelu hakkohanim oto veet beno, ufaslu et avdo. ucheshebbau lifne vet din, kibbelu oto veet avdo, ufaslu et beno:
Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 1:8-2:2: Ellu hen happesulin, hamesachek bekuvya, umalve veribbit, umafriche yonim, vesochare sheviit, vaavadim. ze hakkelal, kol edut sheen haishsha cheshera lah, af hen enan kesherim lah:

Mi sheraa et hachodesh veeno yachol lehallech, molichin oto al hachamor, afillu vemitta. veim tzode lahem, lokchin beyadam makkelot. veim hayta derech rechoka, lokchin beyadam mezonot, sheal mahalach layla vayom mechallelin et hashshabbat veyotzin leedut hachodesh, shenneemar (Vayikra 23), elle moade Adonai asher tikreu otam bemoadam:
Im enan makkirin oto, meshallechin acher immo lahaido. barishona hayu mekabbelin edut hachodesh mikkol adam. mishshekkilkelu hamminin, hitkinu shello yehu mekabbelin ella min hammakkirim:
Barishona hayu massiin massuot. mishshekkilkelu hakkutim, hitkinu sheyyehu sheluchin yotzin:
Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 2:3-7: Ketzad hayu massiin massuot, meviin kelunsaot shel erez arukkin vekanim vaatze shemen uneoret shel pishtan vechorech bimshicha, veole lerosh hahar umatztzit bahen et haur, umolich umevi umaale umorid, ad shehu roe et chavero shehu ose chen berosh hahar hashsheni, vechen berosh hahar hashshelishi:

Umeayin hayu massiin massuot, mehar hammishcha lesarteva, umissarteva ligrofina, umiggerofina lechavran, umechavran levet biltin, umibbet biltin lo zazu mishsham, ella molich umevi umaale umorid ad shehaya roe chol haggola lefanav kimdurat haesh:

Chatzer gedola hayta virushalayim, uvet yazek hayta nikret, ulesham kol haedim mitkannesim, uvet din bodkin otam sham. useudot gedolot osin lahem bishvil sheyyehu regilin lavo. barishona lo hayu zazin mishsham kol hayyom, hitkin rabban gamliel hazzaken sheyyehu mehallechin alpayim amma lechol ruach. velo ellu vilvad, ella af hachachama habbaa leyalled, vehabba lehatztzil min haddeleka umin haggayis umin hannahar umin hammappolet, hare ellu cheanshe hair, veyesh lahem alpayim amma lechol ruach:

Ketzad bodkin et haedim. zug shebba rishon, bodkin oto rishon. umachnisin et haggadol shebbahen veomrim lo, emor, ketzad raita et hallevana, lifne hachamma o leachar hachamma, litzfonah o lidromah, kamma haya gavoah uleayin haya note, vechamma haya rachav. im amar lifne hachamma, lo amar kelum. veachar kach hayu machnisim et hashsheni uvodkin oto. im nimtzeu divrehem mechuvvanim, edutan kayyamet. ushear kol hazzugot shoalin otam rashe devarim, lo shehayu tzerichin lahen, ella kede shello yetzu befache nefesh, bishvil sheyyehu regilim lavo:

Rosh bet din omer mekuddash, vechol haam onin acharav mekuddash mekuddash. ben shennira vizmanno ben shello nira vizmanno, mekaddeshin oto. rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok omer, im lo nira vizmanno, en mekaddeshin oto, shekkevar kiddeshuhu shamayim:
Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 2:8-3:2: Demut tzurot levanot hayu lo lerabban gamliel battavla uvakkotel baaliyyato, shebbahen mare et hahedyotot veomer, hachaze raita o chaze. maase shebbau shenayim veamru, reinuhu shacharit bammizrach vearvit bammaarav. amar rabbi yochanan ben nuri, ede sheker hem. keshebbau leyavne kibbelan rabban gamliel. veod bau shenayim veamru, reinuhu vizmanno, uvelel ibburo lo nira, vekibbelan rabban gamliel. amar rabbi dosa ben harekinas, ede sheker hen, heach meidin al haishsha sheyyalda, ulemachar keresah ben shinneha. amar lo rabbi yehoshua, roe ani et devarecha:

Shalach lo rabban gamliel, gozrani alecha shettavo etzli bemakkelcha uvimotecha beyom hakkippurim shechal lihyot becheshboncha. halach umetzao rabbi akiva metzer, amar lo, yesh li lilmod shekkol ma sheasa rabban gamliel asuy, shenneemar (Vayikra 23), elle moade Adonai mikrae kodesh, asher tikreu otam, ben bizmannan ben shello vizmannan, en li moadot ella ellu. ba lo etzel rabbi dosa ben harekinas, amar lo, im bain anu ladun achar bet dino shel rabban gamliel, tzerichin anu ladun achar kol bet din uvet din sheamad mimot moshe vead achshav, shenneemar (Shemot kad), vayyaal moshe veaharon nadav vaavihu veshivim mizzikne yisrael. velamma lo nitparshu shemotan shel zekenim, ella lelammed, shekkol shelosha ushelosha sheamdu vet din al yisrael, hare hu chevet dino shel moshe. natal maklo umeotav beyado, vehalach leyavne etzel rabban gamliel beyom shechal yom hakkippurim lihyot becheshbono. amad rabban gamliel uneshako al rosho, amar lo, bo veshalom, rabbi vetalmidi, rabbi vechachma, vetalmidi shekkibbalta devaray:

Rauhu vet din vechol yisrael, nechkeru haedim, velo hispiku lomar mekuddash, ad shechashecha, hare ze meubbar. rauhu vet din bilvad, yaamdu shenayim veyaidu vifnehem, veyomru mekuddash mekuddash. rauhu shelosha vehen bet din, yaamdu hashshenayim veyoshivu mechavrehem etzel hayyachid veyaidu vifnehem, veyomru mekuddash mekuddash, sheen hayyachid neeman al yede atzmo:
Kol hashshofarot kesherin chutz mishshel para, mippene shehu keren. amar rabbi yose, vahalo chol hashshofarot nikreu keren, shenneemar (yehoshua 6), bimshoch bekeren hayyovel:
Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 3:3-6:
Shofar shel rosh hashshana shel yael, pashut, ufiv metzuppe zahav, ushete chatzotzrot min hatztzedadin. shofar maarich vachatzotzrot mekatztzerot, shemmitzvat hayyom bashshofar: 
Battaaniyyot, beshel zecharim, kefufin, ufihen metzuppe chesef, ushete chatzotzrot baemtza. shofar mekatztzer vachatzotzrot maarichot, shemmitzvat hayyom bachatzotzrot: 
Shave hayyovel lerosh hashshana lattekia velabberachot. rabbi yehuda omer, berosh hashshana tokin beshel zecharim, uvayyovlot beshel yeelim: 
Shofar shennisdak vedibbeko, pasul. dibbek shivre shofarot, pasul. nikkav usetamo, im meakkev et hattekia, pasul. veim lav, kasher:
Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 3:7-4:3:
Hattokea letoch habbor o letoch haddut o letoch happittas, im kol shofar shama, yatza. veim kol havara shama, lo yatza. vechen mi shehaya over achore vet hakkeneset, o shehaya veto samuch levet hakkeneset, veshama kol shofar o kol megilla, im kivven libbo, yatza, veim lav, lo yatza. af al pi shezze shama veze shama, ze kivven libbo veze lo chivven libbo: 
Vehaya kaasher yarim moshe yado vegavar yisrael vegomer (Shemot 17), vechi yadav shel moshe osot milchama o shovrot milchama. ella lomar lecha, kol zeman shehayu yisrael mistakkelim kelappe mala umeshabedin et libbam laavihem shebbashshamayim hayu mitgabberim. veim lav, hayu noflin. kayyotze vaddavar atta omer (Bamidbar 21), ase lecha saraf vesim oto al nes, vehaya kol hannashuch veraa oto vachay. vechi nachash memit, o nachash mechayye. ella, bizman sheyyisrael mistakkelin kelappe mala umeshabedin et libbam laavihen shebbashshamayim, hayu mitrappeim, veim lav, hayu nimmokim. cheresh, shote, vekatan, en motziin et harabbim yede chovatan. ze hakkelal, kol sheeno mechuyyav baddavar, eno motzi et harabbim yede chovatan: 
Yom tov shel rosh hashshana shechal lihyot beshabbat, bammikdash hayu tokim, aval lo vammedina. meshshecharav bet hammikdash, hitkin rabban yochanan ben zakkay, sheyyehu tokin bechol makom sheyyesh bo vet din. amar rabbi elazar, lo hitkin rabban yochanan ben zakkay ella veyavne bilvad. amru lo, echad yavne veechad kol makom sheyyesh bo vet din: 
Veod zot hayta yerushalayim yetera al yavne, shekkol ir shehi roa veshomaat ukerova vichola lavo, tokin. uveyavne lo hayu tokin ella bevet din bilvad: 
Barishona haya hallulav nittal bammikdash shiva, uvammedina yom echad. mishshecharav bet hammikdash, hitkin rabban yochanan ben zakkay sheyhe lulav nittal bammedina shiva zecher lammikdash, vesheyyehe yom hanef kullo asur:
Mishnah Zevachim 1:1: Kol hazzevachim shenizbechu shello lishman, kesherim, ella shello alu labbealim leshem chova. chutz min happesach umin hachattat. happesach bizmanno, vehachattat, bechol zeman. rabbi eliezer omer, af haasham. happesach bizmanno, vehachattat vehaasham, bechol zeman. amar rabbi eliezer, hachattat baa al chet, vehaasham ba al chet. ma chattat pesula shello lishmah, af haasham pasul shello lishmo:
Mishnah Zevachim 1:2-2:1: Yose ven choni omer, hannishchatim leshem pesach uleshem chattat, pesulim. shimon achi azarya omer, shechatan leshem gavoah mehem, kesherin. leshem namuch mehem, pesulim. ketzad. kadshe kadashim sheshshechatan leshem kadashim kallim, pesulin. kadashim kallim sheshshechatan leshem kadshe kadashim, kesherin. habbechor vehammaaser sheshshechatan leshem shelamim, kesherin. ushelamim sheshshechatan leshem bechor, leshem maaser, pesulin:

Happesach sheshshechato veshacharit bearbaa asar shello lishmo, rabbi yehoshua machshir, keillu nishchat bishlosha asar. ben betera posel, keillu nishchat ben haarbayim. amar shimon ben azzay, mekubbal ani mippi shivim ushenayim zaken, beyom shehoshivu rabbi elazar ben azarya vayshiva, shekkol hazzevachim hanneechalim shennizbechu shello lishman, kesherim, ella shello alu labbealim mishshum chova, chutz min happesach umin hachattat. velo hosif ben azzay ella haola, velo hodu lo chachamim:

Happesach vehachattat sheshshechatan shello lishman, kibbel, vehillech, vezarak, shello lishman, o lishman veshello lishman, o shello lishman velishman, pesulim. ketzad lishman veshello lishman, leshem pesach uleshem shelamim. shello lishman velishman, leshem shelamim uleshem happesach. shehazzevach nifsal bearbaa devarim, bashshechita uvakkibbul uvahilluch uvazzerika. rabbi shimon machshir behilluch, shehaya rabbi shimon omer, i efshar shello vishchita veshello vekabbala veshello vizrika, aval efshar shello vehilluch, shochet betzad hammizbeach vezorek. rabbi eliezer omer, hamehallech bimkom shehu tzarich lehallech, hammachashava foselet. uvimkom sheen tzarich lehallech, en hammachashava fosalet:

Kol hazzevachim shekkibbel daman zar, onen, tevul yom, mechussar begadim, mechussar kippurim, shello rechutz yadayim veraglayim, arel, tame, yoshev, omed al gabbe chelim, al gabbe vehema, al gabbe ragle chavero, pasal. kibbel bassemol, pasal. rabbi shimon machshir. nishpach haddam al haritzpa vaasafo, pasul. netano al gabbe hakkevesh shello cheneged hayesod, natan et hannittanin lemattan, lemalan, veet hannittanin lemalan, lemattan, et hannittanim bifnim, bachutz, veet hannittanin bachutz, bifnim, pasul veen bo charet:
Mishnah Zevachim 2:2-3:1:
Hashshochet et hazzevach lizrok damo vachutz o miktzat damo vachutz, lehaketir et emurav bachutz o miktzat emurav bachutz, leechol besaro vachutz o chazzayit mibbesaro vachutz o leechol kazzayit meor haalya vachutz, pasul veen bo charet. lizrok damo lemachar o miktzat damo lemachar, lehaketir emurav lemachar o miktzat emurav lemachar, leechol besaro lemachar o chazzayit mibbesaro lemachar o kazzayit meor haalya lemachar, piggul vechayyavin alav karet: 
Ze hakkelal, kol hashshochet vehamekabbel vehamehallech vehazzorek, leechol davar sheddarko leechol, lehaketir davar sheddarko lehaketir, chutz limkomo, pasul veen bo charet. chutz lizmanno, piggul vechayyavin alav karet, uvilvad sheyyikrav hammattir kemitzvato: 
Ketzad karav hammattir kemitzvato. shachat bishtika, kibbel vehillech vezarak chutz lizmanno. o sheshshachat chutz lizmanno, kibbel vehillech vezarak bishtika. o sheshshachat, vekibbel vehillech vezarak chutz lizmanno, ze hu shekkarav hammattir kemitzvato. ketzad lo karav hammattir kemitzvato. shachat chutz limkomo, kibbel vehillech vezarak chutz lizmanno. o sheshshachat chutz lizmanno, kibbel vehillech vezarak chutz limkomo. o sheshshachat, kibbel, vehillech, vezarak, chutz limkomo. happesach vehachattat sheshshechatan shello lishman, kibbel vehillech vezarak chutz lizmanno. o sheshshachat chutz lizmanno, kibbel vehillech vezarak shello lishman. o sheshshachat, kibbel, vehillech, vezarak, shello lishman. ze hu shello karav hammattir kemitzvato: 
Leechol kazzayit bachutz vechazzayit lemachar, kazzayit lemachar vechazzayit bachutz, kachatzi zayit bachutz vechachatzi zayit lemachar, kachatzi zayit lemachar vechachatzi zayit bachutz, pasul veen bo charet. amar rabbi yehuda, ze hakkelal, im machashevet hazzeman kadma lemachashevet hammakom, piggul vechayyavim alav karet. veim machashevet hammakom kadma lemachashevet hazzeman, pasul veen bo charet. vachachamim omrim ze vaze fasul veen bo charet. leechol kachatzi zayit ulehaktir kachatzi zayit, kasher, sheen achila vehaketara mitztarfin: 
Kol happesulin sheshshachatu, shechitatan keshera. shehashshechita cheshera bezarim, benashim, uvaavadim, uvitmeim, afillu vekadshe kadashim, uvilvad shello yihyu temeim nogim babbasar. lefichach hem poslim bemachashava. vechullan shekkibbelu et haddam chutz lizmanno vechutz limkomo, im yesh dam hannefesh, yachazor hakkasher vikabbel:
Mishnah Zevachim 3:2-5: Kibbel hakkasher venatan lappasul, yachazir lakkasher. kibbel bimino venatan lismolo, yachazir limino. kibbel bichli kodesh venatan bichli chol, yachazir lichli kodesh. nishpach min hakkeli al haritzpa vaasafo, kasher. netano al gabbe hakkevesh, shello cheneged hayesod, natan et hannittanin lematta, lemala, veet hannittanim lemala, lematta, et hannittanim bifnim, bachutz, veet hannittanim bachutz, bifnim, im yesh dam hannefesh, yachazor hakkasher vikabbel:

Hashshochet et hazzevach leechol davar sheen darko leechol, ulehaktir davar sheen darko lehaketir, kasher. rabbi eliezer posel. leechol davar sheddarko leechol ulehaktir davar sheddarko lehaketir, pachot mikkazzayit, kasher. leechol kachatzi zayit ulehaktir kachatzi zayit, kasher, sheen achila vehaketara mitztarfin:

Hashshochet et hazzevach leechol kazzayit min haor, min harotev, min hakkifa, min haalal, min haatzamot, min haggidim, min hattelafayim, min hakkarnayim, chutz lizmanno o chutz limkomo, kasher, veen chayyavim alehem mishshum piggul venotar vetame:

Hashshochet et hammukdashin leechol shalil o shilya vachutz, lo figgel. hammolek torin bifnim leechol betzehem bachutz, lo figgel. chalev hammukdashin uvetze torin, en chayyavin alehen mishshum piggul venotar vetame:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 1:14-15: Kol haone amen lo yaane lo amen chatufa velo amen ketufa velo amen ketzara velo arukka ella amen benonit. velo yagbiah kolo yoter min hamevarech. vechol mi shello shama et habberacha shehu chayyav bah lo yaane amen bichlal haonim:

Kol hamevarech beracha sheenah tzericha hare ze nose shem shamayim lashshav vahare hu kenishba lashshav veasur laanot acharav amen. hattinokot melammedin otan habberachot ketikkunan veaf al pi shehen mevarchin levattala bishat limmud hare ze muttar. veen onin acharehen amen. vehaone acharehen amen lo yatza yede chovato:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 1:16-17: Kol haone amen achar birchotav hare ze megunne. vehaone achar beracha shehi sof berachot acharonot hare ze meshubbach. kegon achar bone yerushalayim bevirkat hammazon veachar beracha acharona shel keriat shema shel arvit. vechen besof kol beracha shehi sof berachot acharonot one bah amen achar atzmo:

Velamma yaane amen achar bone yerushalayim vahare achareha birkat hattov vehammetiv. mippene shebberacha zo bime chachme mishna tikkenuha ucheillu hi tosefet. aval sof ikkar habberachot shel birkat hammazon hi bone yerushalayim. velamma lo yaane amen achar ahavat olam mippene shehi sof berachot rishonot shel keriat shema, vechen kol kayyotze bah mibberachot shemmevarchin otan techilla laddavar, kegon berachot shemmevarchin lifne keriat megilla vehadelakat ner chanukka. lemaan lo yafsik beamen ben beracha uven haddavar shebberech alav:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 1:18-20: Velamma lo yaane amen achar birkat happerot vechayyotze bah. mippene shehi beracha achat veen onin amen ella achar beracha acharona shekkadma otah beracha acheret o berachot kegon birchot hammelech uvirchot kohen gadol vechayyotze bahen, lehodia shekkevar hishlim kol birchotav ulefichach one amen:

Kol haochel davar haasur ben bezadon ben bishgaga eno mevarech alav lo battechilla velo bassof. ketzad. hare sheachal tevel shel divrehem o sheachal maaser rishon shello nittelu terumotav o maaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu kehilchatan eno mevarech. veen tzarich lomar im achal nevelot uterefot o shata yen nesech vechayyotze bo:

Aval im achal demay af al pi sheeno rauy ella laaniyyim o maaser rishon shennittela terumato af al pi shello nittal mimmennu cheshbon teruma gedola vehu shehikdimo beshibbolin, o maaser sheni vehekdesh shennifdu af al pi shello natan et hachomesh. hare ze mevarech techilla vasof. vechen kol keyotze bahen:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 2:1-2: Seder birkat hammazon kach hi. rishona birkat hazzan. sheniyya birkat haaretz. shelishit bone yerushalayim. reviit hattov vehammetiv. beracha rishona moshe rabbenu tikkenah. sheniyya tikken yehoshua. shelishit tikken david ushelomo beno. reviit chachme mishna tikkenuha:

Happoalim shehayu osin melacha etzel baal habbayit veachlu pittan en mevarchin lefaneha. umevarchin leachar seuddatan shete berachot bilvad kede shello yevattelu melechet baal habbayit. beracha rishona ketikkunah. sheniyya poteach bevirkat haaretz vecholel bah bone yerushalayim vechotem bevirkat haaretz. veim hayu osin bisuddatan bilvad o shehaya baal habbayit mesev immahen mevarchin arba berachot ketikkunan kishar kol adam:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 2:3-4: Birkat haaretz tzarich lomar hodaya bitchillatah uvesofah vechotem bah al haaretz veal hammazon. vechol shello amar eretz chemda tova urechava bevirkat haaretz lo yatza yede chovato. vetzarich lehazekir bah berit vetora ulehakdim berit letora. shehabberit hazzot sheomrim bevirkat haaretz hi berit mila shennichretu aleha shelosh esre beritot vehattora kullah nichretu aleha shalosh beritot shenneemar <small>(Devarim 28 69)</small> "elle divre habberit" vegomer, <small>(Devarim 28 69)</small> "millevad habberit asher karat ittam bechorev", <small>(Devarim 29 9)</small> "attem nitztzavim" vegomer <small>(Devarim 29 11)</small> "leavrecha bivrit" vegomer:

Beracha shelishit poteach bah rachem Adonai elohenu alenu veal yisrael ammecha veal yerushalayim irecha veal tziyyon mishkan kevodecha. o nachamenu Adonai elohenu birushalayim irecha vechotem bah bone yerushalayim o menachem ammo yisrael bevinyan yerushalayim. ulefichach nikret beracha zo nechama. vechol mi shello amar malchut bet david bivracha zo lo yatza yede chovato mippene shehi inyan habberacha, sheen nechama gemura ella bachazarat malchut bet david:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 10:6-7:
Muttar likshor kesher sheeno shel kayyama lidvar mitzva. kegon sheyyikshor limdod shiur mishshiure hattora. nimat kinnor shennifsak koshrin otah bammikdash aval lo bammedina. velo yikshor nima lechattechilla afillu bammikdash: 
Kol kesher shechayyavin al kishshuro kach chayyavin al hettero. vechol kesher shehakkosher oto patur kach hammattir oto patur. vechol kesher shemmuttar lekashro kach muttar lehattiro:
Niddah 25a:2-8: Shaalu lifne rabbi: hammappelet shafir male basar mahu? amar lahem: lo shamati.
Amar lefanav rabbi yishmael berabbi yose: kach amar abba — male dam temea nidda, male basar temea leda.
Amar loy: ilmale devar chadash amarta lanu mishshum avicha — shemanucha. achshav,
Middeha kammayyta kichidaa kaamar — kesomchos sheamar mishshum rabbi meir, ha name — shemma kerabbi yehoshua amarah, veen halacha kerabbi yehoshua.
Detanya: hammappelet shafir sheeno merukkam, rabbi yehoshua omer: valad, vachachamim omrim: eno valad.
Amar rabbi shimon ben lakish mishshum rabbi oshaya: machloket beachur, aval betzalul divre hakkol eno valad. verabbi yehoshua ben levi amar: betzalul machloket.
Ibbaya lehu: betzalul machloket, aval beachur divre hakkol valad, o dilma ben baze uven baze machloket? teku.
Psalms 108:13-109:3: Hava-lanu ezrat mitztzar veshav teshuat adam
Belohim naase-chayil vehu yavus tzarenu {p}
Lamnatztzeach ledavid mizmor elohe tehillati al-techerash
Ki fi rasha ufi-mirma alay patachu dibberu itti leshon shaker
Psalms 45:1-4: Lamnatztzeach al-shoshannim livne-korach maskil shir yedidot
Rachash libbi ׀ davar tov omer ani maasay lemelech leshoni et ׀ sofer mahir
Yofyafita mibbene adam hutzak chen besiftotecha al-ken berachcha elohim leolam
Psalms 75:5-9: Amarti lahollim al-tahollu velarshaim al-tarimu karen
Al-tarimu lammarom karnechem tedabberu vetzavvar atak
Ki lo mimmotza umimmaarav velo mimmidbar harim
Ki-elohim shofet ze yashpil veze yarim
Ki chos beyad-Adonai veyayin chamar ׀ male mesech vayyagger mizze ach-shemareha yimtzu yishtu kol rishe-aretz
Psalms 7:7-12: Kuma Adonai ׀ beappecha hinnase beavrot tzorray veura elay mishpat tzivvita
Vaadat leummim tesovvekka vealeha lammarom shuva
Adonai yadin ammim shofteni Adonai ketzidki uchetummi alay
Yigmor-na ra ׀ reshaim utechonen tzaddik uvochen libbot uchelayot elohim tzaddik
Elohim shofet tzaddik veel zoem bechol-yom
Psalms 94:13-18: Lehashekit lo mime ra ad yikkare larasha shachat
Ki ׀ lo-yittosh Adonai ammo venachalato lo yaazov
Mi-yakum li im-mereim mi-yityatztzev li im-poale aven
Lule Adonai ezrata li kimat ׀ shachna duma nafshi
Im-amarti mata ragli chasdecha Adonai yisadeni
Shevuot 29b:9-15: Gemara amar shemuel: kol haone "amen" achar shevua – kemotzi shevua befiv dame, dichtiv: "veamra haishsha amen amen".

Amar rav pappa mishshemeh derava: matnitin uvarayyta name dayka, dekatane: shevuat haedut noheget baanashim velo benashim, birchokim velo bikrovim, bichsherin velo bifsulin; veenah noheget ella biruyin lehaid, uvifne bet din veshello bifne bet din – mippi atzmo; umippi acherim enan chayyayvin, ad sheyyichperu bahen bevet din. divre rabbi meir.

Vetanya bevarayyta: shevuat haedut ketzad? amar leedim: "bou vehaiduni"; "shevua sheen anu yodin lecha edut", o sheamru: "en anu yodin lach edut"; "mashbia ani alechem", veamru (lo) "amen" – ben bifne bet din ben shello bifne bet din, ben mippi atzmo ben mippi acherim, kevan shekkafru bahem – chayyayvin. divre rabbi meir.
Kashyayn ahadade! ella lav shema minna: ha deana "amen", ha dela ana "amen"? shema minna.

Amar ravina mishshemeh derava: matnitin dehacha name dayka – deka tane: "shevuat bittuy noheget baanashim uvenashim, birchokim uvikrovim, bichsherin uvifsulin, bifne bet din veshello bifne bet din – mippi atzmo in, mippi acherim la; vekatane sefa: "ze vaze musheba mippi acherim – chayyayv".
Kashyayn ahadade! ella lav shema minna: ha deana "amen", ha dela ana "amen"?
Veella shemuel – may ka mashma lan? dukeya dematnitin ka mashma lan.
Sotah 30b:16-31a:12: Tanu rabbanan, darash rabbi yose haggelili: beshaa shealu yisrael min hayyam natnu enehem lomar shira. vechetzad amru shira — olal muttal al birke immo, vetinok yonek mishshede immo. kevan sherau et hashshechina, olal higbiah tzavvaro, vetinok shamat dad mippiv, veamru "ze eli veanvehu", shenneemar: "mippi ollim veyonkim yissadta oz".
Haya rabbi meir omer: minnayin sheafillu ubbarim shebbime imman amru shira — shenneemar:
Veha la chazo? amar rabbi tanchum: kares naasa lahen keaspaklarya hammeira verau.
Bo bayyom darash rabbi yehoshua ben hurekanos shello avad iyyov kulei. velichze hay "lo", i belamed alef ketiv — "lo" hu, i belamed vav ketiv — "lo" hu?
Vechol hecha dichtiv belamed alef, "lo" hu? ella meatta "bechol tzaratam lo tzar", dichtiv belamed alef, hachi name delo" hu?
Vechi tema hachi name, vehachtiv "umalach panav hoshiam"! ella lav, mashma hachi umashma hachi.
Tanya, rabbi meir omer: neemar "yere elohim" beiyyov, veneemar "yere elohim" beavraham, ma "yere elohim" haamur beavraham — meahava, af "yere elohim" haamur beiyyov — meahava.
Veavraham gufeh menalan — dichtiv "zera avraham ohavi".
May ikka ben ose meahava leose miyyira? ikka ha detanya, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: gadol haose meahava yoter min haose miyyira, shezze taluy leelef dor. veze taluy lealpayim dor.
Hacha ketiv: "laalafim leohavay uleshomre mitzvotay", vehatam ketiv: "uleshomre mitzvotav leelef dor".
Hatam name ketiv "leohavav uleshomre mitzvotav leelef dor"!
Hay ledismich leh vehay ledismich leh.

Hanhu tere talmide dahavo yatvi kammeh derava, chad amar leh akreyun bechelmay: "ma rav tuvecha asher tzafanta lireecha", vechad amar leh: akreyun bechelmay "veyismechu chol chose vach leolam yerannenu veyaletzu vecha ohave shemecha". amar lehu: tarvayychu rabbanan tzaddike gemure attun. mar meahava, umar miyyira.
Zohar, Miketz 12: Vayyiru haanashim ki huveu bet yosef. ribbi yose amar, vavy lon livne nasha, dela yade vela mistakkelin bearche deorayyta. vavy lon beshata dekudesha berich hu yete lemitba lon dina al ovadehon, veyakum gufa venafsha lemehav chushebana mikkol ovadehon, ad la yitparshun nafsha min gufa.

Vehahu yoma, yoma dedina ihu, yoma desifrin petichan, umarehon dedina kayymin. begin dehahu zimna, kayyma nachash bekiyyumeh, lenashcha leh. vechol shayyfe mitraggeshin legabbeh, venishmata itparsha min gufa, veazla veshatya. vela yadat lean archa tehach, ulean atar salkin lah.

Vavy lehahu yoma, yoma derugeza uneitzu hahu yoma, vegin kach ibbae leh levar nash, leargaza yitzreh kol yoma, leadkara kammeh hahu yoma, deyekum bedina demalka, deka alin leh techot ara leitrakkeva, venishmata itparsha minneh.

Utenan, leolam yargiz adam yetzer tov al yetzer hara, veyishtaddel avatreh. i azil minneh, yaot. vei lav, yishtaddal beorayyta. deha let lach milla letavra yetzer hara ella orayyta. i azil, mutav. vei lav, yadkar leh yoma demota, begin letabbera leh.

Hacha it leistakkala, deha da hu (161 b) yetzer hara, veda hu malach hammavet. vechi malach hammavet mitbar mikkamme yoma demota. veha ihu katola divni nasha have, veishtema dechedva hu dileh. uvegin kach aste lon livni nasha tadir, begin leamshacha lon leda.

Ella vadday ma deittemar, deyidkor leh bar nash hahu yoma demota. vadday hachi hu, begin demitbar libba devar nash. deha yetzer hara la sharya ella beatar deishtakkach chedva dechamra, vegassuta derucha. vechad ishtakkach rucha tevira, keden itperash minneh, vela sharya bahadeh. uvegin kach bae leadkara leh yoma demota, veyitbar gufeh, veihu azil leh.

Ta chaze, yetzer tov bae chedva deorayyta, veyetzer ra chedva dechamra, veniufin vegassuta derucha. uvegin kach bae bar nash leargaza (leh) tadir, mehahu yoma rabba, yoma dedina, yoma dechushebna. delet leh levar nash laagana aleh, ella ovadoy dechashran, deihu avid behay alma. begin deyaginu aleh behahi shata.

Ta chaze, vayyiru haanashim ki huveu bet yosef. uma kullehu havu gibbarin, kullehu takkifin, vechad ulema deayyte lon leveta deyosef, dachalu. kad yete kudesha berich hu lemitba leh ledina levar nash, al achat kamma vechamma.

Begin kach bae leh levar nash, leizdahara behay alma. leittakfa beh bekudesha berich hu, veyashve beh rochatzaneh. deaf al gav deihu chate, i yehdar minneh bityuveta shelemata, ha takkif ihu, veyittakkaf beh bekudesha berich hu, keillu la chata.

Deha shivtin, begin dechatu al genevat yosef, havu dachalin. deillemale la chatu, la havu dachalin kelal. begin dechovoy devar nash metabberin libbeh, velet leh chela kelal. may tama, deha hahu yetzer hattov itbar immeh, velet leh chela leittakkefa al hahu yetzer hara. veal da ketiv, (Devarim 20:8) mi haish hayyare verach hallevav, hayyare (dayraah da) mechovin devidoy, deinun tevira delibba devar nash.

Veta chaze, lechamma darin itpera kudesha berich hu, meinun chovin deshivtin, deha la itavid mikkammeh dekudesha berich hu kelum. veitpera middara ledara, vedina kayyma kammeh tadir, ad deitpera, veshare dina beatar deitzterich.

Menalan, mechizkiyyahu. chizkiyyahu chav hahu chova, degale setirin dekudesha berich hu, lishar ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, dela hava itzterich legallaa. vekudesha berich hu shaddar leh lishayahu, veamar leh, (Yeshayahu 39:6) hinne yamim baim venissa kol asher bevetecha vaasher atzru avotecha ad hayyom hazze vegomer.

Ta chaze, kamma garim hahu chova, begin degalle ma dehava satim. dechevan deitgele, ityeyhiv ducheta leatar ochora dela itzterich, leshalletaa aleh. begin kach lav beracha sharya, ella beatar satim. veukemuha, ma deihu (hava) satim, beracha (dehava) sharya aloy, kevan deitgele ityeyhiv ducheta, leatar ochora leshaltaa aloy.

Ketiv, (Eicha 1:8) kol mechabbedeha hizziluha ki rau ervatah, veukemuha. aval kol mechabbedeha hizziluha, da hu malchut bavel, deha mittamman ishtaddar doron liyrushelem. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 39:1) baet hahi shalach merodach baladan ben baladan melech bavel sefarim umincha el chizkiyyahu.

Uma ketiv behu, shelam lechizkiyahu melech yehuda, ushelam lelaha rabba ushelam liyrushelem. kevan denafak pitkeh minneh, ahadar lelibbeh veamar, la yaot avdit leakdama shelama deavda, lishlama demareh. kam mikkuresye ufasa 3 pesian veahadar pitkeh, vechatav ochoranin techotayyhu, vechatav hachi. shelam lelaha rabba, shelam liyrushala 40, ushelam lechizkiyya, veda hu mechabbedeha.

Ulevatar hizziluha, may tama hizziluha. begin ki rau ervata, deachze lon chizkiyya. deilmale kach, lo hizziluha levatar. miggo dehava zakkaa chizkiyyahu yattir, itakkav milla milleayytaa, vela ata beyomoy. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 39:8) ki yihye shalom veemet beyamay. ulevatar pakkid hahu chova livnoy abbatreh.

Kegavvna da, hahu chova deshivtin, kaim ad levatar. begin dedina dilela, la yachil leshalletaa alayyhu, ad deishtakkach shata leitpara, veitpera minnayyhu. ubbegin kach kol man deit chovin bidoy, dachil tadir. kema deat amer, (Devarim 28:66) ufachadta layla veyomam vegomer. veal da vayyiru haanashim ki huveu vegomer:
Zohar, Mishpatim 3: Rabbi chiyyay verabbi yosi iarau chad lelya bemigdal detzor. itarachu tamman vechaddu da beda. amar rabbi yosi, kamma chaddena dachamena anpe shechinta, dehashta bechol archa da, itztaarna bachada sava, tayyaya, dehava shail li kol archa.

Man hu nechasha, defarach baavira, veazil befiruda, uven kach uven kach, it nayycha lechad nemala, deshachiv ben shinnoy. share bechibbura vesiyyem befiruda. umay ihu nishra, deka mekannena, beilan dela hava. benoy deitgezalu, velav min biryayn. deitberiu baatar dela itberiu. kad sallekin nachtin, kad nachtin sallekin. teren deinnun chad, vechad deinnun telata. mahu ulemta shappirta, velet lah eynin, vegufa temirta veitgalya, ihi nafkat betzafra, veitkassiat bimama. itkashtat bekishshutin dela havo.

Kol da shail bearcha, veitztaarna. vehasheta it li nayycha. deillu havena kachada, itasakna bemille deorayyta, ma dahavenan bemillin acharanin detohu. amar rabbi chiyyay, vehahu sava tayyaya, yadat beh kelum. amar leh, yadana, delet mammashu bemilloy. deillu hava yada, yiftach beorayyta, vela hava archa berekanayyay. amar rabbi chiyyay, vehahu tayyaya it hacha, deha lezimnin beinnun rekanin, yishkach gevar zaggin dedahava. amar leh, ha hacha ihu, veatkin chamareh bemechla.
Karu leh, veata lekamayyhu. amar lon, hasheta teren innun telat, utelat innun kechad. amar rabbi yosi, la amena lach, dechol milloy rekanin, veinnun berekanayyay, yativ kamayyhu.

Amar lon rabbanan, ana tayyaya itavidna, umiyyomin zeirin, deha bekadmita la havena tayyaya, aval bera chad zeira it li, veyahavit leh beve sifra, uvaena deyishtaddal beorayyta. vechad ana ashkachna chad merabbanan deazil bearcha, ana tain avatreh, vehay yoma, chashivna deeshma millin chadtin beorayyta, vela shemana midi.
Amar Rabbi yosi, bechol millin deshamana dekaamart, la tavavhna, ella mechad. o ant bishttuta amart, o millin rekanin innun. amar hahu sava, uman ihi. amar ulemta shappirta vechulei.

Patach hahu sava veamar, (Tehillim 118:6-7) Adonai li la ira ma yaase li adam. Adonai li beozray vegomer. tov lachasot baAdonai vegomer. kamma tavin uneimin veyakkirin veillain millin deorayyta, vaana hechi ema kame rabbanan, dela shemana mippumayyhu ad hasheta, afillu milla chada. aval it li lememar, deha let kissufa kelal lememar mille deorayyta kame kolla.

Itattaf hahu sava, patach veamar, (Vayikra 22:12) uvat kohen ki tihye leish zar hi bitrumat hakkodashim lo tochel. hay kera, akra achara samich, (Vayikra 22:13) uvat kohen ki tihye almana ugerusha vezera en lah veshava el bet aviha kinureha millechem aviha tochel vechol zar lo yochal bo. hane kerae kemashmaan. aval millin deorayyta millin setimin innun

Vechamma innun millin dechachmeta distimin bechol milla umilla deorayyta, veishtemodan, innun legabbe chakkimin, deyadin archin deorayyta. deha orayyta lav millin dechelma innun, deka itmasran leman defashar lon, veitmashshechan batar puma, veim kol da itzterichu lemifshar lon lefum archoy. uma i millin dechelma itzterichu lemifshar lon lefum archoy, millin deorayyta deinnun shaashuin demalka kaddisha, al achat kamma vechamma deitzterichu lemehach beorach keshot behu, dichtiv, (Hoshea 14:10) ki yesharim darche Adonai vegomer.

Hasheta it lememar, uvat kohen, da nishmeta illaa, berateh deavraham avinu kadmaa laggiyyorin, veihu mashich, lah lehay nishmeta meatar illaa. ma ben kera deamar uvat ish kohen, uven kera deamar uvat kohen, vela ketiv ish. ella, it kohen deikre ish kohen, velo kohen mammash. veal archa da, hava (ish) kohen, vahava segan, vahava kohen gadol, vahava kohen delav ihu gadol. kohen setam, rav veillaa yattir meish kohen. veal da it nishmeta, veit rucha, veit nefesh.

Uvat kohen ki tihye leish zar, da nishmeta kaddisha, deitmashshechat meatar illaa, vealat lego setimu deilana dechayye. vechad rucha dechahana illaa nashva, veyahiv nishmatin beilana da, parchin mittamman innun nishmatin, vealin beotzar chad.

Vavy lealma, dela yadin bene nasha leistammera, deka mashchin meshichu bahade yetzer hara, deihu ish zar, vehay bat kohen parchat letatta, veashkechat binyayna beish zar. uvegin deihu reuta demara, alat tamman veitkafiat, vela yachilat leshalletaa, vela ishtallimat behay alma. kad nafkat minneh, hi bitrumat hakkodashim lo tochel, kishar kol nishmatin, deishtelimu behay alma.

Tu it behay kera, uvat kohen ki tihye leish zar. aluvata ihi nishmeta kaddisha, ki tihye leish zar, deka itmashshechat, al giyyora deitgeyayr, ufarchat aleh miggan eden beorach satim, al binyayna deitbeni mearla misava, da havat leish zar.

Veda hu raza illaa yetera mikkolla. beammuda dekayyeyma letiklin, go avira denashvat, it tikla chada behay sitra, veit tikla achara behay sitra. behay sitra mozni tzedek. uvehay sitra mozne mirma. vehay tikla, la shachich lealmin, venishmatin sallekin venachtin alin vetavin, veit nishmatin ashikin, kad shalta adam beadam, dichtiv, (Kohelet 8:9) et asher shalat haadam beadam lera lo, lera lo vadday.

Aval hay nishmeta, dahavat lesitra achara, ish zar, veitashshekat minneh, da ihi lera lo. lo: lehahu ish zar, veihi bitrumat hakkodashim lo tochel, ad deavid bah kudesha berich hu ma deavid, ata kera veamar uvat kohen ki tihye leish zar hachi hu.

Hacha it raza, hech mitashshekan nishmatin. ella hay alma itnehag kolla, beilana dedaat tov vara. vechad itnahagan bene alma besitra detov, tikla kayyeyma veachra lesitra detov. vechad itnahagan besitra dera, achra lehahu sitra. vechol nishmatin dahavo behahi shaata betikla, hava ashik lon, venatil lon.

Aval lera lo, deinnun nishmatin kafyayn (sefer acher chafyayn) lechol ma deashkechan missitra bisha, veshaytzan leh. vesimana leda, arona kaddisha, deitashak go pelishtim, ushelitu beh, lera lon. uf hachi. hane nishmatin iteshakin missitra achara lera lon.

Ma itavidu meinnun nishmatin. chamenan besifre kadmae, deminnayyhu havo innun chaside umot haolam. veinnun mamzere talmide chachamim, dekadman lechahana rabba amma deara, vechashuv bealma, af al gav deal lifnay velifnim. bacha hay sava riga chada, tavvhu chavrayyay, vela amru midi.

Patach hahu sava veamar, (Shemot 21:8) im raa beene adonyha asher lo yeadah vehefdah leam nachri vegomer. hay parsheta al raza da ittemar, vechi yimkor ish et bitto leama lo tetze ketzet haavadim im raa vegomer. mareh dealma man la yidchal minach, deant shalit al kol malchin dealma, kema deat amer (Yirmeyahu 10:7) mi lo yiraacha melech haggoyim ki lecha yaata vegomer.

Kamma innun bene nasha bealma, deka mishtabbeshan behay kera, vechullehu amri, aval kera da la ityayshshar befumayyhu. vechi kudesha berich hu melech haggoyim ihu, vahalo melech yisrael ihu, vehachi ikre, deha ketiv, (Devarim 32) behanechel elyon goyim vegomer. uchetiv (Devarim 32) ki chelek Adonai ammo. veal da ikre melech yisrael. vei tema deihu melech haggoyim ikre, ha shevacha dilhon dekudesha berich hu melech alayyhu, vela kema deamrin deitmasrin leshammashin velimmanan dileh.

Vetu sefa dikra, dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 10:7) ki bechol chachme haggoyim uvechol malchutam meen kamocha. kol hay, shevacha ihu lishar ammin, utevavha ihu, hech la mistalleke behay kera lerum rekia. ella, dekudesha berich hu sama enayyhu, vela yade beh kelal, deha ma daanan amre dechullehu ayin, vaefes, vatohu. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 40:17) kol haggoyim keayin negdo meefes vatohu nechshevu lo, ha ikara illaa rabba veyakkira shave lon kera da.

Amar leh Rabbi chiyyay veha ketiv (Tehillim 47:9) malach elohim al goyim vegomer. amar leh, ana chamena devatar kotlayyhu havit, venafkat behay kera lesayyeya lon, hava li leatava bekadmita, al ma daamena. aval kevan deashkachna lach bearcha, abar lach mittamman, umittamman ehach leabera kolla.

Ta chaze, kol shemahan, vechol kinnuyayn dishmahan, deit leh lekudesha berich hu, kullehu mitpashshetan learchayyhu, vechullehu mitlabbeshin illen beillen, vechullehu mitpalgin learchin ushevilin yedian. bar shema yechidaa, barir dechol shear shemahan, deachasin leamma yechidaa, barir mikkol shear ammin, veihu yod hei vav hei, dichtiv, (Devarim 32) ki chelek Adonai ammo. uchetiv (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai bishma da mammash, yattir mikkol shear shemahan.

Ushema chad mikkol shear shemahan dileh, hahu deitpeshat veitpelag lechamma archin ushevilin, veikre elohim. veachasin shema da, veitpelag letattae dehay alma, veitpelag shema da, leshammashin velimmanan dimnahage lishar ammin. kema deat amer, (Bamidbar 22:20) vayyavo elohim el bilam layla. (Bereshit 20:3) vayyavo elohim el avimelech bachalom hallayla. vechen kol memana umemanna deachasin lon kudesha berich hu lishar ammin, bishma da kelilan. vaafillu avoda zara bishma da ikre. ushema da malach al goyim, vela hahu shema, da hahu demalach al yisrael, deihu yechidaa, leamma yechidaa, leamma deyisrael, amma kaddisha.

Vei tema, al archa da nokim kera dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 10:7) mi la yiraacha melech haggoyim, deda ihu shema deka malach al goyim, elohim deha dechilu beh sharya vedina beh sharya. lav hachi, velav al da ittemar, dei hachi afillu avoda zara bichlala da ihu.

Aval kevan dechotala dahavet samich avatreh, itnesach, kera kaim al kiyyuma, beistakkeluta zeer. mi lo yiraacha melech haggoyim, vei tema demelech haggoyim al kudesha berich hu ittemar, lav hachi. ella, man hu melech haggoyim dela yiraacha, dela dachil minach, vela yizdaza minach. mi melech haggoyim dela yiraacha. kegavvna da (Tehillim 113:1) haleluyah halelu avde Adonai halelu et shem Adonai. man dishma leh, la yada may kaamar, kevan deamar haleluyah, uf hachi halelu avde Adonai, dehava leh lemichtav, avde Adonai halelu et shem Adonai. uf hacha. hava leh lemichtav, mi mimmelech haggoyim dela yiraacha. ella kolla al tekkuneh ittemar.

Ki vechol chachme haggoyim uvechol malchutam meen kamocha, mahu milla deitpashshat benayyhu bechachmeta dillehon, meen kamocha vechullehu odan al da, kad chaman bechachmeta dilhon ovadach ugevuretach, itpashat milla da benayyhu, veamre meen kamocha bechol chachme haggoyim uvechol malchutam. meen kamocha amre, veitpashshat benayyhu. chaddu chavrayyay, uvachu vela amru midi. uf hachi bacha ihu kemillekaddemin.

Patach veamar (Bereshit 21:10) vattomer leavraham garesh haama hazzot veet benah vegomer, chavrayyay ittearu, devaat sara lefannaa avoda zara mibbeta, veal da ketiv kol asher tomar elecha sara shema bekolah. hacha ketiv vechi yimkor ish et bitto, da nishmeta begilgule al ovadin bishin dealma. leama: hahu sitra achara begilgula bisha detikla, deahadar, veha itashshekat, leappaka lah mittamman. vadday lo tetze ketzet haavadim, kol innun nishmatin demitashshekan.

Man innun hacha. ihu raza, illen innun nishmatin dinokin zeirin, kad innun yanke miggo tukepa deimmehon. vekudesha berich hu chame, dei yitkayyeymun bealma, yevaashun rechehon, veyachmetzun kechometz da. lakit lon (248 amud bet, 249 amud bet) zeirin, beod deyahave recha.

Ma avid. shavik lon leitashsheka bida dehahi ama, veda ihi lilit dechevan deityeyhivu birshutah, chaddat (nusach acher achada) behahu yenoka, vaashikat leh, veappikat leh mealma, kad ihu yanik betukepa deimmeh.

Vei tema, innun nishmatin deyaavdun tav lealma. lav hachi. dichtiv im raa beene adoneha, deyachamitz hahu gavra bah levatar yomin, i itkayyaym bah. da itashkat, veachara la itashshekat. veal illen ketiv, (Kohelet 4:1) vaere et kol haashukim vegomer vehayeynu im raa beene adoneha.
Asher lo yeadah, lo bealef ketiv. i tema, deha behahu sitra achara, azmin lah kudesha berich hu miyyoma dahavat. la. vehasheta begilgule tikla, lo yeadah beVav. ma dela havat mikkadmat dena.

Vehefdah, may vehefdah. parik lah kudesha berich hu hasheta, desalleka recha, ad la tachamitz, vesalik lah lerume meromim, (113 amud bet) bimtivta dileh, vei tema kevan deitashshekat mehahu sitra achara, yahiv lah, kema deamru lachaside (205 amud bet) shear ammin, uleinnun mamzere ta chaze. ata kera veochach, leam nachri lo yimshol lemachrah vadday, bevigdo vah, deashik lah baashiku degilgula detikla, ella leyisrael vadday, vela leachara. vechad nafkat min tikla, lo tetze ketzet haavadim, ella mitattera beitteraha baarama al resheh.

Vei tema, dehay sitra alat lah behahu yannuka. lav hachi. ella natlat lah, vechaddat bahadah, ufarchat min yedaha, vealat behahu atar, veihi pekidat lehahu yenoka, vechaddat beh, vechayyeychat beh, vetaivat (58, 65 amud alef) lehahu basar, ad dilvatar natil kudesha berich hu nishmateh, vehi legufa. ulevatar kolla ihu birshuta dekudesha berich hu.

Ta chaze, (Shemot 21:7) lo tetze ketzet haavadim, may hu. ella, beshaata denafkat min tikla vehahu sitra bechedu, rashim lah lekudesha berich hu, vechatim lah bechad gushepanka, ufaris alah levush yekar dileh, uman ihu. shema kaddisha deikre eloah. veda hu bevigdo vah, levusha yakkira demalka paris alah ucheden ihi netira, dela itmasserat leam nachri, ella leyisrael lechud.

Veda ihu dichtiv, (iyyov 29:2) kime eloah yishmereni, veal raza da ketiv hacha, leam nachri lo yimshol lemachrah bevigdo vah, beod dilvush yekar demalka bah. kevan (Bereshit 94 amud alef, Shemot 172 amud bet, Vayikra amud bet amud bet) devigdo vah, ketiv leam nachri lo yimsol lemachrah.

Ma reshu it lehahu sitra bah. ta chaze, kol bene alma kullehu, birshuteh demalka kaddisha, vechullehu it lon zimna behay alma, ad deihu bae lesalleka lon min alma, veda let leh zimna, veal da ihi chayychat behu, vechaddat behu.

Tu, azharuta levar nash (behay alma) it behane kerae, vechamma etin tavin illain innun, bechol mile deorayyta, vechullehu keshot, beorach keshot, veishtemodan legabbe chakkimin, deyade veazle beorach keshot. bezimna devaa kudesha berich hu lemivre alma, salik biruta kameh, vetziyyer kol nishmatin deinnun zeminin lemehav bivni nasha levatar, vechullehu ittzeyyayru kameh behahu tziyyura mammash, dizminin lemeheve bivni nasha levatar, vechama kol chad vechad.

Veit minnehon dizminin leavasha archayyhu bealma, uveshaata demata zimnayyhu, kare kudesha berich hu lehahi nishmeta, amar lah, zili uli bedoch pelan. beguf pelan. ativat kameh, mareh dealma, day li bealma da daana yatva beh, vela ehach lealma achara, deyishtabedun bi, veehe meluchelcha benayyhu. amar lah kudesha berich hu, min yoma deitberiat, al da itberiat lemehve behahu alma. kevan dechamat nishmeta kach, beal karchah nachtat vealat tamman.

Orayyta deyahivat eta lechol alma chamat hachi, azhirat livne alma, veamrat, chamu kamma chas kudesha berich hu alayychu, margalita tava dahavat leh, zabbin lechu lemaggana, detishtabedun bah behay alma.

Vechi yimkor ish: da kudesha berich hu. et bitto: da nishmeta kaddisha. leama: lemeheve ama mishtabeda benayychu behay alma. bematu minnayychu, beshaata demate zimna lenafka mehay alma, lo tetze ketzet haavadim, la tippuk mittannefa bechovin, tippuk bat chorin, berira nekiyya, begin deyechede bah marah veyishtabbach bah veyahiv lah agar tav, betzichtzuche deginta deeden. kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 58:11) vehishbia betzachtzachot nafshecha, vadday kad tippuk berira nekiyya kedka yeot.

Aval im raa beeni adoneha, kad nafkat meluchelacha betinufe chovin, vela itchaziat kameh kedka yeot, vavy lehahu gufa, deitavid mehahi nishmeta lealmin. begin, dechad nishmatin sallekin beriran, venafkin nekiyyin mehay alma, kol nishmeta venishmeta, alat besifra (338 156 amud bet) deachmata demalka, vechullehu bishmahan, veamar da hi nishmeta diflanya, zeminat tehe lehahu gufa deshavkat, ucheden ketiv, lo yeadah, bev.

Vechad nafkat raa beene adoneha, deka isteava bechovin, uvetinnufa dechattain, keden lo yeadah be. veitavid hahu gufa minah veihi la izdammenat legabbeh bar hahi demarah itree, vetav betiuveta degufa bah, keden ketiv, vehefda. kema deat amer (iyyov log) fada nafsho meavor bashshachat. vehefdah, hay ihu bevar nash, deeta dileh, deyifrok lah, veyetuv betiuveta, velitren sitrin kaamar kudesha berich hu, vehefdah betiuveta. levatar detav betiuveta, pada lah mearcha degehinnam.

Leam nachri lo yimshol lemachrah. man am nachri. aluvata ihi nishmeta, dechad nafkat mealma, uvar nash aste archeh bahadah, hi baat lesalleka leella, go mashreyayn kaddishin, begin demashreyayn kaddishin kayymin behahu archa degan eden, umashreyayn nucherain kayymin behahu archa degehinnam.

Zachta nishmeta, vehahu netiru, uferisu dilvusha yakkira alah. kamma mashreyayn kaddishin, ka mitattedan lah, leitchabbera bahadah, ulemeal lah legan eden. lo zachta, kamma mashyyryan nucherain mitattedan lemeal lah bearcha degehinnam. veinnun mashreyayn demalache chabbala zeminin lemebad bah nukemin, ata kera veochach, leam nachri lo yimsol lemachrah, illen malache chabbala. bevigdo vah, ihu netira, dekudesha berich hu avid lah netira, dela yishlot bah am nachri, behahu perisu dintiru alla.

(Shemot 21:9) veim livno yiadenna, ta chaze kamma it leh lebar nash leizdahara dela yiste archoy behay alma, dei zacha bar nash behay alma, venatir lah lenishmeta kedka yeot, hay ihu bar nash dekudesha berich hu itree beh, veishtavach beh bechol yomayya, befamalyay dileh, veamar, chamu bera kaddisha deit li behahu alma, kach vechach avid, kach vechach ovadoy mittakkenan.

Vechad hay nishmeta, nafkat mehay alma, zachyay nekiyyay berira, kudesha berich hu anhir lah bechamma nehorin, bechol yoma kare alah, da hi nishmeta diflanya beri, netira lihavi leh lehahu gufa deshavak.

Veda hu dichtiv, veim livno yiadenna kemishpat habbanot yaase lah, may kemishpat habbanot. hacha it raza lechakkimin, bego tinara takkifa, rekia temira, it hechala chada, deikre hechal ahava. (146 amud alef) vetamman innun ginzin temirin, vechol neshikin dirchimu demalka innun tamman, veinnun nishmatin rechiman demalka alin tamman.

Kevan demalka al behahu hechala demalka, tamman ketiv, (Bereshit 29:11) vayyishshak yaakov lerachel, vekudesha berich hu ashkach tamman lehahi nishmeta kaddisha, kadim miyyad venashik lah, vegafif lah, vesalik lah bahadeh, veishtaasha bah.

Veda hu kemishpat habbanot yaase lah, kedina deabba avid livrateh, deihi chaviva legabbeh, denashik lah, vegafif lah, veyahiv lah matnan. kach kudesha berich hu avid, lenishmeta zakkaa bechol yoma, kema dechtiv kemishpat habbanot yaase lah.

Hayeynu dechtiv (Yeshayahu 64:3) yaase limchakke lo, kema dehay berata, ashlimat asiyyay behay alma. uf hachi kudesha berich hu ashlim lah asiyyay achara bealma deate, dechtiv, ayin la raata elohim zulatcha yaase limchakke lo. vehacha ketiv yaase lah. al ken. hahu sava ishtattach, vetzalle tzelota. bacha kemilkaddemin.

Veamar (Shemot 21:10) im acheret yikkach lo vegomer, may im acheret, vechi nishmeta achara zammin kudesha berich hu leatava letzaddikayyay behay alma, velav hay nishmeta deashlimat behay alma reuta demarah, i hachi let avtachuta letzaddikayyay kelal. may im acheret yikkach lo.

Patach hahu sava veamar, (Kohelet 12:7) veyashov heafar al haaretz keshehaya veharuach tashuv el haelohim asher netanah. hay kera ukemuha chavrayyay, becharban be makdesha. (vetamman tanenan) veyashov heafar al haaretz keshehaya. hacha ihu may dechtiv, (Bereshit 12:6) vehakkenaani az baartz, keshehaya vadday. veharuach tashuv el haelohim asher netanah, may veharuach tashuv. da shechinta, deihi ruach kaddisha. kad chamat shechinta, beinun eser massaot deka natla, vela baun yisrael leatava bityuveta kame kudesha berich hu, veshalta sitra achara al ara kaddisha, veukemuha chavrayyay.

Ta chazi, rucha devar nash zakkaa, itattar bediyyukena began eden diltatta, uvechol shabbate umoade vereshe yarche, mitatteran ruche, umitpashshetan, vesallekin leella. kemma deavid kudesha berich hu, behahi nishmeta illaa kaddisha leella, hachi name avid behay rucha, letatta began eden letatta, deka salkat kameh. veamar da ihi rucha diflanya gufa, miyyad meattera lah kudesha berich hu lehay rucha bechamma itrin, veishtaasha bah.
Vei tema, deha begin rucha da, shavik kudesha berich hu ma deavid lenishmeta. lav hachi. ella sheerah kesutah veonatah lo yigra, illen innun telat shemahan illain, deayin la raata elohim zulatcha.

Vechullehu bealma deate veitmashshechu mittamman. chad minnayyhu sheerah, meshichu dintzitzu unehiru, denahir beorach satim, mezona (lan) dezan kolla, veikre Adonai binkudat elohim. sheerah behippuch atvavn, asher Adonai veda (Bereshit 49:20) measher shemmena lachmo, veda hu sheerah.
Kesutah: perisu demalka. da meshichu achara, denahir venatir lah tadir, ferisu dilvusha demalka, defaris alah eloah. da bevigdo vah tadir, dela itade minnah, vehay ihu kesutah.

Veonatah, man ihu. da meshichu dealma deate, deveh kolla. Adonai tzevaot ihu, veda ihu denahir bechol nehorin setimin illain deilana dechayye, deveh ona temira, demittamman nafkat. vechol da beidduna vechissufa dealma deate.

Telata hane lo yigra lah, kad ihi zakkat kaddeka yeut. vei lav ihi kadka yeut, hane telata garan minah, dela yitavid lah attara afillu mechad minnayyhu, ta chazi, ma ketiv, veim shelash elle lo yaase lah, dela zachat behu, veyatza chinnam en kasef tippuk mikkameh, vedachyayn lah levar. en kasef, let lah kissufa, velet lah idduna kelal.

Ad kan ochichat orayyta, dechol etin bah talyayn, veyahivat eta tava livni nasha. mikkan ulehala nehdar lemillin kadmain, behahu netiru illaa, deka paris alah kudesha berich hu, begin dela tehe leam nachri, deha bigdo vah, unetiru ihu lah tadir.

(Shemot 21:9) veim livno yiadenna kemishpat habbanot yaase lah. amar hahu sava, chavrayyay, kad tahachun legabbe hahu tinara dealma samich aleh, imru leh, deyidkar yoma detalga deizderau polin lechamshin uteren gavvnin, vahadar akrenan hay kera, vehu yema lechon.

Amru bematu minach man deshari milla hu yema. amar lon, vadday deyadana dezakkain attun, veit lerammeza lechun remaza dechakkimin, veal ma daana ema, kad tidkerun leh simana da, hu yashlim al da. hasheta it lomar, man hu deikre ben lekudesha berich hu.

Ta chaze kol hahu dezache (101 amud alef, 113 amud alef) litlesar shenin ulehala, ikre ben likkeneset yisrael. vechol man deihu mibben esrin shenin uleela vezache behu, ikre ben lekudesha berich hu vadday (Devarim 14:1) banim attem laAdonai elohechem.

Kad mata david litlesar shenin, vezacha behahu yoma deal learbesar, keden ketiv, (Tehillim 2:7) Adonai amar elay beni atta ani hayyom yelidticha. may tama. deha mikkadmat dena la hava leh bera, vela sharat aleh nishmeta illaa, deha bishne arla hava, uvegin kach, (128 amud bet) ani hayyom yelidticha, hayyom vadday yelidticha. ani, vela sitra achara, kema dehava ad hasheta, ani bilchoday. bar esrin shenin, ma ketiv bishlomo, (Mishlei 4:3) ki ven hayiti leavi, leavi mammash vadday.

Veim livno yiadenna. bar telesar shenin ulehala, deha nafka mershu desitra achara deizdammenat leh, ma ketiv kemishpat habbanot yaase lah. mahu kemishpat habbanot. tanenan, bechol yoma veyoma, chame kudesha berich hu lehahu yenoka dekae birshu dearla, veihu nafik minah, veitmeshach leve sifra, vetabbar lah, veazil leve kenishta, vetabbar lah. ma avid kudesha berich hu lehahi nishmeta. ail lah leiddara dileh, veyahiv lah mattenan, unevizbezan saggiin, vekashit lah bekishshutin illain, ad zimna deail (Bereshit 147 amud bet) lah lachuppa behahu (go hahu) bar, mittelesar shenin uleela.

Im acheret yikkach lo. hacha it raza derazin, lechakkimin itmesare, veit leodaa bekadmita milla chada. ta chaze, beyoma deshabbeta beshaata deitkaddash yome, nafke nishmatin miggo ilani dechayye, umenashshevan innun nishmatin kaddishin letattae, venayychin behu kol yoma deshabbeta. ulevatar denafik shabbeta, sallekin kullehu nishmatin umitatteran beitrin kaddishin leella. (vechad mitatteran behahu tava illen inun bealav dehahu tivu vadday) uf hachi, kudesha berich hu azmin lehahu bar nash, veda hu nishmeta acheret, veaf al gav deda zemina leh, nishmeta dahavat leh bekadmita, sheerah dekadmeta, kesutah veonatah lo yigra, kema deittemar.

Bacha hahu sava kemilkaddemin, veamar ihu lenafsheh, sava sava, kamma yagata leadbeka millin kaddishin illen, vehasheta tema lon beriga chada. i tema detechas alayyhu al innun millin vela tema lon, ha ketiv (Mishlei 3:27) al timna tov mibbealav bihyot leel yadcha laasot.

May al timna tov mibbealav. ella, kudesha berich hu ukkenset yisrael innun hacha. deha bechol atar demillin deorayyta amrin, kudesha berich hu ukkenset yisrael innun taman, vetzayyte lon. ucheden, hahu ilana detov vara, beshaata deazlin mittamman, vetzayytu innun millin, hahu sitra detov itgabbar, veistallak leella, vekudesha berich hu ukkenset yisrael mitatteran behahu tov, veillen innun bealav dehahu tov.

Sava sava, at amart millin illen, vela yadat i kudesha berich hu hacha, vei illen dekayyme hacha zakkain lemillin illen. la tidchal sava, deha havet bechamma keravin degavrin takkifin, vela dachilat, vehasheta ant dachil, ema milach, deha vadday hacha ihu kudesha berich hu ukkenset yisrael, vezakkain innun illen dehacha. vei lav hachi, la aarana behu, vela sharena beillen millin. ema millulach sava, ema bela dechilu.

Patach veamar, (Tehillim 104:1) Adonai elohay gadalta meod hod vehadar lavashta. Adonai elohay: (9 amud alef, 216 amud bet) da sheruta dimhemnuta, seliku demachashava, vealma deate, raza chada bela piruda. gadalta: da sheruta, yoma kadmaa, veinnun yomin attikin, sitra dimina. meod: da (68 amud bet) hu sitra dismala.

Hod vehadar lavashta: illen teren badde (vaychi 222) aravot. ad hacha, kevan demata lego ilana dechayye, ittammar, vela istallak (sefer acher velo bae) lemeheve beminyayna, begin hahu meod. may meod. semala, dechol anpin diltatta uvichlala anafa merira chada. veal da ittammar hahu ilana dechayye, vela baa lemehevi beminyayna da, ad deahadar kemillekaddemin, veshabbach begavvna achara.

Veamar, ote or kassalma da sheruta (deor) deyoma kadmaa. note shamayim, hacha itkelil semala, vela amar meod, itkelil semala bimina, lemehve nahir bichlala deshamayim. (Tehillim 104:3) hamekare vammayim aliyyotav, hacha nafik bechedva hahu ilana dechayye, nahar denafik meeden, veishterashu beh bememoy innun tere badde aravot, deinnun gadlin bememoy, hada hu dichtiv (nusach acher hahu ilana dechayye veishterashu beh inun tere badde aravot, deinnun gadlin bememoy vehahu naheraz denafik meeden veda hu) hamekare vammayim aliyyotav. man aliyyotav. illen badde aravot.

Veda hu dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 17:8) veal yuval yeshallach sharashav. veda hu raza dichtiv, (Tehillim 46:5) nahar pelagav yesamchu ir elohim. man pelagav. illen innun sharashav. vehachi ikrun, aliyyotav, sharashav, pelagav, kullehu ishterashu beinnun mayin dehahu nahar.

(Tehillim 104:3) hassam avim rechuvo. da michael vegavriel, illen hem avim. hamehallech al kanfe ruach, lemehav asvavta lealma, veda ihu refael. mikkan ulehala ose malachav ruchot vegomer. sava sava, i kol hane yadat, ema vela tidchal, ema milach veyinharun millin defumach. chaddu chavrayyay, vahavu tzayytin bechedva lemilloy kaddishin. amar i sava i sava, bema ayylat garmach, alat beyamma rabba, it lach leshatteta velnafka mittamman.

(Shemot 21:10) im acheret yikkach lo, kamma gilgulin attikin hacha, dela itgallun ad haiddana, vechullehu keshot kedka yeot, delet leastaa meorach keshot, afillu kimlo nima. bekadmita (nusach acher hasheta) it leitteara, (95 amud bet) nishmatin degiyyorin kullehu, parchan miggo ginta deeden beorach satim, kad mistallekan mehay alma, nishmathon deka revavcha miggo ginta deeden, lean atar tayyvin.

Ella tanenan, man denatil veachid benichse giyyorin bekadmita, zache behu. uf hachi kol innun nishmatin kaddishin illain, deka zammin lon kudesha berich hu letatta kidkamran, kullehu nafkin lezimnin yedian. (vesallekin) (Bereshit 35 amud bet) begin leishtashea began eden, (dilella) ufagan beinnun nishmatin degiyyorin, man deachid behu meillen nishmatin, (desallekin) achid behu vezache behu, umitlabbeshan behu, vesallekin. vechullehu kayyme behay levusha venachtu go ginta bilvusha da. begin divginta deeden, la kayyeyman tamman, ella bilvusha, kol innun dekayyme tamman.

I tema, divgin hay levusha, garan innun nishmatin mikkol innuga dehava lon bekadmita. ha ketiv, im acheret yikkach lo sheerah kesutah veonatah lo yigra. beginta kayyme bilvushe da, dekadman leachada behu vezache behu, vechad sallekin leella, mitpashshetan minneh, deha tamman la kayyman (186 amud bet, 210 amud bet, 229, 50, 58, 67) bilvusha.

Bacha hahu sava kemillekaddemin, veamar lenafsheh, sava sava, bevadday it lach lemivke, bevadday it lach leoshada dimin, al kol milla umilla, aval galle kame kudesha berich hu ushechinteh kaddisha, daana biru delibba, uvefulechana dilhon kamena, begin deinnun bealav dechol milla, umitatteran behu.

Kol innun nishmatin kaddishin, kad nachte lehay alma, begin lemishre kol chad al duchetayyhu, deitchazun behu, livni nasha. kullehu nachte mitlabbeshan beinnun nishmatin deka amaran, vehachi alin vezara kaddisha. uvemalbusha da, kayyme leishtabeda minnayyhu behay alma. vechad ishtaavan innun malbushin mimmillin dehay alma, innun nishmatin kaddishin, itteznan (nusach acher ithanun) merecha deka aricha, miggo levushehon illen.

Kudesha berich hu kol millin setimin deihu avid, al lon beorayyta kaddisha, vecholla ishtechach beorayyta, vehahi milla setima galle lah orayyta, umiyyad itlabbesha bilvusha achara, veittammar tamman, vela itgele. vechakkimin deinnun malyayn ayynin, af al gav dehahi milla astim bilvusha (tamman), chaman lah miggo levusha, uveshaata deitgele hahi milla ad la teul bilvusha, raman bah pekichu deena, veaf al gav demiyyad astim, la itavid meenayyhu. (nusach acher minnayyhu)
Bechamma duchetin azhar kudesha berich hu al giyyora, (begin) dezara kaddisha, yizdaharun beh, ulevatar nafik milla setima minnartikah. vechevan deitgele ahdar lenartikah miyyad, veitlavash tamman.

Kevan deazhar al giyyora bechol innun duchetin, nafak milla minnartikah veitgele, veamar (Shemot 23:9) veattem yedatem et nefesh hager. miyyad alat lenartikah, veahadrat bilvusha veittammerat, dichtiv ki gerim hyitem beeretz mitzrayim, dechashiv kera, divgin deitlebash miyyad, la hava man deashgach bah. behay nefesh hager, yadat nishmeta kaddisha bemillin dehay alma, veithaniat (vaashateabet) minnayyhu.

Patach hahu sava veamar, (Shemot 24:18) vayyavo moshe betoch heanan vayyaal el hahar vegomer, anan da may hi. ella da hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 9:13) et kashti natatti beanan. tanenan, dehahu keshet ashlachat levushoy, veyahiv lon lemoshe, (229 amud alef) uvehahu levusha salik moshe letura uminneh chama ma dechama, veithane mikkolla. ad hahu atar, atu innun chavrayyay, veishtetachu kameh dehahu sava, uvachu veamru, ilmale la atena lealma, ella lemishma millin illen mippumach day lan.

Amar hahu sava, (im acheret yikkach lo) chavrayyay, lav begin da bilchodoy sharena milla, deha sava kegini, lav bemilla chada avid kish kish, vela kare, kamma bene alma beirbuveya besachletanu dilhon, vela chaman beorach keshot beorayyta, veorayyta kare bechol yoma binhimu (nusach acher birchimu) legabbayyhu, (divne nasha) vela baan leatava resha.

Veaf al gav daamena, deha orayyta milla nafka minnartikah, veitchaziat zeer, umiyyad ittammarat. hachi hu vadday. uvezimna deitgeliat miggo nartikah veittammerat miyyad, la avdat da, ella leinun deyadin bah, veishtemodan bah.

Mashal lema haddavar dome, lirchimata, deihi (95 amud alef) shappirta bechezu, ushefirta bereva, veihi temirta bitmiru go hechala dilah, veit lah rechima yechidaa, dela yadin beh bene nasha, ella ihu bitmiru. hahu rechima, miggo rechima derachim lah avar litra beta tadir, zakif enoy lechol setar. ihi, yadat deha rechima aschar tera beta tadir, ma avdat, patchat pitcha zeera behahu hechala temira, deihi tamman, ugeliat anpaha legabbe rechima, umiyyad ithadderat veitkasiat. kol innun dahavo legabbe rechima, la chamu vela istakkalu, bar rechima bilchodoy, umeoy velibbeh venafsheh azlu avatrah. veyada demiggo rechimu dirchimat leh, itgeliat legabbeh riga chada, leitteara (sefer acher legabbeh rechimu leh). hachi hu milla deorayyta, la (230 amud bet) itgeliat, ella legabbe rechima. yadat orayyta, dehahu chakkima delibba aschar litra beta kol yoma, ma avdat, geliat anpaha legabbeh, miggo hechala, vearmizat leh remiza, umiyyad ahadrat leatrah veittammerat. kol innun detamman, la yade, vela mistakkele, ella ihu bilchodoy, umeoy velibbeh venafsheh azil avatrah. veal da, orayyta itgeliat veitkassiat, veazlat birchimu legabbe rechimha, leitteara bahadeh rechimu.

Ta chaze, archa deorayyta kach hu, bekadmita kad sharya leitgallaa legabbe bar nash, (beriga) armizat leh birmizu, i yada tav. vei la yada, shadrat legabbeh, vekarata leh peti. veamrat orayyta, lehahu deshadrat legabbeh, imru lehahu peti, deyikrav hacha, veishtae bahadeh. hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 9:4) mi peti yasur henna chaser lev vegomer. kariv legabbah, shariat lemallela immeh, mibbatar parochta defarsa leh, millin lefum archoy, ad deyistakkal zeer zeer, veda hu derasha.

Levatar, tishtae bahadeh, mibbatar shushifa dakik, millin dechida, veda ihu haggada. levatar deihu ragil legabbah, itgeliat legabbeh anpin beanpin, umelilat bahadeh kol razin setimin dilah, vechol archin setimin, dahavo belibbea temirin, miyyomin kadmain. keden ihu bar nash shelim, baal tora vadday, mare deveta, deha kol razin dilah geliat leh, vela rechikat, vela kassiat minneh kelum.

Amra leh, chamit milla dirmiza deka ramizna lach bekadmita, kach vechach razin havo, kach vechach hu. keden chame, (sefer acher deillain) deal innun millin lav leosafa, velav lemigra minnayyhu. ucheden peshateh dikra, kema deihu, delav leosafa vela lemigra afillu at chad. veal da, beni nasha itzterichu leizdahara, ulemirdaf avatra deorayyta, lemehve rechimin dilah, kema deittemar.
