Ta chaze (Shemot 21:10) im acheret yikkach lo, gilgulin demitgalgelan behay kera, kamma ravrevin veillain innun, deha kol nishmatin alin begilgula. vela yadin bene nasha archoy dekudesha berich hu, veheach kayyeyma tikla, vehech itdanu bene nasha bechol yoma, uvechol iddan, vehech nishmatin alin bedina, ad la yetun lehay alma, vehech alin bedina, levatar denafke mehay alma.

Kamma gilgulin, vechamma ovadin setimin, avid kudesha berich hu bahade kamma nishmatin artilain, vechamma ruchin artilain azlin behahu alma, dela alin lefargoda demalka. vechamma almin ithappach behu vealma deithappach bechamma pelian setimin. uvene nasha la yadin, vela mashgichin, vehech mitgalgelin nishmatin, keavna bekusepita. kema deat amer, (Shmuel 1 25:29) veet nefesh oyvecha yekalenna betoch kaf hakkala.

(Vehoil itdache legallaa) hasheta it legallaa, deha kol (Vayikra 29 amud alef) nishmatin, meilana ravreva vetakkifa dehu nahar denafik meeden nafke. vechol ruchin, meilana achara zeera nafkin. neshama milleella ruach milletatta, umitchabberan kachada, kegavvna dedachar venukeba. vechad mitchabberan kachada, keden nehirin nehiru illaa. uvechibbura detarvayyhu ikre ner. (Mishlei 20:27) ner Adonai nishmat adam. mahu 250. neshama ruach. veal chibbura detarvayyhu kachada ikre ner, dichtiv ner Adonai nishmat adam.

Neshama veruach: dechar venukeba leanhara kachada, veda belo da, la nehirin, vela ikre ner, vechad mittechabberan kachada, ikre kolla ner. ucheden itattaf neshama beruach, lekayyeyma tamman leella, behechla temira, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 57:16) ki ruach millefanay yaatof. yitattef la ketiv, ella yaatof. may tama. begin dinshamot ani asiti, tamman leella beginta, behechla temira, itattaf veitlavash neshama beruach, kema deitchaze.

Vechevan divhahu hechala, la have, vela ishtammash ella beruach uneshama, nefesh la ate letamman, (nusach acher mittamman) ella mitlavash behahu ruach tamman, vechad nachta lego gan eden diltatta, (behay alma) itlavash behahu rucha achara daamena, hahu denafik mittamman, vahava mittamman, uvechullehu sharya behay alma, veitlavash behu.

Hahu ruach denafik mehay alma, dela itrabbe (dela itdache) vela itpashat behay alma. azla begilgula, vela ashkach nayycha, itti begilgula bealma, keavna bekusefita, ad deyishkach hahu paroka deyifrok leh, veayyte leh behahu mana mammash, dehava ihu ishtammash beh, vedavik beh tadir rucheh venafsheh, vahavat bat zugeh, rucha berucha, vehahu paroka bani leh kemillekaddemin.

Vehahu rucha deshavak veitdevak behahu mana, la itavid. deha let milla afillu zeera bealma, dela have leh atar veducheta leittammera uleitkannesha tamman, vela itavid lealmin. ubbegin kach, hahu rucha deshavak behahu mana, tamman hu, vadday radif batar ikara visoda dileh, deka nafik minneh, veayyte leh, uvane leh beducheteh, baatar dehahu ruach bat zugeh, (lecha lecha 85 amud bet) denafkat bahadeh, veitbene tamman kemillekaddemin. veda ihu birya chadta hasheta bealma, rucha chadta vegufa chadta.

Vei tema, ruach da hu ma dehava. hachi hu aval la itbene, ella begin hahu rucha achara deka shavak behahu mana, hacha it razin (sefer acher raza derazin behahu mana.) besifra dechanoch, binyayna da deitbene, la itbene, ella behahu rucha achara deshavik tamman, behahu mana. vechad share leitbenaa, da mashich avatreh dehahu ruach deazil artilaa, umashich leh legabbeh, vetamman tere ruchot deinnun chad. levatar, da ihu ruach, veda ihu neshama, vetarvavyyhu chad.

I zacha leitdakkea kedka yeot, tarvavyyhu innun chad, leitlabbesha behu nishmeta achara illaa. kema deit lishar bene alma, ruach, dezakkain behu nishmatin, innun dekadman veachidan behu, verucha achara milleella. venishmeta kaddisha itlabbesha behu. uf hachi name, middileh mammash it teren ruchin, begin leitlabbesha behu neshama illaa.

Yehe leden gufa achara, deka itbene hasheta chadta, hahu gufa kadmaa deshavak, ma itavid minnih. o hay berekanayyay, o hay berekanayyay. lefum sachletanu debar nash ishtema, dehay kadmaa dela ishtelim bekadmita, itavid, hoil vela zacha. i hachi, lemaggana ishtaddal befikkude orayyta, o afillu bechad minnayyhu. veha anan yadenan, deafillu rekanin shebbeyisrael, kullehu malyayn mitzvot karimmon. vegufa da, af al gav dela ishtelim, leitrabbea, ulemizke ulemisge bealma, pikkudin acharanin deorayyta natar, dela itavidu minneh, vechi lemaggana havo.

Chavrayyay chavrayyay, pekichu enayychu, deha ana yedana, dehachi attun savrin veyadin, (nusach acher salleka datin) dechol innun gufin, tziyyunin innun berekanayyay, dela it lon kiyyuma lealmin. lav hachi, vechas lan leistakkela beillen millin.

Patach sava veamar, (Tehillim 106:2) mi yemallel gevurot Adonai yashmia kol tehillato. man hu bealma, deyachil lemallela gevuran, deavid kudesha berich hu bealma tadir. hahu gufa kadmaa deshavak, la itavid, vekiyyuma lehve leh lezimna deate. deha onsheh saval bechamma zinin, vekudesha berich hu la mekappeach agra deshum biryayn devara, bar innun denafku miggo mehemanuta dileh, vela hava behu tav lealmin. uvar meinnun dela karu bemodim, dehane kudesha berich hu avid minnayyhu biryayn acharanin, begin dela yitbene hahu gufa diyyukena devar nash, vela yekum lealmin. aval hane lav hachi.

Ma aved kudesha berich hu. i hahu ruach, zache leittakna behay alma, behahu gufa achara, me avid kudesha berich hu. hahu paroka deka parik leh, hahu ruach dileh deka ail tamman, veshataf vearav behahu ruach dehava behahu mana, vadday la itavid, uma itavid, deha telat ruchin tamman, (sefer acher behahu gufa achara beh yakum uma avid kudesha berich hu. ta chaze hahu paroka deka parik leh. ruach dileh ha ail haman veshavik vashechaf vaerev behahu mana. vehahu rucha kadmaa dehu behahu mana veitdabbak beh vadday ishtaar tamman velo itavid uvegin kach hahu rucha deshavak behahu mana veitdabbak tamman hu radif batar ikara dileh visoda dileh deka nafik minneh vaayytayh leh uvene leh beducheteh baatar dahavavt bat zugeh. ha telat ruchin tamman) chad, dehava behahu mana, veishtear tamman. vechad, hahu deitmeshach tamman dehava artilaa. vechad, hahu deail tamman hahu paroka, veitarav behu. lemehve bitlat ruchin i efshar. uma itavid.

Ella, kach innun gevuran illain, deavid kudesha berich hu. hahu rucha deail tamman hahu paroka, beh itlavash hahi nishmeta, baatar dilvusha degiyyore, (vehu) vehahu rucha artilaa, detav tamman leitbenaa, lehve levusha lenishmeta illaa. vehahu ruach dehava bekadmita, deishtear behahu mana, parach mittamman. vekudesha berich hu azmin leh atar, bego razin kavvin detinara, devatar kitfoy degan eden, veittammar tamman. veistallak lehahu gufa kadmaa, dehu bekadmita. uvehahu ruach yekum hahu gufa, veda ihu chad deinnun teren, deka amena (leella).

Aval hahu gufa, ad dela yekum, onsheh sagya deha begin dela zacha leitrabbea, nachte leh lego (tikkunin 79 amud alef) adama, desamich learka. veitdan tamman. ulevatar sallekin leh lehay tevel. hasheta nachit, vehasheta salik, ha salik, veha nachit, let leh shechichu bar beshabbate, uveyomin tavin uvereshe yarche.

Veillen demichin beadmat afar, admat, meadama. afar mittevel. veal illen ketiv, (Daniel 12:2) verabbim miysheni admat afar yakitzu elle lechayye olam veelle lacharafot ulediron olam. kol illen dela zachu leittakna aval i zacha hahu rucha artilaa, detav kemillekaddemin, leittakna. zakkaa ihu, deha hahu rucha deittemar beh, deittemmar betinara, yittakkan behahu gufa kadmaa. veal illen ketiv ele lechayye olam veelle lacharafot vegomer. kol innun dela zachu leittakna.

Veillen innun gevuran illain, demalka illaa kaddisha, vela itavid kelum. afillu haval defuma atar veducheta it leh, vekudesha berich hu avid mine ma deavid. vaafillu milla devar nash, vaafillu kala, la have berekanayyay, vaatar veducheta it lehu lecholla.
Hay deitbene hasheta, venafak lealma birya chadta, let leh bat zug. veal da la machrize, deha bat zugeh itavidat minneh, bat zugeh dahavat leh, itavidat immeh, veachuha avuha.

Sava sava, ma avdat, tav hava lach shetika, sava sava, ha amena dealat beyamma rabba, bela chavlin, uvela digla, ma taaved. i tema detisllak leella, la tichol. i tema detechut letatta, ha imka dithoma rabba, ma taaved. i sava i sava, la it lach leahaddera laachora. beidanin illen, la havet, vela itregilat, leitchallesha betukefach, deha yadat, devar nash achara bechol dara da, la al bearba beamika da deant tamman.

Bereh deyochay yada leistammera archoy, vei al beyamma amika, ashgach bekadmita, hech yaavar bezimna chada, vishotet beyamma, ad la yeul veant sava, la ashgacht bekadmita. hasheta sava, hoil veant tamman, la techolash betukefach, la tishbok kol archach, limshatteta limina velismala, learka ulefuteyay, leamka uleruma, la tidchal. sava sava, ittakkaf betukfach, kamma gavrin takkifin tavart betukfehon, vechamma keravin natzacht.

Bacha, patach veamar, (Shir hashshirim 3:11) tzeena ureena benot tziyyon bammelech shelomo baatara sheittera lo immo beyom chatunnatto uveyom shimchat libbo. hay kera ukemuha, vehachi hu. aval tzeena ureena, vechi man yachil lemechome bammelech shelomo, dehu malka dishlama dileh, veha satim hu, mikkol chele meromin dilella, behahu atar, (Yeshayahu 64:3) deayin la raata elohim zulatcha. veat amart tzeena ureena benot tziyyon bammelech shelomo. vetu, deha kavod dileh, kullehu malache illae shaali veamre, ayye mekom kevodo.

Ella, ma deamar tzeena ureena benot tziyyon bammelech shelomo, baatara ketiv, vela ketiv uvaatara dechol man dechame hahu attara, chame noam malka dishlama dileh. sheittera lo immo, ha tanenan, kare lah bat, vekare lah achot, kare lah em, vecholla ihu. vecholla have, man deyistakkal veyinda behay, yinda chachmeta yakkira.

Hasheta ma avid, i ema, raza setima da, la itzterich legallaa. i la ema, yishtaarun zakkain illen, yatmin mehay raza, nafal hahu sava al anpoy, veamar, (Tehillim 31:6) beyadcha afkid ruchi padita oti Adonai el emet. mana dahavat letatta, hech yitavid leella, balah dehava leella, hech yithappech vahava letatta. bat zugeh itavidat immeh. tavavha al tavavha. achuha avuha. i avuha dekadmeta, yifrok leh, yeot, aval achuha deleheve avuha, vechi la tavavha ihu da. alma behippucha ihu. vadday illain letatta, vetattain leella.

Ella, (Daniel 2:20) lehve shemeh di elaha mevarach min alma vead alma di chachmeta ugevureta dileh hi. vehu mehashene iddanayya vezimnaya vegomer yada ma bechashocha unehora immeh shara. ta chazi, man dishre binhora, la yachil leistakkela ulemechome bechashocha. aval kudesha berich hu lav hachi, yada ma vachashocha, af al gav dinhora immeh shara. miggo nehora, istakkal bachashocha, veyada kol ma detamman.

Hacha, it leakdema bekadmita, milla chada, deamru kadmae, beinnun chezve lelya. ditnan, man deate al immeh bechelma, yetzappe labbina. dichtiv, (Mishlei 2:3) ki im labbina tikra, hacha it leistakkela, i begin deihi em yeot, vahava leh lemichtav hachi, deman dechama immeh bechelma, yizke labbina. aval man deate al immeh amay.
Ella raza illaa ihu, begin deithappach vesalik mittatta leella. bera hava bekadmita, kevan desalik leella, ithappach ilana, veitavid ihu mealma illaa, veshalit alah, vezache labbina.

Bekadmita kad salik enash 43 (98 amud alef) shenin, ma ketiv, (Tehillim 2:7) Adonai amar elay beni atta ani hayyom yelidticha, keden ihu letatta minah. kevan desalik alah, hay ihu mealma illaa. deha istallak bedarga deyosef, veda (sefer acher vadday) zache labbina.

Uf hachi hay mana, bekadmita ihu hava bedarga deyosef, baal ilana tattaa, kayyeyma biruteh, veshalit aleh, deha kol nukeba, bediyyukena denukeba ilana tattaa kayyeyma. kevan deihu la baa lekayyeyma behahu darga deyosef, vela itkeyaym leshammesha beh, uleappasha bealma, ulemebad toladin, keden nachit letatta, veitavidat ihi immeh. vehahu paroka, yarit yaruta deyosef, dehava hu bekadmita veihu nachit letatta.

Kevan denachit letatta, keden itkayyaym beh, Adonai amar elay beni atta ani hayyom yelidticha. ithappach ilana, ma dehava techoteh veihu shalit aleh, ithaddar veshalit hahu ilana aleh, veihu nachit letatta. kevan deihu nachit letatta, hahu deyarit yaruta atar deyosef, avoy ikre, avoy have vadday, kolla ihu al tekkuneh vadday kedka yeot.

Bekadmita hava mealma didchura, veha itakkar mittamman, vehasheta ihu mealma denukeba. uma dehava ihu shalit alah, shalta ihi aleh, veithaddar lemehve bealma denukeba. veal da let leh bat zug kelal. vela machrize aleh, al nukeba. deha mealma denukeba ithaddar ihu.

Vehahu gufa kadmaa deshavak, ilmale yindeun veyistakkelun beni alma, tzaara deit leh, kad yitakkar mealma didchura, veithaddar lealma denukeba. yindeun, deha let tzaara bealma, kehahu tzaara. bat zug let leh, deha la kayyeyma beatar didchura. la machrize aleh, al nukeba, deha mealma denukeba ihu. vei it leh bat zug, havi berachame, iarat bahade (nusach acher bechad) nukeba, dead kean la it lah bar zug. veal da tanenan, dilma yekaddemenu acher berachamim. acher tenan. vecholla ihu al tekkuneh.

Veal da ketiv (Vayikra 22:13) uvat kohen ki tihye almana ugerusha vezera en lah veshava el bet aviha kinureha. uvat kohen, ha okimna milla da. almana, mehahu gufa kadmaa. ugerusha, dela alat lefargoda demalka, dechol innun dela kayyme bealma didchura, la it lehu beh chulaka. hu ishtemit veakar garmeh mealma didchura, la it leh chulaka beh veal da ihi gerusha. vezera en lah, dei hava lah zera, la itakkar minneh, vela hava nachit lealma denukeba.

Veshava el bet aviha, man bet aviha. da alma denukeba, dehahu alma bet aviha ikre, vehahu mana dehava ittakkan leishtammesha beh, ithappach veihu nachit letatta, vehahu mana salik leella. kinureha, kehahu zimna dichtiv, ani hayyom yelidticha, yelidticha vadday, yashuv lime alumav, kema dehava (bekadmita) mittelesar shenin uleella.

I zachat leittakna, hoil veshava el bet aviha, millechem aviha tochel, titannag mehahu innuga. dealma denukeba, deachle minnahama deabbirim, denachit milleella. aval leistakkela uleithane bema deithanun shear tzaddikayyay, la yachla begin dehava zar letamman. veal da la achil kodesh aval achil teruma, deihu yativ bealma denukeba.

Umiggo deihu mealma denukeba, la achil leh ella ballayla, dichtiv, (Vayikra 22:7) uva hashshamesh vetaher veachar yochal min hakkodashim ki lachmo hu. deha kodesh deihu mealma didchura, la itachil ella bayyom. begine kach (Yirmeyahu 2:3) kodesh yisrael laAdonai reshit tevuato, (Bereshit 31 amud bet) sheruta illaa dechol alma didchura, (59 amud alef) kodesh ihu, uma desalik beh, bakkodesh yisrael hava, uvegini kach kodesh yisrael laAdonai rishit tevuato.

Kad ruchin pekidan, beinnun zimnin defakdin leve kivre, innun la pakdin, deha la zachan lealma dekodesh, dichtiv, (Vayikra 22:10) vechol zar lo yochal kodesh. vei la zacha hahu rucha leittakna kedka yeot, kevan deahadar begilgula, afillu behahu atar, bitruma la achil, vezar ikre, afillu lealma tattaa vela achil bah. ad hacha beraza da.

Sava sava, kevan dishriat leshatteta beyamma rabba, zil birutach, lechol sitrin deyamma. hasheta it legallaa, deha amena, dehay paroka kad ate, al gabbe hahu mana, deka amena, ail tamman, vedavik tamman rucha (dealma) dileh behahu mana vela itavid kelum, afillu haval defuma, yeot hu vechach hu. sava sava, i tema utegale, ema bela dechilu.

Shear bene nasha dealma, deka mistalleke minneh, veha yedana, deruach dileh shavik behahi itteta dahavat leh, verucha ail tamman, ma itavid mehahu ruach. vei nasva hay itteta, uf hachi, ma itavid mehahu ruach deshavak bah balah kadmaa, deha gevar achara ate alah.

Leitkayyeyma ruach beruach la efshar, deha hay deate alah hasheta, ruach ail bah. vechen hahu kadmaa deistalik, ruach ail bah. hahu kadmaa deistallak benin havo leh, veda dehashta lav paroka ihu, ruach deshavak hahu kadmaa behahu mana, veata hay achara veail bah ruach, vadday la yachle tarvayyhu leitkayyeyma behahu gufa deitteta kachada, i nima deitavid, i efshar, ma itavid minneh.

Uf hachi i ihi la itnesivat, hahu rucha deshavak bah balah, may itavid minnih. i nima deitavid, lav hachi. kol da tzarich legallaa hasheta. sava sava, chame ma avdat, uvamme ailat garmach. kum sava, arim diglach. kum sava, veashpil garmach kame marach.

Patach hahu sava veamar, (Tehillim 131:1) Adonai lo gava libbi velo ramu enay vegomer. david malka amar da, begin dehava malka illaa, veshallita al kol malchin illain, veshallitin deit mimmizrach vead maarav, vela salik al libbeh leastaa mearcha, vetadir shafil libbeh kame mareh, vechad hava lae beorayyta, hava mitgabbar kearya, veenoy tadir meichin beara, middechilu demareh. vechad hava azil ben amma, la hava beh gassut rucha kelal.

Veal da ketiv, Adonai lo gava libbi vegomer, lo gava libbi, af al gav daana malka shallita al kol shear malchin dealma. velo ramu ene, bezimna daana kayyeyma kammach, lae beorayyta. velo hillachti bigdolot uveniflaot mimmenni, beshaata daana azil ben amma. vei david malka amar hachi, shear bene alma al achat kamma vechamma. vaana kamma ana shafil libba, umaich ena kame malka kaddisha. vechas li, divmillin kaddishin deorayyta, yerom libbay. bacha vedimoy naflin al dikneh.

Amar, sava lae bechela, kamma shappiran dimin al diknach, kema dehava shappir mishcha tava, kad hava nachit al dikna desava tava deaharon. ema milach sava deha malka kaddisha hacha. shear bene nasha dealma, deka istalaku minneh, veshavku rucha behahu mana, dahavo mishtammeshe beh, veitnesivat, veata achara veail behahu mana rucha achara, ma itavid mehahu kadmaa, kema deittemar.

Ta chazi, kamma illain gevuran demalka kaddisha, deka avid, uman yachil lemallela lon. kad hay balah tinyayna, ate veail rucha behahu mana, rucha kadmaa, mekatrega behay ruach deal, vela ityayshshevan kachada.

Uvegine kach, itteta la ityayshshevat kedka yeot, bahade balah tinyayna, begin derucha kadmaa mechashkesha bah, ucheden ihi dechirat leh tadir, uvachat aleh, o itanchat aleh, deha rucha dileh, mechashkesha bimaha kechivya, umekatrega bahade ruach achara, deal bah mibbalah tinyana. ad zeman saggi mekatregin da beda.

Vei abar da deal, lehahu (ittearu) dehava kadmaa (levatar), da kadmaa nafik veazil leh. ulezimnin, dedache da kadmaa lehahu tinyayna, veitavid leh mekatrega, ad deappik leh mealma. veal da tanenan, demitteren ulehala, la yissav bar nash lehay itteta, deha malach hammavet ittakkaf bah, uvene alma la yadin, deha rucha kevan deittakkaf veka natzach lehahu rucha achara tinyayna, mikkan ulehala la yitarav bar nash achara bahadah.

Chavrayyay, ha yedana divaatar da it lechu lemikshe, velema i hachi la mit bedina hay tinyayna, vela dayynin leh milleella. ta chazi, kolla ihu bedina, deyintzach peloni lifloni o dela yekatreg aleh peloni lifloni. uman denasiv armalta, keman deal beyamma, beruchin takkifin, belo chavlin, vela yada i yaavar bishlam, i yitba go tehome.

Vei da deal hahu rucha tinyayna, ittakif venatzach lehahu kadmaa, hahu kadmaa nafak mittamman veazil leh. lean atar azil leh, uma itavid. sava sava ma avdat. chashavt ditmallel zeer, venafkat lehay, ha alat baatar dela al bar nash achara, min yoma dedoeg vaachitofel avdu bayayn illen, beinnun arba mea bayiyi, dahavo baan al migaddela defarach baavira, vela ativ alayyhu bar nash, ad deata shelomo malka, uvirer lon kol chad vechad al tekkuneh. sava sava, raza illaa dehava temira, atit legallaa, ma avadit.

Sava sava, bekadmita hava lach lenatra archach, vetistakkal bereshach. aval hasheta, lav shaata leittammera. sava, ahdar betukfach. hahu ruach denafak, lean azil. bacha veamar, chavrayya, kol hani bichyayn deka bachena, lav beginayychu hu, ella dachilna lemare alma, degallena archin setimin, belo reshu. aval galle kame kudesha berich hu, dela likara dili avidna, vela likara deabba, aval reuti lefulechana dileh, vaana chamena, yekara dechad minnayychu, behahu alma, veachara yedana dehachi hu. aval la galle kamay, vehasheta chamena.

Tanenan, dachyayn gavra mikkame gavra, bechamma archin setimin (vayyelech 284 amud alef) itdachyayn. hahu rucha kadmaa, deitdache mikkame hahu tinyayna, lean azil. hahu rucha, nafik veazil, umeshatteta bealma, vela yedia, veazil lego kivra dehahu bar nash, umittamman meshatteta bealma, veitchazze bechelma livni nasha, vechaman bechelma diyyukena dehahu bar nash, veoda lon millin lefum archeh dehahu ruach kadmaa, deka itmeshach mineh, kema deihu behahu alma, hachi meshatteta hay, veoda behay alma.

Vehachi azil umeshatteta bealma, ufakdat tadir lehahu kivra, ad (achore haddaf) zimna deruchot pakdan legabbe kivrayyhu degufin. keden, hay rucha, itchabbar behahu ruach dileh, veitlavash beh, veazil leh. kad al leducheteh, itpashat minneh. veducheta it leh (beinnun ruchin began eden) beinnun hechalin degan eden, o levar, lefum archoy dechol chad vechad, vetamman ittammar.

Vechad ruchin pakdan lehay alma, demetin nizkakin legabbe chayyin, la nizkakin ella behahu meshichu derucha, uveh itlavash rucha achara. vei tema, i hachi, toalta ihu lerucha, vehay itteta toalta avdat lecholla. lav hachi, deilmale la itnesivat legabbe achara, vehay rucha kadmaa la mitdachyay mikkame hay gavra ochora, toalta achara hava leh, begavvna achara, vela yehe lae bealma, kema dehave, vela yizdakkek legabbe chayyin dehay alma, kema dehave meshatteta hacha vehacha.

I hachi ziuuga tinyayna dehay itteta, la have milleella. veat amart deitdachyay gevar mikkame gevar, vaamena dehay balah tinyayna, denasiv leitteta da, ihu bat zugeh mammash. vehahu kadmaa lav bar zugeh mammash hava. vehay tinyayna dilay hava, vechad mata zimneh, itdachyay da mikkammeh. vaday hachi hu, deha la itdachyay hahu ruach kadmaa, dehava behay itteta. ella begin dehay tinyayna, deihu bar zugah. (davar ihi bat zugeh) (hay tinyayna).

Vechol innun tinyaynin, deitdachyayn mikkame kadmain. kadmain havo bene zugayyhu, vela hane. uvegin kach, la it lon kiyyuma bahadayyhu, veitdachyay ruach tinyayna mikkame rucha kadmaa. uvegin kach, man denasiv armalta, karenan aleh, (Mishlei 7:23) velo yada ki venafsho hu. (Mishlei 1:17) ki chinnam mezora harashet vegomer vela yedia i hi bat zugeh mammash i lav.

Armalta dela nesivat, af al gav deate bar zugah, veihi la baat leitnasseva, kudesha berich hu la kayif lah min dina, vekudesha berich hu azmin lehahu bar nash itteta achara, vela alat bedina kehay (sefer acher velet aleh bi dina behay) behahu alma, veaf al gav delet lah bar, deha itteta la itpakkedat appirya ureviyya, kema deukemuha.

Itteta da dela itnesivat zimna tinyayna, hahu ruach deshavak bah balah ma itavid minneh. yativ tamman teresar yarche, uvechol lelya velelya, nafik ufakda lenafsha, veithaddar leatreh. levatar teresar yarche, deka istallak dina dehahu gavra, deha kol innun teresar yarche, ha rucha itkafyay baatzivu kol yoma. levatar teresar yarche, nafik mittamman, veazil vekayyeyma litra gan eden, (achore haddaf) ufakda lehay alma, legabbe hahu mana, denafik minneh. vechad hay itteta istallakat mealma, hahu ruach nafik veitlavash behahu ruach dilah, vezachat beh legabbe balah, venaharin tarvavyyhu, kedka yeot, bechibbura chada.

Kevan deatena lehay atar, hasheta it legallaa archin setimin, demare alma, la yadin behu bene nasha. vechullehu azlin beorach keshot, kema deat amer (Hoshea 14:10) ki yesharim darche Adonai vetzaddikim yelchu bam ufoshim yikkashlu bam. uveni nasha la yadin, vela mashgichin, kamma innun illain, ovadin dekudesha berich hu, vechamma meshanyayn innun, uveni alma la yadin, vechullehu beorach keshot, dela satan limina velismala.

Hane demitgalgelin, deka itterachu betiruchin mehahu alma, velet lon bat zug. bat zug deka mizdavvevgan behay alma, mean innun, innun nashin, deka mizdavvevgan bahadayyhu behay alma. deha (tarich la velet leh bat zug keinnun guvrin dela tareykev veka mizdavvevgan bahade nasheyyhav) lechullehu bene nasha, it lon bat zug, bar mehay.

Chamu hasheta, kamma innun ravrevin veillain gevuran dileh. tanenan, man dimtarech itteteh kadmaa, madbecha achit aloy dimin. madbecha amay. ella, ha amena, dechol nashin dealma bediyyukena dehay mizbach kayyme, veal da (nasha 184 amud alef) yartan innun sheva birkan, dechullehu mikkenset yisrael innun. vei ihu metarach lah, ahdar avna (nusach acher demadbecha illaa) legirona. may tama. begin demitchabberan tiruchin bahade hadade.

Veraza da dichtiv, (Devarim 24:2) vechatav lah sefer keritut venatan beyadah vegomer, veyatza mibbeto vehalcha vehayta leish acher. mimmashma deamar, vehalcha vehayta leish, la yedana (dehahi azla legabbe balah detarech la, (nusach acher deleteh) hahu detarech laAdonai) may acher. ella kema deittemar, acher tenan, veacher ketiv, veacher karenan leh, dichtiv, (iyyov 8:19) umeafar acher yitzmachu. vetiruchin mitchabberan kachada, tiruchin dehahu alma, vetiruchin dehay alma. uma dahavat hay itteta, bediyyukena illaa, ha ishtabeda lediyyukena tattaa, karena leh acher.

Vekkarenan leh acharon, acharon menalan. dichtiv, (iyyov 19:25) veacharon (105 amud bet) al afar yakum. vehacha ketiv useneah haish haacharon. o ki yamut haish haacharon. acharon, sheni mibbae leh. vei tema, dela tizdavvevg afillu laasara, da batar da. lav hachi. vechi levalah da tizdavvevg, velo leachara, may acharon.

Ella da ihu hay acher dekaamran, veihu acher, veihu acharon. hasheta avna mitgalgela bekusefita. acher amay ikre hachi deha kol binyayna nafal, veithaddar leafra, ihu hava ma dehava, vela achara. amay karenan leh acher. uf hachi amay ikre acharon, vechi acharon ihu, veha i yityeshar yeot, vei la, yehdar veyitgalgel veyitneta kemillekaddemin, amay ikre acharon.
Aval ta chazi, ketiv (Bereshit 1:31) vayyar elohim et kol asher asa vehinne tov meod, may tov. tanenan, da malach detov. meod, da malach hammavet. ulecholla kudesha berich hu azmin tikkunoy.

Ta chaze, ketiv (Bereshit 2:10) venahar yotze meeden lehashekot et haggan, nahar da, la shachich lealmin, milleappasha ulemisge ulemebad perin. veel acher isteras, velet leh tiuveta lealmin, vela appish, vela avid perin, deilmale avid perin, yetashtesh lechol alma.

Ubbegin kach, bar nash degarim lehahu setar deyippush bealma, ikre ra, vela chame appe shechinta lealmin, dichtiv, (Tehillim Adonai:Adonai) lo yegurecha ra. hay bar nash, demitgalgela begilgula, i ihu avar veitdabbak behahu el acher, dela avid perin, vela appish bealma, begin kach ikre acher, ushema garim leh, ihu hu, veachar ikre, acher vadday.

Acharon: mikkadmaa veelach, acharon karenan leh, veacharon ikre. tinyayna ihu, umiyyad ikre acharon, vehachi kare leh kudesha berich hu acharon, begin deyittakkan lemehve acharon, vela yetuv kemillekaddemin. telitaa uf hachi. vechen bechol zimnin, mikkadmaa veelach. hachi ikre acharon, vehachi itzterich lemikre acharon, deilmale itkere miyad tinyayna, ha petichu defuma leahaddera kemilkaddemin, vehahu binyayna istetar.

Menalan. mibbayit sheni deikre acharon, dichtiv, (chaggay 2:9) gadol yihye kevod habbayit hazze haacharon min harishon. deha mikkadmaa veelach, acharon ikre, deha la yehe petichu defuma, dehahu binyayna yinpol, veyithaddar kemilkaddemin.

Uf hachi da, acharon karenan leh. uvegin kach ketiv, lo yuchal balah harishon asher shillechah lashuv lekachta. lo yuchal, lo yikkachenna mibbae leh, may lo yuchal. ella kevan dehay itteta itdabbekat beacher, venachtat leishtabeda bedarga tattaa, la bae kudesha berich hu, deihu yetuv middarga dileh, lemehav iva, uleitdabbeka behahu darga delav dileh.

Veta chaze, i hay itteta la itnesivat, afillu tizne bechol guverin dealma, i bae balah yetuv legabbah, aval i itdabbeka benissuin leacher, (nusach acher veachar) da (hay) lo yuchal lashuv ledarga kadmaa, dehava bekadmita legabbah. lo yuchal vadday leatava lehahu darga lealmin.

Achare asher huttammaa. taninan, dehuttammaa belibbeh. i hachi, afillu i titrachek vetizne bela nissuin. ella, kevan deitdabbekat leacher, ha kabbilat ala chulaka dehahu sitra, vebalah kadmaa deihu missitra achara tava detov, la yehe leh bah chulaka lealmin, vela yappish kelal lehahu atar. ha im shillechah haish haacharon, o ki yamut haish haacharon, lekadmaa asura, aval lishar beni nasha, tishtere. dilma tishkach atra kemilkaddemin, veacharon yakum deyizdavvivg bahadah.

Man deit leh benin meitteteh kadmita, veail hay lego beteh, hahu yoma itdabbak becharba kashya demithappecha, begin teren sitrin. chad, deha teren dachat lon levar, vehasheta ihu telitaa. vetu, mana deishtaabbed (nusach acher deishtattaf) beh acher, hech yete ihu lemehav beh rucha dileh, veyishtattaf bahadah, veyitdabbak bah. lav deihi asura, aval vadday shittufa bisha ihu legarmeh. (kedaamaran)

Rabbi levitas ish kefar ono, hava chayich umitlotzetz al itteta da, kad chame man deizdavvag bahadah, vahava amar, (Mishlei 31:25) vattischak leyom acharon ketiv, man deitdabbekat beh beish acharon, chiyyucha ihi levatar.

Hasheta, it leahadra uleayyna, al atar (nusach acher ilana) chad rav veillaa, dehava bealma, vegiza vesharsha dikshot, veihu oved avi yishay avi david. deha ittemar deacharon hava, hech nafak sharsha dikshot, miggo atar da.
Ella, oved ittakkan betikkuna illaa, veahdar sharsha deilana deka ithappach, al tekkuneh, veistelik beh, veittakkan kedka yeot, veal da ikre oved. ma dela zachu hachi, shear bene alma.

Ata ihu, palach veadar ikara vesharsha deilana, venafak meanfin meriran, veahdar (nusach acher veadar) veittakan benofa deilana achara illaa, ata yishay bereh, veachasin leh, vetakin leh, veitachad beanpoy (175 amud bet) deilana achara illaa, vechiver ilana beilana, veistebachu da beda. kevan deata (170 amud alef) david, ashkach ilanin mistavchan umitachadan da beda, keden yarit shultanu beara, veoved garim da.

Bacha hahu sava veamar, i sava sava, vela amena lach, dealat beyamma rabba, hasheta ant hu go tehome ravrevin, ittakkan lesalleka. sava sava, ant garamt da, deilmale havet shatik bekadmita, hava yeot lach, aval hasheta la yachilat velet man deachid bidach, ella ant bilchodach. kum sava veistallak bisliku.

Oved da, ittakkan venfak miggo chakal bisha, deguvin bishin. ata yishay bereh, veatkin veadar ilana, veim kol da, (veoved) da raza derazin, vela yedana i ema, i la ema. ema milach sava, vadday ema, beda yedian kol shear bene gilgula. (nusach acher oved ilana atkin) oved im kol da ilana atkin. kad ata david malka, beilana tattaa denukeba ishtear, veitzterich lekabbela (Bereshit 165 amud alef) chayyin meachara, uma i hay deittakkan, veatkin kolla, hachi. shear bene alma deatyayn begilgula, dela yachlin leittakna hachi, al achat kamma vechamma.

Bechol sitrin ithappach begilgula. peretz hachi hava. boaz hachi hava. oved hachi hava. (sefer acher veim kol da ilana ittakkan) uvecholla nafik ilana missitra dera, veitdabbak levatar besitra detov. bekadmita, (Bereshit 38:7) vayhi er bechor yehuda ra. (onen uf hachi) machlon uf hachi, velav kol kach. aval behani itakkol ra, venafik tov levatar, (nafak) hahu dichtiv beh, (Shmuel 1 16:12) vetov roi. (Shmuel 1 16:12) vaAdonai immo. hacha kayyeyma ilana tattaa al tekkuneh, umelech elohim al goyim.

Besheruta decholla, meikara visoda illaa, ishterashu dargin, reuven shimon levi yehuda, ma ketiv beh, (Bereshit 29:35) happaam ode et Adonai, uchetiv vattaamod milledet. hayeynu (Yeshayahu 54:1) ranni akara lo yalada. begin dechad ityelid yehuda, nafkat nukeba mitdabbeka bidchura, vela havat al tikkunaha anpin beanpin, vela itkesharat leolada kevan denasar lah kudesha berich hu, veatkin lah, (sefer acher anpin beanpin) keden itkesharat leitabbera uleolada.
Uvesifra dechanoch, vattaamod milledet, lav al lea ittemar, ella al rachel ittemar, hahi dimvakka al baneha, hahi deishtarashat bihuda: Yahu dibur hamatchil. vattaamod milledet, deha la ittakna.

Bekadmita, diyyukena dilella hava kolla reuven: or ben. (Bereshit 1:6) vayyomer elohim yehi or, yemina or. (52) shimon semala or behahu siga dedahava bahadeh shem avon. levi: chibbura decholla, leitchabbera mitteren sitrin. yehuda: nukeba bahade dechura mitdabbekat, Yahu, da dechura. dibur hamatchil, da nukeba dahavat bahadeh.

Dibur hamatchil, amay dibur hamatchil. ella 4, beitdabbekuta dera bahadah, ihi dalet, miskena ihi, veitzterich leatava begilgula, leitakkela hahu ra, ulemitbele beafra. ulevatar letzamcha besitra detov, velnafka mimmiskenu laatiru, ucheden Adonai. veal da, Yahu dibur hamatchil.

Pok sava, miggo tehome, la tidchal, kamma arbin zeminin lach, beshaata ditshotet yamma, begin lenayycha behu. bacha kemillekaddemin veamar, mare dealma, dilma yemrun mashreyayn illain, daana sava, uvache kinoka. galle kammach, deal yekarach ana avid, vela avidna al yekara dili, deha bekadmita hava li leistammera, dela eul beyamma rabba, vehasheta kevan daana beh, it li leshatteta bechol sitrin, velnafka mineh.

(Bereshit 29) yehuda atta yoducha achecha, (sefer acher kullehu odan al shemma da vehayeynu vechulei) hayeynu daanan amrin baruch atta. ihu baruch veihi atta, lechullehu benoy la amar yaakov atta, ella laatar deitzterich. da ihu atta.

Shema da, (nusach acher vadday atta) yoducha achecha, kullehu odan lach al shema da, vadday atta yoducha achecha, al shema da, istallak veitkafya setar achara, begin dechad itkere veadkar, ha nafkat sitra achara bahadah. kevan deamre atta, shultanu veravrevanu it lah, vesitra achara itkafyay, vela itchaziat tamman. vadday bishma da itreshim veitberir missitra achara. veda istalaku veshultanu dilay, uteviru uvish lesitra achara. kevan deyoducha achecha al shema da, atta, keden yadcha beoref oyvecha, miyyad itkafyayn legabbach, ushema da garim.

Yadana chavrayyay yadana, deha atta shema da, attun amrin laatar achara illaa, dichtiv, (Tehillim 110:4) atta kohen leolam, bimina illaa. shappir ihu, deha kevan derabbi shimon odan leh illain vetattain, vezacha lecholla, kol ma deihu amar, hachi ihu veshappir.

Aval kad tehevon matan legabbeh, imru leh, veadkeru leh, yoma detalga, kad (97 amud bet) zerana polin, lechamshin uteren gavvnin. deha atta kohen, hacha itkashshar kos divracha bimina, belo piruda kelal. uvegin kach, atta kohen leolam, hacha itkashshar kos bimina, kedka yeot.
Veal da amar kera, yehuda atta, lehay atta yoducha achecha, vela ketiv yehuda yoducha achecha, vela yattir, ella al shema deatta. atta, atar da, itzterich lishma da, vela achara.

Yehuda, abba kadmaa, veabba tinyayna, vela hava beh chillufa lealmin. ubbegin kach peretz ittakkaf beh betokfoy, ma dela hava hachi lechol bene alma. veal da binyayna dedavid, share cheshbona mipperetz, vela mibboaz, dehava beh shinnuya. chavrayyay, i tashgechun, lav millin bistimu ka amena, veaf al gav distimin innun.

Veal da, yehuda ravavch shema da, deikre atta. kam al bureye zimna kadmaa, vezimna tinyayna, vela ishtani lealam. uvenoy dihuda vezara dileh, odan veamrin ki atta avinu. ma delet hachi lishar beni gilgula lealmin. shear bene gilgula, teren avahan, teren immahan, it lon gon levinyayna. verazin illen, beimke yamma, belibba dithome innun, man yachil leappaka lon. kum sava, itgabbar veittakaf betukefach, appik margelan miggo tehome.

Boaz, itchaze dehava beh shinnuya, kad olid leoved, deha oved (sefer acher ovada) beshinnuya hu. lav hachi. ivtzan hu boaz, hu abba kadmaa, dela aved shinnuya. vei tema, ihu hava, vadday kad ittear leovada da, beh hava, man dehu takkif kearya ucheleta beh hava. begin dela lehve shinnuya beh bedavid, veithaddar milla leikara kadmaa, begin dihe kolla meabba chada, veshalshela chada. vecholla chad, vela hava shinnuya begilgula dezara dedavid. veal da, atta meresha vead sofa, belo shinuyay kelal.

Hasheta, nafkat sava, meimke libba deyamma. yehuda atta, vadday meresha vead sofa vela itchaze lechol shear benin, leitkere atta, ella leh bilchodoy. zakkaa chulakeh dedavid, dehachi itberir, veistallak mishshear ikara divne nasha beara.

Yoducha achecha, yoducha kol bene alma mibbae leh, may tama achecha. ella orach kol bene alma, la mityabbemin legilgula, ella missitra deachin, veacha izdaman leyyivuma, (veatta bageramech, izdammenat leyyivuma.) vehacha kullehu achecha yoducha, dela yishtalshel minnayyhu, vela mechad minnayyhu, shilshula demalchu, ella atta bilchodach. atta, merisha vead sofa atta avdat, uminach nafak, kol shilshula vegiza (diyyukena vegufa) dearye.

Banecha, bene arye, dela itavaru leshinnuya deachecha, la itchelafu letale, vela leshor, vela ligdi, vela leshum diyyukena achara, ella arye share lemivne, vearye siyyem binyayna. kol shilshulach, bene arye ninhu. deilmale ata gilgula missitra deachuch, yitchallefun kol diyyukenin, veyitarvun illen beillen. veal da yoducha achecha, dela hava chad minnehon, begilgula deshalshelaa divnach. yadcha zakif, dela hava bach irbuveya achara minnayyhu.

Vehayeynu mitteref beni alit, dela hava tarpa leachara al patorach. kara, bemitat er. ravatz, bemitat onan. levatar itgabbar kaari, leakama leferetz. uchelavi, leakama lezerach. mi yekimennu, dichtiv, (Bereshit 38:26) velo yasaf od ledatah. vetargum vela pasak. mi yekimennu, man hu deyema, asura itteta da. man hu deyema, hoil veishlimat archaha, la itztericha lach yattir, yevama da, kevan deashlimat archaha, la itzterichat lach yattir, veitchaziat leitparsha minah, aval mi yekimennu, vadday mittamman ulehala ihi dileh. deha appik man dimchashkesh bimaha.

Raza setima hacha, achuha devar nash amay. tu yehuda dehava avoy amay. ella, hahu dimchashkesha bimaha, chame deman dehava natir leh, mekatreg leh kitrugin, bechol sitrin. bae leappaka. kevan denafik, zammin leachara hahu ruach achara, veatyayn leaala kemillekaddemin, ad deitbene kemillekaddemin, bechela dekitruga takkif deka mekatreg beachu. mittamman ulehala shariat itteta da leh.
Zakkaa chulaka dihuda, bekadmita hava gor. levatar arye, deka itgabbar veitpashshat becheleh (ulevatar) arye. vesiyyem belavi. kol shear bene alma lav hachi, veal da yehuda kidkaamran.

Reuven shimon levi, ha telata, kidkaamran. yehuda itchabbar bahadayyhu, vecholla kedka yeot. yissaschar zevulun, teren yarchin. atar deyanke nevie keshot. yissaschar yarcha yemina, ketiv (divre hayamim 1 12:33) umibbeni yissaschar yode vina laittim (sefer acher zevulun yarcha semala) uchetiv, (Devarim 33:18) semach zevulun betzetecha, uveshiura ravreva, ketiv, (Bereshit 49:13) zevulun lechof yammim yishkon vehu lechof oniyyot. may tama. begin devyarchato al tzidon. shiura (sefer acher deyerech dideh) ad tzidon.

Binyamin, ishtear leella ben yarchin, deha (Bereshit 143 amud bet) yosef hava diyyukeneh beara, uleishtammesha bealma da, veimmeh ishtammash moshe, dichtiv, (Shemot 13:19) vayyikkach moshe et atzmot yosef immo. binyamin istallak leella, binyamin tzaddiko dealma.

Mevarchin letatta, dan venaftali gad veasher. beyarcha semala, dan ad pirka deragla. pirka deragla naftali. ubbegin kach, naftali ayyala shelucha, kal beragloy. beyarcha yemina. gad, vehu yagud akev, ad pirka deakev. asher pirka deakev yemina. (Devarim 33:25) vetovel bashshemen raglo. uchetiv barzel unechoshet minalecha. kol illen, innun diyyukenin illain, diyyukena dilella. uvegin dahavo biryayn mammash behay alma, itaknat behu shechinta, beillen teresar pirkin, teresar metichin, deitmetachu miyyisrael mammash. dichtiv, (Bereshit 49:28) kol elle shivte yisrael shenem asar. metichin deyisrael, elle ikrun. leitmattecha shema demi, lemehve binyayna kadka yeot, lemeheve yisrael bichlala dishma deelohim. elle ihu yisrael bichlal. mi chibber (nusach acher bara) elle bahadeh, vahava binyayna shelim al tekkuneh, shema chada mammash.

Hada hu deamar leh leyaakov, hahu memana deesav, dichtiv, (Bereshit 32:29) ki sarita im elohim, (im anashim vattuchol) leella, betikkuna kadmaa, bevinyayna kadmaa. kol elle, vadday binyayna kadmaa ihu.

Veal da, let shetziu leyisrael, lealam ulealme almin. vechas veshalom ilmale yishtetziu, shema da la have, hada hu dichtiv, (yehoshua 7:9) vehichritu et shemenu min haaretz uma taase leshimcha haggadol. shema gadol, da, binyayna kadmaa, shema kadmaa elohim. vehasheta deyisrael innun begaluta, kivyachol kol binyayna nafal. lezimna deate, kad yifrok kudesha berich hu livnoy miggaluta, (mitchabber) mi veelle dehava beferuda begaluta, yitchabberun kachada, ushema deelohim yehe shelim al tekkuneh, vealma yitbesam. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 60:8) mi elle kaav teufenna vechayyonim el arubbotehem.

Uvegin deihu shema chada, la ketiv mi veelle, ella mi elle, shema chada, bela piruda, vehu elohim. dehashta begaluta, istallak mi leella, kivyachol ima meal benin. uvenin naflu. ushema dehava shelim, dehu shema illaa ravreva kadmaa, nafil.

Veal da, anan metzalan, umekaddeshan bevatte kenesiyyot, al shema da, deyitbene kema dehava. veamre yitgaddal veyitkaddash shemeh rabba. amen (165 amud bet) yehe shemeh rabba mevarach. man shemeh rabba. hahu kadmaa decholla, begin delet leh binyayna ella bahadan. mi la yitbeni leolam, ella beelle. veal da, behahu zimna, mi elle kaav teufenna. veyechomun kol alma, deha shema illaa ittakkan al tekkuneh.

Vei shemeh rabba da itkkan, veitbeni al tekkuneh, ha yisrael shallitin al kolla, vechol shear shemahan yithadderun al tikkunayyhu, veyisrael shallitin al kolla, deha kullehu talyayn bishmeh rabba, kadmaa lechol binyaynin.

Raza da, kad bara kudesha berich hu almin. kadmaa lechol binyaynin, shema da itbene. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 40:26) seu marom enechem ureu mi vara elle, bara shemeh al tekkuneh, vechad bara elle, bara (shemeh) leh bechol chelin deyitchazun leh, lemeheve shemeh al tekkuneh kedka yeot, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 40:26) hammotzi bemispar tzevaam.

May bemispar. ella bera chad denahir missayyfe alma ad sayyfe alma, it leh lekudesha berich hu, vehu ilana rabba vetakkif. resheh mate letzet shemayya, vesofeh matchin sharshoy, veishtarshan beafar kaddisha, umispar shemeh. vetalya bashshamayim illain, vechamesh rekiin talyayn minneh, ad hay mispar, vechullehu natlin shema da begineh dichtiv, (Tehillim 19:2) hashshamayim mesapperim, begin hay mispar, kullehu (davar acher begin hay shemma mispar) shamayim ravvchin shema da begineh, veal da hammotzi bemispar tzevaam, deilmale mispar da, la yishtekchun chayyaylin vetoladin lealmin.

Veal da ketiv, (Bamidbar 23:10) mi mana afar yaakov umispar et rova yisrael, teren innun, demanu ana, vealu bechushebana al yedayyhu, begin dela shalta behu ena bisha. mi mana afar yaakov, ha chad, deavid chushebana. umispar et rova yisrael, ha mone achara.

Veal teren illen la shalta behu ena bisha, deha mi mana leafar yaakov, illen innun avanin (davar acher dargin) kaddishin, avanin mefulamin, deminnehon nafke mayin lealma. veal da ketiv (Bereshit 28:14) vehaya zaracha kaafar haaretz. ma hahu (vayyishlach 170) afar, alma mitbarich begineh. uf hachi (Bereshit 22:18) vehitbarachu vezaracha kol goye haaretz. kaafar haaretz mammash. umispar deihu mone tinyayna, mana lerova kol innun nukevin, margelan illain, demitta deshachiv aleh yisrael.

Umittamman ulehala, ihu mone lecholla, begin deihu tov ayin. hada hu dichtiv, mone mispar lakkochavim. man hu mone lakkochavim. mispar. mone mispar lakkochavim, al yedoy avrin kullehu bechushbana, ulezimna deate, (Yirmeyahu 33:13) od taavorna hatztzon al yede mone, vela yadinan man hu. ella begin divhahu zimna, yehe kolla beyichuda belo piruda, kolla lihave (vecholla lihave) mone chad.

Kum sava, ittear veitgabbar bechelach, veshut yamma. patach veamar, (Bamidbar 23:10) mi mana afar yaakov umispar et rova yisrael. beshaata deyittear kudesha berich hu leachayay metayya, hane deithaddaru begilgula, teren gufin berucha chada, teren avahan, teren immahan, kamma gilgulin mitgalgelan al (veda) da, af al gav deittemar, vehachi hu, aval mi mana afar yaakov, veihu yatkin kolla, vela yitavid kelum, vecholla yekum.

Veha ittemar, (Daniel 12:2) verabbim miyyeshene admat afar yakitzu. admat afar hane, kema deittemar besifra dechanoch, kad chavrayyay istakkalu beinnun atvavn (datesayn) baavira beh, veinnun 75 720, hayeynu, admat afar.

Hayeynu (Kohelet 4:2) veshabbeach ani et hammetim shekkevar metu, admat afar innun atvavn vekala ittear veoda vehachi amar bevinyayna (103 amud bet) tinyayna. afar, afar kadmaa. admat tinyayna, deittakkan ikar kadmaa pesolet legabbeh.

Admat afar kullehu, yakitzu. elle deittakanu, lechayye olam. (sefer acher yakitzu kema deittemar besifra dechanoch. chavrayyay aysatekalev beinnun atvavn 445 350 (veinnun 75 720) inun atvavn tasean baavira vekala ittear veoda (sefer acher veachrez) hakitzu verannenu shochne afar veda ihu binyayna tinyayna deittakkan vehachi amar besifra dechanoch binyayna tinyayna afar deittakkan. kadmaa admat. vehahu kadmaa pesolet legabbe tinyayna deittakkan vehane yeshanne admat afar kullehu yakitzu elle daatatekanev lechayye olam) man olam. da olam diltatta deha la zachu lemohre baolam dilella. veelle dela zachu, lacharafot ulediron olam. may lacharafot, ella begin desitra achara yitabbar mealma, vekudesha berich hu, illen dahavo minneviu dehahu sitra, yashar lon, letavvevha behon kol bene alma.

Kol da man garim, hahu dela bae leappasha bealma, vela bae lekayyeyma (sefer acher bedarga dehahu nahar deihu) berit kaddisha, al da garim kol ma degarim, vechol hane gilgulin deka amena alah ad hacha. (hada hu) ad kan sava. shatik riga chada, vechavrayyay havo tavvhin, vela havo yadin, i hava yemama, i hava lelya, i kayyme tamman, i la kayyme.

Patach hahu sava veamar, (Shemot 21:2) ki tikne eved ivri shesh shanim yaavod uvashsheviit vegomer. kera da ochach, al kol ma deittemar. ta chaze, kol dechura, kaim bediyyukena, bealma didchura. vechol nukeba kaim bediyyukena, bealma denukeba. beod deihu avda dekudesha berich hu itdabbak beh, beinnun shesh shanim kadmoniyyot, vei iakar garmeh mippulechaneh, yakar leh kudesha berich hu meinnun shesh shanim, dealma didchura, veitmesar (94 amud alef) lebar nash, deihu mishshit sitrin, yiflach leh shit shenin, veyitakkar mishshit shenin (kadmoniyyot) dilella.
Levatar nachit mittamman, veitmesar bealma denukeba. hu la baa lekayyeyma bidchura, nachit vekayyeyma benukeva. atat nukeba, deihi sheviit, venatla leh, ha mikkan ulehala, mealma denukeba ihu.

La baa lekayyeyma bah, uvefiruka dilah, nachit letatta, veitdabbak letatta, veitachid besitra achara. mikkan ulehala, itakkar mealma didchura, umealma denukeba. ha itachad, beinnun avadim deinnun missitra achara.

Hasheta kevan dehachi hu, itzterich pegam, ulemebad beh reshimu difgam, deha kol pegam desitra achara ihu, umiyyovel ulehala ithaddar legilgula, vetav lealma kemillekaddemin. (sefer acher i zache veittakkan garmeh itbar) veitdabbak behahu alma denukeba, vela yattir. zacha avid toladin bealma denukeba, vechullehu raza dichtiv, (Tehillim 45:15) betulot achareha reoteha muvaot lach. vezakkaa ihu kad ittakkan vezache lechach.

Vei la zacha afillu begilgula deyovla, ha ihu kela hava ithaddar, vela ashlimu yomoy, leitnasseva bealma, ulemebad toladin. ma ketiv, im begappo yavo begappo yetze. i yechiday yeul behahu alma bela toladin, vela baa leishtaddela behay, venafak mehay alma yechiday, bela zara, azil keavna bekusefita, ad hahu atar detinara (100 amud alef) takkifa, veal tamman umiyyad nashav rucha dehahu yechiday, deka ishtevik minnukeveh, veazil yechiday, (95 amud alef) kechivya dela itchabbar beachara beorcha, venashiv beh.

Umiyyad nafak miggo hahu atar detinara takkifa, hu bilchodoy, veazil umeshatteta bealma, ad deka ashkach paroka leatava. vehayeynu im begappo yavo begappo yetze, hay dela baa leitnasseva, lemeheve leh toladin.

Aval im baal ishsha hu, deka itnesiv, veishtaddal beitteteh, vela yachil, hahu la ittarach kehahu achara, la yeul yechiday, vela nafik yechiday, ella im baal ishsha hu, kudesha berich hu la mekappeach agar kol biryayn, af al gav dela zachu bivne, ma ketiv veyatza ishto immo. vetarvavyyhu atyayn begilgula, vezachyayn leitchabbera kachada kemillekaddemin. vehay la nasiv itteta ditruchin, ella hahi deishtaddal bah bekadmita, vela zachu, hashsheta yizku kachada, i yetakkenun ovadin, veal da veyatza ishto immo.

(Shemot 21:4) im adonav yitten lo ishsha vegomer. (hasheta) ahdar kera lemillin acharanin, (sefer acher lemilla kadmaa) lehahu denafik yechiday bela nukeba kelal, vayifrok leh hahu ducheta deikre sheviit. vehahu sheviit ikre adonav, adon kol haaretz ihu. im da adonav chas aleh, veativ leh lehay alma yechiday kema dehava, veyahiv leh itteta hahi demizbeach achitat aloy dimin, veitchabbera kachada. veyalda lo vanim o vanot haishsha viladeha tihye ladoneha kema deittemar.

Deha i tav, veatkin hahu atar defagim bechayyyoy, itkabbal kame malka kaddisha, natil leh, veatkin leh al tikkunoy levatar. veda ikre baal teshuva, deha yarit motveh, dehahu atar, dehahu nahar denagid venafik, veatkin garmeh mimma dehava bekadmita. (sefer acher hahu atar defagim veatkin leh al tikunoy bacheyvey itkabbal kamme malka kaddisha venatil leh levatar veda ikre baal teshuva deha atkin garmeh mimma dehava bekadmita) kevan deittakkan vetav betiuveta, ha salik al tekkuneh. delet milla bealma, velet maftecha bealma, dela tavar hahu detav betiuveta.

May yetze begappo. ha ittemar, aval tu raza it beh, yetze begappo, kema deat amar, (Mishlei 9:3) al gappe merome karet, ma lehatam illuyay useliku, uf hacha illuyay useliku, atar demarehon detiuveta sallekin, afillu tzaddikim gemurim la yachlin lemekam tamman. ubbegin kach kevan detav betiuveta, kudesha berich hu mekabbel leh vadday miyyad.

Tanenan, let milla bealma dekayyeyma kamme teshuva, ulecholla kudesha berich hu mekabbel vadday. vei tav betiuveta ha izdaman lokovleh orach chayyim, veaf al gav defagim ma defagim, kolla ittakkan, vecholla ithaddar al tekkuneh, deha afillu bema deit beh omaa, (kamme kudesha berich hu kare beh ki Adonai tzevaot yaatz umi yafer da ihu raza setima. vetu kad kudesha berich hu ome omaa lo ome ella im lo yabed teyuveta deha let pitgama dekayyeyma kamme teyuveta veal kolla mechapper kudesha berich hu kad avdin teyuveta shelemata) kudesha berich hu mekabbel, dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 22:24) chay ani neum Adonai ki im yihye kanyahu vegomer uchetiv (Yirmeyahu 22:30) kitvu et haish hazze ariri vegomer. uvatar detav betiuveta ketiv, (divre hayamim 1 3:17) uvene yechanya asir beno vegomer, mikkan ditshuva mittebar kamma gizrin vedinin, vechamma shalshelain defarzela, velet man dekayyeyma kamme detiuveta.

Veal da ketiv, (Yeshayahu 66:24) veyatzu verau befigre haanashim happoshim bi. asher pashu bi, la ketiv, ella happoshim bi, dela baan leatava, uleitnachama al ma deavdu. aval kevan deitnachamu, ha mekabbel lon kudesha berich hu.

Begin kach, bar nash da, af al gav defasha beh, ufagim beatra dela itzterich, vetav lekameh, mekabbel leh, vechas aleh, deha kudesha berich hu male rachamin ihu, veitmele rachamim al kol ovadoy, kema deat amer (Tehillim 145:9) verachamav al kol maasav. afillu al beire veofoy matun rachamoy. i alayyhu matun rachamoy, kol shekken al bene nasha, deyadin veishtemodan leshavcha lemarehon, derachamoy matun alayyhu, vesharan alayyhu. veal da amar david, (Tehillim 119:156) rachamecha rabbim Adonai kemishpatecha chayyeni.

I al chayyayvin matun rachamoy, kol shekken al zakkain. ella man bae asvavta, innun mare keevin, uman innun mare keevin. illen innun chayyayvin, innun baan asvavta verachame, dekudesha berich hu (rachame) alayyhu, dela yehon shevikin minneh, veihu dela istalak minnayyhu, vituvun lokovleh. kad mekarev kudesha berich hu, bimina mekarev. vechad dache, bismala dache. uveshaata dedache, yemina mekarev. missitra da dache, umissitra da mekarev, vekudesha berich hu la shavik rachamoy minnayyhu.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv (Yeshayahu 57:18) vayyelech shovav bederech libbo. uchetiv batreh, derachav raiti veerpaehu veanchehu vaashallem nichumim lo velaavelav. vayyelech shovav, af al gav dechayyayvin avdin, kol ma deavdin bezadon deazlin bearcha delibbayyhu, veacharanin avdin behu hateraa, vela baan letzayyta lon. beshaata detavin bityuveta, venatlin archa tava dityuveta, ha asvavta zemina lokovlayhu.

Hasheta it leistakkela, i al chayyay amar kera, o al metayyay amar kera. deha resha dikra, lav ihu sefa. vesefa, lav ihu resha. resha dikra, achze al chayyay. vesofeh achze al metayyay. ella, kera (sefer acher resha dikra) amar, beod devar nash ihu bechayyyo, vehachi hu, vayyelech shovav bederech libbo, begin deyetzer hara deveh, takkif veittakkaf beh, veal da azil shovav, vela bae leatava bityuveta.

Kudesha berich hu chame archoy, deka azlin bevish, bela toalta, amar kudesha berich hu, ana itzterichna leatkefa bideh, hada hu dichtiv derachav raiti, (veerpaehu) deka azlin bechashocha, ana bae lemehav leh asvavta hada hu dichtiv veerpaehu, kudesha berich hu ihu ail belibbeh archeh ditiuveta veasvavta lenishmateh. veanchehu, may veanchehu. kema deat amer (Shemot lak) lech neche et haam. anhig leh kudesha berich hu beorach meshar, keman deatkif bida deachara, veafkeh miggo chashocha.

Vaashallem nichumim lo velaavelav, ha itchaze demita ihu, (ella) in, vadday meta ihu, vekayyeyma bachayyin dehoil (ella deihi ihu vekayyeyma bachayyin vehoil) veihu rasha, meta ikre. mahu vaashallem nichumim lo velaavelav. ella kudesha berich hu avid tivu im bene nasha, dechevan deal mig shenin ulehala, pakid immeh (Bereshit 144 amud bet, 165 amud bet) teren malachin neturin denatre leh, chad miminneh, vechad missomaleh.

Kad azil bar nash beorach meshar, innun chaddan beh, veittakifu immeh bechedva, machrezan kameh veamrin, havu yekar lediyyukena demalka. vechad azil beorach akimu, innun mitabbelan aleh, umitavran mine. kevan deatkif beh kudesha berich hu, veanhig leh beorach meshar, keden ketiv, vaashallem nichumim lo velaavelav. vaashallem nichumim lo bekadmita, deihu itnecham al ma deavad bekadmita, veal ma deavad hasheta, vetav bityuveta. uvatar ken velaavelav, innun malachin dahavo mitabbelan aleh kad itavaru minneh, vehasheta deithaddaru bahadeh, ha vadday nichumim lechol sitrin.

Vehasheta ihu chay vadday. chay bechol sitrin, achid beilana dechayye, vechevan deachid beilana dechayye, keden ikre baal teshuva, (nasha 122 amud bet) deha keneset yisrael, teshuva uf hachi ikre. veihu baal teshuva ikre. vekadmae amru, baal teshuva mammash. veal da, afillu tzaddikim gemurim enam yecholim laamod, bemakom shebbaale teshuva omdim.

David malka amar, (Tehillim 51:6) lecha levaddecha chatati vehara beenecha asiti vegomer, lecha levaddecha, may lecha levaddecha. ella, begin deit chovin, dechate bar nash lekudesha berich hu velivnay nasha. veit chovin dechata livne nasha, vela lekudesha berich hu. veit chovin dechate lekudesha berich hu bilchodoy vela livni nasha. (achara) david malka, chav lekudesha berich hu bilchodoy, vela livne nasha.

Vei tema ha chav hahu chova devat sheva, vetanenan, man deate al erva itteta birutah asra al balah, vechav lechavreh, vechav lekudesha berich hu. lav hachi hu dehahu deat amar. behettera hava, vedavid dileh nakat, veget hava lah mibbalah, ad la yehach likrava, dehachi hava minhaga dechol yisrael, deyahavin get zeman leitteteh, kol denafik chela. vechen aved uriyya levat sheva. ulevatar deavar zeman vahavat petura lecholla, natal lah david. uvehettera avad kol ma deavad.

Deilmale lav hachi, uveisura hava, la shavka kudesha berich hu legabbeh. vehayeynu dichtiv lesahaduta, (Shmuel b 12:24) vaynachem david et bat sheva ishto. sahaduta deishto hi, vaddai ishto, uvat zugo havat, deizdammenat legabbeh, miyyoma deitberi alma. (veraza demilleta malchuta dilella deihu itavid raglah rabeyaa lamerakebatea illaa vaatakeray bat sheva al even achat sheva aynayym) ha sahaduta dela chav david chova devat sheva kidkamran.

Uma hi chova dechav, (ella) lekudesha berich hu bilchodoy, vela leachara. dekatal leuriyya becherev bene ammon, vela katleh ihu beshaata deamar leh vaadoni yoav, deha david hava ribbon aleh, (veal yoav) vekara ochach, dichtiv, (Shmuel bakeg) elle shemot haggibborim asher ledavid, velo asher leyoav, velo katleh hahi shaata, vekatleh becherev bene ammon.

Vekara amar, velo nimtza itto davar, (Melachim 1 15:5) rak bidvar uriyya hachitti. rak lemaute ka ate, bidvar uriyya, vela beuriyya. vekudesha berich hu amar, veoto haragta becherev bene ammon, vechol cherev beni ammon, hava chakik beh chivya akim, diyyukena dedarkon, veihu avoda zara dilhon. amar kudesha berich hu, yahavat chela lehahu shikkutz. (davar acher dechevan decharev bene ammon itgabbar hahi shaata al uriyya kema tukepa takkif hahu chivya akima) begin divshaata dekatlu bene ammon leuriyya, vesaggiin mibbeni yisrael immeh, veitgabbar behahi shaata cherev bene ammon, kamma tukpa ittakkaf hahi avoda zara shikkutz.

Vei tema, uriyya la hava zakkay, kevan dichtiv aleh uriyya hachitti. lav hachi, zakkaa hava, ella dishma deatreh hava chitti. kema deat amer (Shoftim 11:1) veyiftach haggiladi, al shum atreh itkere hachi.

Veal da bidvar uriyya hachitti, deshikkutz bene ammon itgabbar al machani elohim, demashshiryata dedavid, diyyukena mammash dilella havo. uvehahu shaata defagim david mashshiryata da, pagim leella mashshiryata achara. veal da amar david, (Tehillim 51:6) lecha levaddecha chatati. levaddecha, vela leachara. da hava hahu chova dechav legabbeh. veda hu bidvar uriyya. veda hu becherev bene ammon.

Ketiv, (divre hayamim b 16:9) ki Adonai enav meshottot bechol haaretz, illen (vaychi 248 amud alef) nukevin. uchetiv (zecharya 4:10) eni Adonai hemma meshottim, illen dechurin, veha yedian innun. david amar (Tehillim 51:6) vehara beenycha asiti. beenecha, lifne enecha mibbae leh. ella may beenecha, amar david, behahu atar dechavna, beenecha hava. dahavena yada, deha enycha havo zeminin, vekayyeymin kamay, vela chashabbena lon, hare chova dechavna, veavadna, bean atar hava, beenecha.

Lemaan titzdak bedavrecha tizke veshaftecha, velo yehe li pitchon pe lememar kammach. ta chaze, kol umana, kad mallil, beumanuteh mallil. david bedicha demalka hava, veaf al gav dehava betzaara, kevan dehava kamme malka, tav livdichuteh, kema dehava, begin levaddecha lemalka.

Amar, mare dealma, ana amena, (tehillim 26) bechaneni Adonai venasseni, veat amart dela ichul lekayyeyma benisyonach. ha chavna, lemaan titzdak bedavrecha, vihe millach keshot, deilmale la chavna, yehe milla dili keshot, vihe millach berekanyya, hasheta dechavna, begin deleheve millach keshot, yahivna atar letzaddeka millach, begin kach avidna, lemaan titzdak bedavrecha tizke veshaftecha. ahdar david leumanuteh, veamar go tzaareh millin divdichuta lemalka.

Tanenan, lav david itchaze lehahu ovada, deha ihu amar, (Tehillim 109:22) velibbi chalal bekirbi (ankkid chalal kevar hava chalal bekirbi) hachi hu. aval amar david, belibba it teren hechalin, bechad dama, uvechad rucha, hahu chad demalyay dama, beh diyyura leyetzer hara. velibbi lav hachi, deha rekan ihu, vela yahavit diyyura ledama bisha, leshachna beh yetzer hara, velibbi vadday chalal ihu, bela diyyura (nusach acher dema) bisha, vechevan dehachi hu, la itchaze david lehahu chova dechav ella, begin lemehav petichu defuma lechayyayvayya, deyemrun, david malka chav vetav bityuveta, umachal leh kudesha berich hu, kol shekken shear bene nasha. veal da amar (Tehillim 51:15) alammeda foshim derachecha vechattaim elecha yashuvu.

Uchetiv, (Shmuel b 15:30) vedavid ole bemaale hazzetim ole uvoche verosh lo chafuy vehu holech yachef. rosh lo chafuy, veyachef amay. ella, nazuf hava, aved garmeh nazuf, lekabbela onsha. veamma havo rechikin minneh 4 ammot. zakkaa avda dehachi palach lemareh, veishtemoda bechoveh, leatava mineh bityuveta shelemata.
Ta chaze, yattir hava, ma deavad leh shimi ben gera, mikkol aktin deavru aleh ad hahu yoma, vela ativ david lokovleh milla dehachi hava yeot leh, uveda itkapparu chovoy.

Hasheta it leistakkela, shimi talmid chacham hava, vechachmeta saggia havat beh, amay nafik legabbe david, veavid leh kol ma deavad. ella meatar achara hava milla, veail leh belibbeh milla da. vechol da letoalta dedavid. deha hahu deavad leh shimi, garma leh lemetav bityuveta shelemata, vetavar libbeh bitviru saggi, veoshid dimin saggiin, miggo libbeh kodam kudesha berich hu, veal da amar, (Shmuel b 16) ki Adonai amar lo kallel. yada, deha meatar illaa achara nachat milla.

Teren pikkudin, pakid david lishlomo bereh, chad deyoav, vechad deshimi, im shear pikkudin defakid leh. deyoav: dichtiv, (Melachim 1 2:Adonai) vegam atta yadata et asher asa li yoav ben tzeruya. milla setima hava, deafillu shelomo la hava leh leminda, vela yada ella begin deyadu acharanin, itgele (leh) lishlomo. veal da amar, vegam atta yadata vegomer. ma dela itchaze lach leminda.

Deshimi: ketiv, vehinne immecha shimi ben gera. may vehinne immecha, zammin hu immecha tadir, rabbo hava. uvegin kach la amar al yoav vehinne immecha yoav. aval shimi da, deishtechach immeh tadir, amar vehinne immecha.

Vayyishlach hammelech vayyikra leshimi vayyomer bene lecha vayit biyrushalam. an hu chachmeta deshlomo malka behay. ella kolla bechachmeta avad, ulechol sitrin ashgach, deha chakkim hava shimi, veamar shelomo, beena deyisge orayyta beara al yedoy deshimi, vela yippuk levar.

Tu milla achara ashgach shelomo bechachmeta, dichtiv, (Shmuel b 16:5) yotze yatzo umekallel. may yotze yatzo tere zimne, vayyetze vaykallel saggi. (leh) ella, chad yetzia, denafak mibbe midrasha legabbe david. vechad yetzia, denafak miyrushala 40, legabbe avdoy demit aloy. yetzia chada legabbe malka, vitzia tinyayna legabbe avdin. vechol da chama shelomo, veashgach beruach kudesha, hahu yetzia tinyayna. veal da amar, vehaya beyom tzetcha, yada devitzia yamut.

(Shmuel b 16:13) veippar beafar mahu. amar shelomo legabbe abba beafar hava. legabbe shimi bemayya, dichtiv vehaya beyom tzetcha veavarta et nachal kidron. afar hatam, vehacha mayya. tarvavyyhu dan shelomo, lemeheve afar umayya kassota, leman deastin archa legabbe avoy.

Ketiv (Melachim 1 2:8) vehu killani kelala nimretzet. uchetiv vaeshshava lo baAdonai lemor im amitcha becharev. may becharev. vechi shimi tippesha hava, deillu hachi ome leh, dela yema becherev la. aval bachanit o begira in.

Ella teren millin hacha. chad amar yannoka, bereh denuna rabba hahu dekaskasoy salkin lerum ananin. omaa dedavid malka, kad hava bae leumaa, appik charba dileh, detamman hava chakik shema gelifan, vetamman ome. vechach avid leshimi, dichtiv vaeshshava lo baAdonai lemor im amitcha becharev. bemay hava omaa da. becharev. (sefer acher behay cherev dishma kaddisha chakik beh ome) becharev ome. umilla achara, dan shelomo, amar, biklala ata legabbe abba, bemillin, ha millin legabbeh, uveshem hammeforash katleh, velo becharev. uvegin da avad shelomo hachi.

Hasheta it leistakkela, dechevan deome leh david, amay katleh, deitchaze deha omaa da baalila hava, deha libba ufuma la havo kachada. ella vadday david la katleh, veha yedia, kol shayyfin degufa mekabbelin kolla, velibba la mekabbela afillu kechuta denema desaara. david malka libba hava, vekabbil ma dela itchaze leh lekabbela, uvegin kach, (Melachim 1 2:9) veyadata et asher taase lo ketiv. vetu, deha ilana garim lemeheve natir venokem kechivya.

Ketiv (Tehillim 51:18-19) ki lo tachpotz zevach veettena ola lo tirtze. zivche elohim ruach nishbara lev nishbar venidke elohim lo tivze. ki lo tachpotz zevach, vechi la bae kudesha berich hu deyikrevun kameh karbena, veha ihu atkin legabbe chayyayvayya karbena, deyikrevun veyitkapper lehu chovayyhu. ella david lekame shema deelohim amar, vekarbana la keravin lishma deelohim, ella lishma 24 hei vav hei. deha legabbe dina kashya middat haddin, la mekarvin karbena. dichtiv, (Vayikra 1:2) adam ki yakriv mikkem karban laAdonai. laAdonai, vela (Vayikra Adonai amud alef) lishma deelohim. vechi takriv karban mincha laAdonai. zevach toda laAdonai. zevach shelamim laAdonai.

Uvegin kach, kevan dedavid malka, legabbe elohim amar. itzterich lemichtav, ki lo tachpotz zevach veettena ola lo tirtze. deha lishma da la mekarvin, ella ruach nishbara. dichtiv zivche elohim ruach nishbara. karbena deelohim, atzivu, uteviru delibba. uvegin kach, man dechalam chelma bisha, atzivu itzterich leachazaa, deha bemiddat elohim kayyeyma, vezevach demiddat dina, atzivu itzterich veruach nishbara, vehahu atzivu missetyeh lechelma bisha, vela shalta dina aloy. deha zevach deitchaze lemiddat dina, akriv kameh.
Lev nishbar venidke elohim lo tivze, may lo tivze, mikkelal deikka lev deihu boze. in. hayeynu lev deihu gee, lev begassut rucha, hayeynu lev deihu boze, aval lev nishbar venidke elohim lo tivze.

Hetiva virtzoncha et tziyyon tivne chomot yerushalam. may hetiva, itchaze deha tivu it bah, vehasheta hetiva al hahu tivu. vadday hachi hu, deha min yoma dekudesha berich hu ishtaddal bevinyan be makdesha leella, ad (Vayikra 221 amud alef) kean, hahu hatava deratzon, la sharyay al hahu binyan, veal da la ishtachlal. deha beshaata deratzon dilella yittear, yetiv veyadlik nehorin dehahu binyan, vehahu avidta, deafillu malachin dilella, la yechlun (lo) leistakkela behahu be makdesha, velav behahu binyan. ucheden be makdesha, vechol ovada ishtachlal.

Tivne chomot yerushalam, vechi min yoma deishtaddal bevinyan be makdesha ad kean, la bana lon. (o) i chomot yerushala 40 ad kean la bana, be makdesha al achat kamma vechamma. ella kudesha berich hu, kol ovadoy, lav keovade debar nash. bene nasha kad banu be makdesha letatta, bekadmita avdu shure karta, ulevassof avdu be makdesha. shure karta bekadmita, begin leaggana alayyhu, ulevatar binyayna deveta. kudesha berich hu lav hachi, ella bane be makdesha bekadmita, ulevassof, kad yachit leh mishshemayya, veyotiv leh al atreh, keden yibbane chomot yerushala 40 deinnun shurin dekarta. veal da amar david alav hashalom, (Tehillim 51:20) hetiva virtzoncha et tziyyon bekadmita, ulevatar tivne chomot yerushala 40.

Hacha it raza, kol ovadin deavid kudesha berich hu, bekadmita akdim hahu dilvar, ulevatar mocha dilgo, vehacha lav hachi. ta chaze, kol innun ovadin deavid kudesha berich hu, veakdim hahu dilvar, mocha akdim bemachashava, uveovada hahu dilvar, deha kol kelippa missitra achara have, umocha min mocha, vetadir sitra achara akdim verabbi veagdil venatir ibba. kevan deitrabbe, zarkin leh levar, (iyyov 27:17) veyachin rasha vetzadik yilbash, vezarkin lehahi kelippa, umevarchin (ekev 271 amud alef) letzaddika dealma.

Aval hacha, bevinyayna deve makdesha, desitra bisha yitabbar mealma, la itzterich, deha mocha ukelippa dileh have. akdim mocha, dichtiv hetiva virtzoncha et tziyyon bekadmita, ulevatar tivne chomot yerushalam. hahi choma dilvar, deihi kelippa, dileh hi mammash. dichtiv, (zecharya 2:9) vaani ehye lah neum Adonai chomat esh saviv. ani vela sitra bisha.

Yisrael, innun mocha, illaa dealma. yisrael seliku bemachashava bekadmita, ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, deinnun kelippa, akdimu. dichtiv, (Bereshit 36:31) veelle hammelachim asher malchu beeretz edom lifne melach melech livne yisrael. vezammin kudesha berich hu, leakdema mocha, bela kelippa. dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 2:3) kodesh yisrael laAdonai reshit tevuato, mocha kadim liklippa. veaf al gav democha yekum belo kelippa, man hu deyoshit yada lemechol minneh, begin, (yremayhab) dechol ochlav yeshamu raa tavo alehem neum Adonai.

Behahu zimna, (Tehillim 51:21) az tachpotz zivche tzedek. begin, deha keden, yitchabbar kolla bechibbura chada, vihe shema shelim bechol tekkuneh. ucheden karbena leheve shelim, laAdonai elohim. dehashta elohim la itchabbar lekorbana, deilmale itchabbar beh, kama elohim yesalkun udenin leitchabbera tamman. aval behahu zimna, (Tehillim 86:10) ki gadol atta veose niflaot atta elohim levaddecha. veen elohim achara.

Uvehahu zimna ketiv, (Devarim 32:39) reu atta ki ani ani hu veen elohim immadi (rau atta) reu ki ani ani hu saggi, may atta. ella dela hava kodem lachen, vehahu zimna lihave. amar kudesha berich hu, atta reu, ma dela techlun lemecheme mikkadmat dena.

Ki ani ani, tere zimni amay. ella ledayyka, deha let tamman elohim, ella hu. deha kamma zimnin, deittemar ani zimna chada, vela yattir, vahava tamman sitra achara. aval hasheta ani ani hu veen elohim immadi, deha kol sitra achara itavar, vedayyka ani ani.

Ani amit vaachayye, ad hasheta mota havat missitra achara, mikkan ulehala, ani amit vaachayye, mikkan divhahu zimna, kol innun dela taame taama demota. minneh tehe lon mota, veyakim lon (miyyad). amay. begin dela yishtear mehahu zuhama bealma kelal, vihe alma chadta, beovde yedoy dekudesha berich hu.

(Tanenan 10 Devarim kulei 113 amud bet) (shayych leel 106 amud alef) (Shemot 21:5) veim amor yomar vegomer lo etze chafshi. kema deittemar keden pagim leh pegimu. im begappo yavo, mahu begappo. tanenan, ketargumo, bilchodoy. yeot hu. aval ha tanenan, kol alma, la kaim, ella al gappa chada, delivyatan.

Veraza da, beshaata dekayyeyma dechar venukeba, didchar venukeba bara lon kudesha berich hu, uvechol ma deazlin, alma mizdeaza, veilmale desires kudesha berich hu dechura, vetzinnen yat nukeba, havo metashteshin alma. veal da la avdin toladin, (davar achar uman dela avid toladin begappo) im begappo yavo, techot hahu gappa, dela avid toladin al. vehoil vechen, begappo yetze, letamman itdacha, vela al lefargoda kelal, veitdacha veitrid mehahu alma. begappo yetze, begappo yetze vadday.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv, (Vayikra 20:20) aririm yamutu, aririm (ketiv) kelal dechar venukeba. beraza didchura al, uveraza denukeba yippuk. al behay, veyippuk behay. vehay ihu atar, deka itdabbak beh behahu alma, deha kudesha berich hu la bae deyeol kameh, man dimsares garmeh behay alma.

Ta chazi, min karbena. dela havo mekarvin kameh sirusa, veappiku leh, dela yitkariv lekameh, ufakid veamar, (Vayikra 22:24) uveartzechem lo taasu. vechen ledare darin asir lesaruse biryayn, devara kudesha berich hu bealma. deha kol sirusa, desitra achara ihu.

Vei ihu ishtaddal, venasiv itteta, vela avid toladin, vela baa, veaf al gav deit leh itteta, o i hi la baat, veal lehahu alma, bela toladin, ma ketiv. im baal ishsha hu, vela ashgachu lefoal yedoy demarehon, veyatza ishto immo, ihu yeul begappo didchura, veihi benukeva. begappo yavo begappo yetze kema deittemar, kolla al tekkuneh.

Im adonav yitten lo ishsha, kema deittemar, im adonav, da ihu adon kol haaretz. yitten lo ishsha, mehacha, delav birshuta devar nash kayyeyma lemesav itteta. ella (kolla Mishlei 16:11 palles mozne mishpat Adonai) kolla bemoznayim laalot. yitten lo ishsha, deha lav birshuteh ihu. uman ihi. hahi delav dileh, vela izdammenat legabbeh, uman ihi. hahi dahavat zemina leachara, veakdim hay berachame, venatil lah, da ityeyhivat leh, dela itchaziat leh.

Vekudesha berich hu chame merachik, vechame lehahi itteta, dizminat leappaka toladin bealma. akdim hay berachame, veityeyhivat leh, veavid ivin, vezara zara, beitteta (sefer acher beginta) delav dileh, begin kach, haishsha viladeha tihye ladoneha, vehu yetze vegappo. i anyay miskena, kamma ishtaddal berekanyya, laa veishtaddal lemebad perin, beginta delav ihi dileh, venafak berekanyya.

Sava sava, beidanin (nusach acher baanayyneyn) illen, la havet beraglaych dache letara, keman deshachiv beara bela tukepa, deha itchalash umechalsha saggi, dela yachil, dache beragloy. ittetkaf sava, vela tidchal. ha anyay miskena, deishtaddal berekanyya, ema amay. i begin dezara beginta achara delav dileh, yeot. i hachi (sefer acher aval hacha) kudesha berich hu yahiv leh hahu ginta lemizra bah, deha ihu la natil lah.

Ella ta chaze kol millin dekudesha berich hu avid kullehu bedina innun vela have milla berekanya hay dekudesha berich hu yahav leh itteta veavad bah perin veibbin lav hay kishar bene gilgula vela dame man deishtadal behay alma leasgaa ilana (sefer acher velo yachil) leman dela baa leasgaa uleishtadla veaakar veappil tarpin deilana veazar ibba dileh.

Hay daadonav yahiv leh itteta, begin lemebad ivin, ha ishtaddal bekadmita begin leasgaa ilana, vela yachil. zachyayn kol kach let leh, (sefer acher divnin gam ken let leh) dei hava zakkaa kedka yeot, la hava tav begilgula, (keavna bekusefita) deha ketiv, (Yeshayahu 56:5) venatatti lachem beveti uvechomotay yad vashem tov mibbanim umibbanot. vehasheta dela zacha, kudesha berich hu chame, deha ishtaddal vela yachil, hay, adonav yitten lo ishsha, kema deittemar. vechevan dechas aleh kudesha berich hu, veyahav leh berachame, kudesha berich hu gave middideh bekadmita, venatil ma degara hahu mabbua, ubbegin kach, haishsha viladeha tihye ladoneha, ulevatar yetuv, veyishtaddel al garmeh, leashlume gironeh. ad hacha raza dikra.

Sava sava, at amart al da, divrekanya ishtaddal, vela ashgacht alach, divrekanya at azil bema daamart, deha kera radif avatrach, desatir kol binyayna devanit ad hasheta, veat chashiv deant meshatteta yamma lirutach. umay ihu. dichtiv, veim amor yomar haeved ahavti et adoni et ishti vegomer.

I sava sava, lae chela, ma taaved, chashavt dela lihave man deradif avatrach, ha hay kara radif avatrach, venafik mibbatar kotala, keayyala bechakla, medalleg dillugin avatrach, telesar dillugin dalig avatrach veadbik lach, ma tabid sava. hasheta it lach leitgabbera bechelach. deha gibbar takkif havet ad yoma. sava sava, have dachir yoma (97 amud bet) detalga, kad zerana polin, vahavu kamma guverin beni chela, lokovlach, veant bilchodach, natzacht telesar gavrin takkifin, bene chela, dechol chad minnayyhu katil arya, ad la yechul.

I leinun telesar guverin natzacht, hane telesar delet behu chela, ella millin, al achat kamma vechamma. amor yomar ketiv. ella kudesha berich hu archeh lemebad dina lecholla. kad mata zimna dehay itteta leashkecha bar zugeh ma avid katil leden, venatil lah hahu bar zuga, veihu nafik mehay alma bilchodoy yechidaa.

Veim amor yomar, ha ukemuha chavrayyay kifshateh dikra. veim amor, besheruta deshit shenin, ymar, besofa deshit shenin, ad la yeul sheviaa, deha i amar, kad ihu afillu beyoma chad mishsheviaa, milloy betelin. may tama. haeved ketiv, beod deihu eved, beshatta shetitaa. amar besheruta deshit shenin, vela amar besofa deshit shenin, lav kelum hu, uvegin kach, tere zimni amor yomar.

Vehacha, beod deihu behay itteta, asge (Vayikra 244 amud alef) tzelotin uvautin bechol yoma, legabbe malka kaddisha, kema dehava sheruta berachame, hachi hu sofa berachame, veda hu amor yomar. emor bekadmita, kad akdim berachame. yomar besofa veyitkabbel berachame. uma yomar. ahavti et adoni, dibbegin da, uvisgiu ditzlotin, rachim leh lekudesha berich hu. atkin ovadoy, veamar ahavti et adoni et ishti veet banay lo etze chafshi. vekudesha berich hu kabbil leh, behahu tiyyuveta, uveinnun segiu ditzlotin.

Ma avid kudesha berich hu, ma dehava zammin leahaddera leh begilgula, ulemisbal onashin behay alma, al ma deavad, la ahdar leh lehay alma. ume avid, kariv leh leve dina dimtivta dirkia, vedayynin leh, umasrin leh leve malkiyyuta, vearshim leh kudesha berich hu, hech itmesar leve onsha, ufagim leh, lemeheve techot shultaneh dearla, (nusach acher ufakkid leh lemaher techot shuletana deyovla) ad zeman yedia, uvatar parik leh.

I behahu zimna deka avdin leh pegimu, i mata yovla, afillu yoma chad leyovla, itchashav kema deashkach zimna ad yovla, hachi itannash vela yattir. ata yovla, veafruk, vealin leh go pargoda. ad hacha. astim enoy hahu sava, riga chada.

Patach veamar, (Micha 6:2) shimu harim et riv Adonai vehaetanim mosde aretz ki riv laAdonai im ammo vegomer. i sava, ad hasheta havet beimke yamma, vehasheta dalagta beturin takkifin, lemebad immehon kerava. ella vadday ad kean, beyamma takkifa ant, aval ad deazlat beimke yamma, pagat beinnun turin takkifin, di bego yamma, veiaraat behu. hasheta it lach leaggacha kerava beimke yamma, uvehanhu turin.

Sava lae chela, man yahavach beda, havet bishlam, uvait lechol hay, ant avdat, ant savil. hasheta let lach, ella leaggacha kerava, ulenatztzecha kolla, vela lemehadar laachora. ittakaf bechelach, chagor chartzach, vela tidchal, letavra hane turin, dela yittakfun legabbach. ema lon, turin ramain, turin takkifin, hech attun mittakfin.

Tere kerae ketive, chad ketiv, (Micha 6:1) kum riv et heharim vetishmana haggevaot kolecha. vechad ketiv, shimu harim et riv Adonai. ella it turin, veit turin. it turin, deinnun turin (3 amud alef) ramain leella leella, leillen ketiv, shimu harim et riv Adonai. veit harim, deinnun turin tattain letatta minnayyhu, leillen ketiv, kum riv et heharim. deha radif matzutin, (tikkunin 53) it legabbayyhu. veal da it turin veit turin.

Vei tema, sava, ha ketiv vetishmana haggevaot, illen givot kol (102 amud bet, 129 amud bet) innun diltatta, vehasheta ant avid lon harim. ella hachi hu, legabbe innun turin ramain, ikrun givot. kad innun bilchodayyhu innun harim ikrun.

Ta chazi, ketiv vehaetanim mosde aretz, kevan dichtiv shimu harim, man innun harim, uman innun etanim. ella, harim veetanim kullehu chad. aval innun telat illain leella al reshayyhu. veinnun telat letatta minnayyhu. vechullehu chad. harim leella, vealayyhu amar david (Tehillim 121:1) essa eni el heharim. veillen innun telat kadmae. vehaetanim mosde aretz, illen innun telat batrae, letatta minnayyhu, tere samche beta, vechad chedva deveta, veillen ikrun mosde aretz. etanim innun, veetanim ikrun.

Sava sava, ha yadat, man deaggach kerava, i la yada leistammera, la yintzach keravin, itzterich lemachaa bideh, uleistammera berayoneh, ma dihe chashiv achara, dihe chashiv ihu, veyad yemina zemina tadir lemachaa. umachashavoy vida semalit, zemina tadir lekabbela uleistammera, vimina kolla.

Hasheta amart vehaetanim, etanim innun letatta, veharim leella. istammar sava, deha rayona achara lokovlach, dichtiv, (Tehillim 89:1) maskil leetan haezrachi. veda ihu avraham sava, veikre etan, vei avraham ihu etan, yitzchak veyaakov etanim ikrun. kum sava, deha yadat rayona da have mache lerayonach.

(Bamidbar 24:21) veyissa meshalo vayyomar etan moshavecha vesim bassela kinnecha. etan: da (119 amud bet, balak 14 amud alef) boker deavraham. vehayeynu, (Bereshit 45) habboker or. da ammuda, dechol alma kayyeyma aleh, unehiru dileh meavraham yarit. nahar hayyotze meeden ikre. i sava sava, ha rayona achara lokovlach, vela yadat leistammera, hechi maggichin kerava. sava, an hu tukepa dilach, vadday (Kohelet 9:11) lo laggibborim hammilchama.

Ketiv maskil leetan haezrachi, uchetiv maskil ledavid, da nahar hayyotze meeden, deihu turegman ledavid, leodaa leh, meinnun millin setimin illain. i maskil ihu nahar denafik meeden. etan haezrachi avraham, ihu leella vadday, ha yedana. veaf al gav daana sava, al rayona da machena. etan haezrachi, terin dargin innun. kema deat amer, boker or. or, hu avraham. (Vayikra 6 amud alef, 22 amud bet) boker hu nahar. uf hachi, etan haezrachi, ezrach, hu avraham. etan, kema deittemar, da hahu nahar denaged venafik meeden.

Hasheta sava, kum kaim al retichach, dehashta tinpol vela tichul lemekam. ha shelomo malka, ate becheloy uretichoy vegavroy ufarashoy, veate lokovlach, kum pok min chakla, dela yishkach lach tamman. ketiv (Melachim 1 8:2) vayyikkahalu el hammelech shelomo kol ish yisrael beyerach haetanim bechag vegomer. yerach deityelidu beh haetanim, uman innun. avahan, veinnun etane olam. vayyarach da, ihu tishre. dealfa beta ahdar lemafrea mittatta leella.

Vetu mimmillach, yeot detippok min chakla, vela tishtechach tamman. ilu ketiv maskil etan haezrachi kidkaamart. hasheta dichtiv maskil leetan haezrachi. let keravach kelum, vetippok min chakla, beal karchach vela titchaze tamman.

I sava anya miskena, hechi teppok. i hachi, yintzechun lach vetaarok min chakla, kol bene alma yirdefun avatrach, velet lach anpin leitchazaa kame bar nash lealmin. hacha omena, dela ippok min chakla, vehacha itchaze anpin beanpin bishlomo malka, vechol ish yisrael, veguverin ufarashin uretichin dileh. kudesha berich hu yesayyea lach sava, deha lae chela ant. kum sava itgabbar bechelach veittakkaf, dead yoma da havet gibbar takkif beguverin.

Patach veamar, maskil leetan haezrachi. ellu ketiv maskil ledavid, kidkaamart, aval maskil leetan, it maskil veit maskil. it maskil leella, veit maskil (Bereshit 16 amud bet) letatta. maskil leetan bezimna dehahu nahar, kam betiuveta kol shayyfin chadan umitchabberan legabbeh, vei hu salik, ad democha illaa itpayyays legabbeh, vechadde lokovleh. ucheden maskil leetan haezrachi, maskil leh, veoda leh al yeda deavraham (sefer acher al yedoy deavraham) rechimoy, kol ma deitzterich, vehahu mocha illaa maskil leetan. vechad david malka, ittakkan betiuveta legabbeh, ihu maskil ledavid. kema dehava mocha illaa, maskil leh. veal da, it maskil, veit maskil. (it maskil).
Beyerach haetanim, deityelidu beha yerach etanim, binyana letatta ihu kegavvna dilella, veityelidu beh harim veetanim. harim setimin. etanim: yarchin takkifin kinchasha, vehahu etan benayyhu.
