Kum sava, have mache lechol sitrin, beshaata desalik moshe lekabbela orayyta, masar leh kudesha berich hu shivin maftechan deorayyta. kad mata letisha (veshittin) vechamshin, hava chad maftecha ganiz vesatim, dela hava masar leh, itchannan lekameh. amar leh, moshe, kol maftechan illain vetattain behay maftecha talyayn. amar lekammeh, mareh dealma, ma shemeh. amar leh etan. vechol innun etanim beh talyayn, uveh kayyman levar miggufa detora shebbichtav ihu. oda leh, umaskil leh, ihu ikara umaftecha detora shebbichtav.

Vechad ittaknat tora shebbeal pe legabbeh, ikara dehechala hu maftecha (Bereshit 37 amud bet) dilah, (legabbeh) vadday keden maskil ledavid. umiggo (118 amud bet) deyarta tora shebbeal pe, (legabbeh) atvavn lemafrea. al da ikre tishre 900 ihu, aval begin deihu raza dishma kaddisha chatim beh kudesha berich hu, at dishmeh 10. bammizbeach, chatim beh Adonai, harshet ad chatzi hammizbeach. atat devora, vechatim beh 6, vehayeynu dichtiv, (Shoftim Adonai:1) vattashar devora. uvaatar da, chatimu dishma kaddisha, deachtim beh.

Vehahu maftecha, kad patcha battora shebbeal pe, baenan leishtemoda leh, veda ihu (47 amud bet) tanya, etan moshavecha, barayyta levar miggufa. etanim: innun tannaim. ammudim samchin, levar miggufa. hasheta it leodaa milla, bezimna deillen legabbe tora shebbichtav, ikrun etanim. legabbe tora shebbeal pe, ikrun tannaim. etan, legabbe tora shebbichtav. tanya, legabbe tora shebbeal pe. vecholla kadka yeot.

Chavrayyay, ha ana bechakla. shelomo malka, veguverin takkifin dileh. yeyte veyishkach chad sava, lae bechela, takkif gibbar, natzach keravin. ha yedana deata, vekayyeyma levatar tinra dechakla, vehu ashgach bi, vehech gevureti kayyeyma bechakla, bilchodoy ashgach, deihu ish shalom, mareh dishlama, veazal leh. hasheta sava, gevuretach alach, veant bilchodach bechakla, tuv leatrach. veshari zinach mealach.

(Davar acher keman denafik min chakla) (Micha 6:2) shimu harim et riv Adonai vehaetanim mosde aretz. shimu harim kidkamran. vehaetanim mosde aretz, mosde aretz vadday, deha minnayyhu ittezan, uminnayyhu kabbil kol yoma, veinnun mosde aretz.

(Micha 6:2) ki riv laAdonai im ammo, man hu deyachil lemekam beriv dekudesha berich hu (kol shekken) beyisrael. veal da amar leillen, shimu harim et riv Adonai, da ihu matzuta chada. kum riv et heharim, matzuta tinyayna. denatzach behu kudesha berich hu, kol illen rivot leyisrael, vechol innun tochachot, kullehu keabba deochach livrih, veha ukemuha.

Beyaakov ketiv, beshaata devaa lenatztzecha bahadeh, ma ketiv, (Hoshea 12:3) veriv laAdonai im yehuda velifkod al yaakov. ma riv ihu, kema dichtiv, (Hoshea 12:4) babbeten akav et achiv. al hay milla ata tochacha, vechol innun rivot. vechi lav milla ravreva ihu, babbeten akav et achiv vegomer. hay lav milla zeira ihu, may deavid babbeten. vechi ukeva avid babbeten, in vadday.

Sefer acher (nusach acher veha ittemar) (aval) becholla, dacha yaakov leesav achuy, begin dela yehe leh chulaka kelal. esav la hitraam ella mechad deinnun teren, dichtiv, (Bereshit 27:36) vayyakeveni ze faamayim. faamayim mibbae leh, may ze. ella, chad deakish litren. chad denafak litren. umay nihu. bechorati ithappechu atvavn, vahava birkati. ze faamayim: chad, deittekash litrin.

Vela yada esav ma deavad leh babbeten, aval rav memana dileh yada hava, vekudesha berich hu argish shemayya vcheylayyhu lekala da, deha beracha uvechora la tava memana dileh, vela amar. deha beracha hava leh lemitba, vela tava. achuha ha tava vday, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 58:7) umibbesarcha lo titallam vela baa yaakov lemehav leh lemechal, ad denatal minne bechorata dileh.

May bechora natal minneh, habbechora dilella vetatta. bechora chaser 6. keden akav et achiv, vday deavad leh ukeva, vearme leh laachora. may achora. akdim leh, deyippuk bekadmita lehay alma. amar yaakov leesav, tol atta hay alma bekadmita, vana levatar.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv, (Bereshit 25:26) veachare chen yatztza achiv veyado ochezet baakev esav. may baakev esav. vechi salleka datach dehava achid yedeh beragleh, lav hachi. ella, yado ochezet beman dehahu dehava akev, umanno esav. deha esav akev ikre, mishaata deakav leh leachuy, umiyyoma deitbere alma akev kare leh kudesha berich hu, dichtiv, (Bereshit 3:15) hu yeshufecha rosh veatta teshufennu akev. ant deikre akev, teshufennu bekadmita. ulevassof hu deyimche reshach mealach. umanno. samael. deihu resha dechivya, demache behay alma.

Veal da babbeten akav et achiv, shavi aleh lemehevi akev, venatal esav hay alma bekadmita, vda raza dichtiv, (Bereshit 36:31) veelle hammelachim asher malchu beeretz edom lifne melach melech livne yisrael. vda ihu raza deamar shelomo malka, (Mishlei 20:21) nachala mevohelet barishona veacharitah lo tevorach, besof alma.

Veal da (Hoshea 12:4) babbeten akav et achiv uveono sara et elohim. may veono. hachi amru bechela vetukepa dileh yeot, aval lav hachi. beriru demilla, yaakov diyyukena illaa hava, vegufa kaddisha. delet gufa miyyoma dehava adam harishon, kegufa deyaakov, veshufereh deadam harishon, hahu shufereh mammash hava leh leyaakov. vediyyukeneh deyaakov, diyyukena deadam harishon mammash.

Adam harishon, beshaata chivya deata veitpatta al yedoy, yachil chivya leh. may tama. begin dela hava tukepa leadam harishon, vead kean la ityylid man dehava tukepa dileh. umanno tukepa deadam harishon. da shet, dehava bediyyukena deadam harishon mammash, dichtiv, (Bereshit Adonai:3) vayyoled bidmuto ketztzalmo vyyikra et shemo shet. may bidmuto ketztzalmo. dehava mahul. vechad ata memana deesav legabbe deyaakov, kevar ityelid tukepa deyaakov, deihu yosef. vezehu uveono sara et elohim. (ad kan matzati)

Hay kala deitteta, deyachla kala dechivya leachada bah, kechalba bechalbeta, man ihu. ella ta chazi, delet bechol kalin denashin dealma, deyachla kala dechivya leitdabbeka bah, uleitachada bah, uleishtattefa bah. ella terin nashin innun deyachla kala dechivya leitachada behon, chada. hay dela netirat soavut niddutah, vime libbunah, kedka yeot, o deakdimat yoma chada litbol. vachada, hay itteta dimachret levalah ona dilah lemebad tzaara levalah, bar i ihu la chayish, vela ashgach leda.

Illen innun teren nashin, deha kema deakdimu, hachi innun mitacharan, legabbe kala denachash, ad deadbik kala bekala, uchema demitacharan lemebad tzaara levalah (baavoda) beikkuva demitzva, hachi akdim kala denachash, leitdabbeka behahi kala deitteta. veillen innun teren nashin, dekala denachash achid bekala dilhon, kechalba bechalbeta, siuveta batar siuveta, zina batar zineh.

Veim tomar, ma ichpat lan, i achid kala bekala, i lo achid. vavy dehachi mitabbedan bene alma belo data. hay kala deitteta, kad itarav veishtattaf bahade kala denachash, beshaata dechayyayvat umarshaat nafkat miggo efa umeshatteta bealma, i arat behane teren kalin, kala denachash, vekala deitteta, veitteta itchammemat behu, veinnun bah, vechevan (sefer acher dametachemamen rucha azlin bahadah) deitchammemat, mitabbedin rucha, veaglim bahadah, ad dimshatteta, veal bimaha dehay itteta.

Vehay yannoka diylidat, kad atat hahi chayyayvta, pekidat leh lehahu rucha, deihu chibbura bisha, kala denachash, dimkashkesha bah, veihu mechayycha binnoka, ad deatat hahi chayyayvta, keitteta defakidat bera leitteta achara, umefatfetet leh vechayyeychat leh, befitputa ad detete immeh. kach avda hay rucha. uzemanin saggiin, deihu shelicha dehahi chayyayvta, vekatla leh, hada hu dichtiv, (Kohelet 4:1) umiyyad oshkehem koach. vela kema deattun amrin. ella hahu koach dehahu rucha, veal da, terin zimnin ketiv behay kera, veen lahem menachem. chad millilit chayyayvta, vechad mehahu rucha.
I sava, hasheta it lach rechimin, veat mishtae, keman dela chamit innun maggiche kerava, ha kullehu bishlama immach. hasheta mikkan ulehala, la ade minnay mane kerava bedil leadkera shemi.

Hahu chattat rovetz, kaim al pitcha kechalba. bezimna dekala batrayyta, deyahivat itteta, nafik, ihu dalig meal pitcha veitavar mittamman, veazil avatrah. may tama. begin dekudesha berich hu shadar chad maftecha dileh, vekala parcha, umaftecha atya, vechivya azal batar kala dehu nafik lealma, vead tura devitna azil, umechashkesha, ad iddan deitnekiat, mehahu zuhama, dinshichin dechivya bisha. vekudesha berich hu, mesabbev sivuvin, veavid ovadin kadka yeot.

Vechol da, begin dehahu beten itdachya. ha vadday, itdachya mehahu beten, velet leh chulaka, veitdache mibbeten diltatta, dishar neshin dealma deaf al gav deavid tzaar la ityeyhiv leh reshu leshalletaa beh. uman beten ityeyhiv leh, veihu shalit aleh. hahu beten desota, dichtiv, (Bamidbar Adonai:27) vetzavta vitnah, begin dehay beten, avid beh nukemin liruteh, vehay beten dileh ihu, vekudesha berich hu yahiv leh begin dela itdache mikkolla. hasheta rechimin dili, atzitu. la chamena lechu, umallilna lechu. (Kohelet 1:8) kol haddevarim yegeim, la yachil inish lemallela, afillu millin deorayyta yegeim innun.

Ketiv, (Bereshit lak) vayyivvater yaakov levaddo vayyeavek ish immo, uchetiv vayyar ki lo yachol lo vayyigga bechaf yerecho. vehahu yarech deravavch miyyaakov. vehahu yarech bachalishu dileh (Bereshit nusach acher amud bet, 144 amud alef) ad deata shemuel. may bachalishu dela mashich nevua. kad ata shemuel, natal hahu yarech, vesalkeh mehahu atar, vechataf leh minneh, umehahu zimna itade minneh, vela hava leh chulaka bikdusha kelal.

Kudesha berich hu la kafach, vela dache leh mikkolla, begin denatal shemuel yarech dileh, ella yahiv leh chulaka chada. may ihi. yahiv leh hahu yarech uveten desota, cholaf hahu yarech uveten, deade minneh. veal da tarvavyyhu yahiv leh kudesha berich hu, lemehve atra dekudsha panuy mikkol saavuta.

Velanpil yarech. mahu velanpil, venafla yerechah velatzbot, vetzavta yerechah mibbae leh. ella, keman deashde garma lechalba, veamar leh, tol hay lechulakach. umikkolla la avish kameh, ella degazlu (sefer acher deappiku) minneh yarech, begin deihu yaga velae aleh, veravavch leh veappiku leh minneh. veal da, kudesha berich hu appil leh, garma da desota, veappik leh kidkamran, uveda ihu ravvi vechadde.

Kol innun retichin vesiyyayta dileh, baan tadir yarech, veazle bechisufa avatreh. uvegin da, (112 amud bet) hane barchi derabbanan deshalhe, min da ihu. dechol kissufa dilhon, batar yarech ihu, vechol shekken yarech derabbanan, vechol milla ahdar leatreh, vekudesha berich hu la gara kelum, mikkol ma deitzterich, vela baa deyikrav likdusha, bar immeh veadveh chulakeh veachasanteh. kema deavid kudesha berich hu leella, hachi avde yisrael letatta, vehachi itzterich lemebad, vehachi tanenan, asir leh leyisrael, lemelaf orayyta leovde kochavim umazzalot, dichtiv, (Tehillim 147:20) maggid devarav leyaakov vegomer, lo asa chen lechol goy vegomer.

Veal da dache leh yaakov, vedache leh shemuel, dela yehe leh chulaka bikdusha. uvegin da, kol netiru devavu leyisrael, al da ihu. lechalba dechatif ofa dachya min shoka, veayyte leh, vead la ittevar, ata chad bar nash vechatfa minneh, levatar yahiv leh chad garma gerira bela toalta.

Kacha lesaro shel esav, appiku leh mehahu beten, chatifu minneh hahu yarech. levatar yahavu leh garma chad, hahu beten vehahu yarech desota, vela ochora. ha garma, deka yahavu leh lechulakeh veadveh, vearav leh. ubbegin kach, kol dinin dekudesha berich hu dinin dikshot innun, uveni nasha la yadin, vela mashgichin lekudesha berich hu. vechullehu beorach keshot. hi astiat garmah mibbalah, kema deat amer (Mishlei 2:17) haozevet alluf neureha vegomer, uf hachi itteta, kegavvna dilah beara.

Ta chaze, man deashkach chavra kevavteh, deavid keovadoy bealma, rachim leh, veitdabbak bahadeh, veavid immeh tivu. aval sitra ochora lav hachi, kevan deashkach man deshavak sitra dikdusha dekudesha berich hu, veavid keovadoy, veitdabbak bah, keden baya leshetzaa uleappaka leh mealma. hay itteta, avdat keovadaha, veitdabbekat bah, chazi ma deavdat bah, vetzavta vitnah venafla yerechah. kudesha berich hu lav hachi, man deshavik lesitra ochora, veitdabbak beh bekudesha berich hu, keden rachim leh, veavid leh kol tivu dealma. hasheta sava atkin garmich, deha chivya azil leh, uvaa leitgara bahadach, vela yachil.

Patach veamar (Kohelet 1:3) ma yitron laadam bechol amalo sheyyaamol tachat hashshamesh, vechi la ata shelomo ella leolfa milla da. illu amar (sefer acher vechi ma ata shelomo malka leallafa bemilla da vetu ellu amar) baamalo sheyyaamol yeot, deha ishtear amal, deit beh yitron. ella kevan dichtiv bechol amalo, ha kelala decholla, dela ishtear kelum deit beh yitron.

Ella, lav lechol adam amar shelomo milla da, ella adam it bealma, deihu mishtaddel tadir bevish uleavashsha, vela ishtaddal betav afillu riga chada. veal da ketiv amalo, vela ketiv yegio. amalo: kema deat amer, (Tehillim 7:17) yashuv amalo verosho. (Bamidbar 23:21) velo raa amal beyisrael. yegio: kema deat amer (Tehillim 128:2) yegia kappecha ki tochel vegomer. uchetiv (Bereshit 31:42) veet yegia kappay raa elohim. aval amalo, ketiv, (Tehillim 10:14) amal vachaas. ishtaddeluteh hu tadir levish, veal da ihu tachat hashshamesh.

Beshaata dehay adam ishtaddal bevish, al hay ketiv, (iyyov 18:19) lo nin lo velo neched beammo vegomer, deha kudesha berich hu bae, dela yabid toladin, deilmale yabed toladin, hava metashtesha alma. veal da ketiv, ma yitron laadam bechol amalo. uman dela yishtaddal lemebad toladin, itdabbak behay sitra deadam bisha veal techot gadpoy.

Rut amra, (Rut 3:9) ufarasta chenafecha al amatcha, begin leizdavvevga bahadeh detzaddik, lemebad toladin, vekudesha berich hu paris gadpoy al bar nash, begin leappasha bealma. leman dela bae lemebad toladin, begappo yavo, begappo dehahu bish, deihu azil ariri, kechivya da, (95 amud alef) deazil yechiday. begappo yetze, (kema deat amar hasheta) ihu dela ishtaddal lemebad toladin, ha ittemar kol ma deitzterich. (sefer acher ta chaze, deit leahaddera sava, bemillin kadmain)

Riv deavad kudesha berich hu, ha ittemar, riv: dichtiv, (Micha 6:1) kum riv et heharim. may ihu. ella, innun turin diltatta. amay riv da. begin divhu talya, kol chova deavdin yisrael, legabbe avuhon devishmayya. may taama. begin deyisrael havo yadin shimmusha dechol malachin illain devishmayya, vela anis lehu, afillu shema dechad minnayyhu, vechol shimmusha dilhon.

Uvitren sitrin have taan avatrayyhu. chad, dahavo yadin leamshacha chela dilhon, dekochavayya umazzale beara. vechad, dahavo yade leumaa lon, bechol ma deitzterichu. veal da baa kudesha berich hu lemebad behu riv vedina. vechevan dibbehon leheve riv vedina, kol shilshula nafal deha la yeheve beh toalta. uvegin kach, kum riv vegomer. vetishmana haggevaot kolecha. man givot. illen innun immahot, (109 amud bet, 189 amud bet) dargin deikrun (Tehillim 45:15) betulot achareha vegomer, uvegin kach vetishmana haggevaot kolecha. dehachi havo avde yisrael, ad deishtattafu bedargin tattain. ta chaze, deit leahaddera sava, bemillin kadmain,

Dehachi havo avde yisrael, ad deishtattafu bedargin tattain yarech deka amaran, saggi atkifu lon yisrael, behahu yarech. mardechay hava achme lehahu rasha dehaman hahu yarech dileh, veal da hava ragiz, milla deitchaze leh, veihu argiz leh bahadeh. chamu chavrayyay, ma ketiv, (Bereshit 27:15) vattikkach rivka et bigde esav benah haggadol hachamudot vegomer. beillen levushin dileh, gazal dileh, veappik leh mikkol birkan dileh, umibbechiruta.

Uvegin kach, ila deka ashkachu retichin dileh, lerabbanan, ihu dechufeya dilhon lemane derabbanan tadir. (111) leyarchin dilhon. ulemanin dilhon. veillen teren millin distar achara havo, vechol da begin degazlu lon minneh. let lehu ila ella lerabbanan. uvegin kach, hane mani derabbanan deka balu mechufeya dilhon ihu, vehani barchi deshalhe, minnayyhu hu vadday. umiddilhon havo, uminnehon natle ila, umimma dahavo minnayyhu. baan lerabbanan, deinnun kelala dehahu yoshev ohalim, veal da let ila bela ila, veal da let milla, bela dina, vechol milla tav leatreh.

Shelomo amar, (Kohelet 4:1) veshavti ani vaere et kol haashukim asher naasim tachat hashshamesh vehinne dimat haashukim veen lahem menachem umiyyad oshkehem koach veen lahem menachem. hay kera armizna beh, (111 amud bet) veittemar. aval shavti ani, vechi mean atar tav shelomo. i nima, levatar deamar milla da, tav kemilkaddemin, veamar milla ochora, yeot aval shavti vaere (Vayikra 233 amud alef).

Tamman tanenan, bechol yoma hava akdim shelomo betzafra, vahave shavve anpoy listar mizrach, vechame ma dechame, ulevatar tav listar darom, vechame ma dechame vehadar tav listar tzafon, vekaim tamman. maich enoy vezakif resheh.

Behay shaata, ha ammuda deeshsha veammuda daanana, havo atyayn, veal hahu ammuda daanana, hava ate nishra chada. vehahu nishra hu ravreva vetakkif, vechen hava ate, gadpa yemina, al gabbe ammuda deeshsha, vegufa vegadpa semala, al gabbe ammuda daanana. vehahu nishra havi mayyte teren tarfin befumaha, ata ammuda daanana, veammuda deeshsha, vehahu nishra alayyhu, vesagdin lekameh deshlomo malka.

Ata nishra, umaich lekameh, veyahiv leh innun tarfin, natil lon shelomo malka, vahava meriach behu, vahava yada behon siman, veamar da ihu denofel, veda ihu digluy enayim. beshaata ditren tarfin havo, hava yada detarvavyyhu, (balak Rosh Chodesh amud alef) nofel ugeluy enayim baan leodaa leh millin.

Ma avid, chatim kurseyeh begushepanka, dehava chakik beh shema kaddisha. veihu natil izka dechakik aleh shema kaddisha, vesalik leigra, verachiv al hahu nishra, veazil leh. vehahu nishra, hava mistallak, lerum ananin, uvechol atar deihu avar, hava itchashach nehora. chakkime dahavo behahu atar deitchashach nehora, havo yade, vahavu amre, shelomo malka ha azil, veabar hacha, vela yade lean atar hava azil. tippeshin dahavo tamman, havo amre, ananin havo innun, deka azle vechashich alma.

Gava nishra bahadeh, ufarach arba mea parsin, ad demata leture chashoch. vetamman ihu tarmud bammidbar beharim, veihu nachit tamman. zakif resheh, vechame tura chashoch, vahava yada tamman kol ma deitzterich. vahava yada detamman yeul. hava rachiv al nishra kemillekadmin, vetas veal lego turin, ad hahu atar dezeta taman, kara bechela veamar, (Yeshayahu 26:11) Adonai rama yadcha bal yechozayun vegomer.

Al tamman, ad dekariv lehahu atar, shavve izka kamayyhu, vekariv, vetamman hava yada kol ma devae meinnun chachmetan nucherain, devae leminda. kevan dahavo amrin leh kol ma devae, keden hava rachiv al hahu nishra, vetav leatreh. kevan dehava yativ al kuresyeh, ityayshshav bedateh vahava memallel bedateh millin dechachmeta yakkira. behahi shaata hava amar, veshavti ani vaere, shavti vadday mehahu archa, shavti mehahi chachmeta, veityeyshavit belibbay uvedatay. ucheden vaere et kol haashukim. vechi zeirin innun bealma deihu amar et kol haashukim

(Nusach acher salleka datach dechol ashikin dahavo bealma, hava chame shelomo malka.) ella, may ashukim illen dehu amar. innun yenokin demetin betukefa deimmehon, deka ashukim mikkamma sitrin, ashukim baatar illaa dilella, vaashukim letatta. veha chavrayyay ittearu, vehachi hu, aval saggiin innun. kum sava, ittear bechelach. sava ema milach, devadday bela dechilu tema.
Let ashuk keinnun ashukim, dehava ihu ashik bekadmita, o mittelata leochora, kema dichtiv, (Shemot 20:Adonai) poked avon avot al banim veal bene vanim al shilleshim veal ribbeim.

Hecha hava ashik. shelomo malka tzavavch veamar (Mishlei 28:17) adam ashuk bedam nafesh ad bor yanus al yitmechu vo. kevan dehu ashuk, bedam nefesh, hu, o beno, o ben beno, yehon ashukin betikla, dichtiv ad bor yanus al yitmechu vo. ad hahu bor rak yanus meatar kaddisha, veal yitmechu bo behay alma. kevan deihu ashuk bedam nefesh, ihu, o zareh, lehevo ashukim mehahu sitra ochora.

It ashuk, mishshear ashukim, kema deat amer (Vayikra 19:13) lo taashok et reacha. ihu avar veashak, ihu ashuk bivnoy, mehahu sitra ochora. ubbegin kach amar, et kol haashukim. amar shelomo, kaimna bechol innun ashukim, bechol sitrin daashak.
Vaamay innun ashukim. asher naasu tachat hashshamesh. asher naasu, asher garu mibbae leh, may asher naasu. i asiyyay ihi lishvacha, lav asiyyay dilhon ella leella min shimsha.

Aval vadday naasu. hech naasu. ella kevan deashukim meruchehon tamman, amay atyayn lehay alma. ella ruchin vadday naasu, itavidu beruchin uvegufa behay alma, kevan deishtachlal gufa dilhon, veitavid hahu rucha begufa zach venaki bela lichlucha dechovin, behay alma, keden itashak gufa, kema deitashak rucha. vehay ihu gufa, deithane beh yattir mikkolla. vaashukin acharanin it, bechamma zinin meruchin tamman, vela naasu begufin. aval illen, innun ashukim asher naasu.

It acharanin, asher naasu, veatrachu bene nasha lemarehon. uman ihu. man deashik itteta dechavreh bitmiru, o beitgalleyay. vehahu valda deityelid minnayyhu, ashuk ihu, bela reuta demarihon, vela yada balah deitteta, innun ovadin ashukin innun, veatrachu lekudesha berich hu lemebad lon gufa, uletzayyeyra lon tzura, illen ashukim asher naasu. asher naasu vadday gufin dilhon, al karcha. begin kach, shelomo malka amar, (Kohelet 4:1) vaere et kol haashukim, bechol zine ashukim kaimna, innun asher naasu veitavidu baasiyyay.

Kema dehane (davar achar ihu baarla, eno rabbi veavid ulevatar ashkin leh minna hachi) innun ashukin, dechvar naasu bearla rabbe venatil vegadil gufa, veavid leh, ulevatar ashkin lon minneh, venatlin lon, hare ashukim asher naasu, veal kolla kaim shelomo malka veamar, kaimna al kol haashukim asher naasu.

Vehinne dimat haashukim, kolla oshdin dimin, im taana kame kudesha berich hu. hane oshdin dimin, deha arla rabbe lon, vegadil lon, ad 13 shenin, ulevatar ashkin lon mearla, venatil lon kudesha berich hu, ha lach ashukin asher naasu kevar.

Avar avera katlin leh. lon it taana, uzeminin lomar, mare dealma, tinok bar yomeh dechav, dayynin leh dina. ana bar yomeh havena, deha (98 amud bet) mehahu yoma kare leh kudesha berich hu ben, dichtiv (Tehillim 2:7) Adonai amar elay beni atta ani hayyom yelidticha, mareh dealma, yelid bar yoma, dina avdin leh, hare dimat innun haashukim veen lahem menachem.

Veit ashuk acher, hahu ashuk deikre mamzer, kad nafak mealma, miyyad mafrishin leh mikkehillata deamma kaddisha. hahu mamzer, anya miskena, oshid dimin kame kudesha berich hu, veatin kameh, mareh dealma, i avahatay chavu, ana ma chova avidna, ha ovaday, mittakkenan lekammach havo, vehinne dimat haashukim veen lahem menachem. vechen lechol innun ashukim, it lon taana kame kudesha berich hu, umehahi taana let lon menachem, velet deyativ milla al libbehon.

Uma deamar (et kol haashukim) vehinni dimat haashukim, illen innun demetin betukefa deimmehon, illen avdin leoshada dimin, lechol bene alma, begin delet dimin denafke millibba, kehane dimin, dechol beni alma tavvhin veamrin, dinin dekudesha berich hu keshot innun, veal orach keshot azle. hani miskene yenuke dela chavu, amay mitu. an dina dikshot, deavid mare alma. i bechove avahathon istalleke mealma, amay. vadday en lahem menachem.

Tu, vehinne dimat haashukim, hahu dima dilhon behahu alma, deka meginnin al chayyaya. ditnan atar it mittakna lon behahu alma, deafillu tzaddikim gemurim la yachlin lekayyeyma taman, vekudesha berich hu rachim lon, veitdabbak behu, veatkin behu, (96 amud bet) metivta illaa dileh. vealayyhu ketiv, (Tehillim 8:3) mippi ollim veyonkim yissadta oz. umay toalta avdin tamman, vaamay sallekin tamman. dichtiv, (Tehillim 8:3) lemaan tzorrecha lehashebit oyev umitnakkem. vechen it atar ochora levaale tiyyuveta. (tachzor leel daf 106 tanenan let milla)

Tanenan, asara devarim itberiu beerev shabbat kulei. hakketav vehammichtav vehalluchot. dichtiv vehalluchot maase elohim hemma vehammichtav michtav elohim hu. may irya middehachi deerev shabbat hava, vedilma elef shenin levatar, o beshaata dekayymu yisrael al tura desinay. ella, vadday hachi hu deberev shabbat hava. ta chaze, bechol ovada divreshit, la ittemar shem male, ella elohim, elohim, bechol ma deitbere. vechullehu shem elohim, ad dechol ovada ishtachlal beerev shabbat. middeishtachlalu kol ovada, ikre Adonai elohim, shem male.

Veaf al gav divshem elohim itbere kolla, la ishtachlal baasiyya, kol ma deitbere, ad erev shabbat. behahi shaata ishtachlal kolla baasiyya, dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:2) melachto asher asa. mikkol melachto asher asa. vekayyeyma bemaase. veal da ketiv, vehalluchot maase elohim, kad ishtachlal alma, beshem elohim bemaase, vela levatar, dichtiv Adonai elohim uveda ishtachlal alma, vekayyeyma al kiumeh.

Ta chaze, behahi shaata detavar moshe halluchot, dichtiv, (Shemot 32:19) vayshabber otam tachat hahar. tzaf okyaynus meatreh, vesalik leshattefa alma. chama moshe deokyaynus salik legabbayyhu, vahava bae leshattefa alma, miyyad vayyikkach et haegel asher asho vayyisrof oto baesh vegomer, vayyizer al peni hammayim. kam moshe al me okyaynus veamar, mayya mayya ma attun baan. amru vechi itkayyaym alma ella beorayyta deluchot, veal orayyta deshakru bah yisrael (davar acher vaavadu egla dedahava, anan baan leshattefa alma.)

Miyyad amar lon, ha kol ma deavdu bechova deegla, ha masir lechon, vela day kol innun alfin denaflu minnayyhu, miyyad vayyizer al peni hammayim. la havo mishtachche mayya, ad denatil mayya minnayyhu veashke lon, miyyad ishteka okyaynus beatreh.

Deha behahu midbar la havo mayya, dichtiv, (Bamidbar 20:Adonai) lo mekom zera vegomer. umayim ayin lishtot. vei tema, levera demiryam armi leh. chas veshalom, detamman shade moshe duchrana bisha da lemishte levatar. vetu, dead kan la hava lehu bera, ad deatu lemidbar mattana, dichtiv, (Bamidbar 21:18) beer chafaruha sarim vegomer. umimmidbar mattana. mittamman yartu bera. ketiv hacha al pene hammayim, uchetiv hatam (Bereshit 1:2) al peni tehom.

Charut al halluchot, may charut al halluchot. hachi ukemuha, cherut mimmalach hammavet, cherut mishshibud malchiyyot, cherut mikkolla, hachi hu. umay charut. gushepanka dealma deate, deveh hava cherut, bechol mine cherut. veilmale la ittebaru, kol ma deata lealma levatar, la ata, vahavu yisrael diyyukena demalachin illain dilella. veal da achriz kera veamar, vehalluchot maase elohim vegomer, la tema dilvatar dealma ishtachlal, veadkar shem male havo, ella beshaata deishtachlal beshem elohim, ad la yeul shabbat.

Hemma, may hemma. hippuch 50 havo. mitteren sitrin havo. chada beovada, vachada decherut leela, rashim leella lenatra lecholla. veal da 50. vehammichtav michtav elohim hu, eshsha uchama al gabbe eshsha chivvavra. michtav elohim hu, hayeynu dichtiv, (Bamidbar 18:23) veavad hallevi hu. charut kema deittemar, deha yovel kare charut, veavid cherut lechol almin.

Ad kan chavrayyay. mikkan vehala tindeun, deha sitra bisha, la shalta alayychu vaana yeva sava, kaimna kamayychu, leitteara millin illen, kamu innun, keman deittear mishshenateh, veishtetachu kameh, vela havo yachlin lemallela. levatar shaata bachu.

Patach rabbi chiyyay veamar, (Shir hashshirim 8:6) simeni chachotam al libbecha kachotam al zeroecha vegomer, simeni chachotam, beshaata deitdabbeka keneset yisrael bevalah, ihi amrat simeni chachotam, (vaychi 244 amud bet) archa dechotam, kevan deitdabbak behahu atar deitdabbak shavik beh kol diyyukeneh, af al gav dehahu chotam azil hacha vehacha, vela kayyeyma tamman, veha itavar minneh, kol diyyukeneh shavik tamman, vetamman kayyeyma. uf hachi amrat keneset yisrael, kevan deitdabbakna bach, kol diyyukeni lihave chakik bach, deaf al gav deezil hacha o hacha, tishkach diyyukeni chakik bach, vetidkar li.

Vechachotam al zeroecha, kema dichtiv, (Shir hashshirim 2:6) semolo tachat leroshi vimino techabbekeni, uf hachi, tehe diyyukeni chakik tamman. uvechen ehe bach mitdabbeka lealmin, vela itnneshe minach. ki azza chammavt ahava, takkifa kammavet ahava, betukefa takkif, kehahu atar desharya beh mota. ahava, hahu atar deikre ahavat olam.

Kasha chishol kina, uf hachi, deha illen shemahan, mehahu sitra innun. reshafeha rishpe esh, man innun rishpe illen. innun avnin umargelan tavan, deityelidu mehahu esh. shalhevet yah. mehahu shalhova, denafka mealma illaa, veitachada bichneset yisrael, lemeheve kolla chad yichuda, vaanan, ha ahava ureshafin deshalhova delibba avatrach, yehe raava, dediyyukena dilan, tehe chakuka belibbach, kema dediyyukena dilach chakkuk belibban. nashak lon, uvarich lon veazlu.

Kad matu legabbe derabbi shimon, vesachu leh kol ma deira lon, chadde vetavvav, amar, zakkain attun dezachitun lechol hay, uma havetun bahade arya illaa, gibbar takkif, dela havo kamma gibbarin legabbeh kelum, vela yedatun leishtemoda leh miyyad. tavavhna, ech ishtezavtun meonsha dileh, ella kudesha berich hu baa leshezava lechon, kara alayyhu, (Mishlei 4:18) veorach tzaddikim keor noga holech veor ad nechon hayyom. (Mishlei 4:18) belechtecha lo yetzer tzaadecha veim tarutz lo tikkashel. (Yeshayahu 60:21) veammech kullam tzadikim leolam yirshu aretz netzer mattaay maase yaday lehitpaer. (ad kan min rav yeva sava). <small>amru hamegayhaym matzanu rainu happekudim haelle baheatekavet hannimtzaot immanu hayyom mavetaaym lachen el na ysheytev hameayyneym alenu chattat. veim haatakevat madevaykavet yetakkenu hameavevat vayyasimu haakaveb lemishor vechaet hagehanevam keyad Adonai hattova alenu</small>
Zohar, Vayakhel 15: Kevan dehay rucha shara al alma, kol ruchin bishin, vechol mekatregin bishin, istalaku mealma vela baenan letzallaa al netura, begin deyisrael innun netirin behahu rucha, vesukkat shalom perisat gadfaha alayyhu, veinnun netirin mikkolla.

Vei tema, ha tanenan, dela yippuk bar nash yechiday, la belelya reviaa deshabbeta, vela belelya deshabbeta, uvae bar nash leistammera. veha amaran, divlelya deshabbeta netirin bene nasha mikkol mekatregin dealma, vela bainan letzallaa al netura.

Ta chaze, hachi hu vadday, lelya reviaa deshabbeta, baenan leistammera minnayyhu, may tama. begin dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:14) yehi meorot, meerat ketiv chaser, veha ukemuha, divgin dehi chasera, kama chavile tehirin itkelilan behay meorot. levavtin umeorot innun bigriuta desihara, vechullehu shallitin behahu lelya.

Belelya deshabbeta, kevan dechullehu mitbadran leaala benukeba deafra, dela yachlin leshalletaa, bae bar nash yechiday, leistammera. vetu, af al gav dela yachlin leshalletaa, itchazyayn lezimnin, uvar nash yechiday bae leistammera.

Milla da hachi tanenan, vei hachi geriuta dintura ihu. aval beshabbeta netiru ishtechach leamma kaddisha, vekudesha berich hu kad al shabbeta, meatter lechol chad vechad miyisrael, uvae deyinterun leh lehay itra kaddisha, deitattaru beh, veaf al gav deinnun la ishtechachu beyishshuva, lezimnin levar nash yechiday itchazun, veittera mazzaleh. veitzterich leh levar nash, leitattera beitra kaddisha, ulenatra leh.

Sof sof, netiru ishtechach behahu lelya leamma kaddisha, hoil vesukkat shalom perisa al amma, deha tanenan, bechol atar desukkat shalom ishtechach, sitra achara la ishtechach tamman. veal da netura ihu unetura shechiach.

Yoma deshabbeta, chedva ihu lecholla, vecholla itnetar leella vetatta. unehora (nusach acher unekuda) tattaa nahara lesalleka leella, bishfiru deitrin shivin chulakin yattir, vesava dechol savin ittear.

Keden kad salik nehora, amma kaddisha mekaddeme leve kenishta bilvush yekar bechedva, mitatteran beitra kaddisha dilella, behahu rucha dekayyeyma alayyhu letatta, meshabbechan beshirin vetushebchan, vesallekin tushebchan leella, veillain vetattain kullehu bechedva, umitatteran kullehu kachada. patche illae veamre, zakkain attun amma kaddisha beara, demarechon itattar alayychu, vechol chelin kaddishin, mitatterin beginechon.
Hay yoma, yoma denishmatin ihu, velav yoma degufa, begin deshultanu ditzrora denishmatin ihu, vekayyman illain vetattain kullehu beziuuga chada, beitra derucha yetera illaa kaddisha.
Zohar, Vayikra 30: (Vayikra 4:2) nefesh ki techota. ribbi abba patach, (Tehillim 44:18) kol zot baatnu velo shechachanucha velo shikkarnu bivritecha. kol zot baatnu, kol ellu bau alenu mibbae leh. ella kol dinin dilella atu alana. vela shechachanucha, vela anshena millule orayytach. mikkan olifna, kol man deanshe millule orayyta, vela bae lemile bah, keillu anshe lekudesha berich hu, deha orayyta kullah shema dekudesha berich hu havi.

Vlo shikkarnu bivritecha, dechol man dimshakker beh behay at kayyayma kaddisha derashim beh, keillu meshakker bishma demalka, begin dishma demalka itreshim beh bevar nash. ukera ochora ode beh behay kera, dichtiv, (Tehillim 44:21) im shachachnu shem elohenu vannifros kappenu leel zar. im shachachnu shem elohenu, kema deat amer velo shechachanucha (veda hi orayyta deihu sham elohenu). vannifros kappenu leel zar, kema deat amer, velo shikkarnu bivritecha. vecholla chad milla. may shikra hacha. defaris kappav lirshuta ochora, umeshakker behay berit. veal da orayyta achidat behay, dechol man denatir hay berit, keillu natir orayyta kullah, uman dimshakker behay, keillu meshakker beorayyta kullah.

Ta chazi, avraham ad la itgezar, ha la ittemar deihu natir orayyta, kevn deitgezar ma ketiv, (Bereshit 26:5) ekev asher shama avraham bekoli vayyishmor mishmarti mitzvotay chukkotay vetorotay. vecholla begin deitgezar, itreshim beh reshima kaddisha, venatir leh kedka yeot, salik leh keillu natar orayyta kullah. yitzchak uf hachi ketiv, (Bereshit 17:21) veet beriti akim et yitzchak. veal da orayyta ikre berit.

Ta chaze, yosef begin denatar leh lehay berit, vela baa leshakkera beh, zacha likara behay alma, velikara lealma deate. velo od, ella dekudesha berich hu ashre shemeh begavih, dichtiv, (Tehillim 81:6) edut bihosef samo. vezacha levirchata dehay alma, ulevirchata dealma deate.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, ketiv (Devarim 33:17) bechor shoro hadar lo vegomer. yosef begin denatir lehay berit, zacha beshor, deihu kadmaa lekarbena. amar leh ribbi yehuda, i hachi amay itberach bemilla deihi semala, bimina mibbae leh, deha ketiv (yechezkel 1:10) ufene shor mehassemol. amar leh begin deyagin al chove deyaravam.

Amar leh, raza olifna behay kera, dechevan deyosef natar leh lehay berit, dehay berit achid bitren dargin, veinnun teren dargin leella, bishmahan itkerun. veolifna befarashat para adumma, dehay para chad darga meinnun teren dargin illain havi, veziuuga defara shor ikre, veda hu bechor shoro hadar lo vekarne reem karnav hadar lo vday. velav hay keshor dealma, ella vekarne reem karnav. karna illaa hu al kol ochoranin, veal da bahem ammim yenaggach yachdav afse aretz.

Amar ribbi abba, mashma, dechol man denatir lehay at reshima kaddisha, innun teren dargin illain itkashsheran beh. lenatra leh becholla, uleattera leh bikara illaa. veal da zacha bitren (lecha lecha 93) malchu. chad hu. vechad beno. dechevan dishlomo malka itdebak bennashim nachriyyot, ityeyhiv malchuta leyaravam, val da berit chaviv mikkolla.

Begin kach amar ribbi shimon, hay bar nash deolid bar, itkeshshar bishchinta, dehi pitcha dechol pitchin (sefer acher vehay ravya deitgezar itkeshar bishchinta, dehi pitcha dechol kitrin) illain, pitcha deitkeshshar bishma kaddisha. (deamar rabbi shimon) vehahu dama denafik mehahu ravya, natir kame kudesha berich hu, uveshaata dedinin mitarin bealma, ashgach kudesha berich hu behahu dama, vesheziv alma. uvegin kach ketiv (Bereshit 17:12) uven shemonat yamim yimmol lachem kol zachar. uchetiv (Tehillim 90:10) veim bigvurot shemonim shana. vecholla bechad matkela salleka.

Tana behahu dama, zache alma leitbassema bechesed, vekayymin kullehu almin, dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 33:25) im lo veriti yomam valayla chukkot shamayim vaaretz vegomer. im lo veriti tinach. yomam valayla lamma.

Amar ribbi shimon, tanenan teren kitrin itachadan kachada, veinnun pitcha dechol shear kitrin, vetana, chad dina, vechad rachame, umitbasseman da beda, dechar venukeba. (sefer acher vetana chad dechar vechad nukeba, chad dina, vechad rachame) besitra didchura sharya chesed. (lecha lecha 94) besitra denukeba sharya dina. (uvegin kach) chad chivvavra vechad sumaka. uvegin leitbassema da beda, (begin kach) mitkashsheran da beda. vehay berit achid behu beyomam valayla, bedina vechesed. bedina bekadmita. ulevatar sharya beh bechesed, veitbesam becholla. veda hu berit deikre yomam valayla, deachid betarvavyyhu.

Uman dezache lenatra lehay berit kedka yeot, vela chate beh kol yomoy, achid behu beyomam valayla. vezache litren almin, alma da vealma deate. veal da ikre avraham shelim, dichtiv, (Bereshit 17:1) hithallech lefanay vehye tamim, veematay ikre shelim. kad zacha betarvavyyhu, beyomam valayla. dichtiv, (Tehillim 42:9) yomam yetzavve Adonai chasdo uvallayla shiro immi. vetarvvyyhu achasin avraham. vela itkayyeyma beh chesed bekiyyuma shelim, ad deitgezar. kevan deitgezar, itkayyaym beh, vzacha letarvvyyeyhu, veikre shelim.

Kema detanenan dichtiv, (Bereshit 18:1) vehu yoshev petach haohel kechom hayyom. petach haohel, da hu kitra asiraa demalka, deihu pitcha lechol mashkena kaddisha dishar kitrin, vkaryih david malka (lehay) pitcha (nusach acher tzedek), dichtiv, (Tehillim 118:19) pitchu li shaare tzedek, uchetiv ze hashshaar laAdonai. kechom hayyom. kad nahara nehiru dechesed, chulak adbeh, kema deyativ behay, yativ behay. ematay itkayyaymu beh, kad itgezar. uvegin kach ikre berit yomam valayla. tana ketiv, (Shemot 12:23) ufasach Adonai al happetach. may ufasach Adonai al happetach. desharya al hay pitcha chesed, leitbassema. uvegine kach velo yitten hammashchit vegomer.

Amar ribbi elazar, ha tanenan, giyyora kad itgezar veayil techot gadpe dishchinta, ikre ger tzedek vela yattir, ger tzedek vday, zache lemeal behahu kitra detzedek veat amart yomam valayla dezachu letarvavyyeyhu.

Amar leh rabbi shimon, elazar beri, la dame man deate misharsha kaddisha, umiggiza dikshot, leman deate miggiza bisha, umisharsha degaale bishin takkifin. beyisrael ketiv behu, (Yirmeyahu 2:21) veanochi netatich sorek kullo zera emet. beumot ovde avoda zara ketiv (yechezkel 23:20) asher besar chamorim besaram vezirmat susim zirmatam.

Uvegin kach, yisrael kaddishin zara dikshot, giza deitbesamu betura desinay, veitpesak minnayyhu kol zuhama, kullehu mitvassemin, vechullehu ayyle bekayayma kaddisha deyomam valayla, lemehevi shelemim becholla. aval beumot ovde avoda zara, kashya lemebar minnayyhu zuhama, vaafillu ad 3 darin. uvegin kach ger tzedek. vday.

Deamar rav hamenuna sava, umot ovde avoda zara, ad la itgezaru sharyayn bechitrin tattain dela kaddishin, veruach misava sharya alayyhu. kevan deitgeyayru veitgezaru, sharyayn bechitra kaddisha (shel shechinta) desharya al shear kitrin tattain, verucha kaddisha sharya alayyhu. aval yisrael, kaddishin bene kaddishin, degizin vesharashin, veitbesamu betura desinay, vealu bimhemnuta shelemata kaddisha. beshaata deitgezar sharya becholla, dichtiv, (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem chayyim kullechem hayyom.
Zohar, Vayikra 33: Tana. missitra deimma, nafkin gardinin nimusin kelifin, veachadin bekulefoy digvura, shaltin al rachame, kema deat amer (Bamidbar 16) hannoadim al Adonai, al Adonai mammash. ucheden ishtechachu almin chaserin, (sefer acher ketirin) dela shelemin, uketatuta itar bechullehu.

Vchad beni alma machsherin ovadehon letatta, mitbasseman dinin, umitavran, umitare rachame veshaltan al hahu bisha deittear min dina kashya. vechad mitaran rachame, chedva venichumin mishtakkechin, mishshum deshalitin al hahu bisha. hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 32:14) vyyinnachem Adonai al haraa. vayyinnachem mishshum (deshalta al haraa) deitkafya dina kashya, veshaltin rachame.

Tana, beshaata demitbasseman dinin, veshaltin rachame, kol kitra vechitra tav bekiyyumeh, umitbarchan kullehu kachada. vechad tayyvin kol chad vechad leatreh, umitbarchan kullehu kachada, umitbassema imma bekaldite gelifin vetayyvin lesitraha, keden ikre teshuva shelema, veitkappar alma, deha imma bechedvavta shelemata yatva, dichtiv, (Tehillim 113:9) em habbanim semecha, ucheden itkere yom hakkippurim, dichtiv beh (Vayikra 16:30) letaher etchem mikkol chattotechem. umitpatchin 50 tarin desitrin gelifin.

Tana, ketiv vehaya ki yechota veashem, mahu ki yechota, ulevassof veashem. ella hachi tana, ki yechota meinnun chovin deikrun chet, dichtiv mikkol chataot haadam. veashem: kema deat amer (Bamidbar Adonai:8) haasham hammushav laAdonai. veashem: vitakken, kelomar im yetakken ovadoy, veheshiv et haggezela asher gazal. amar ribbi yose mimmashma dichtiv veheshiv, vyashiv la ketiv ella veheshiv, veheshiv dayyka.

ohc: Ki menasse vegomer. veim tomar meatta ki lenassotenu ba Adonai navi ze, lamma yumat im devar Adonai befihu lenassot? venire ki maamar ki menasse lo ba lomar ki Adonai amar lannavi lomar kaddevarim haelle, ella ba latet taam lammoftim shennatan Adonai, veamar ki menasse vegomer, uchefi ze Adonai natan mofet ze lenassot.

O efshar ki leolam mofet veot ze lo asao Adonai lenassot, ella laasher yaggidu otot hashshamayim niflaim maase Adonai, venatan taam "ki menasse" teshuva lema sheyyomru yisrael: lamma Adonai lo hesir hammofet vehaot leval yitu yisrael meachare Adonai? laze amar ki menasse vegomer, laze hinniach haolam keminhago, aval zulat taam ze Adonai yaase leval techezakna yede reshaim velo yihye lo ot velo mofet.

rashi: Ki lo mimmotza. hashshemesh umimmaaravo, velo min hammidbarot sheattem mefarsim beshayyara leharebot mamon, lo vechol elle leharim keren:
targum: Arum let bar mini mimadincha vead maarva vela min tzippuna demadberaya umin deroma atar turaya:

rashi: Tachat hannaatzutz vegomer. rabbotenu darshu: tachat harshaim yaalu tzaddikim:
Naatzutz vsirpad – mine kotzim hem, kelomar: harshaim yovdu vehatztzaddikim yittelu memshaltam (Megila 10 2):
targum: Chalaf rashiaya vachalaf chayavaya yitkaymun dachale cheta vihe kodam Adonai leshum leat alam dela yifsok:

rashi: Pen tinnakesh. unkelos tirgem leshon mokesh, vaani omer shello chash ledakdek ballashon, shello matzinu nun bilshon yokesh, vaafillu laysod hannofel mimmennu, aval bilshon teruf vekishkush matzinu nun, "vearkuvate da leda nakshan" (Daniel Adonai); veaf ze ani omer "pen tinnakesh acharehem" – pen tittaref acharehem, lihyot karuch achar maasehem; vechen (Tehillim 109) "yenakkesh noshe lechol asher lo" – mekallel et harasha lihyot alav noshim rabbim veyihyu machazirin umitnakkeshin achar mamono:

Achare hishshamdam mippanecha. achar shettire sheashmidem mippanecha, yesh lecha latet lev mippene ma nishmedu ellu, mippene maasim mekulkalim shebbidehem, af atta lo taase chen shello yavou acherim veyashmiducha (80 sifre):

Echa yaavdu. lefi shello anash al avoda zara ella al zibbuach vekittur venissuch vehishtachavaa, kemo shekkatuv (Shemot 22) "bilti laAdonai levaddo" – devarim hannaasim laggavoah, ba velimmedcha chan sheim darkah shel aza leavdah bedavar acher, kegon poer lifor vezorek even lemarkulis, zo hi avodato vechayyav, aval zibbuach vekittur venissuch vehishtachavaa – afillu shello chedarkah chayyav (sanhedrin 60):
Mehachel chermesh bakkama. mishshenniktzar haomer shehu reshit hakkatzir (80 sifre; menachot amud alef):
ohc: Tachel lispor shiva shavuot. tzarich ladaat lamma kafal lomar "tispor shiva shavuot"? veulay ki ba lomar lahem: im lo haya kama lehachel bah chermesh uva min haaliyya (menachot fag:), af al pi chen tachel lispor shiva shavuot. veze leman deamar (rov poskim) sefirat haomer bazzeman hazze midderabbanan. aval leman deamar (282) deorayta, kafal hakkatuv lazzeman hazze.
Chassalat parashat raa

rashi: Ki lo machshevotay machshevotechem. en shelli veshellachem shavot, lechach ani omer lachem yaazov rasha darko, veyitpos et darki:

Veish aven machshevotav, veyitpos et machshevotay laasot hattov beenay. umidrash aggada (tanchuma Buber vayyeshev 11): ki lo machshevotay vegomer en dini kedine basar vadam: attem, mi shemmode baddin mitchayyev, aval ani "mode veozev yerucham" (Mishlei 28:13):
targum: Are la machshevatay machshavatchon vela orchatchon takanan keorchat tuvi amar Adonai:

rashi: Hen goy lo teda tikra. leshimmushach, im elay tishmeu, leshem Adonai hannikra alecha:
targum: Ha am dela teda yiflechinach veam dela yeduch yirhatun leasaka lach misin bedil Adonai elahach ulekadisha deyisrael are shabbechach:

rashi: Lagger asher bisharecha. ger toshav shekkibbel alav shello laavod aza veochel nevelot (sifre):
Ki am kadosh atta laAdonai. kaddesh et atzmecha bammuttar lecha – devarim hammuttarim vaacherim nohagim bahem issur, al tattirem bifnehem (sham):
Lo tevashshel gedi. shalosh peamim, perat lechayya uleofot velivhema temea (chullin 113):
ohc: Lo tochlu chol nevela vegomer. amro chol, leman deamar issur chal al issur (chullin 113:) yirtze lerabbot kol hammitnabbel ben tehorim ben hattemeim baa alehem azharat "lo tochlu chol nevela", uleman deamar en issur chal al issur amro chol merabbe kol min tahor ben behema ben chayya ben of, aval temea lo.

Od yirtze beamro chol al pi ma sheamru bammishna (meila 4,3) ufesako rambam perek 4 mehilchot maachalot asurot veze leshono: kol hannevelot mitztarfim ze im ze vechulei, ketzad? hallokeach minnivlat hashshor venivlat hatztzevi venivlat hattarnegol vekibbetz min hakkol kazzayit basar vaachalo – loke, ad kan. vehu maamar lo tochlu chol nevela, perush shemmazhir al shiur achila shehu kazzayit habbaa mikkol davar hammitnabbel, hagam sheen hazzayit ba ella mishshelashtam yachad.

Lagger asher vegomer. hikdim zichron hagger lezichron hannetina, uvenachri hikdim zichron hammechira lezichron hannachri. bemassechet chullin (chullin 114:) heviu bemachloket rabbi meir verabbi yehuda. rabbi meir sover shebba hakkatuv ledabber beseder ze lehattir netina legoy umechira leger, velaze samach netina umechira yachad. verabbi yehuda sover haddevarim kichtavan mittaam sheamar kera "o machor" velo amar "umachor". verabbi meir meyashshev tevat "o" lehakedim netina deger limchira degoy. vetzarich ladaat lisvarat rabbi yehuda lamma dibber hakkatuv beseder ze. veyitbaer al pi machloket acheret shennechleku bemassechet avoda zara (77 67:) rabbi meir verabbi shimon bedin issur pagum, rabbi shimon mattir verabbi meir oser, detanya: "lo tochlu chol nevela lagger asher" vegomer – kol haruya leger keruya nevela, sheen reuya leger enah keruya nevela, ad kan. mashma shedderashat rabbi shimon hi mimma shebba hakkatuv lomar letittah leger, veim enah reuya en adam noten umocher davar sheeno shave. ha lamadta shebbiruya hakkatuv medabber, velaze doresh sheen keruya nevela ella vechulei. veen devarim ellu nirim, ki leolam kesheasar hakkatuv hannevela – kol nevela bemashma, umaamar hannetina vehammechira ba keshehem reuyim, umi tala ze baze?

Al ken nire shedderashat rabbi shimon hi mimma sheshshinna hakkatuv beshiur haddibbur, vechatav tevat "lagger" samuch letevat "nevela", velo amar keseder sheamar achar kach "machor lenachri", vehu gam ken shiur dibbur harauy lehakedim hammaase veachar kach yomar lemi. laze darash rabbi shimon shebba hakkatuv lehaircha bemishpat ze, lomar sheenah nevela ella im hu rauy lagger, aval im haya omer hakkatuv "tittenenna lagger" en makom lidrashato.

Ulederech ze hirvachnu taam shinnuy hasseder allibba derabbi yehuda, ki sover kerabbi shimon deen issur pagum, uletaam ze shinna hakkatuv ledabber beseder ze lehasemich maamar tevat "nevela" letevat "hagger", veshinna misseder hassamuch lo lehaircha al derasha zo. velaze lerabbi meir sheddoresh shebba hakkatuv lehattir netina legoy umechira leger, en lo makom lidrosh "nevela haruya leger" vechulei, veasar afillu enah reuya leger, venityashshevu al bureyan.

Ella sheraiti sham bemassechet avoda zara (68.) shehiksha hashshas kesheamar nevela sheenah reuya lagger enah nevela, hiksha veze leshono: verabbi meir, hahu lemaute serucha meikara. verabbi shimon, serucha meikara lo itzterich kera", ad kan. ulefi devarenu ma makshe hashshas lerabbi meir, vahalo lisvarat rabbi meir en makom lidrosh derashat rabbi shimon kemo shekkatavnu? veulay ki leravcha demilleta amar ken baggemara, afillu im timtza lomar sheyyisbor derashat rabbi shimon yachol lehaemidah bisrucha meikara, aval achar haemet en kushya lerabbi meir uchemo shekkatavnu. ulefi ze achar haemet gam rabbi meir yisbor (kerabbi shimon) bisrucha meikara deafra bealma kisvarat rashbi veeno tzarich kera.

rashi: Min hadderech asher anochi metzavve etchem hayyom lalechet vegomer. ha lamadta kol haoved aza hare hu sar mikkol hadderech shennitztauu yisrael, mikkan amru hammode baaza kechofer bechol hattora chullah (sifre):
ohc: Vehakkelala im lo tishmeu. perush, hammonea atzmo mishshemiat hattora hare hu mekullal meatzmo, veze hu shiur hakkatuv "vehakkelala im lo tishmeu" – zo hi hakkelala, veod lo sheyyesovvennu lasur mikkelalut derech hachayyim kemo sheggamar omer vesartem min hadderech vegomer, velo zo ella yachtzov lo borot nishbarim keamro lalechet achare vegomer:

rashi: Hattinshemet. 133 606:
Al shoshannim. lichvod talmide chachamim yissedu hashshir hazze, shehem rakkim keshoshannim venaim keshoshannim, umartivim maasim tovim keshoshannim (Shir HaShirim 2:3):
Maskil. al yede turegman (fesachim 117.):
Shir yedidot. shir ahuvim, shir shel shevach lahem, lehaahivam al habberiyyot ulehaahiv toratam alehem:
targum: Leshabbacha al yatve sanhedrin demoshe deitamar binvua al yedehon divne korach sichla tava vetushbachta veodaata:

rashi: Ki gavhu shamayim vegomer. kelomar, ki yesh hevdel vechilluk maalot veshevach biderachay yoter middarchechem uvmachshevotay yoter mimmachshevotechem, kegavoah shamayim al haaretz. attem notnim lev limrod bi, vaani noten lev lehashiv etchem:
targum: Are chema deramin shemaya min ara ken taknan orchatay meurechatchon umachashvati taknan mimachshevatchon:

rashi: Vezacharta ki eved hayita. veheenakti veshaniti lecha mibbizzat mitzrayim uvizzat hayyam, af atta haanek ushene lo (sifre):
Missat nidvat yadcha. de nidvat yadcha, hakkol lefi habberacha have shalme simcha vekaddesh keruim leechol:

Rak chazak levilti achol haddam. mimma shenneemar chazak atta lamed shehayu shetufim baddam leachlo, lefichach hutzrach lomar chazak divre rabbi yehuda, Rabbi shimon ben azay omer lo va hakkatuv ella lehazehircha ulelammedcha ad kamma atta tzarich lehitchazzek bammitzvot, im haddam shehu kal lehishshamer mimmennu sheen adam mitavve lo, hutzrach lechazzekcha veazharato, kava lishar mitzvot (80 sifre):
Velo tochal hannafesh im habbasar. azhara leever min hachay (chullin 102):
Hen gor yagur efes meoti. hen yare yira veyagur megorat raot, oto sheen ani immo, hu seir:

Mi gar ittach. mi asher neesaf alecha lemilchama, o mi gar – mi shennitgara bach. verabbotenu pershuhu (yevamot kad 2) begerim, lomar sheen mekabbelim gerim limot meshichenu. veaf bifshuto shel mikra yittachen: mi shennaasu gerim ittach baaniyyutech, alayich yippol beashirutech, kemo "al pene chol echav nafal" (Bereshit 25:18):
targum: Ha itkanasha yitkanshun lich galvat amich lesofa malche ammaya demitkanshin laaaka lich yerushelem begavich yitremun:

rashi: Umachazikim. ochazim:
targum: Are chidnan amar Adonai lesarisaya deyitrun yat yome shabbaya dili umitraan bidtzavena umatkefin bikyami:

rashi: Ki yimmacher lecha. al yede acherim, bimcharuhu bet din bignevato hakkatuv medabber; vahare chevar neemar "ki tikne eved ivri" uvimcharuhu vet din hakkatuv medabber? ella mippene shene devarim shennitchaddeshu kan, echad shekkatuv o haivriyya af hi tetze beshesh. velo shemmecharuha vet din, sheen haishsha nimkeret bignevatah, shenneemar "bignevato" velo "vignevatah" – ella viktanna shemmecharah aviha, velimmed kan sheim yatzu shesh shanim kodem shettavi simanin tetze, veod chiddesh kan haanek taanik:
ohc: Vaavadcha vegomer. amro vaavadcha betosefet vav lehaircha shekkadma mitzva lefaneha, vehu ma sheddarshu rabbotenu zichronam livracha betevat "lecha" sheen reshut levet din limkor eved yisrael ella leyisrael, veze hu shiur hakkatuv ki yimmacher perush, kesheyyitztarech limmacher lecha levad hu sheyyimmacher, umosif mishpat sheni "vaavadcha shesh shanim",

Veamro uvashsheviit vegomer, velo amar "veyetze lachutz bashsheviit", ella shennitkavven lomar ki lifamim yaavod gam bashsheviit, uchegon im barach haeved, hagam sheshshalmu shesh shanim laavodato tzarich lehashelim haavdut shesh shanim. vechen pasak rambam perek 2 mehilchot avadim, verabbotenu zichronam livracha derashuha (kiddushin 16:) mimma sheamar hakkatuv bemishpatim "shesh shanim yaavod". veulay dedarshinan mishshesh shanim yaavod" shebba lelammed sheim chala arba shanim shetztzarich lehashelim (kiddushin 17.) velaavod shesh, umiddikduk "uvashsheviit" nilmod im barach shetztzarich lehashelim afillu berichat shana achat.

rashi: Lifne Adonai. lifnim min hachoma:
Vehallevi asher bisharecha. im en lecha latet lo mechelko, kegon maaser rishon, ten lo masar ani, en lecha masar ani, hazeminehu al shelamecha (sifre):

Efes ki lo yihye becha evyon. ulehallan hu omer "ki lo yechdal evyon"? ella bizman sheattem osim retzono shel makom evyonim baacherim velo vachem, uchesheen attem osim retzono shel makom evyonim bachem:
Evyon. dal meani, uleshon evyon shehu taev lechol davar (80 Vayikra Rabba 34):
Bechol asher teavve nafshecha – kelal:
Babbakar uvatztzon uvayyayin uvashshechar – perat:
Uvechol asher tishalcha nafshecha – chazar vechalal, ma happerat meforash velad valdot haaretz verauy lemaachal adam vechulei (eruvin 27):
Ree anochi … beracha ukelala. haamurot behar gerizzim uvehar eval:
ohc: Ree anochi noten vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma amar leshon reiyya al haddevarim. od amro anochi. od lamma amar leshon yachid kevan shekkol happarasha kullah bilshon rabbim neemra.

Venire shehakkavvana hi, ki lefi shebba lehavechiram baolam haelyon ulehamit kol tovot olam hazze, uchede sheyyitammetu etzlam haddevarim tzarich shehammochiach yihye bo shene inyanim: echad sheyyakkir hakkara chushit battov haelyon, vehashsheni shehissig hassagat tuv olam hazze vekinyanav. ki im hammochiach yihye meshullal mikkinyene olam hazze, lo yeamnu devarav lemassige tovat olam hazze, ki yomru: en omrim lemi shello raa yavo veyaggid, sheim haya toem taame hanaot gedullat haolam hazze vekinyanav vetaanugav, lo haya memaaso uvocher bezulato, uvaze lo yattu aznam lekabbel devarav. gam habba lehafelig betuv olam habba, lo yutzdeku velo yeamnu devarav lassechel hattivi kol shehu atzmo en devarav ella mippi haemuna vehu lo raa velo yada. velaze amar moshia varav haish moshe ree anochi, perush, elay tiru vetatzdiku vetaskilu lehatzedik haddevarim, ki hu hissig lehakkir tuv olam hazze, ki haya gadol meod vegibbor umelech veashir gadol keamram zichronam livracha (shabbat tzav.), veyafe dodi af naim, gam battov haelyon hikkir ki ala shamayim vetaam taam elyon. veachar shehissig hakkara chushiyyit hakkarat shene devarim vehassagatam, amar lahem haddevarim haamurim bainyan kaasher avaer. veamro "ree" leshon yachid, ki reiyya zo kullan shavim behakkaratah keish echad, sheggaluy lakkol hassagat moshe baolam hazze uvaolam habba.

Od yirtze bemaamar ree anochi al derech amram zichronam livracha (282 hilchot teshuva 85) yachol adam laasot atzmo kemoshe rabbenu, vehu ma sheheiram ki elav yiru lehiddamot elav kol habba likrav laavodat hakkodesh avodat Adonai, velo yaarichu atzman im ma shelmatta mehem veyihyu beene atzman ki chabbir matza yadam, veamar leshon yachid ulay shello amar remez ze ella lichide am asher yachinu atzman lehassaga elyona, ki mi vami harauy lehassig hassaga zo lihyot kemoshe, ucheneged shear kelalut yisrael amar "noten lifnechem".

Uvederech remez yirmoz al pi divrehem zichronam livracha sheamru (Zohar 11 273.) shekkol bene tora yesh lahem nitzotz mimmoshe, veen tzarich lomar haddor hahu sheshshamu mippiv shehem chelek mimmennu, vehu ma sheramaz bemaamar ze ree anochi, perush keillu medabber im atzmo veomer lo anochi, ki chol yisrael yityachasu elav, ucheshehu medabber immam keillu medabber im atzmo, velaze gam ken amar "ree" leshon yachid keshiur "anochi" shehu leshon yachid yeamer alav "ree".

Od yirmoz al Adonai shekkara veamar "anochi", veze hu shiur hakkatuv: "ree" ki oto shekkara veamar lachem "anochi" hu "noten lifnechem" vegomer, veamro ree leshon yachid, ki beerech davar ze kullan yihyu shavim keechad ladaat ki Adonai hu hannoten lifnehem beracha vegomer:
Noten lifnechem hayyom vegomer. perush, lefi shehayyom amdu al datam, keamram zichronam livracha (avoda zara 5:) en adam omed al daat rabbo ad arbaim shana:

Od yitbaer behair od amro beracha ukelala, shello haya tzarich lomar ella "et habberacha vegomer vehakkelala" vegomer kemo sheamar achar ken. achen yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (sifre), amar lahem moshe: attem roim harshaim matzlichim shenayim ushelosha yamim vesofam liddachot, ad kan. vehu amro hayyom beracha ukelala, perush beracha shehi gam ken kelala, vehu shalvat harshaim baolam hazze sheenah ella bizman muat, sheolam hazze yikkare yom echad al derech amro (Devarim 7:11) "hayyom laasotam" (eruvin 22.). vehu ma sheddikdek lomar "hayyom" samuch lezichron beracha, lomar sheenah beracha ella hayyom velo lemachar, veadrabba kelala hi. nimtzet tovat olam hazze muetet vegoreret kelala.

Od yitbaer al pi maamaram zichronam livracha (sifre) sheamru: mashal leechad shehaya yoshev befarashat derachim, vehayu lefanav shene shevilin: echad techillato mishor vesofo kotzim, veechad techillato kotzim vesofo mishor, vehaya modia laovrim veshavim veamar lahem: "attem roim shevil ze shettechillato mishor bishtayim veshalosh pesiot vechulei vesofo" vechulei, ad kan. vehu amro noten lifnechem vegomer, perush shene mine tovot uvechol achat yesh beracha ukelala, ki derech harshaim yesh bo mishor battechilla vekotzim besofo – hare beracha ukelala, vederech hachayyim gam ken techillato kotzim vesofo mishor – hare beracha ukelala gam ken. vechazar uferesh et habberacha, perush, laze yikkare beracha sheen rauy lachush leanaf hakkelala shebbah asher tishmeu vegomer, hagam sheyyesh beemtzaut ze tzaar ki hatztzaddikim mitztaarim baolam hazze behishtaddelut hammuskol veolamam kashe alehem lema shetztzerichin bo, vehakkelala im lo tishmeun, hagam sheattem mitaddenim baolam bechol avvat nefesh habbahamit veyeerav lachem, mishor ze liklala yechashev.

Od yitbaer kol hakkatuv al ze hadderech: lefi sheamar lahem besamuch (Devarim 11:24) nachalat haaretz "kol hammakom asher tidroch kaf raglechem bo lachem yihye", laze amar lahem ree anochi noten vegomer, perush, netina zo she noten lachem hayyom. dikdek lomar hayyom ki beracha zo sheamar lahem "kol makom" vegomer lo neemra lahem ad hayyom hazze. veamro beracha ukelala perush yesh bintina zo beracha veyesh bah kelala, vechazar uferesh et habberacha asher tishmeu perush, im tishmeu tihye netina zo lachem livracha, veim lo tishmeun en zo lachem ki im kelala, shebbeemtzautah yitkanneu vachem haummot viabbedu etchem mimmenna binkama gedola. gam tihye lahem hahanaa mimmenna leraa lahem laolam hannitzchi, kederech amro (Devarim 7:10) "umeshallem lesonav el panav lehaavido", veayyen besamuch:

rashi: Lamma tishkelu chesef. lamma tigremu lachem lishkol kesef leoyvechem belo lechem? (Vayikra Rabba 30 1)
targum: Lema titkelun kaspechon bela lemechal veleutechon bela lemisba kabbilu kabbela lememri veechulu detav vetitpanek bedidhen nafshechon:

ohc: Ki yachrit vegomer et haggoyim vegomer hishshamer lecha vegomer. tzarich ladaat: 1, lamma tala azharat shemirat avoda zara beki yachrit" sheyyerae shezzulat ze eno baazhara kesheyyire et haggoyim ovde avoda zara shelevim uvetuchim shanim rabbot, veze eno, sheazharat avoda zara enah mishtannet mehammivchan bema sheyyeera lehaummot. 2, amro pen tinnakesh vegomer achare hishshamdam – halo adrabba achar sheyyire shennishmedu lefanav lo yinnakesh acharehem, vedivre hammaor Rashi zichrono livracha lo hispiku bo yishshuv hakkatuv al nachon. 3, amro pen tinnakesh ufen tidrosh – kevan shehannekisha hi derishat avodatam haya lo lomar "pen tinnakesh vegomer lidrosh achare" vegomer. 4, amro lemor – lemi yomru. Adonai, amro echa – en yadua kavvanat maamar ze im shoel, o matmiah, o medamme, ulechol happerushim en yadua hammechuvvan. 6, amro lo tosef alav velo tigra – kashe, bishlama "lo tigra" yetzav Adonai leval yigra mikkol haazharot shetztzivva al avoda zara, aval "lo tosef" ma ba lelammed? im leval yosif seyagim, ze eno, shehare ketiv (Vayikra 18:30) "ushemartem et mishmarti", umatzinu lerabbotenu zichronam livracha shehechmiru ligdor kol dedame laavoda zara, veim leval yeesor mine avoda zara shello hizkir hakkatuv, hare matzinu sheasar hakkatuv kol min avoda zara.

Achen kavvanat hakkatuv hi shebba lehazehir al hattauyyot asher yite adam mimmachaze asher enav techezena reshaim meeretz yikkaretu, veyomar mimma nafshach lo yimmana millomar achat mishtayim: o tomar sheavoda zo sheovdim hannichratim hi chashuva avoda, velaze hikpid Adonai al asotam lezulato velo lo vayyissachem meeretz hachayyim, o tomar sheavoda zo sheovdim haggoyim enah chashuva avoda lehitkanot aleha el kanno venokem, kemo shettomar hazzorek lemarkulis happoer lifor o hammaavir lammolech vechaddome laze, veharaya sheen ovdin avoda zo laAdonai elohim, vetaam shehikpid Adonai lehacherit haggoyim lo al sheavdu avoda kazo ella al shello avaduhu laAdonai baavoda haruya veazvu shear mitzvot.

Vechol achat mishshete chalukot ellu sheyyachria hammachria bedato hare ze bittul tora. im yachria lomar shehaavoda hi avoda reuya, tavo lo hassevara laavod laAdonai elohenu bemine haavodot atzman shebbahem kinne keshennaasu lezulat. veim yachria lomar sheenah avoda, tavo lo hassevara laasot gam hu ken kevan sheen ze maase avoda zara. laze ba maamar Adonai veamar ki yachrit vegomer hishshamer lecha millitot beechad mishshete chalukot harshumot. keneged taut habba mehashemadatam sheavodatam avoda, amar "hishshamer lecha" pen tinnakesh acharehem, perush "tinnakesh" kemo shepperesh Rashi tittaref acharehem lihyot karuch laasot kemaasehem lelohay sheani ovdo, achar sheani roe shehikpid Adonai al sheovdim baze lezulato, vehu amro achare hishshamdam mippanecha. ucheneged taut habba mehavechanat haavoda heyotah bezuya veen avoda zo nikret avoda velo yakpid Adonai aleha laasotah lifor levazzoto vechaddome, amar ufen tidrosh lelohehem vegomer, perush tidrosh bemaase haavoda umeemtzaut hasekalatcha bah tomar, vehu amro lemor echa yaavdu haggoyim, perush, davar tamuah hu ki ech yaavdu avoda bezuya kazo, en zo chashuva avoda veyachol ani laasot ken ki en baze lo kavod velo chibba laavoda zara, vehu amro veeese ken gam ani lifor velizrok even berigmat markulis, hishshamer pen tomar ken.

Vegamar omer lo taase chen laAdonai, ze keneged taut harishona sheyyachshov laasot laAdonai min avoda sheovdim haggoyim, veshalal ikkar hassevara shemmimmenna ba hattaut veamar ki et kol toavat Adonai asher sane asu vegomer, lo kemo sheatta choshev she mitkanne sheosim maase meshubbach ze lezulato, lo chen hu, eno ella davar hassanouy beene Adonai, vesamach gam ken lomar davar zar gam beene adam, keamro gam et benehem vegomer yisrefu, umeatta gam taut sheniyya sheen avoda zo avoda veen Adonai makpid al hammaasim, satar baze benoam devarav, ki hammaase mitztzad atzmo sone oto Adonai, hagam sheenah maala vechavod, vehu amro toavat Adonai asher sane asu lelohehem, perush hammaase mitztzad atzmo hu metoav beene Adonai, kederech shettiev harebe devarim belo taam mussag lechol maskil, kemo shettomar issur shete achayot hagam sheyyachpetzu shenehem baddavar vechaddome laze, kemo chen asar maase ze laavoda zara hagam sheen chefetz sheyyaasuhu laavodato hakkedosha.

Vegamar amro et kol haddavar vegomer lo tosef vegomer velo tigra lefi devarenu yavo al nachon, perush lo tosef – keneged avodat haggoyim lelohehen shello yaase mehem laavodat Adonai, velo tigra mimmennu – perush lehattir avodot habbezuyot shel avoda zara kannizkar ella hakkol bichlal haissur, uvaze nityashshevu kol haddikdukim.

rashi: Ki attem ovrim et hayyarden vegomer. nissim shel yarden yihyu siman beyedchem shettavou vetirshu et haaretz (80 sifre):
Ken yihye devari asher yetze mippi. lehodiachem al yede hanneviim lo yashuv rekam, ach yetiv lachem im tishmeu lahem:
targum: Ken have pitgam tuvi denafek min kodamay la efshar deyituv likdamay rekan elahen avad yat deraena umatzlach lidshalachna leh:

rashi: Ki yarchiv vegomer. limmeda tora derech eretz shello yitavve adam leechol basar ella mittoch rachavat yadayim veosher (chullin 84):
Kol avvat nafshecha vegomer. aval bammidbar neesar lahem besar chullin ella im ken makdishah umakrivah shelamim (sham 16):
ohc: Ki yarchiv vegomer. perush, lefi shehikpid Adonai al hammitavvim taava leechol basar bammidbar (Bamidbar 11), vekavru hammitavvim, meatta omed taavat habbasar beissur. laze amar ki yarchiv vegomer veamarta vegomer, perush hagam shettomar beferush sheatta rotze leechol basar, veze dimyon maamar hammitavvim sheamru "mi yaachilenu basar", gam amar ki teavve nafshecha dimyon haamur bammitavvim sheamar hakkatuv "hitauu taava", af al pi chen mattir hakkatuv lahem veamar bechol avvat nafshecha tochal basar.

rashi: Vaadat leummim tesovvekka. im yachzeru acharecha lehoshiam al tishma lekolam, hitrachek mealehem veshuv veshev bimkomcha bammarom 591 belaaz. davar acher: lammarom shuva lehareot lahem sheyyadcha elyona:
targum: Uchenishat umaya tachzerinach veamtultaha leve shechintach tuv:

rashi: Lo tochlennu. azhara ledam haevarim (sham):

Lemaan yitav lecha vegomer. tze ulemad mattan secharan shel mitzvot, im haddam shennafsho shel adam katza mimmennu, happoresh mimmennu zoche lo ulevanav acharav, kal vachomer legezel vaarayot shennafsho shel adam mitavva lahem (makkot 23):
Yaase zot. shomer shabbat vegomer:
targum: Tuve enash deyabad da uvar enasha deyitkef bah yitar shabbeta meachalute veyiter yedohi milmebad kol devish:

rashi: Ki vesimcha tetzeu. min haggalut:
Heharim vehaggevaot yiftzechu lifnechem rinna. sheyyittenu lachem piryam vetzimcham, veyehanu (yeronnu) yoshvehem:
targum: Are vechedva tifkun mibbene ammaya uvishlama tittovlun learachon turaya veramata yevuun kodamechon tushebcha vechol ilane chakla yishanun beanfehon:

rashi: Kol toeva. kol shettiavti lecha, kegon tzaram ozen bechor kede leshochoto vammedina hare davar shettiavti lecha, kol mum lo yihye bo, ba velimmed kan shello yishchat veyochal al oto hammum. bishshel basar bechalav hare davar shettiavti lecha, vehizhir kan al achilato (chullin 114):

ohc: Lerishtah kol hayyamim vegomer. nitkavven lomar sheim yishmeru laasot haamur, tihye hayyerushsha shennatan Adonai lahem nimshechet kol hayyamim asher vegomer:

rashi: Abbed teabbedun. abbed veachar kach teabbedun, mikkan laoker aza shetztzarich lesharesh achareha (avoda zara 45):
Et kol hammekomot asher avdu sham vegomer. uma teabbedun mehem? et elohehem asher al heharim:
ohc: Abbed teabbedun et kol hammekomot vegomer. yitbaer al derech ma sheamru bemassechet avoda zara daf 47, veze leshon hammishna: shelosha battim hem, bayit shebbanuy mittechilla laavoda zara hare ze asur, siyyedo vechiyyero laavoda zara vechiddesh notel ma shechiddesh vechulei, veamru baggemara veze leshonam: amar rav hammishtachave levayit asaro, alma kasavar talush ulevassof chibbero asur, vehaannan benao tenan, benao af al pi shello hishtachava lo, ad kan. vechen pasak rambam beferek 8 mehilchot avoda zara (halacha Adonai), vehu maamar hakkatuv kan et kol hammekomot asher avdu sham, perush, kol shehayu lahem sham avoda, ben shebbanuhu laavoda zara ben shehishtachavu lo vehu banuy, hagam shehu mechubbar asur vetzarich leabbedo.

Veamro asher attem yorshim otam, yitbaer al pi ma shekkatav rambam beferek 7 mehilchot avoda zara (halacha 1) veze leshono: uveeretz yisrael mitzva lirdof achareha ad shenneabbed otah, aval bechutz laaretz vechulei kol makom shennichbosh oto neabbed kol avoda zara shebbo, ad kan. hare ki geder chiyyuv ibbud avoda zara hu kol sheyyarshu et hammakom asher hi shamma, vehu amro asher attem yorshim ki begeder ze shavim kol haaretz.

Vetaam kefel "abbed teabbedun", yitbaer al derech amram bemassechet avoda zara (77 43:) shebbittul avoda zara tzarich shene devarim: shochek, vezore laruach o metil layyam, uveechad mehenna eno yotze yede chovato, velaze kafal lomar shene ibbudim.

Veamro et elohehem al heharim, lefi sheasar kol hammekomot, uferashnu afillu bayit banuy shehu mechubbar asur, uva lomar ki yesh mechubbar sheeno neesar hagam sheyyaavduhu, uma hu – heharim, uchemo sheddarshu baavoda zara (avoda zara ma.) veze leshonam: elohehem al heharim velo heharim elohehem, uveferek rabbi yishmael (avoda zara na:) darshu kol hammekomot beim eno inyan laavoda zara tenehu inyan lechelim, ad kan, hem zichronam livracha sovrim shettalush ulevassof chibbero eno tzarich kera, veshivim panim lattora.

Od yitbaer amro et elohehem, behair lamma hifsik bemaamar "asher attem yorshim otam" ben zichron haovdim vehanneevadim, shehaya lo lomar al ze hadderech: "avdu sham haggoyim et elohehem vegomer asher attem yorshim otam". achen hakkavvana hi al derech ma sheamru rabbotenu zichronam livracha bemassechet avoda zara daf 44 veze leshonam: rav huna rame, ketiv (divrei hayamim 1 14:12) "vayyissarfu vaesh" uchetiv (Shmuel 2 5:21) "vayyissaem", lo kashya – kan kodem shebba ittay haggitti, kan achar shebba ittay haggitti, dichtiv "vayyikkach et ateret malkam meal rosho". umi share? amar rav nachman: ata ittay uvittelah, ad kan. hare ki yesh metziut lirash gam elohehem atzman, vehu keshehayu immahem ovdeha shebbittelum hem veyehanu mehem yisrael. vehu amro asher attem yorshim otam, velo otam levad ella gam elohehem, vehu amro et elohehem. utenay hammishpat ramaz hakkatuv bema shehikdim maamar "otam" veachar kach "et elohehem", kedivre hashshas sheamar achar shebba ittay nehena david baateret malkam.

Uvederech remez yechavven hakkatuv lirmoz ibbud lakkoach hannelam gam ken bechoach am bene yisrael, shekkaasher yitatztzemu betaatzumot hammaase hattov yeabbedu nigle venistar mehem, vehu amro kol hammekomot asher avdu sham, perush, asher maggaat sham avodatam, shehu kisse 100 harasha leakro, ki binfilat koach ze yitatztzem koach haelyon vehaya Adonai lemelech al kol haaretz.

rashi: Hoy kol tzame. hoy ze, leshon keria vezimmun vekibbutz hu, veyesh harebe bammikra: "hoy hoy venusu meeretz tzafon" (Zecharya 2:10):
Lechu lammayim. lattora:
Shivru. leshon "lishbor bar" (Bereshit 42:3), kenu:
Yayin vechalav. lekach tov miyyayin vechalav:
targum: Vay kol detzavi lemelaf yete veyelef udelet leh kesaf eto shemau vaalifu veeto shemau vela vedamin uvela bemamon ulefan detav machamar umechalav:

rashi: Ki yirchak mimmecha hammakom. velo tuchal lavo velaasot shelamim bechol yom kemo achshav shehammishkan holech immachem:
Vezavachta … kaasher tzivviticha. lamadnu sheyyesh tziuuy bazzevicha heach yishchot, vehen hilchot shechita shenneemru lemoshe besinay (sham 28):
ohc: Ki yirchak vegomer. ba lehattir ma shenneesar bammidbar leechol zulat zivche shelamim, vehitim taam hahetter benoam devarav veamar "ki yirchak", laze amar veachalta bisharecha veen tzorech lahavio lammikdash. uferush "yirchak" kol shehu omed bemakom rachok, umatzinu shennechleku rabbotenu zichronam livracha (fesachim 93:) befasuk "uvederech rechoka", yesh omrim min hammodiim velachutz, veyesh omrim min petach yerushalayim, veyesh omrim min petach haazara. veefshar lomar shekkol adam sheshshochet befetach haazara behema asher yakrivu mimmenna karban laAdonai, sheeno yachol lizboach ella shelamim laAdonai, matay yavo leyadi mikra ze vaakayyemennu.

rashi: Vehallevi, lo taazvennu. millitten lo maaser rishon:
Ki en lo chelek venachala immach. yatzu leket shichcha ufea vehefker, sheaf hu yesh lo chelek immecha bahen kamocha, veenan chayyavin bemaaser:
Lehashekit lo mime ra. ki hayyissurin gormin lo lehashekit lahem mime din gehinnom, ad sheyyire sheyikkare larasha shachat:
targum: Leshadacha leh min yome visha ad deyitbere lerashiaya shucha:

rashi: Lechem oni. lechem shemmazkir et haoni shennitannu bemitzrayim (sifre):
Ki vechippazon yatzata. velo hispik batzek lehachamitz veze yihye lecha lezikkaron; vechippazon lo shellecha haya ella shel mitzrayim, shekken hu omer "vattechezak mitzrayim al haam vegomer" (sifre):
Lemaan tizkor. al yede achilat happesach vehammatztza et yom tzetcha:
Ki fi rasha. esav:
targum: Arum puma derashia ufuma denichla alay patchin malilu imi lishan dishkar:

rashi: Chagor charbecha al yarech. lehillachem milchamtah shel tora, vehu hodcha vehu hadarecha:
targum: Zarez saypach al yarchach gibbara lemiktal malchin im shiltonin hodach veshivhorach:

rashi: Ki chos. hattarela beyado:
Veyayin chamar. chazak, vinosh belaaz:
Male mesech. hakkos male mezeg, limzog ulehashkot et kol haggoyim:
Vayyagger mizze. mizze hakkos yafitz veyiklach et mishtehem, leshon "kemayim muggarim" (Micha 1:4):
targum: Arum kas dilvat beyad Adonai vachamar ashin mele mezigat mererta letaltela mearat di rashiaya uma dishre mineh kashe min den kadmain beram duredyaha ufikatyaha yematztzun yishtun kol rashie ara:

rashi: Lo tuchal. ba hakkatuv litten lo taase al haddavar:

Lo tuchal. rabbi yehoshua ben karcha omer yachol atta, aval encha rashshay, kayyotze vo (Yehoshua 15) "veet hayevusi yoshve yerushalayim lo yachlu vene yisrael (yehuda) lehorisham", yecholim hayu, ella sheenan rashshain lefi shekkarat lahem avraham berit keshellakach mehem mearat hammachpela; velo yevusim hayu, ella chittiyyim hayu, ella al shem hair sheshshemah yevus, kach meforash befirke derabbi eliezer (80 36), vehu shenneemar "ki im hesircha haivrim vehappischim" (Shmuel 2 Adonai) – tzelamim shekkatvu alehem et hashshevua:
Uvechorot bekarcha. azhara lakkohanim:
Uterumat yadecha. ellu habbikkurim (sifre; makkot 17):
Ki harog tahargennu. im yatza mibbeddi zakkay hachazirehu lechova, yatza mibbet din chayyav al tachazirehu lizchut (sham):
Yadcha tihye bo varishona. mitzva beyad hannissat lahamito. lo met beyado, yamut beyad acherim, shenneemar veyad kol haam vegomer (80 sifre):
Ki yesitcha. en hasata ella geruy, shenneemar (340 26) im Adonai hesitcha bi, 331 belaaz, shemmassio laasot ken:
Achicha. meav:
O ven immecha. meem:
Chekecha. hashshochevet bechekcha umechukka becha, apekayydea belaaz, vechen (Yechezkel 43), "umechek haaretz" – misod hattakua baaretz:
Asher kenafshecha. ze avicha, peresh lecha hakkatuv et hachavivin lecha, kava laacherim:
Basseter. dibber hakkatuv bahove, sheen divre mesit ella basseter, vechen shelomo hu omer (Mishlei 7) "beneshef beerev yom beishon layla vaafela":
Asher lo yadata atta vaavotecha. davar ze genay gadol hu lecha – sheaf haummot en mannichin ma shemmasru lahem avotehem, veze omer lecha azov ma shemmasru lecha avotecha (sifre):
ohc: Ki yesitcha achicha vegomer. befarasha zo ramaz Adonai heara gedola beofne hahasata habbaa laadam meatzmo lehattoto midderech hattov vehayyashar. da ki yesh mesit shebba im haadam miyyom heyoto baolam, ucheamram zichronam livracha (sanhedrin tze:) bappasuk (Bereshit 4:7) "lappetach chattat rovetz" vehu mesit lehaadam lehara.

Od yivvaled baadam koach mesit sheni, beemtzaut haavera. im avar al mitzva achat, tivvaled bo koach hechafetz resha, sod maamar (avot 84 42) avera goreret avera, veheerichu baze anshe emet lomar ki al yede avera achat kone kategor echad venosaf gam hu al koach hara harishon lehachetio, vechen shenayim vechen shelosha ki yarbe lachto yigdal bo hahasata. uletaam ze amru (berachot lod:): makom shebbaale teshuva omdim en tzaddikim gemurim yecholin laamod.

Od beemtzaut netot haadam lederech lo tov, yesovvennu kenot koach shelishi, shehu nefesh raa, kederech sheyyizke haadam betosefet neshama yetera behitatztzemuto bedarche Adonai, kemo chen beemtzaut derachim haraim yikne tosefet nefesh raa lehachetio.

Od yosif mizze gader revii, vehu lehikkanes nafsho begader acheret sheen lemala mimmenna, vehi shennafsho titchabber vetishtattef im chelek hara vetishve lo betivah, veze hu gemar hechlet nefesh adam lichpor baikkar velaavod avoda zara.

Vehu ma sheramaz beamro "ki yesitcha achicha", hu chelek hara shehu mitache im haadam mittechillato kodem boo baolam. veamro ben immecha nitkavven lehodia minnayin ba ach letzara, veamar ben immecha shehi em kol chay, shehi chavva sheggarma taarovet hara bimkor hakkedushsha bachet harishon. ucheneged gader sheni shehu mesit hannolad mechet haadam kannizkar amar o vincha o vittecha, hem toldot maasim raim sheggam hem nikraim banim zarim. veamar o vittecha ki yesh averot sheyyolidu kategor bemadregat zachar veyesh bemadregat nekeva, kefi koach hachet, kesheyyihye gadol yolid koach hazzachar ulefi chalishuto yityaches elav kinnuy habbat.
Ucheneged gader shelishi shehu kinyan nefesh raa shettitlavve im hachote, amar o eshet chekecha, sheshshochenet betocho nefesh raa vetagbir bo hahasata lehafeil hara.

Ucheneged gader revii shehu netot hannefesh uchelotah lachelek hara sheyyihye benafsho, amar reacha asher kenafshecha, sheen gader ben shenehem ella chelek hara venafsho bechina achat. veachar haderagot ellu yihye koach bammesit ledabber elav kaddevarim haelle "nelcha venaavda" vegomer.
Vedikdek lomar basseter, lehair ki hammesit hu mastir atzmo ki hu hammesit, umedabber kimdabber divre ahava vereut, umare telafayim ki lo lehara hu mitkavven.

Veamro lemor nelcha, perush lo sheomer beferush "nelcha naavda", ella omer devarim mesuttarim, vetachlit devarav hu lomar nelcha naavda vegomer. gam yaarim bemaamaro lomar "nelcha naavda" shekkolel atzmo immo, umitchakkem baze lomar sheggam hu ad atta lo haya maskim laavoda zara ella mikkan ulehabba hu rotze laavod, uvaze yachshov haadam ki nafsho hi hammedabberet velo zulatah shehu yetzer hara.

Veamro asher lo yadata. perush, ba betaana neged ma shennitchayyev haadam bekabbalat hattora shello laavod elohim acherim, veomer lo ki en alav hachiyyuv ella davka baavoda zara sheyyada vekibbel shello leavdah, aval avoda zara elohim lo yedaum baolam en alav taanat ma shekkibbel shello laavod, ki lo ala ze al daat az keshekkibbel, vehu amro asher lo yadata atta, velo atta levad ella vaavotecha gam hem keshekkibbelu alehem issur avoda zara lo yadu zo.

rashi: Chasde david. sheegmol ledavid chasadav:
targum: Archinu udenechon vekabbilu lememri shemau vetitkayem nafshechon veegzar lechon keyam alam tavvat david dimhemnan:

rashi: Miktze shalosh shanim. ba velimmed sheim hishha maasrotav shel shana rishona usheniyya lishmitta, sheyyevaarem min habbayit bashshelishit:
Haanek taanik. leshon adi baggova uvemarit haayin, davar sheyyehe nikkar shehetivota lo; veyesh mefarshim leshon hateana al tzavvaro:

Mitztzoncha umiggornecha umiyyikvecha. yachol en li ella ellu bilvad, talo asher berachcha – mikkol ma shebberachcha boraacha. velamma neemru ellu? ma ellu meyuchadim shehem bichlal beracha af kol shehu bichlal beracha, yatzu peradot; velamdu rabbotenu vemassechet kiddushin (daf 17) bigzera shava kamma noten lo mikkol min vamin:
Rak kodashecha. aappi sheatta muttar lishchot chullin, lo hittarti lecha lishchot et hakkodashim uleachlan bisharecha belo hakerava, ella haviem levet habbechira:
Veze asher lo tochlu mehem. leesor et hashshechuta (sham):
Kadchod. min even tova:

Shimshotayich. yonatan tirgem "aach", umenachem chibbero im "yeshammeshune" (Daniel 7:10), veyesh potrin leshon 'shemesh – challonot shechamma zorachat bahen, veosin kenegdo mechitza bemine zechuchit tzevaim lenoy, umidrash tehillim poter "shimshotayich" veshemesh umagen" (tehillim 84:12) shinne hachoma:

Leavne ekdach. yonatan tirgem "leavne gemar", 'gumerin targum 'gechalim. patar 'ekdach leshon "kodche esh" (Yeshayahu 50:11), vehem min avanim tovot boarot kallappidim, vehu 489 leshon 'gachelet. veyesh potrin (bava batra 75 1) leshon 'makdeach, avanim gedolot shekkol chalal happetach kaduach betocho, vehammezuzot vehammiftan vehassaf kullan mittoch haeven hem:
Leavne chefetz. "leavne tzeruch" (targum yonatan):
targum: Veeshave vemargelin aach vetarayich leavne gemar vechol techumich leavne tzeroch:

rashi: Shemor. zo mishna sheatta tzarich leshamrah bevitnecha shello tishkach, kainyan shenneemar (Mishlei 22) "ki naim ki tishmerem bevitnecha", veim shanita efshar shettishma utekayyem, ha chol sheeno bichlal mishna eno bichlal maase (80 sifre):
Et kol haddevarim. shettehe chaviva alecha mitzva kalla kemitzva chamura (sham):
Hattov. beene hashshamayim:
Vehayyashar. beene adam:
ohc: Shemor veshamata. kashe, shehaya lo lomar "shema veshamarta", velamma hikdim shemira lishmia? od, ma ribba betevat et uvetevat kol? od, lamma lo amar hatavat habbanim ella befasuk ze? od tzarich ladaat amro ki taase hattov shennire shebba latet taam lemaamar "lemaan yitav", vahalo kevar kadam veamar shemor vegomer vegamar omer lemaan vegomer, hare shehattova haamura hi sachar bead hashshemira vehashshemia shekkadam lomar hakkatuv.
