Achen hakkavvana hi shemmetzavve al shene devarim: 1 tora umitzvot Adonai asher kevar nodu leyisrael mippi moshe, 8 asher yigzeru rabbotenu zichronam livracha haggedarim vehasseyagim asher yechaddeshu. laze keneged tora umitzvot shehem yeduim kevar battora amar shemor, ucheneged devarim hammitchaddeshim merabbotenu zichronam livracha amar veshamata shetztzarich lekabbel kol gezerat rabbotenu zichronam livracha useyagehem, vehu ma sheramaz bemaamar et kol perush 'et lerabbot kol gezerot ushemirot ugedarim sheyyechaddeshu rabbotenu zichronam livracha, veamro kol perush, shebbeemtzaut haggedarim yihyu haddevarim nishmarim bishlemut, vehu amro kol haddevarim ki zulat ze en hammitzva naaset kullah bishlemut, shebbeemtzaut haggader en nigra mimmenna davar. vegamar omer lemaan yitav lecha ulevanecha ki gedarim useyagim sheasu rabbotenu zichronam livracha hu davar hammaamid dorot am bene yisrael leolam lehavedilam mikkol kiur vehaddome lo.

Veamro ki taase hattov vegomer, perush, ki devarim sheggozrim chachamim enam ki im laasot hattov vehayyashar beene Adonai, shekkol divrehem revid hazzahav. uchefi ze maamar ki taase vegomer hu gam ken taam hatztziuuy veshamata, ki baze taase hattov vehayyashar shetztzivva Adonai beemtzaut haggedarim vehasseyagim, veze millevad hattov hammussag laddorot meemtzaut divrehem zichronam livracha. ulederech ze amro ki taase hu taam nosaf lemaamar "veshamata".

Od yirmoz hakkatuv bemaamar shemor veshamata, shello yomar adam: "lamma li lilmod shemua zo achar sheamadti aleha veyadati ma sheyyesh alay lishmor bemitzva zo?" talmud lomar "shemor", perush – vahagam achar sheshshamarta, umimmotza davar atta yodea shekkadam veamad al haddevarim ladaat et asher yishmor, veaf al pi chen veshamata, perush – encha patur mehaggaat bishmuatah shel mitzva.

Od yitbaer al derech amro (Hoshea 14:3) "uneshallema farim sefatenu", vehinne lefi sheamar "shemor vegomer et kol haddevarim", vedavar ze hu min geder hannimna sheyyachol haadam lekayyem kol haddevarim, laze amar shemor – perush, keneged mitzvot lo taase shehem beyad haadam lishmor atzmo mikkol mitzvot lo taase, ucheneged mitzvot ase amar veshamata – perush, yekayyem hammitzvot belimmud shemiatah bappe, uvaze nechshav alecha keillu baa leyadcha vekiyyamta otah, umeatta yachol lishmor velaasot et kol haddevarim.

Od yitbaer al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (avoda zara 19.), sheamru: ligras inish vahadar lisbar, vehu amro shemor veshamata, perush, shemor – sheyyishmor yediat hahalacha vehi haggirsa, veshamata – hi hassevara lechavven shemuotav besichlo.

Od yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (zohar 11 193.) ki mi shehu baal averot shaare daat hattora ninalim befanav, vetimtza (shulchan aruch 216 zichrono livracha hilchot talmud tora) ki shaare pitche hahavana bedivre hattora hem hakkushyot sheyyaamdu bifne haadam, vehem sod hakkelippot hammithavvim meaverot haadam, veze sheheir hakkatuv bemaamar ze shemor veshamata, perush, im atta rotze shettaamod al amittat hattora lehavin amareha, shemor hammitzvot leval taavor alehem, uvaze "veshamata et kol" vegomer.

Od yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (chagiga 15:) veze leshonam: im harav dome lemalach Adonai tzevaot tora yevakshu mippihu vegomer, ad kan. vehu amro shemor, perush, im hu bishmira sheshshomer hattora, az "veshamata" tora mippihu. veamro et kol haddevarim, lederech ze yitbaer al pi ma sheamru bachagiga (sham) veze leshonam: verabbi meir hechi gamar tora mippumeh deacher? vehaamar vechulei "ki sifte chohen" vegomer, amar resh lakish: rabbi meir kera ashkach vedarash "hat aznecha vegomer, velibbecha tashit ledati" – ledatam lo neemar ella ledati vechulei. kashu kerae ahadade! la kashya: ha begadol ha bekatan. veamru od sham veze leshonam: darash rava, may dichtiv "el ginnat egoz" vegomer, ashkecheh rabba bar shila leeliyyahu, amar leh: may ka avid hakkadosh baruch hu? amar leh: kaamar shemata mippumayyhu dechullehu rabbanan umippumeh derabbi meir la kaamar, mishshum degamar shemata mippumeh deacher. amar leh: rabbi meir rimmon matza vechulei, amar leh: hasheta kaamar "meir beni omer" vechulei, ad kan. hinne lefi divrehem zichronam livracha haggadol yachol lilmod meharav hagam sheyyihye harav rasha, ma sheen ken hakkatan. verambam zichrono livracha matzinu shekkatav (hilchot talmud tora 4) sheen lilmod meharav ella im hu kemalach Adonai, velo chillek ben gadol lekatan kedivre haggemara.

Veraiti labbach (320 yore dea siman 246) shekkatav shello chillek baggemara ella ledaat rabbi meir, aval hashshas eno sover ken, vediyyek leshon hashshas sheamar rabbi meir kera ashkach vedarash, mashma davka rabbi meir hu shessover ken, ad kan.

Veen devarav nechonim. echad, minnayin lo lattalmud lomar shemmaase rabbi meir bemachloket omed kol sheanu yecholin lehashevot baddavar sevara. veod, mimma shemmakshe lerabbi meir midderashat "ki sifte chohen" muchach shechafetz lehashevotam, sheim atta omer sheachar haemet sherabbi meir lechallek ata mehadderasha shehu limmud haggadol, im ken ma makshe hattalmud midderashat "ki sifte chohen" vegomer, im lo shettomar shessover shedderasha zo muskemet, sheim lo chen haya yachol lomar rabbi meir eno doresh ken. veim tomar shezzo hi kavvanat hametaretz sheamar "rabbi meir kera ashkach" vechulei, uferush veeno mode bidrashat "sifte" vechulei, im ken may chozer lomar "kashu kerae" vechulei im haddoresh ze eno doresh ze. veod, hare rava shehu amora acharon darash "el ginnat egoz", ma haegoz hazze hagam shehu meluchlach betit vechulei en ochel shebbetocho nimas vechulei ad kan, udevarim ellu hem kisvarat rabbi meir, veyadua dehalacha kerava hagam shennomar shemmaase rabbi meir bemachloket shanuy. veod, im derashat "ki sifte chohen" hi ben legadol ben lekatan verabbi meir levad hu shessover lechallek, ma meshiv rabba bar shela leeliyyahu "rabbi meir rimmon matza" vechulei, halo eno sover ella rabbi meir, aval hashshas sevira leh sheen hetter lilmod ella mikkemalach ben yihye gadol ben yihye katan. veod, ma reaya gedola mizzo shehiskim Adonai al hammaase shel rabbi meir shechazar veamar shemata mippiv. veim tomar hakkadosh baruch hu mittechilla ma savar ulevassof ma savar, sheen lomar shennelam meene Adonai chas veshalom hattaam sheamar rabba bar shela "rabbi meir rimmon matza" vechulei. da ki yakpid Adonai al haadam baasoto davar shello yihye bo naki ella meAdonai velo meadam, veyechashev lo lechet ad sheyyihye naki meAdonai veadam. velaze kesheasa rabbi meir maase ze shehaya lamed meadam sheeno kemalach, haya rabbi meir naki meAdonai aval lo meadam, kol od shello noda tamo im zach veyashar poolo. veze sibbev shello haya Adonai omer shemua mippiv lihyoto chasar hashshelemut. veachar shenneemar bishiva shel matta taam lishvach bemaasav, nichnas begeder "vihyitem nekiyyim gam miyyisrael", velaze techef umiyyad chazar veamar shemata mishshemo. uleolam haemet kedivre rabbi meir.

Vehannachon latet taam larambam hu, shessover shebbazzeman hazze en daat shelema shettikkare gadol lehattir lo lilmod mechacham rasha, sheddavka rabbi meir shehaya shalem bedaat uvidia hu shehuttar lo haddavar, sheen lachush vadday sheyyilmod mimmennu risho. veulay ki laze diyyek hattalmud veamar: rabbi meir kera ashkach vedarash vechulei rabbi meir rimmon vechulei, perush davka geder ze shel rabbi meir hu sheyyeshno behetter ze, lefi shehu vadday yizrok hakkelippa velo yochal ella haochel. usevara zo nechona usemucha meatzmah hi, laze satam rambam leesor lilmod meharav sheeno kemalach ben legadol ben lekatan, ki haddorot nitmaatu veen lanu hetter ze ella berabbi meir vechayyotze. vetze ulemad middivrehem zichronam livracha (shabbat 112:) sheamru: im harishonim kemalachim vechulei.

Veal pi ze yitbaer al nachon amro shemor veshamata et kol haddevarim vegomer, perush, ematay ani matne alecha sheen lecha lehavin shemua ella meadam shehu meshammer hattora vehammitzvot? ella davka lemi shehu katan vechaser lishmoa kol haddevarim o rubbam sheharov kakkol, aval haggadol sheeno tzarich lishmoa ella chelek katan yachol hu lishmoa afillu meadam sheeno shomer tora umitzvot, ucherabbi meir shehaya lomed tora meacher, hagam shello haya meshammer tora umitzvot, shehaya zorek kelippato veochel tocho.

rashi: Uvishshalta. zehu tzeli esh, sheaf hu karuy bishshul:
Ufanita vabboker. levakro shel sheni, melammed shettaun lina lel shel motzae 19 (sifre; fesachim 95; chagiga 17):
ohc: Uvishshalta veachalta. amar leshon bishshul, vehattora amra bemitzvat happesach (Shemot 12:9) "al tochlu vegomer uvashel mevushshal". ulay shechozer lizvichat habbakar lishlamim sheamar hakkatuv lemala "vezavachta pesach tzon uvakar" vegomer, veamru rabbotenu zichronam livracha (fesachim 70:) tzon lefesach uvakar lishlamim. uvechibburi peri toar al yore dea heerachti bedavar ze bitchillat siman 87.

rashi: Hishshamer lecha. litten lo taase al haddavar (sifre):
Al admatecha. aval baggola encha muzhar alav yoter meaniyye yisrael (sham):

Veachalta vegomer. ze maaser sheni. shekkevar limmedanu litten maaser rishon lalviyim, shenneemar "ki tikchu meet bene yisrael vegomer" (Bamidbar 18) venatan lahem reshut leachlo bechol makom, shenneemar "vaachaltem oto bechol makom" (sham 18), al karchacha ze maaser acher hu:
Shamot kol baal mashshe yado. shamot et yado shel kol baal mashshe:

Rak bechol avvat nafshecha. bamme hakkatuv medabber? im bivsar taava lehattirah lahem belo hakeravat emurim hare amur bemakom acher (pasuk 20) "ki yarchiv Adonai et gevulecha vegomer veamarta ochla vasar vegomer", bamme ze medabber? bekadashim shennafal bahem mum sheyyippadu veyeachlu bechol makom, yachol yippadu al mum over? talo "rak" (sifre):
Tizbach veachalta. en lecha vahem hetter gizza vechalav ella achila al yede zevicha (22 6):
Hattame vahetaher. lefi shebbau mikkoach kadashim shenneemar bahem "vehabbasar asher yigga bechol tame lo yeachel" (Vayikra 7), hutzrach lehattir bo shettame vetahor ochlim bikara achat:
Katztzevi vechaayyal. sheen karban ba mehem:
Katztzevi vechaayyal. lefatran min hazzeroa vehallechayayim vehakkeva (sifre):
Hakke takke. im encha yachol lahamitam bammita hakketuva bahem, hamitem beacheret (sifre; bava metzia 31):
Lahollim. larshaim hamearbevim et yisrael:
targum: Amaret limtalavun la titlaavun verashiaya la terimun aykar:

rashi: Rak et damo lo tochel. shello tomar hoil vechullo hetter habba mikkelal issur hu, shehare kadosh venishchat bachutz belo fidyon veneechol, yachol yehe af haddam muttar, talmud lomar rak et damo lo tochel:
Vezavachta pesach laAdonai elohecha tzon. shenneemar (Shemot 12) min hakkevasim umin haizzim tikkachu:
Uvakar. tizbach lachagiga, sheim nimnu al happesach chavura merubba, meviim immo chagiga kede sheyyehe neechol al hassova (fesachim 69); veod lamdu rabbotenu devarim harebe mippasuk ze:
Venatan elecha ot. bashshamayim, kainyan shenneemar begidon (Shoftim 6) "veasita li ot" veomer "yehi na chorev el haggizza" vegomer:
O mofet. baaretz, aappi chen lo tishma lo, veim tomar mippene ma noten lo hakkabba memshala laasot ot? ki menasse Adonai elohechem etchem (sifre; 80 sanhedrin 90):
ohc: Ki yakum bekirbecha navi. amro navi, perush, afillu hu muchzak lenavi, hagam sheyyihye neeman etzlecha im amar lecha laavor al ezo mitzva lefi shaa keeliyyahu behar hakkarmel (Melachim 1 18), vechulei, af al pi chen im yomar lecha shettaavod avoda zara chayyav mita.

Venatan elecha ot vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma lo hizkir bitchilla maamar hannavi davar shealav natan haot vegomer. od tzarich ladaat kavvanat amro uva haot vegomer lemor vegomer, vechi haot hu haomer? halo hannavi hu haomer laavod avoda zara sheal ze hu shemmitchayyev mita?

Venire shennitkavven hakkatuv ledabber keneged navi shebba vedibber beseder ze: Adonai amar elav sheim yitten mofet ze o ot ze, kavvanat haot hu lomar shennaavod avoda zara, veim yihye haot vehammofet beseder ze en hakkavvana ken ella adrabba letaavah ulesarfah kemishpatah harishon. uva haot vehammofet – perush, hagam shehu lo amar ella o ze o ze, uvau shenehem haot vehammofet, vehayu beseder asher amar sheyyaggidu al kavvanat Adonai shertzono sheyyaavdu avoda zara, lo tishma vegomer, vechayyav mita hannavi vegomer, hagam shello hechlit bidvarav sheyyaavdu ad bo haot vehammofet vehem haomrim laavod, veod shehu lo amar ella o ot o mofet vehayu shenehem, af al pi chen lo tishma vegomer.

rashi: Zot habbehema, ayil utzevi veyachmur. lamadnu shehachayya vichlal behema, velamadnu shehabbehema vechayya temea merubba min hattehora, shebbechol makom poret et hammuat (sifre; chullin 13):
Lifne Adonai elohecha tochlennu. lakkohen hu omer, shekkevar matzinu shehu mimmattenot kehunna echad tam veechad baal mum, shenneemar (Bamidbar 18) uvesaram yihye lach vegomer (22 28):

Shana veshana. mikkan sheen mashhin oto yoter al shenato; yachol yehe pasul mishsheavra shenato, kevar hukkash lemaaser, shenneemar (Devarim 14) veachalta lifne Adonai elohecha masar degancha tiroshcha veyitzharecha uvechorot bekarcha vetzonecha, ma maaser sheni eno nifsal mishshana lachavertah af bechor eno nifsal, ella shemmitzva toch shenato (22 27):
Shana veshana. im shechato besof shenato ochlo oto hayyom veyom echad mishshana acheret, limmed shenneechol lishne yamim velayla echad (sham):
Yigmar. leshon killayon, vechen patar menachem "gamar omer" (tehillim 77:9), "gamar chasid" (tehillim 12:2), vechen kullam (sefer acher eno):
Utechonen tzaddik uvochen libbot. atta yodea mi hu hatztzaddik shettechonnehu:
Elohim tzaddik. ken shemecha:
targum: Yishtetze chean bisha derashie veyishtachlelun tzadike uvachen libbeve vechalyan elaha zakkaa:

rashi: Vekara alecha. yachol mitzva, talo velo yikra:
Vehaya vecha chet. mikkol makom, afillu lo yikra. im ken lamma neemar "vekara alecha"? memaher ani lippara al yede hakkore yoter mimmi sheeno kore (sham):
Kol of tahor tochelu. velo et hattame, ba litten ase al lo taase; vechen babbehema "otah tochelu", velo vehema temea, velav habba mikkelal ase ase, laavor alehem baase velo taase:
Ki ad tzedek yashuv mishpat. hayyissurin shellahem, ad sheyyitzdeku bishvilam. veachar hammishpat kol yishre lev yitkabbetzu, ki yittelu secharam:
targum: Arum ad tzidkata yetuv dina uvatroy yitparkun kol teritze libba:

rashi: Halo hemma. natan bahem siman:
Achare. achar haavarat hayyarden harebe vahala lemerachok; vezehu leshon achare, kol makom shenneemar achare muflag hu:

Derech mevo hashshemesh. lehallan min hayyarden letzad maarav, vetaam hammikra mochiach shehem shene devarim, shenninkedu vishne teamim, "achare" nakud befashta, vederech" nakud bemashpel, vehu dagesh, veim haya "achare derech" dibbur echad, haya nakud "achare" bimsharet, beshofar hafuch, vederech" befashta verafe:
Mul haggilgal. rachok min haggilgal:
Elone more. shechem hu, shenneemar (Bereshit 12) ad mekom shechem ad elon more (sifre):
Veakko. meturgam yaala (Iyov 39) "yaale sala", hu ashetanebavek:
Uteo. "torbala", tor hayyaar, "bala" — yaar bilshon arammi:
Levi ger yatom vealmana. arbaa shelli keneged arbaa shellecha – bincha uvittecha veavdecha vaamatecha, im atta mesammeach et shelli ani mesammeach et shellecha:
Shellecha. hashshole dagim min hayyam (sham):

Lo taasun kechol asher anachnu osim vegomer. musav lemala al ki attem ovrim et hayyarden vegomer, keshettaavru et hayyarden miyyad attem muttarim lehakeriv bevama kol 14 shana shel kibbush vechilluk, uvabbama lo takrivu kol ma sheattem makrivim po hayyom bammishkan, shehu immachem venimshach vehu chasher lehakeriv bo chattaot vaashamot nedarim unedavot, aval bevama en karev ella hanniddar vehanniddav, vezehu ish kol hayyashar beenav, nedarim unedavot, sheattem mitnaddevim ay sheyyashar beenechem lahaviam velo ay chova, otam takrivu babbama (sham; zevachim 117):

Sheshet yamim tochal matztzot. uvemakom acher (Shemot 12) hu omer "shivat yamim"? shiva min hayyashan veshishsha min hechadash (sifre; menachot 66); davar acher — limmed al achilat matztza bashshevii sheenah chova, umikkan atta lamed lesheshet yamim, shehare shevii bichlal haya veyatza min hakkelal lelammed sheen achilat matztza bo chova ella reshut, velo lelammed al atzmo yatza, ella lelammed al hakkelal kullo yatza, ma shevii reshut af kullam reshut, chutz millayla harishon shehakkatuv kevao chova, shenneemar (Shemot 12) "baerev tochlu matztzot" (mechilta; fesachim 120):
Atzeret laAdonai elohecha. atzor atzmecha min hammelacha; davar acher — kenufeya shel maachol umishte, leshon "natzera na otach" (Shoftim 13):
Kol tzippor tehora tochelu. lehattir meshullachat shebbammetzora (sifre; kiddushin 57):
Et habberacha. al menat asher tishmeu:
ohc: Et habberacha asher vegomer. amro et, lehair ki millevad habberacha hammusseget midderech Adonai, od lo immah yiud hattov, vehu asher tishmeu, ki hashshemia battora hu taanug mufla umechayye hannefesh, keamro (yeshaya 55:3) "shimu utechi nafshechem", vehammargish betaam hattora tesichennu nafsho ki alav leshallem gemul tov lemattan mattana tova muflet, veen tzarich lomar sheen litboa sachar aleha.

Od yirtze al pi divrehem zichronam livracha sheamru zechut yesh lah keren veyesh lah perot (kiddushin 40.), vehu ma sheramaz beamro et habberacha, ki tevat habberacha metzayyenet olam shehu mekor habberacha vechullo baruch, veribbuy "et" leferot hazzechut sheochel baolam hazze.

Vedikdek lomar asher, gilla hakkatuv shello ratza hannavi laasot haddavar begeder hassafek lomar "im", veamar "asher" shehu davar muchlat kaasher kivveta lahem nefesh hatztzaddik. vetala hakkatuv habberacha bashshemia velo hizkir lo maase velo shemira, lefi shehashshomea divre elohim chayyim hattora metiva nafsho umeyashsharto ki yesh bah sam chayyim, keamram zichronam livracha (Eicha Rabba, Petichta) veze leshonam: "hammaor shebbah machziro lemutav", laze tala hakkol bashshemia.

rashi: Mafreset. seduka, ketargumo:
Parsa. 171:
Veshosaat. chaluka vishte tzipparnayim, sheyyesh seduka veenah chaluka batztzipparnayim, vehi temea:
Babbehema. mashma ma shennimtza vabbehema echol, mikkan amru shehashshelil nittar bishchitat immo (chullin 69):
Vaavartem et hayyarden vishavtem baaretz. shettechallekuha vihe chol echad makkir et chelko veet shivto (nusach acher – shivto):
Veheniach lachem. leachar kibbush vechilluk umenucha min haggoyim asher hinniach Adonai lenassot bam et yisrael – veen zo ella bime david – az:
Lashevet sham. perat lirushalayim shello nittena ledira (sham):
Ki tishma, lemor. omrim ken yatzu vegomer –
ohc: Lashevet sham lemor. amro lemor, nitkavven lema sheamru zichronam livracha (ketuvot 110.) sheyyesh mitzva lashevet beeretz kenaan, vehu amro lashevet sham lemor keillu amar lemor lashevet sham.

Od yitbaer bedikduk amro yatzu anashim bene veliyyaal, lamma amar "anashim" shehaya maspik lomar "bene veliyyaal" vaani yodea shehem anashim, veim lomar anashim velo ketannim – ze eno tzarich kera lemaatam shekkol shello higgia lichlal onashin en tzarich lemaato. achen nitkavven hakkatuv lomar shehagam sheamru "yatzu anashim", perush shehem tzaddikim, keamram zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba 16) "anashim" shebbammikra tzaddikim, vehu amro lemor yatzu anashim, modiacha hakkatuv shettachzik otam bivne veliyyaal vetasir mehem chezkat kashrut.

Od yirtze, shehagam shello shamata haddevarim berurim sheyyatzu hammaddichim, ella amira shennishma mimmenna davar ze sheyyatzu vegomer, vedarashta vegomer – perush yaase derisha vachakira ladaat im yesh mammash bakkol hannishma, vehu amro vedarashta vechakarta veshaalta, umin harauy haya lo lehakedim "veshaalta" shehi hashsheela veachar kach hadderisha vehachakira, ella nitkavven lomar sheyyidrosh bashshemia harishona sheshshama im yesh edim baddavar veachar kach yishal pi haedim ladun al pi edutam.

rashi: Behimmatzo. kodem gezar din, beod shehu omer lachem "dirshuni":
targum: Tevau dechalta dayya ad deattun chayin beo min kodamohi ad deattun kayamin:

rashi: Kol keli yutzar. kol keli zayin asher yilteshuhu vichaddeduhu bishvilech lehillachem bach:
Yutzar. leshon "charvot tzurim" (Yehoshua 5:2), "af tashiv tzur charbo" (tehillim 89:44):
targum: Kol zayin deyittakan alach yerushelem la yatzlach vechol lishan dikum imach ledina techayvine da achsanat avadaya dayya vezachvatehon min kodamay amar Adonai:

rashi: Rak im shamoa tishma. az lo yihye bach evyon:
Shamoa tishma. shama kima mashmiin oto harebe (sifre):
ohc: Rak im shamoa vegomer. amar maamar ze samuch lemaamar "lo yihye becha evyon", lefi shehaosher vehaoni lefi divrehem zichronam livracha (moed katan koach.) enam teluyim bizchut, laze amar samuch lehavetachat meniat haevyon rak im shamoa vegomer, perush im yisrael yishmeru kol haamur bappasuk, shamoa tishma ze talmud tora lilmod ulelammed, lishmor ze mitzvot lo taase, vlaasot ze mitzvot ase, vegamar omer et kol vegomer, perush shello yihye beyado bittul shum mitzvat lo taase velo menia mishshum mitzvat ase, az hu sheyyeshno bahavetacha shello yihye bo evyon, ki maamar chachamenu zichronam livracha sheamru sheeno taluy bizchut hu hagam sheyyihyu zechuyyotav merubbim, kol sheyyesh lo afillu chet echad lo yishlot al hammazzal hammare alav oni, aval kesheyyaggia lishlemut hattora vehammitzvot yishlot gam al hammazzal veyassig osher uvanim vechayyim.

rashi: Havedel yavdilani Adonai meal ammo. lamma etgayyer? halo hakkadosh baruch hu yavdileni meal ammo kesheyshallem secharam:
Veal yomar hassaris. lamma etiv derachay umaalalay? hen ani ketz yavesh, meen zikkaron:
targum: Vela yemar bar ammin demittosaf al ama dayya lememar afrasha yifreshinani Adonai meal ame vela yemar sarisa ha ana chashiv kea yavesh:

rashi: Velo yerae et pene Adonai rekam. ella have olot reiyya veshalme chagiga:
Lo tove lo. lo tehe taev lo, lo teehavennu, lefi shenneemar (Vayikra 19) veahavta lereacha kamocha – et ze lo teehav:
Velo tishma elav. behitchanneno al nafsho limchol lo, lefi shenneemar (Shemot 23) azov taazov immo – laze lo taazov:
Velo tachos encha alav. lefi shenneemar (Vayikra 19) lo taamod al dam reecha – al ze lo tachos:
Velo tachmol. lo tahafoch bizchuto:
Velo techasse alav. im atta yodea lo chova encha rashshay lishtok (sifre):
ohc: Veamro lo tachos vegomer, perush shetztzarich leharechik mimmennu kol asher teavve nafsho, afillu devarim sheen bahem issur, kede leannot adam nafsho, velo yachus velo yachmol alav lomar lamma yeanne nafsho lelo davar vaAdonai hirshahu leteavon ze. vehinne hagam sheinnuy ze hu lannefesh, ikkaro hi leoto hammitlavve lah shehem kochot hammesitim shezzacharnu, vehu sod hattaanit sheyyitanne haadam leabbed koach hara haddavuk bo shehu koach hammesit haamur.

Veamro velo techasse, perush, al derech maase shel rav amram chasida (kiddushin 81.) shetztzaak "nura be amram!", veussefu yachad gam bene adam gam bene ish, uvaze geresh mimmennu mesit. vehu amro lo techasse alav – hacherez alav vegallehu leene hakkol, uvaze tihye nimlat mimmennu, ki vaze atta horgo, vehu amro ki harog tahargennu.

Veamro yadcha tihye vo varishona lahamito vegomer, perush shello hirsha otcha hakkatuv legallot maasav velikro kehechasid "nura be amram" (kiddushin 81.) ella keshello tassig yadcha, aval keshettassig lehitatztzem kenegdo velidchoto en lecha lehikkalem bederech ze, ella yadcha tihye vo varishona lahamito, al derech amro (tehillim 109:22) "velibbi chalal bekirbi", veim lo tassig yadcha – yad kol haam baacharona, likro "nura be amram" lavo elav haam lehargo bechocham, sheibbud taavato hi harigato.

rashi: Mi yakum li. zechut mi yaamod lanu ben hammereim hallalu?
targum: Man yakum li leagacha kerava im mavashin man yitattad li lemintzi im avde shekar:

rashi: Lo tochlennu. azhara ledam hattamtzit (keritut 4):
Hinne anochi. asher barati charash hammetakken keli, vaani asher barati mashchit hamechabbelo, kelomar: ani hu sheggeriti bach et haoyev, ani hu shehitkanti lo puraniyyot:
Umotzi cheli lemaasehu. letzorech, gomro kol tzarko:
targum: Ha ana baret nappacha nafach nur bishchorin umappik mana letzorche vaana baret mechabbela lechabbala:

rashi: Lo tevashshel gedi … asser teasser. ma inyan ze etzel ze? amar lahem hakkabba leyisrael: al tigremu li levashshel gedayim shel tevua ad shehen bime immotehen, sheim en attem measserim maasrot karauy keshehu samuch lehitbashshel ani motzi ruach kadim vehi meshaddaftan, shenneemar (Melachim 2 19) "ushedefa lifne kama", vechen leinyan bikkurim (250 Rabbi; tanchuma):
Shana shana. mikkan sheen measserin min hechadash al hayyashan (sifre):
Veet mitzvotav tishmoru. torat moshe:
Uvekolo tishmau. bekol hanneviim:
Veoto taavodu. bemikdasho (sifre):
Uvo tidbakun. hiddabbek bidrachav – gemol chasadim, kevor metim, bakker cholim, kemo sheasa hakkabba (sota 14):
ohc: Achare Adonai vegomer. kashe lamma hifsik befasuk ze beemtza mishpat nevi sheker, shehare acharav hu omer "vehannavi hahu vegomer yumat", shehaya lo leamro achar pasuk "vehannavi" vegomer. od tzarich ladaat lamma heerich kol elle haddevarim telechu, tirau, tishmoru, tishmau, taavodu, tidbakun?

Venire shebba lehair haddevarim hakkelalim sheyyeshnam baavodat Adonai, kede shetteda mehem lechayyev hannavi vehacholem kesheyyomar laasot achat mehenna laavoda zara. vehitchil lomar "achare Adonai elohechem telechu" – zo mitzvat kabbalat ol malchut shamayim, lalechet achare Adonai velo achare zulato. ha lamadta sheim amar hannavi lekabbel alehem avoda zara lalechet achareha – chayyav. vedikdek lomar "telechu" leshon atid, lehaircha beshiur chiyyuv hannavi shemmitchayyev alav, shehagam shello amar "kum avod" atta, ella tekabbelu avoda zara alechem leeloah lemachar – yitchayyev mita meet sheamar lahem haddevarim, hagam sheddevarav leatid.

Veamro veoto tirau – perush, davka oto tirau velo laavoda zara. hakkavvana, sheim ba lomar yerou meavoda zara pelonit, hagam shello amar laasot lah davar velo leavdah ella leyirah shemma tarea lo, veen ze memaet yirato yitbarach, af al pi chen chayyav mita, ki oto levad yiru.

Veamro veet mitzvotav tishmoru mitzvotav velo mitzvot avoda zara, hakkavvana baze sheim tetzavve avoda zara laasot davar sheyyesh bo hanaa, kegon shettomar avoda zara: "mi sheyyirtze lehareviach yaase davar ze veyarviach" vechaddome laze, veen bemaase ze davar shennogea laavoda zara, veyesh makom lomar kevan sheen bedavar ze min avoda en bechach kelum, talmud lomar mitzvotav yitbarach tishmoru, veim ba hannavi lomar she tzivva lo sheyyaasu divre avoda zara baze veyatzlichu – yumat.

Veamro uvekolo tishmau, perush, davka bekolo yitbarach hu sheyyesh lachem lishmoa, lilmod ulelammed imrotav hattehorot, velo bekolah shel avoda zara, sheim avoda zara amra ezo amarim asur leshamam. veim ba hannavi veamar shetztzivva Adonai lelech laavoda zara lishmoa devareha, hagam sheen bahem lo maase velo leyira mimmenna, af al pi chen yumat.

Veamro veoto taavodu, perush, laAdonai velo lezulato, vehakkavvana baze al derech amram zichronam livracha (gittin 57.) sheamar kesar leven katan shel channa sheyyaarim lehashelich tabbato meal yado lifne avoda zara veyelech vivienna veyerae laroim sheavad, hagam sheen belibbo leavdah velo ratza vechulei, al ken ba hakkatuv kan lomar sheim ba navi lomar al pi Adonai ki Adonai marshehu laasot ken yumat hannavi:

Veamro uvo tidbakun yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (ketuvot ki:) vechi efshar liddavek bashshechina? ella sheyyidbak belomde tora shehem merkava lashshechina ucheillu nidbak bo yitbarach. vechan tzivva Adonai shello yidbak ella bikrove Adonai ukedoshav, velishlol ba shello yidbak bikrove avoda zara, veim ba navi veamar bemaamar Adonai laasot ken – yumat hannavi hahu. veulay ki laze nitkavven beamro uva haot vehammofet lemor nelcha achare elohim acherim velo amar nelcha venaavda elohim acherim, lomar shechayyavin gam im lo yomru laavod, vahagam sheggamar omer venaavdem, hakkavvana baze shessofo lomar venaavdem, uleolam sheyyitchayyev al kol peratim sherasham Adonai bappasuk "achare Adonai" vegomer, velaze gamar omer vehannavi hahu vegomer perush sheratza lenagged haamur yumat. vetaam hammita amar hakkatuv ki dibber sara al Adonai, vahagam shello hesit beferush laavod avoda zara af al pi chen mechayyevo hakkatuv al sheshshikker al Adonai shennibba devarim raim kaelle, umodia Adonai shennevua kazo lo yenabbe nevio, vahagam sheyyenabbeo lomar leyisrael levattel ezo mitzva horaat shaa, davka bishar mitzvot, aval baavoda zara kol shehu beissur, ben davar shechayyav alav mita uven davar sheeno chayyav alav mita lo yaskim Adonai alav laasoto afillu lefi shaa. veim amar ken navi sheker ana baAdonai, vechen amru besifre veze leshonam: "ki dibber sara" – shebba lezayyef devarav shel hakkadosh baruch hu, ad kan, veal ziyyufo hu met.

Vechutz middarkenu yitbaer hakkatuv shebba lehazehir al kelalut hattora shekkalal beshishsha sidre mishna al ze hadderech, achare Adonai vegomer telechu ze seder zeraim, ulefi sheyyesh bahem din leket shichcha ufea umattenot aniyyim vechullan mimmiddotav yitbarach, gam leinyan maaser sheni shetztzarich leholicho lammakom asher yivchar Adonai, gam beinyan maaser levi, perush al derech ma sheamru zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba lo) maase beadam echad shehaya noten maasrotav vehayta lo sadehu motzia lo elef vechulei, leachar zeman met haish hahu veamad beno shana rishona raa eno bemaasro ufichet mishshiur hatztzarich, leshana habbaa hotzia lo hassade keshiur ma sheppara alav eshtakad, leshana acheret pichet od, hotzia lo sadehu keshiur ma sheppara shana sheavra, vechen al ze hadderech, ad kan, haddevarim mochichim ki leshiur ma shehaya noten hayta sadehu motzia lo. laze ba maamaro yitbarach kan vetzivva alav sheyyelech hu achar maasav yitbarach latet kefi ma sheyyitten lo, velo yesovev she yelech acharav kefi ma sheyyitten hu maasrotav al ofen shekkatavnu.

Od nitkavven hakkatuv lomar lashon ze keneged seder zeraim, lefi shebbo michyat haadam umezonotav, vechatav rambam behilchot deot (83 7) shetztzarich sheyyechavven adam bemaachalo uvemishtehu lehaverot gufo laavodat Adonai vechulei, dichtiv (Mishlei 3:6) "bechol derachecha daehu" vegomer, vehu maamar achare Adonai elohechem telechu bedarchechem.

Veoto tirau – ze seder moed, uremazam betevat oto, ki shabbat nikra ot, dichtiv (Shemot 31:17) "ot hi", gam yamim tovim nikraim otot, veyiches lahem hammora al derech amram zichronam livracha besefer tikkune hazzohar (tikun 9) yere shabbat, shetztzarich liro meansham.
Veet mitzvotav tishmoru – ze seder nashim, shetztzarich lishmor harebe mitzvot shebbehilchot nashim veissure bia vezikot.

Uvekolo tishmau – ze seder nezikin, veramaz bemaamar uvekolo tishmau shetztzarich lehattot ozen laasher yishpetu hashshoftim lechayyev hachayyav ulezakkot hazzakkay, velo yasur mikkol asher yoruhu, uchemo sheamar hakkatuv (Devarim 17:12) "vehaish vegomer levilti shemoa el hakkohen vegomer o el hashshofet" vegomer.
Veoto taavodu – ze seder kadashim, shekkullo mishpete avodat bet elohenu.
Uvo tidbakun – ze seder teharot shekkullo mishpete hatteharot, uremazo bemaamar uvo tidbakun ki beemtzaut hattahara yihyu reuyim liddavek bashshechina.

rashi: Uva hallevi. veyittol maaser rishon:
Vehagger vehayyatom. veyittelu maaser sheni, shehu shel ani shel shana zo, velo tochlennu atta birushalayim kederech shennizkakta leechol maaser sheni shel shete shanim:

Veachlu vesaveu. ten lahem kede savan, mikkan amru en pochatin leani baggoren vechulei (sifre 110). veatta holech lirushalayim bammaaser shel shana rishona usheniyya shehishheta, umitvadde "biarti hakkodesh min habbayit" kemo shemmeforash bechi techalle laser (Devarim 26):

Vedarashta vechakarta veshaalta hetev. mikkan lamdu sheva chakirot meribbuy hammikra, kan yesh 3 – derisha vachakira vehetev, veshaalta eno min hamminyan, umimmennu lamdu bedikot – uvemakom acher hu omer (Devarim 19) "vedarshu hashshoftim hetev", veod bemakom acher hu omer (sham 17) "vedarashta hetev", lamdu 'hetev 'hetev ligzera shava, litten haamur shel ze baze (sanhedrin 40):
Kaasher dibber lach. vehechan dibber? (Devarim 28) baruch atta bair (sifre):
Vehaavatta. kol leshon halevaa keshennofel al hammalve nofel bilshon mafil, kegon vehilvita, vehaavatta. veim haya omer veavatta haya nofel al hallove, kemo velavita:
Vehaavatta goyim. yachol shettehe love mizze umalve laze, talo "veatta lo taavot":
Umashalta begoyim rabbim. yachol goyim acherim moshlim alecha, talo "uvecha lo yimsholu" (sham):

Kol habbechor, takdish. uvemakom acher (Vayikra 27) hu omer "lo yakdish ish oto", ha chetzad? eno makdisho lekarban acher; vechan limmed shemmitzva lomar hare atta kadosh livchora. davar acher — i efshar lomar "takdish", shekkevar neemar "lo yakdish", vei efshar lomar "lo yakdish", shehare chevar neemar "takdish", ha chetzad? makdisho atta hekdesh illuy venoten lahekdesh kefi tovat hanaa shebbo (arachin 29):
Lo taavod bivchor shorecha velo tagoz vegomer. af hachilluf lamdu rabbotenu sheasur, ella sheddibber hakkatuv bahove (bechorot 25):
Sheretz haof. hem hannemuchim, harochashim al haaretz. zevuvin utzeraim vachagavim temeim keruyim sheretz:
Ki yihye vecha evyon. hattaev taev kodem:
Meachad achecha. achicha meavicha kodem leachicha meimmecha:
Shearecha. aniyye ircha kodmim laaniyye ir acheret:
Lo teammetz. yesh lecha adam shemmitztaer im yitten im lo yitten, lechach neemar "lo teammetz". yesh lecha shepposhet et yado vekoftzah, lechach neemar "lo tikpotz" (sham):
Meachicha haevyon. im lo titten lo, sofcha lihyot achiv shel evyon (sham):
ohc: Ki yihye vecha evyon vegomer. amro vecha, ulay shennitkavven lirmoz maamaram zichronam livracha (bava batra 10.) sheamru ki taam shebbocher Adonai leyasser laadam baolam hazze beyissure haoni hu kede shebbeemtzauto yizke chavero hammefarneso, vehu ma sheramaz bemaamar becha evyon perush besibbatcha ba lo haoni haggadol. veamro meachad achecha, perush lo tachshov biroto evyon shehu pachut, da shehu mehammeyuchadim shebbeachecha veen hochacha mehaoni heyoto shefal achim. vetaam shessidder haderagot ellu meachad achecha meartzecha, hagam sherabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (bava metzia 71.) shebba lomar aniyyecha vaaniyye ircha vegomer,

Od efshar lomar gam ken haderagot haggezerot asher yigzor Adonai baevyonim, hinne kevar perashti befasuk (Shemot 22:24) "im kesef talve" vegomer shechelek heani mafkido Adonai beyad heashir, veze hu ashro shemmufkadim beyado meot haaniyyim. vehinne lifamim yafkid Adonai menat ani ze leadam karov laish velo yitztaer bilkichat parnasato mimmennu leheyoto kerovo, gam lo yitztarech lesovev netivot. uchesheyyishpot Adonai betzedek letzaer heani, yarchik lo parnasato beish zar gam berichuk makom, veyitztaer haevyon lesovev meir leir limtzo makom asher hechin Adonai lo sham teref nafsho. vehu amro meachad achecha, o hagam sheeno achicha ella hu beachad shearecha, o hagam sheeno meircha beartzecha.
O yirtze amro beartzecha, perush afillu beartzecha shehu mekom haosher lechol yisrael, af al pi chen yimmatze bah evyon.

Uvederech remez yirmoz lehair heara gedola al echad hammeyuchad shebbaumma, sheelav anu mekavvim umetzappim matay yavo, vehu melech yisrael meshichenu asher hu evyon, uchevar nimshal leani keamro (Zecharya 9:9) "ani verochev al chamor", veramaz haddavar asher yesovvennu lihyot evyon veamar becha, perush besibbatcha, ki avonotenu heerichu kitztzenu. gam ramaz betevat becha ki hu evyon banu shemmitavve matay yavo legoolenu, vetze ulemad mimma sheamru rabbotenu zichronam livracha bemaase rabbi yehoshua ben levi shekkesheraahu melech hammashiach shealo al yisrael shebbaolam, veamar lo rabbi yehoshua ben levi ki hem yoshvim umetzappim biato, uchesheshshama ken gaa hechasid bivchiyya rabba mitteshukato lavo legoolam. velaze ramaz beamro meachad achecha shehu hammeyuchad shebbeachecha, al derech sheppershu rabbotenu zichronam livracha (targum yonatan al Bereshit 26:10) beamro "kimat shachav achad haam" shertzono lomar echad hammeyuchad shehu melech haam. veamro beachad shearecha lehair elav shehu meyuchad shebbesanhedrin sheen kamohu more, keamro (yeshaya 11:3-4) "veshafat betzedek vegomer velo lemare enav yishpot" vegomer ella "vaharicho beyirat Adonai". uferush shearecha al derech amro (Devarim 25:7) "vealta yevimto hashshara". veamro beartzecha lehair ki horato veledato beeretz yisrael hakkedosha.

O yirtze al ze hadderech: evyon beachad shearecha, al pi divrehem zichronam livracha sheamru besefer hazzohar (Zohar chodesh parashat noach) veze leshono: i chada kehila o chada kenishta yittearun bityuveta miyyad ate ben david, ad kan, umeatta evyon hu taev bedavar ze shehu achad shearecha shezze yaspik lemalleot taavato lavo berinna. veamro beartzecha, heir mekom taavato hi eretz hakkedosha asher Adonai elohecha noten lach, shehu taev matay tippaked hair hayyona (Tzefanya 3:1) chemdat hallevavot. vitzav Adonai lechol ish yisrael shello yeammetz et levavo vegomer, ella yitchazzek bechol oz vetaatzumot lemalleot cheshek haechad hammeyuchad, ki beemtzaut maase bene adam uvifrat bemitzvat hatztzedaka dichtiv (yeshaya 54:14) "bitzdaka tikkonani". vegamar omer meachicha haevyon, perush missibbat achicha haevyon hayyadua, sheyyaarich adam bedato shehammaase hu letachlit davar ze shel meshiach Adonai shemo chayyim.

rashi: Hera vaheayh. hi raa hi ayya hi dayya, velamma nikra shemah raa? sheroa beyoter, velamma hizhir bechol shemoteha? shello litten pitchon pe levaal din lachalok – shello yehe haosrah kore otah raa, vehabba lehattir omer zo dayya shemah o ayya shemah, vezo lo asar hakkatuv. uvaofot peret lecha hattemeim lelammed shehaofot hattehorim merubbim al hattemeim, lefichach peret et hammuat (chullin 63):
ohc: Veharaa vegomer leminah. nire shekkol min mehaesrim vearbaa (chullin 63.) sheyyesh bo minim harebe umeshunnim, amar bahem hakkatuv "leminehu" "leminehem", vechol sheen bo ella minim muatim vedomim ketzat eno omer "lemino". veharaya ki nesher lo neemar bo "lemino", veomer baggemara (chullin 61.) al of echad sheeno nikkar shehu nesher shechoshshin shehu min nesher, hare sheyyesh lannesher minim veaf al pi chen lo amar hakkatuv "lemino".

rashi: Ki gam et benehem. "gam" – lerabbot et avotehem veimmotehem; amar rabbi akiva ani raiti goy shekkefato leaviv lifne chalbo vaachalo (sifre):
Duma. "dumiyya" (tehillim 39:3):
targum: Ilule Adonai said li kizer sherat bishtikuta nafshi:

rashi: Et kol haddavar. kalla kachamura (sham):
Tishmeru laasot. litten lo taase al ase haamurim bapparasha, shekkol hishshamer leshon lo taase hu, ella sheen lokin al hishshamer shel ase (makkot 13):
Lo tosef alav. chamishsha totafot, chamishsha minin ballulav, arba berachot levirkat kohanim (sifre):

Ki mishne sechar sachir. mikkan amru eved ivri oved ben bayyom uven ballayla, vezehu chiflayim shebbaavodat sechire yom. umahu avodato vallayla? rabbo moser lo shifcha chenaanit vehavveladot laadon (sifre):
ohc: Ki mishne sechar sachir. ulefi ze haddin yitten sheim chala shalosh shanim eno tzarich lehashelim, ki yesh baze tashlum mamon shennatan bo. verabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (kiddushin 15.) veze leshonam: mikkan amru sachir oved bayyom, eved bayyom uvallayla, ad kan, vezo halacha uremuza bammikra.

rashi: Mikketz sheva shanim. yachol sheva shanim lechol milva umilva, talo "karva shenat hashsheva", veim atta omer sheva shanim lechol milva umilva, lehalevaot kol echad veechad, heach hi kereva? ha lamadta sheva shanim leminyan hashshemitta (sifre):
Sara. davar hammusar min haolam, shello haya velo nivra velo tzivvitiv ledabber ken, dayshatevarenaveraa belaaz:
Vehappodcha mibbet avadim. afillu en lo alecha ella sheppedaacha — dayyo (sifre):
ohc: Vehannavi hahu o cholem vegomer. hutzrach hakkatuv lomar navi vecholem, sheim lo haya omer ella navi hayiti omer shello chiyyev hakkatuv mita ella laze sheamar sheddibber Adonai elav binvua, shemmetzuvvim yisrael lishmoa lenavi, dichtiv (Devarim 18:15) "elav tishmaun", ma sheen ken habba bedivre chalomot, sheen chiyyuv al yisrael lishmoa divre chalomot veyesh makom lomar alehem "chalomot shav yedabberu" – eno chayyav, talmud lomar "o cholem". veim haya omer "cholem" vegomer velo navi, hayiti omer sheen chayyav mita ella hacholem, aval hannavi, uma gam navi shehu muchzak linvi emet kemo shepperashti befasuk shellifne ze, yeamnu devarav kederech sheyyeamnu devarav, kesheyyomar laavor al shear mitzvot lefi shaa, talmud lomar "vehannavi" vegomer:

Hachalom hahu yumat ki dibber vegomer. kavvanat hakkatuv hi lefi sheyyomar haomer: bishlama hannavi bevadday shello tavo hannevua kederech ze ella asher bada millibbo, ma sheen ken hacholem, leheyot shebbachalom yavou lehaadam devarim muflaim vechozvim, yachol lihyot shezze haish chalom hazze chalam velo shikker. vehen emet im haya chiyyuv mita al asher yomar lahem ivdu avoda zara, ze yitchayyev middin mesit, aval kevan shehu met al sippur hachalom levad, uchemo shepperashti sheafillu hechlet haddevarim eno omer ella shehammofet hu haomer laavod, im ken lamma yamut hacholem al chalomo? laze amar ki dibber sara, perush, hagam shennatzdik lomar ki ba hachalom kidvarav, vehu ma sheheir betevat "hachalom", perush, lu yehi shehaemet heyoto chalom kidvarav, af al pi chen lo haya lo lehacheshivo ulesappero leam bene yisrael, kevan shehu dibber sara al Adonai, veal ze levad yumat.

Vegamar omer hammotzi etchem meeretz mitzrayim – ba hakkatuv lishpot betzedek chiyyuv mitat hacholem bemaamar ze, al ze hadderech: kevan she elohechem hotzi etchem meeretz mitzrayim, hare hera Adonai beayin petucha behakitz emunat Adonai vehachechashat zulato, uchemo shepperashti befarashat yitro befasuk "anochi Adonai vegomer asher hotzeticha meeretz mitzrayim" (Shemot 20:2), vechevan shekken hacholem hazze haya lo levattel et asher yaggid lo baal hachalomot baddimyonot hakkozvot mippene ma sheraa behakitz velo bachalom, vechevan shello asa chen uva lesappero – ze yaggid shetztzadku haddevarim etzlo vechafetz sheyyishmeu elav bet yisrael, laze yumat al chalomotav veal devarav.

Min hadderech asher tzivvecha Adonai. ba lomar ki taam chiyyuv mita lenavi vecholem hu lefi shebbau divrehem al davar shehu oker kelalut hattora, shehu avoda zara sheshshekula keneged kol hattora, ha lamadta sheim ba al achat mikkol mitzvot Adonai, ben cholem ben navi, lo yumetu, vedin hakkabbala mehem – baal hachalomot nomar elav shav yedabber, vehannavi im hu yadua linvi emet nekabbel mimmennu keeliyyahu behar hakkarmel:

Uviarta hara mikkirbecha. ulay sheyyirmoz leoto shekkerao hakkadosh baruch hu beshem ze, dichtiv (Bereshit 8:21) "yetzer lev haadam ra", velaze amar hara hayyadua. vehakkavvana baze ki kesheyyaasu mishpat bechayyotze baze mitbaer hara venittash kocho velo yitatztzem belibbot bene adam, keamro "mikkirbecha".

rashi: Hakkerovim elecha o harchokim. lamma peret kerovim urechokim? ella kach amar hakkatuv: mittivan shel kerovim atta lamed tivan shel rechokim, keshem sheen mammash bakkerovim, kach en mammash barchokim (sanhedrin sefer acher):
Miktze haaretz. zo chamma ulevana utzeva hashshamayim shehen mehallechin missof haolam vead sofo (sifre):
ohc: Meelohe haammim, perush, ki yavo betaana lehochiach mimma shellefanav meelohe haammim asher sevivotechem, ki yiru haammim shesseviv yisrael yachanu beshalva uvehatzlacha merubba veyomru elav lehiddamot lema shellefanav, o yavo betaana lehochiach hochacha gedola vehu keshettihye avoda zara shennitpashsheta baolam shekkol haolam o rubbo ovdim otah kemo sheera bazzemannim ellu, shemmalchut edom kullam ovdim vechulei, vehi pinna gedola, uledivre rabbotenu zichronam livracha (yoma 10.) sheamru atida malchut harshaa shettitpashshet bechol haolam, hinne avoda zara achat bechol haolam miktze haaretz vead ketze haaretz, vahasata zo immah taana lehochiach ki yesh bah mammash chas veshalom, af al pi chen amar "lo tove lo" vegomer, perush, notenet hattora etza laadam sheyyimmalet bah mimmennu, echad "lo tove lo", perush al derech amro (Mishlei 1:10) "beni im yefattucha chattaim al tove", perush, lo tikkanes immo betaanot ella shelilat haratzon belo taana. veayyen ma shepperashti befasuk "velo ava" (Devarim 2:30), veyishlol shemoa devarav od baze, vehattaam sheim yikkanes immo betaanot, hatemadat hachoshev tolid techunat hara baadam.

rashi: Ish kemattenat yado. mi sheyyesh lo ochlin harebe unechasim merubbin yavi olot merubbot ushelamim merubbim (sifre; chagiga 8):

Lo taasun ken. lehaketir lashshamayim bechol makom, ki im bammakom asher yivchar. davar acher — venittatztem et mizbechotam, vaavadtem et shemam, lo taasun ken. azhara lammochek et hashshem velannotetz even min hammizbeach o min haazara (makkot 22). amar Rabbi yishmael vechi taale al datecha sheyyisrael nottzin et hammizbechot? ella shello taasu chemaasehem veyigremu avonotechem lemikdash avotechem sheyyitcharev (sifre):
ohc: Lo taasun ken laAdonai elohechem. rabbotenu zichronam livracha besifre amru veze leshonam: amar rabbi yishmael, minnayin lammochek ot min hashshem sheover belo taase? dichtiv "veibbadtem et shemam lo taasun ken", ad kan. veulay ki nitkavven hakkatuv lirmoz shene perate dinim sheyyeshnam bedin hammochek shem mishshemotav yitbarach: echad hashshem atzmo, veechad hannitpal laAdonai milleacharav. beamro "laAdonai" hare azhara al hashshem, velo havaya levad ella shekkol kayyotze bo mishshemotav, veze binyan av lahem. veamro elohechem ramaz lechem shennitpelu lelohim. uma shekkatav rambam beferek 6 mehilchot yesode hattora sheen loke ella al otiyyot hashshem, kevan sheen haddavar meforash beferush bakkatuv eno loke alav. vesham besifre amru od veze leshonam: minnayin lenotetz even achat min haazara sheover belo taase? dichtiv "lo taasun" vegomer. nire shello amar bediyyuk even achat ella sheose bintitzato roshem babbinyan.

rashi: Kuma Adonai beappecha. al sonay, kegon yishbi veechav ufelishtim (Shmuel 2 21:16), shello emmaser beyadam:
Hinnase. hitpaer lehareot nikmat evra behitabbercha alehem:
Veura elay. sheuchal laasot bahem mishpat nekama asher tzivvita, vehechan tzivvita? "teroem beshevet barzel" (tehillim 2:9), "veayavti et oyvecha" (Shemot 23:22). ze matzati vammidrash:
targum: Kum Adonai betukefach itnatal berugeza al meikay vesarhev li dina di fakedta:

rashi: Eved olam. yachol kemashmao, talo "veshavtem ish el achuzzato veish el mishpachto tashuvu" (Vayikra 25), ha lamadta sheen ze ella olamo shel yovel (mechilta Shemot 21):
Veaf laamatcha taase ken. haanek lah; yachol af lirtzia hishva hakkatuv otah, talo (Shemot 21) "veim amor yomar haeved" – eved nirtza veen ama nirtzaat (sifre):
ohc: Lecha eved olam. lefi shebbeshesh shanim im yamut harav yashlim lifne beno, baavoda zo shel retzia lecha hu sheyyihye eved olam velo levincha.

rashi: Vehayita ach sameach. lefi feshuto en ze leshon tziuuy ella leshon havetacha, ulefi talmudo lamdu mikkan lerabbot lele yom tov haacharon lesimcha (sham 48):
Elohe tehillati al techerash. al kol yisrael neemar:
targum: Leshabbacha al yad david tushebcha elohim shevachati la tishtok:

rashi: Yafyafita mibbene adam. haoskim bimlechet chayye shaa, lamma? lefi shehutzak chen besiftotecha lehorot kahalacha. hutzak – kemo nishpach, kemo "mutzakot" (Zecharya 4:2), "vayyitzok aleha shemen" (Vayikra 2:1):
Al ken berachcha. kemo shenneemar "Adonai oz leammo yitten", uma secharan? "Adonai yevarech et ammo vashshalom" (tehillim 29:11):
targum: Shofrach malka meshicha adif mibbene nesha ityehev ruach nevua vesifvatach metul ken berchinach Adonai lealma:

rashi: Rachaki meoshek. kemo "hitnaari meafar" (Yeshayahu 52:2), tirchaki min haoshkim otach:

(Rachaki meoshek. tirchaki millaashok bene adam kederech sheosim reshaim, sheosfim mamon miggazel, aval attem lo titztarchu ligzol, ki lo tiru middallut vaaniyyut, umimmechitta ki lo tavo vlo tikrav elayich. aberabenaal.)
(Bitzdaka. shettaase tihye nechona bigullat olam, vetihye rechoka meoshek bene adam ki lo tirai, afillu pachad veyira lo yihye lach mehem, vetihye rechoka mimmechitta shelo tikrav elayich. 46 349.)
targum: Vezachuta tittaknin itrachaki meusheka are la tidchalin umittevira are la yeul alach:

rashi: Leummim. sar vegadol alehem, umochiach umeid darchehem al penehem:
targum: Ha rav leammaya manite melach veshalit al kol malkevata:

rashi: Shamor et chodesh haaviv. mikkodem boo shemor sheyyehe rauy leaviv – lehakeriv bo et minchat haomer, veim lav abber et hashshana (80 sanhedrin 11):

Mimmitzrayim layla. vahalo bayyom yatzu shenneemar (Bamidbar 33) mimmochorat happesach yatzu vene yisrael vegomer? ella lefi shebballayla natan lahem paro reshut latzet, shenneemar (Shemot 12) vayyikra lemoshe uleaharon layla vegomer (Bereshit 9):
Lemaan yashuv Adonai mecharon appo. shekkol zeman sheaza vaolam charon af baolam (sifre):
ohc: Venatan lecha rachamim verichamcha. kavvanat maamar ze kan, lefi shetztzivva al ir hanniddachat sheyyahargu kol hair lefi cherev vaafillu behemtam, maase hazze yolid teva haachzariyyut belev haadam, kemo shessipperu lanu hayyishmeelim kat harotzchim bemaamar hammelech ki yesh lahem cheshek gadol beshaa shehorgim adam, venichreta mehem shoresh harachamim vehayu leachzar, vehabbechina atzmah tihye nishreshet berotzche ir hanniddachat. laze amar lahem havetacha sheyyitten lahem Adonai rachamim, hagam shehatteva yolid bahem haachzariyyut, mekor harachamim yashpia bahem koach harachamim mechadash levattel koach haachzariyyut shennolad bahem mikkoach hammaase.
Veamro verichamcha, heir baze shekkol zeman shehaadam hu begeder teva achzari, kemo chen yitnaheg Adonai immo, sheen hashshem yitbarach merachem ella lerachman.

Veamro vehirbecha nitkavven lenachem haam birotam ki nifretzu peretz beavdan anshe ir achat yachad, laze hivticham ki lo yera levavam ki hu yarbe vimalle hachesron betosefet merubba. veamro ki tishma natan taam lehavetachato ki bishlama im hayta hartzicha shel anshe ir hanniddachat linkama enoshit yesh makom lehannimshach mehaddavar, ma sheen ken atta sheen hammaase ella mittaam kabbalat mitzvat hammelech, vehu amro ki tishma bekol Adonai lishmor et kol mitzvotav, ki kesheosim mishpat beir hanniddachat keillu kiyyemu kol mitzvot Adonai keamram zichronam livracha (sanhedrin ki:).

rashi: Vezacharta ki eved hayita vegomer. al menat ken pediticha, shettishmor vetaase et hachukkim haelle:

Beachad shevatecha. bechelko shel binyamin, ulemala hu omer "mikkol shivtechem", ha chetzad? keshekkana david et haggoren mearavna hayevusi gava hazzahav mikkol hashshevatim, umikkol makom haggoren bechelko shel binyamin haya (sham):
ohc: Asher yivchar Adonai beachad shevatecha. perush, shello telagleg lomar lamma yihye mekomo kavua etzel shevet echad mishshevatecha, vetachshov likboa makom zulato, ella en lecha ella hammakom hahu.

rashi: Hashshesua. beriyya hi sheyyesh lah shene gabbin ushete shidraot (sham 60); amru rabbotenu lamma nishnu? babbehemot mippene hashshesua uvaofot mippene haraa, shello neemru betko (sham 63):
Ki am kadosh atta. kedushshat atzmecha meavotecha, veod uvecha bachar Adonai:
Ach kaasher yeachel et hatztzevi vegomer. encha muzhar leachlan betohora, i ma tzevi veayyal chelban muttar af chullin chelban muttar? talo "ach":

Baarev kevo hashshemesh moed tzetcha mimmitzrayim. hare shelosha zemannim chalukim, baerev mishshesh shaot ulemala zavchehu, uchevo hashshemesh tochlehu, umoed tzetcha atta sorfehu, kelomar naase notar veyetze levet hasserefa (sifre; berachot 9):
Et hannochri tiggos. zo mitzvat ase (sham):
Duchifat. hu tarnegol habbar, uvelaaz harofe, vecharbalto chefula (22 68):

Vela yalin min habbasar asher tizbach baerev bayyom harishon labboker. azhara lammotir befesach dorot, lefi shello neemar ella befesach mitzrayim; veyom rishon haamur kan hu 14 benisan, kema deat amar "ach bayyom harishon tashbitu seor mibbattechem" (Shemot 12); ulefi shennistallek hakkatuv meinyano shel pesach vehitchil ledabber bechukkot shivat yamim, kegon shivat yamim tochal alav matztzot, velo yerae lecha seor bechol gevulcha, hutzrach lefaresh beezo zevicha hu mazhir, sheim katav velo yalin min habbasar asher tizbach baerev labboker hayiti omer shelamim hannishchatim kol shiva kullan beval totiru veenan neechalin ella leyom valayla, lechach katav baerev bayyom harishon. davar acher bachagigat 14 hakkatuv medabber, velimmed aleha shenneechelet lishne yamim, veharishon haamur kan beyom tov harishon hakkatuv medabber, vechen mashmaut hammikra – besar chagiga asher tizbach baerev lo yalin beyoto harishon ad bakro shel sheni, aval neechelet hi vearbaa asar uvachamisha asar, vechach hi shenuya vemassechet pesachim (daf amud alef):
Rachash libbi. kach hitchil hameshorer beshiro: hishritz libbi bekirbi davar tov beshivchacha atta, talmid chacham;
Rachash. leshon naanua, vechen kol leshon shirutz verichush:
Omer ani maasay lammelech. hashshir hazze sheyyissadti veasiti, ani omro lammelech, shenneemar (Mishlei 8:15) "bi melachim yimlochu":
Leshoni. tzach beshirim keet sofer mahir. raiti bisodo shel rabbi moshe haddarshan: mahir bilshon aravi baki:
targum: Bae libbi mamlal tav emar ani ovaday lemalka mamlal lishane mochi hech kolmos safra ragil:

ohc: Usekalto vaavanim vamet. al derech amram zichronam livracha bazzohar (chelek 3 272.) besod "shema yisrael" sheyyesh bo chamesh avanim shebbo soklin 100 bekirta vamet.
Veamro vechol yisrael yishmeu veyiraun, ki kesheyyiru yisrael keriatam vetaam keriatam, yishmeu veyosifu leyira et Adonai, keamram zichronam livracha sham beoto maase shel hechasid (kiddushin 81.).

rashi: Vehaya hammakom vegomer. benu lachem bet habbechira birushalayim, vechen hu omer bedavid "vayhi ki yashav hammelech beveto vaAdonai heniach lo missaviv mikkol oyvav vayyomer hammelech el natan hannavi ree anochi yoshev bevet arazim, vaaron haelohim yoshev betoch hayeria" (Shmuel 2 7):

Shamma taviu vegomer. lemala amur leinyan shilo vechan amur leinyan yerushalayim, ulechach chillekam hakkatuv litten hetter ben zo lezo, mishshecharva shilo uvau lenov vecharva nov uvau legivon hayu habbamot muttarot ad shebbau lirushalayim (zevachim kayit):
Mivchar nidrechem. melammed sheyyavi min hammuvchar (sifre):

Veasita olotecha. im olot hen, ten habbasar vehaddam al gabbe hammizbech, veim zivche shelamim hem, "dam zevachecha yishshafech" al hammizbeach techilla veachar kach "vehabbasar tochel". veod darshu rabbotenu, "rak kadashecha" ba lelammed al hakkodashim shebbechutza laaretz, ulelammed al hattemurot veal valdot kadashim sheyyikrevu (sifre; bechorot 14):
Venatatta et habberacha. ketargumo "yat mevarchayya" – et hamevarchim:

Al har gerizim. kelappe har gerizzim hofchin penehem ufatchu bivracha – baroch haish asher lo yaase fesel umassecha vegomer. kol haarurim shebbapparasha amru techilla bilshon baruch, veachar kach hafchu fenehem kelappe har eval ufatchu biklala (sota 33):
Ki elohim shofet. al kol haraa sheasitem:
Ze yashpil veze yarim. haggevohim yashpil vehannemuchim yarim (tanchuma, mattot 9):
targum: Arum elaha dayan zakkay denan yamech udenan yeromem:

rashi: Ki kaasher yered haggeshem vehashsheleg. vlo yashuv rekam, ach yetiv laolam:
targum: Are kema denachet mitra vetalga min shemaya uletaman la efshar leh dituv elahen merave yat ara umarbe lah umoilah veyahav bar zara kemisat lezarea velachma kemisat lemechol:

rashi: Fatoach tiftach. afillu chamma feamim (sham):
Ki fatoach tiftach. hare chi meshammesh bilshon ella:
Vehaavet taavitennu. im lo ratza vemattana ten lo behalevaa (80 sham; ketuvot 67):
De machsoro. vei atta metzuvve lehaashiro:
Asher yechsar lo. afillu sus lirkov alav veeved larutz lefanav (sham):
Lo. zo ishsha vechen hu omer (Bereshit 2) eese lo ezer kenegdo (sifre):
ohc: Ki fatoach vegomer. tzarich ladaat ma netinat taam hu ze lelev atum. veulay shennitkavven lomar lo al derech amro (Mishlei 11:24) "yesh mefazzer venosaf od", ki al yede sheppoteach hu yado potchim lo shaare shefa, vehu amro ki perush, taam sheani omer lecha shello teammetz vegomer – ki fatoach, perush, otzar hannelam im atta tiftach et yadcha. vegamar omer vehaavet vegomer perush kesheatta poteach et yadcha lo encha ose ella halevaa davka, vetechef Adonai yeshallem lecha betosefet merubba, uvaze yesh taam nachon lelibbo shello yitammetz vechulei:

rashi: Mum. kelal:
Pisseach o ivver. perat:
Kol mum ra. chazar vechalal — ma happerat meforash mum haggaluy veeno chozer, af kol mum shebbaggaluy veeno chozer (sham 37):
Soara. shellibbah soer berove tzarot:
Marbitz bappuch. rotzef ritzpatech meavne nofech:
targum: Chashivata mekabbela uleban karta deamrin ala ammaya la titnechem ha ana kavesh vitzdida avne ritzpatich vaashachlelinich beavnin tavin:

ohc: Ushemartem laasot vegomer. perush, lefi shehammitzvot shebba letzauot alehem hem teluyim baaretz, laze amar lahem sheyyishmeru, al derech amro (Bereshit 37:11) "veaviv shamar et haddavar", vehakkavvana sheyyihyu mechakkim laasotam. vehakkavvana baze shehagam shebbizman shehu medabber immahem enam beyadam laasotam, yihyu meshammerim haddevarim laasot otam kesheyyaggia haet. vegamar omer elle hachukkim vegomer, perush elle hem sheani metzavve etchem shettishmeru laasot baaretz, perush, lefi shehem teluyim beviat haaretz ki sham tzivva Adonai leabbed kol hammekomot, vechol zeman shello bau shamma enam beyadam laasot.

rashi: Adonai yadin ammim. hafoch haddin mealenu utenehu al harshaim:
Yadin. leshon yissurin:
Shafteni Adonai ketzidki. shefot lefi maasim tovim shebbeyadam velo lefi haaverot:
targum: Memra dayya yedin ammaya don yati Adonai kizchuti ucheshalmuti pera alay:

rashi: LaAdonai elohecha. lishmo uvishvilo:
Shofet tzaddik. atta lishpot tzedek:
Zoem bechol yom. kesheroe et maase harshaim:
targum: Elaha dayana zakkaa uvitkof ragiz al rashie kol yoma:

rashi: Vezivchechem. shelamim shel chova:
Maserotechem. masar behema umaaser sheni, leechol lifnim min hachoma:
Terumat yedchem. ellu habbikkurim, shenneemar bahem (Devarim 26) velakach hakkohen hattene miyyadecha (80 sifre):
Uvechorot bekarchem. letittam lakkohen veyakrivem sham:

Uvenivlatam lo tiggau. rabbotenu pershu — baregel, sheadam chayyav letaher et atzmo baregel, yachol yihyu muzharim bechol hashshana, talo "emor el hakkohanim vegomer", uma tumat hammet chamura, hakkohanim muzharim veen yisrael muzharim, tumat nevela kalla, lo kol shekken:
Naton titten lo. afillu mea feamim:
Lo. beno uvencha:
Ki biglal haddavar. afillu amarta litten, atta notel sechar haamira im sechar hammaase (sham):
Hishshamer lecha. litten lo taase al haddavar:
Bechol makom asher tire. asher yaale belibbecha, aval atta makriv appi navi, kegon eliyyahu behar hakkarmel (sham):
Al ken. mippene chen:
Lemor. etza letovatcha ani massiacha:
Leachicha laaniyyecha. leeze ach? leani:
Laaniyyecha. beYod echad — leshon ani echad hu, aval aniyyecha vishne yodin — shene aniyyim:
Leshichno tidreshu. ze mishkan shilo:
Lo titgoddu. lo tittenu gedida veseret bivsarchem al met kederech shehaemoriyyim osin, lefi sheattem banav shel makom veattem reuyin lihyot naim velo gedudim umekorachim:
Ben enechem. etzel happaddachat, uvemakom acher hu omer (Vayikra 21) lo yikrechu berosham – laasot kol harosh keven haenayim (sifre):
ohc: Banim attem vegomer. tzarich ladaat ma taam samach maamar banim attem lemaamar "titgoddu"? nire shennitkavven lomar shebbemitat ish en aveda lammet, ella hare hu dome leadam sheshshalach beno lischora leir acheret, uleyamim shalach haav achar beno, veen heder habben ella min hammakom shehalach mishsham, aval al kol panim yeshno, veadrabba battov lo, shechazar habben etzel aviv shehu mekor hachayyim. veal ze en lanu lehitgoded velasim karcha. ma sheen ken haummot shello nikreu banim laAdonai, vehu amro attem lishlol shear haummot shealehem yidvu haddovim beyom mitatam, shehem metim mita sheenam od bannimtza ben hachayyim.

rashi: Anashim. velo nashim:
Bene veliyyaal. beli ol, shepparku ullo shel makom (sham):
Yoshve iram. velo yoshve ir acheret, mikkan amru en naaset ir hanniddachat ad sheyyaddichuha anashim vead sheyyihyu maddicheha mittochah (sanhedrin 111):
Rak haddam lo tochelu. aappi sheamarti sheen lecha vo zerikat dam bammizbech, lo tochlennu:
Tishpechennu kammayim. lomar lecha sheen tzarich kissuy (sifre; chullin 84). davar acher — hare hu chammayim lehacheshir et hazzeraim (sham 35):
Ki lo vatem. kol otan 14 shana:
Ad atta. kemo adayin:
El hammenucha. zo shilo:
Nachala. zo yerushalayim (sifre; zevachim 119):

Beospecha. bizman haasif sheatta machnis labbayit perot hakkayitz; davar acher — beospecha miggornecha umiyyikvecha, limmed shemmesakkechin et hassukka bifsolet goren veyekev (rosh hashshana 13; socha 12):
Mizbeach. shel avanim harebe:
Matztzeva. shel even achat, vehu bimos sheshshenuya bammishna (avoda zara 47): even shechatzavah mittechillatah levimos:
Ashera. ilan hanneevad:
Veibbadtem et shemam. lechannot lahem shem lignay, bet galya — korin lah bet karya, en kol — en kotz (sham 36):
ohc: Veibbadtem et shemam vegomer. rabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (avoda zara ma:): "ma ba lelammedenu? hare kevar amar 'abbed teabbedun"? veamru shebba lomar shetztzarich lesharesh achar sharshe haashera, verabbi akiva amar shebba lomar leshannot shemah levizzayon, ad kan. veulay shebba hakkatuv litten azhara al eretz yisrael mikkol haaratzot, kederech shekkatav rambam sheshshear aratzot, hagam sheanu chayyavin leabbed avoda zara, en anu tzerichin lechappes achareha leabbedah, ma sheen ken beeretz yisrael shetztzarich lechappes achareha leabbedah mikkol artzenu, ad kan. vehu ma sheddikdek lomar veibbadtem et shemam min hammakom hahu shehi eretz hakkedosha.

rashi: Asher berachcha Adonai. lefi habberacha have (sifre):
Ki yevarechcha. shettehe hattevua merubba laset:

targum: In amarit itmotata rigli tuvach Adonai yasid yati:
Yashbik rashia orche derisha ugevar anes eshtonohi vituv lefulechana dayya virachem alohi velidchalta deelahana are masge lesalacha:
Kidnan amar Adonai taru dina avidu tzidkata are kariv purekani lemete uzechuti leitgelaa:
La terimun limroma aykarchon attun di memallin betukefa uvegidufin:
Umemalle sanuta chazaru yati veagichu imi magan:
Veetten lehon bevet makdeshi uvaara bet shechinti atar veshum detav mibbenin umibbenan shum alam etten lehon dela yifsok:
Arum la yintosh Adonai ameh veachsanteh la yishbok:
Teresi al elaha parik teritze libba:
Uvene ammaya demittosfin al ame dayya leshamashute ulemircham yat shema dayya lemeheve leh leavdin kol deyitar shabbeta leachalute umatkefin bikyami:
Vechol banayich alfin beorayta dayya vesage yehe shelam benach:

bart: Arbaim zug. kitte edim zug achar zug:
Veikkevan rabbi akiva. shello haya levet din tzorech bahen:
Atta machshilan leatid lavo. sheyyimmanu millavo lehaid kesheyyiru sheddivrehen lo nishmeu. vahalacha kerabban gamliel:
Kohen mashiach shechata veachar kach avar mimmeshichuto. velo hispik lehavi karbano ad sheavar mikkehunnato:

Kohen mashiach mevi far. vaafillu avar leachar sheheeviruhu mimmeshichuto, amrinan lekamman bematnitin demevi par. velo nakat leh ella mishshum deitzterich lemitne denasi mevi sair keshechata kodem sheheeviruhu, tane nammi bechohen mashiach mevi par.
Venasi mevi sair. dichtiv (Vayikra 4) al chattato asher chata, melammed shemmevi chattat kemo shehaya chayyav beshaa shechata:
Kelunsaot. etzim arukkim ugevohim. targum nes kelonas. kede sheyyerau lemerachok:
Vekanim vaatze shemen uneoret shel pishtan. kol ellu marbim shalhevet:
Shete searot haamurot bappara. dekayma lan (para 82) shete searot shechorot poslot bah:
Uvannegaim. sear lavan, kayma lan betorat kohanim miut sear shetayim:
Vehaamurot bechol makom. betinok uvetinoket:
Likrotz. leechoz meat:

Sheyyehu nittalot bezug. shel misparayim, vehave shiura rabba. vahalacha kedivre kullan lehachemir, umishshennikretzet batztzipporen dahave shiura zuta mikkullehu, lo memaenet shemma gedola hi. uleinyan chalitza, enah choletzet, ad deikka shiura rabba dechullehu:
Shel yael pashut. delitfilla bainan peshutot:
Ufiv metzuppe zahav. beshel mikdash kaamar:
Shofar maarich. leachar shechatzotzrot poskim tekiatam nishma kol hashshofar:

Kol shechayyav bappea chayyav bammaasrot. degabbe pea tenan, kelal amru befea, kol shehu ochel venishmar vegiddulo min haaretz umachniso lekiyyum ulekitato keachat, chayyav befea. veillu gabbe maaser tenan, kol shehu ochel venishmar vegiddulo min haaretz chayyav bemaaser. umachniso lekiyyum ulekitato keachat lo katane. nimtza yarak sheen machniso lekiyyum, uteena vechayyotze bahem sheen lekitatam keachat, chayyavin bammaasrot ufeturim min happea:

Kol hammittamme bemidras. hazzav, kol keli harauy lihyot av hattuma bemidras hazzav, kegon keli hameyuchad lemishkav umoshav, rauy lihyot av hattuma im naga bemet o nitma beohel hammet. veyesh shehu keli gamur lekabbel kol tumot venaase av hattuma al yede met, veeno naase av hattuma al yede hazzav bemidras, kegon im kafa hazzav sea veyashav aleha, o tarkav veyashav aleha, en oto keli tame midras lihyot naase av hattuma, ella rishon lattuma bemaggao shel zav, dichtiv (Vayikra 15) asher yeshev alav hazzav, mi shemmeyuchad lishiva, yatza ze sheomrim lo amod venaase melachtenu. aval im naga bemet, naase av hattuma, sheen omrim bitme met amod venaase melachtenu:
Mechallelin et hashshabbat. edim sherau et hachodesh, keday lelech ulehodia levet din:

Shebbahem sheluche bet din yotzim lesureya. lehodia laggola yom keviutam, hilkach chashive. umin hattora mechallelin al kullan, aval rabbanan asru lefi sheen tikkun hammoadot taluy bahen, aval shene chodashim ellu heemidu al din tora, shekkol hammoadot teluyin bahen:
Takkanat karban. shel rosh chodesh, sheyyehe karev bizmanno:
Halach umetzao rabbi akiva. lerabbi yehoshua:
Metzer. al shehannasi gazar alav lechallel et yom hakkippurim:
Asher tikreu. bikriat bet din telao hakkatuv:
Ba. rabbi yehoshua etzel rabbi dosa:

Lamma lo nitparshu shemotan vechulei. sheim yavo adam ladun achar bet din shebbeyamav, lomar vechi bet din ze kemoshe veaharon o keeldad umedad, omrim lo shemma chashuv hu keotan shennisharu shello nitparshu shemotan:
Rosh bet din omer mekuddash. dichtiv (Vayikra 26) vaydabber moshe et moade Adonai, mikkan sherosh bet din omer mekuddash:
Vechol haam onin acharav. dichtiv (sham) moade Adonai‏ asher tikreu otam, kare beh attem, dechaser ketiv belo 22:
Mekuddash mekuddash. tere zimne, dichtiv (sham) mikrae kodesh, shene mikraot:
Shennira bizmanno. belel sheloshim:
Im lo nira bizmanno. vekovin rosh chodesh lel echad usheloshim:

En mekaddeshin oto. shekkiddush hachodesh enah chova, deamar kera (Vayikra 25) vekiddashtem et shenat hachamishshim shana, shanim atta mekaddesh, shechova al bet din lomar mekuddeshet hashshana bishnat hayyovel, veen atta mekaddesh chodashim, sheen chova al bet din lomar hachodesh mekuddash. ucheshennira bizmanno mekaddeshim oto mippene shetztzarich chizzuk. vahalacha kerabbi elazar berabbi tzadok:
Lo hayu zazim mishsham kol hayyom. haedim sheyyatzu chutz litchuman bashshabbat uvau lehaid. shehayyotze chutz lattechum en lo ella arba ammot:
Hamerubbe vivgadim. leachar shennigneza tzelochit shel shemen hammishcha haya kohen gadol nichnas lichhunna gedola bilvishat shemona begadim, kedichtiv (sham 21) umille et yado lilbosh et habbegadim:
Ella far habba al kol hammitzvot. sheen merubbe bivgadim mevi par al shiggato, dechohen hammashiach ketiv:
Baavodat yom hakkippurim. sheen avodat oto hayyom keshera ella bechohen gadol bilvad, vechohen hameshammesh vechohen sheavar shavin bah:
Velo forin velo formin. kedichtiv bechohen gadol (sham) et rosho lo yifra uvegadav lo yifrom:
Umachazirin et harotzeach. im met echad mehem, chozer harotzeach meir miklato, kedichtiv (Bamidbar la) ad mot hakkohen haggadol:

Kol keli cheres shehu machnis. mashke. keshemmannicho al hammayim, yesh bo nekev gadol shehammayim nichnasim letocho, kol shekken sheim noten hammayim letocho yotze hammashke lachutz. aval yesh nekev katan shemmotzi veeno machnis. venafka minna leha dekayma lan dichli cheres shalem shennikkav, eno pasul lekaddesh bo me chattat, dehaynu latet betocho mayim shel efer para, ad sheyyinnakev nekev gadol bechones mashke. aval nikkav nekev katan kemotzi mashke, lo nafek mittorat keli velo mippesil behachi. uleolam en nekev katan bemotzi mashke motzi mittorat keli ella haggistera bilvad, dehaynu shever keli sheyyichado lemalleot bo mayim ulehishtammesh bo, im nikkav bemotzi mashke, batal mittorat keli, sheen omrim have gistera acheret venasim tachat gistera zo lekabbel hammashke hayyotze. aval keli shalem shennikkav bemotzi mashke, lo batal mikkelum, lefi sheadam chas alav veeno shovro, umishtammesh bo, umevi shever keli umanniach tachtav lekabbel hammashke hayyotze mimmennu. umeatta hachi perusha dematnitin, kol keli cheres happasul leme chattat pasul legistera, veyesh pasul legistera vechasher leme chattat:

Kol evar sheyyesh bo tzipporen. kegon etzba yetera shebbeetzbeot hayyad, im yesh bah tzipporen, chashuva evar, umetamme bemagga uvemassa uveohel, keevar sheyyesh bo etzem shemmetamme beohel vaafillu i lekka kazzayit basar, dekayma lan haevarim en lahem shiur:

Veyesh sheyyesh bo etzem. velo chashuva evar im yoteret hi, kevan sheen bo tzipporen, umetammea bemagga uvemassa, veenah metammea beohel kol zeman sheen bah kazzayit basar. vei lav yoteret hi, vadday metammea beohel mishshum evar, af al gav deen bah tzipporen veaf al gav delekka kazzayit basar:
Kifa. tavlin vedak dak shebbeshule kedera:
Alal. shiyyure habbasar hannidbakim baor bishat hefshet. perush acher, gid hatztzavvar shehu kashe veeno rauy laachila shekkorin kappilo belaaz:
Hakkarnayim vehattelafayim. vaafillu ma sheyyesh bahen karov labbasar shekkeshechotchin oto yotze mimmennu dam, la chashiv kevasar:
Veen chayyavin alehem mishshum piggul. im haya hazzevach piggul, shechashav al besaro leachlo chutz lizmanno, veachal meellu, patur:
Vetame. im achal meachat meelle betumat hagguf mizzevach kasher, eno chayyav mishshum ochel kadashim betumat hagguf:

Lifne hachamma o leachar hachamma. pegimatah shel levana lifne hachamma, nota letzad hachamma, o letzad acher. vaalah katane sefa im amar letzad hachamma lo amar kelum, shemmeolam lo raata chamma pegimatah shel levana, dilolam hachelek hammeir mimmenna note letzad hashshemesh vehachelek happagum note letzad haacher:

Bitzfonah o bidromah. shehallevana mitracheket min hashshemesh paam letzad tzafon paam letzad darom, veim yadu bet din bederech hacheshbon shebbeoto zeman reuya shettihye letzad tzafon veamru haedim sherauha nota letzad darom o ippecha, bayyadua sheede sheker hen:
Kamma haya gavoah. min haaretz lefi reut enechem. im amar echad min haedim gavoah shete komot vehaechad omer shalosh, edutan kayyemet. echad omer shalosh veechad omer chamesh, edutan betela:
Uleayin haya note. rashe happegima leeze tzad notin, letzad tzafon o letzad darom:
Vechamma haya rachav. shehallevana mishtanne shiurah kefi ma shehi rechoka min hachamma o kerova eleha:

Veyesh sheyyesh lo sheviit veen lo viur. kegon haddevarim sheshsharsham nishar bakkarka ben bimot hachamma ben bimot haggeshamim, kemo halluf shote vehaddandanna, shekkorim baaravi nana, uvelaaz menta, dechevan sheen kalin leolam min hassade, en chayyav levaaram min habbayit, dichtiv (Vayikra 25) velivhemtecha velachayya asher beartzecha, kol zeman shechayya ochelet bassade, haachel livhemtecha min habbayit, kala lachayya min hassade kalle livhemtecha min habbayit, vechol hanach delo kalu lachayya min hassade, en tzarich levaaram min habbayit:
Haroa chetem. shemmatza tippat dam bachalukah:
Hare zo mekulkelet. enah yodaat petach niddoteha leda matay yatchilu achad asar yom shebben nidda lenidda, deha lo yada emat chazay:

Vechosheshet mishshum zov. im avru aleha shelosha yeme ziva mishshellavsha chaluk ze, umatza alav ketem gadol shiur shelosha gerisin vaod, kelomar meat yoter mishshelosha gerisin, mesappekinan lehu dilma kol chada vachada bechad yoma, vehaveya zava gedola missafek, veaf al gav divmakom echad nimtzeu:

Vachachamim omrim en bakketamim mishshum zov. baggemara moke milletayhu dachachamim dehacha, kichidaa, veamar derabbi chanina ben antignos hi. umode rabbi chanina ben antignos sheim lavsha shalosh chalukot levanot bishlosha yamim bime ziva, chaluk leyom, umatza bechol achat mehen ketem, dechosheshet lezivut. veen tzarich lomar im raata shene yamim dam miggufah, uvashshelishi lavsha chaluk habbaduk lah umatza bo ketem, difshita dechosheshet lezivut. velo nechelak rabbi chanina ben antignos dehu chachamim dematnitin, ella al halloveshet chaluk echad bishlosha yamim mime zivatah ulevassof matza ketem gadol shiur shelosha gerisin vaod bemakom echad, o afillu bishlosha mekomot, deihu savar bichhay gavna enah chosheshet lezivut, hoil velo hayu hakketamim bishlosha chalukot. verabbi meir verabbanan deippeligu aleh savre, keshemmatza shiur shelosha gerisin vaod bechaluk echad, ben bemakom echad ben bishlosha mekomot, chosheshet lezivut. veen halacha kerabbi chanina ben antignos:

Neemanim lomar kavarnu. detumat met midi deorayta hi. uchegon shekkohen kuti omed sham uteruma beyado veochlah, delekka lemechash shemma teruma temea hi. uvelav hachi en neemanin, delet lehu lifne ivver lo titten michshol, velo ichpat lahem im anu chotin al pihem:
Im bikkera. vehu sherinuhu oved vegozez bo. dei lav deyada delav bechor hu, lo avar addeorayta, dichtiv (Devarim 15) lo taavod bivchor shorecha velo tagoz bechor tzonecha:
Neemanim al tziyyun kevarot. letzayyen mekom hakkever. vesomchin alehen. veaf al gav demidderabbanan hu, kevan dichtiva, zehirin beh. dichtiv (Yechezkel 39) veraa etzem adam uvana etzlo tziyyun:

Lo al hassechachot. ilan hammesech al haaretz vaanafav muvdalim veyadua vadday sheyyesh kever tachat achat hoohalot veen yadua eze hu, uva kuti veheid al echad shezze tahor, eno neeman, lefi sheeno chash al hassafek:
Velo al happeraot. avanim gedolot boltot min haggader, vekever tachat achat mehen veen anu yodim tachat ezo mehen, uva kuti veheid al miktzatan shehen tehorot:
Eno neeman. mishshum delisfeka lo chayesh:

Bet happeras. sade shennecherash bah kever. vechol mea amma shel sevivot hakkever okminhu rabbanan bechezkat tuma, shemma gilgela hammacharesha veholicha etzem kasseora min hammet. uferas, leshon davar parus veshavur, sheatzamot shel met nifresu sham. umippi acherim shamati, al shem shepparsot bene adam nimnaim lalechet sham mippene hattuma:

Ze hakkelal. laatoye techumim veyen nesech. sheen kuti neeman lomar ad kan techum shabbat, ditchumin derabbanan, vechutim lo sevira lehu. vechen en neemanim al yen nesech, lefi sheen nizharim mimmagga nachri. vechol haddevarim hallalu lo neemru ella baddorot harishonim, aval bazzeman hazze, hen kannachrim lechol divrehem:
Bor. chafira bakkarka:
Dut. makom mukkaf mechitztzot al haaretz:
Pittas. keli gadol shel cheres:
Im kol shofar shama. haomed chutz labbor, veshama kol tekiat hattokea babbor. deillu otan shebbabbor leolam yetzu, shehen shomin kol shofar leolam:
Im kivven libbo. latzet:

Yatza. veaf al pi shello nitkavven hattokea lehotzio, hacha mayre bechazzan hakkeneset shettokea, shehu mitkavven lehotzi kol hashshomim kol tekiato, hilkach af al gav delo nitkavven lehotzi ze haover achore bet hakkeneset velo yada leh, yatza. aval hattokea lehotzi yachid yede chovato bainan sheyyitkavven shomea umashmia:
Kol harauy ladun dine nefashot. kol shekken sherauy ladun dine mamonot:
Veyesh sherauy ladun dine mamonot. kegon mamzer, dechasher ledine mamonot, ufasul ledine nefashot:

Veyesh shekkasher lehaid veeno chasher ladun. kegon suma beachat meenav. umatnitin rabbi meir hi dedaresh kera dichtiv (Devarim 21) veal pihem yihye kol riv vechol naga, mekish riv lenega. ma nega shello besuma dichtiv (Vayikra 13) lechol mare ene hakkohen, af riv shello besuma. veen halacha kehay setama, dachachamim pelige aleh derabbi meir veamre dechi hechi deashkechan digmar din kasher ballayla af al pi sheen roim negaim ballayla, hachi nammi suma beachat meenav kasher ladun af al pi sheeno kasher lirot negaim:
Leechol davar sheen darko leechol. chutz lizmanno o chutz limkomo:
Verabbi eliezer posel. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:
Paggah. semadar. kemo hatteena chanta faggeha (Shir HaShirim 2). kach hattinoket sheen lah siman lo baddaddin velo bassearot:
Bochal. happeri hakkarov lehitbashshel. uleshon chachamim hu, hatteenim mishsheyyavchilu chayyavim bemaaser. kach kesheyyesh lah siman daddin ketzat, beyadua shehevia shete searot venaara hi:
Tzemel. leshon notarikon yatzta melea. sheyyesh lah siman muvhak bedaddeha vehi bogeret:
Bazo uvazo. afillu keshehi naara, aviha zakkay bakkol. dichtiv (Bamidbar 30) binureha bet aviha, kol shevach neureha leaviha:
Beshel zecharim. elim:
Ushete chatzotzrot baemtza. shene shofarot hayu lahem, echad mikkan veechad mikkan, vachatzotzrot baemtza:

Shemmitzvat hayyom bachatzotzrot. distam taanit al tzarat tzibbur, uchetiv (Bamidbar 10) al hatztzar hatztzorer etchem vahareotem bachatzotzrot. vedavka bammikdash osin ken, aval baggevulim bizman sheyyesh shofar en chatzotzrot, uvizman sheyyesh chatzotzrot en shofar, dichtiv (tehillim tzach) bachatzotzrot vekol shofar hariu lifne hammelech Adonai, lifne hammelech Adonai‏ in, shello lifne hammelech Adonai‏ lo:
Dam velo chatem. vachachamim hu degazzur al hakketamim, lefichach holchim bahem lehakel:

Yom tov shel rosh hashshana, bammikdash hayu tokim. shettekiat shofar enah melacha, verabbanan hu degazur ala gezera shemma yittelennu beyado veyaavirennu arba ammot birshut harabbim, uvammikdash lo gazur, deen issur shevut derabbanan bammikdash:
Aval lo bammedina. lo birushalayim, velo bigvulin. veharambam mefaresh sheyyerushalayim kullah keruya mikdash, ushear eretz yisrael keruya medina:
Bechol makom sheyyesh bo vet din. vaafillu enan kevuin ella shebbemikre bau sham, tokin bo:
Ella beyavne. shehayta sham sanhedri gedola beyamav. vechen bechol makom sheggalta sham sanhedri gedola, aval lo bevet din shel esrim ushelosha:

Amru lo vechulei. ikka ben amru lo letanna kamma, detanna kamma savar kol makom sheyyesh bo bet din, vaafillu beakray. veamru lo savre, echad yavne veechad kol makom sheyyesh bo bet din kavua kemo beyavne, aval bet din shel akray lo. vahalacha keamru lo:

Vehi aylonit. kelomar vetzarich sheyyerau bah nammi simane aylonit. sheim lo niru bah simane aylonit, af al pi shehi bat esrim velo hevia shete searot, adayin ketanna hi, ad shettihye bat sheloshim vechamesh shana veyom echad. veim lo hevia shete searot az, af al pi shello niru bah simane aylonit, hare zo aylonit. vesimane aylonit perashnu [resh] perek kamma divamot:
Lo choletzet velo mityabbemet. umutteret linnase lashshuk. derachamana patra, dichtiv (Devarim 25) vehaya habbechor asher teled, perat leaylonit, sheenah yoledet:

Vehu saris. kelomar shenniru bo simane saris. dei lo niru bo simane saris, adayin hu katan ad sheyyihye ben sheloshim vechamesh shana veyom echad, deaz afillu lo niru bo simane saris, beyadua shehu saris, kevan shello hevi shete searot. vesaris lav bar chalitza [veyibbum] hu, dichtiv (sham) lehakim leachiv shem beyisrael, vehay lav bar hachi hu:
Rabbi eliezer omer hazzachar kedivre vet hillel. ben esrim, im niru bo simane saris, hare ze saris:
Vehannekeva. bat shemone esre, im niru bah simane aylonit, hare zo aylonit kedivre bet shammay. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:
En chayyavin al shemiat hakkol. shehishbio chavero im yodea lo edut velo heid lo, kedichtiv (Vayikra 5) venefesh ki techeta veshama kol ala vehu ed vegomer:
Veal bittuy sefatayim. shevua shello ochal veachal, o sheochal velo achal. vechen achalti velo achal, lo achalti veachal:

Veal tumat mikdash vekadashav. hannichnas lammikdash betuma, o sheachal kodesh [betuma]. im shaggu behoraa beachat mikkol ellu, en chayyavin karban lo bet din velo hammashiach, lefi sheen hayechidim chayyavin al shiggatan chattat kevua:

Vehannasi kayyotze vahem. melech sheshshagag beechad mikkol ellu eno mevi sair ufatur mishshum karban, divchol hanach ketiv veim lo taggia yado veim lo tassig yado, mi shebbaim lide aniyyut, yatza melech vechohen gadol sheenan bain lide aniyyut:
