Rabbi akiva omer hannasi chayyav. devannasi ketiv (sham 4) vechipper alav hakkohen mechattato, uvekarban ole veyored haamur bishmiat kol uvevittuy sefatayim uvetumat mikdash ketiv (sham 5) vechipper alav hakkohen mechattato, lelammedcha shehannasi chayyav bahen. vehay dechohen mashiach patur mikkarban haamur bishmiat kol uvittuy sefatayim vetumat mikdash, ledivre rabbi akiva hu mishshum dichtiv (sham 6) ze karban aharon uvanav vegomer‏ asirit haefa, ze, miut hu, lomar asirit haefa shel minchat chavittin ba chova lakkohen hammashiach, veen asirit efa acher ba lo chova, limute asirit haefa haamur bishmiat kol vechulei‏ sheen hakkohen hammashiach mevi oto. vechevan shemmiato hakkatuv measirit haefa, nitmaet nammi mishshete torim umikkol karban haamur bainyan. dichtiv besof otah parasha vechipper alav hakkohen al chattato asher chata meachat meelle, hammitkapper beachat meelle mitkapper bechullan, vesheen mitkapper beachat meelle en mitkapper bechullan. veen halacha kerabbi akiva velo kerabbi yose, ella kohen mashiach venasi chayyavin karban ole veyored al shemiat kol veal bittuy sefatayim veal tumat mikdash kidmuchach lekamman bematnitin. veha ditninan en chayyavin al shemiat hakkol vechulei‏ demashma lo bet din velo kohen mashiach, hayenu eno chayyav par habba al shear mitzvot, aval chayyav karban ole veyored:

Kol happesulin sheshshachatu shechitatan keshera. vehu haddin daafillu lechattechilla shochatin. dichtiv (Vayikra 1) veshachat et ben habbakar vehikrivu bene aharon hakkohanim et haddam, mikkabbala vaelach mitzvat kehunna, limmed al hashshechita shekkeshera bezarim uvifsulim. velo katane sheshshachatu demashma diavad in lechattechilla lo, ella mishshum temeim bilvad, detame lechattechilla lo yishchot, gezera shemma yigga babbasar. vetame sheshshachat bekadashim uchesherim lo mashkachat la ella vesakkina aricha, uchegon shehu omed chutz laazara veshochet habbehema shebbetoch haazara, deha shechitat kadashim baazara haveya, veen tame nichnas laazara. uvenitma besheretz, sheeno metamme et hassakkin, delav av hattuma hu. o bitme met uchegon shebbadak kerumit shel kane veshachat bah, aval besakkin lo, shetteme met metamme et hassakkin lihyot av hattuma kayyotze vo, vehassakkin metamme et habbasar:
Lefichach hen poslim et hakkarban bemachashava. hoil ureuyin laavoda zo machashavtan machashava ufoselet:
Vechullan. happesulim:
Shekkibbelu et haddam. al menat leechol ulehaktir chutz lizmanno o chutz limkomo:

Im yesh dam hannefesh. od babbehema, yachazor hakkasher laavoda vikabbel veyizrok, vehazzevach kasher. sheen machashavtan shel ellu posaltan bekabbala, lefi sheenan reuyin lah, veen hammachashava poselet ella bemi sherauy laavoda, uvaddavar harauy, uvammakom harauy laavod, dichtiv (Vayikra 7) hammakriv oto lo yechashev, barauy lehakerava hakkatuv medabber:

Shehu keren. veeno karuy shofar, dichtiv (Devarim 33) bechor shoro hadar lo vekarne reem karnav. vegabbe rosh hashshana shofar ketiv (Vayikra 25) vehaavarta shofar terua, vegamrinan rosh hashshana miyyovel:

Bekeren hayyovel. veyovel dichra hu, deamar rabbi akiva keshehalachti legalya hayu korin ledichra yovla, alma afillu shofar shel ayil nikra keren. verabbanan amre kol hashshofarot ikkeru keren veikkeru shofar, defara, keren ikkere shofar lo ikkere. vahalacha kachachamim:
Dam hannidda. metammein lachin. dichtiv (Vayikra 15) vehaddava beniddatah, ma shezzav mimmenna tame kemotah, uveshaa shezzav lach hu:
Umetammeim yeveshim. dichtiv (sham) dam yihye zovah, bahavayato yehe, veaf al pi shennityabbesh:
Uvesar hammet. metamme yavesh, dichtiv (Bamidbar 12) o beetzem adam, adam dumeya deetzem, ma etzem yavesh af basar yavesh:
Vehannia. rok rach sheyyotze al yede ninua. vaani shamati, lecha hayyoredet min hachotem. umimmayenot hazzav hen vahavu av hattuma:

Vehashsheretz. dichtiv (Vayikra 11) hannogea bahem bemotam, keen motam, dehaynu keshehem lachim kemo shehayu beet motam. aval kol zeman shehashshidra kayyemet vehaatzamot mechubbarot bashshidra, hoil vetzurato nikkeret, kelach hu necheshav:
Vehannevela. dichtiv (sham) ki yamut, keen mita:
Vehashshichvat zera. shetztzarich sheyyehe rauy lehazeria:
Metammein lachin veen metammein yeveshin. hazzov metamme lach velo yavesh, dichtiv (sham 15) rar besaro et zovo, kemin rir shehu lach. kemo vayyored riro al zekano (Shmuel 1 21):
Vehannia veharok. dichtiv (Vayikra 15) vechi yarok, uvaet sheyyarok lach hu:
Vechamma hi sheriyyatan. denema i hadra bechi hay shiura lachin hen:
Befoshrim meet leet. aval i tzeriche tefe mayim chammim, o yoter mizzeman meet leet, yeveshin hen:
Rabbi yose omer besar hammet yavesh, tahor. milletamme bechazzayit. aval metamme tumat rakav kimlo tarvad. veen halacha kerabbi yose:

Rauhu bet din vechol yisrael. belel sheloshim. desalka datach amina hoil verauhu bet din vechol yisrael, ipparsema leh milleta divyom sheloshim nira lekaddesho, ka mashma lan deim chashecha vehiggia lel echad usheloshim velo amru bet din mekuddash, meabberim oto vekovim rosh chodesh yom sheloshim veechad:

Nechkeru haedim. hachi kaamar, i nammi nechkeru haedim bilvad velo hispiku lomar mekuddash ad shehiggia layil shel sheloshim veechad, meabberim oto. desalka datach amina tahave chakirat edim kitchillat din, umekuddash mekuddash kigmar din, ugemar din have ballayla unekaddesheh belelya, ka mashma lan delo, sheen mekaddeshin et hachodesh ballayla. umihu im lel sheloshim rau hayyareach im shekiat hachamma veyesh shehut bayyom lomar mekuddash kodem tzet hakkochavim, mekaddeshin oto, delo chashev layla ad tzet hakkochavim:

Yaamdu shenayim veyaidu. matnitin ayre kegon sherauhu bet din ballayla lel sheloshim, vei efshar lekaddesho ballayla, hilkach lemachar yaamdu shenayim veyaidu, deim lo al edutan shel ellu al ma yekaddeshu. aval im rauhu bet din im shekiat hachamma bizman sheyyesh shehut lomar mekuddash, yekaddeshuhu biriyyatam, delo tehe shemia sheshshomin mippi edim gedola meriyya, deha gabbe kiddush hachodesh lo ketiv edut, ella kaze ree vekaddesh:
Yaamdu shenayim. lemachar keshebbaim lomar mekuddash:

Veyoshivu mechavrehem etzel hayyachid. veaf al gav deyachid mumche dan afillu bichidi, kiddush hachodesh lo hava bichidi. sheen lecha mumche larabbim yoter mimmoshe rabbenu, vekaamar leh rachamana ad deikka aharon bahadach, dichtiv (Shemot 12) vayyomer Adonai‏ el moshe veel aharon vegomer‏ hachodesh hazze lachem:
Veyesh taun beracha lefanav veen taun beracha leacharav. kegon tzitzit, utefillin, umezuza, shofar, sukka, velulav, shemmevarchin alehen over laasiyyatan, veen teunin beracha leacharehen:
Hayu massiin massuot. leachar shekkiddeshu hachodesh. velo hayu tzerichin liskor sheluchin lishloach laggola ulehodia, shehammassuot hayu modiin otan:

Mishshekkilkelu hakkutim. vehissiu gam hem massuot shello bazzeman, lehateot. lefi shebbet din lo hayu massiin massuot ella al hachodesh shennitkaddesh beyom sheloshim, ucheshello hayu massiin leerev shel yom sheloshim hakkol yodim shehachodesh meubbar. ufaam achat ibberu bet din et hachodesh velo asu massuot laerev shel yom sheloshim, vehakkutim hissiu beharim shellahem vehitu bene haggola laasoto chaser:
Bishtika. belo machashava happoselet:
Happesach vehachattat sheshshechatan shello lishman. motzian mide piggul. aval shear zevachim en shello lishman motzian mide piggul, deha kesherim hen beshello lishman:
Haroa yom achad asar. shehu sof yeme ziva. ulemachar matchilin yeme nidda:
Ben hashshemashot. sefek yom hu vehave dam ziva, sefek layla utechillat nidda:

Techillat nidda vesof nidda. baggemara mefaresh dehachi katane, techillat nidda vesof ziva. uvashshevii leniddatah, sof nidda utechillat ziva. kelomar, ben hashshemashot shel achad asar, im layla hu, hare reiyyatah techillat nidda. veim yom, hare haddam dam shel sof ziva. veim raata shene yamim kodem lachen, chosheshet mishshum ziva. vechen im raata bishvii leniddatah ben hashshemashot, mesappekinan nammi, im layla hu, hare haddam dam shel techillat ziva, veim tire shene yamim achare chen, chosheshet mishshum ziva. veim yom hu, hare reiyyatah sof yeme nidda, veaf al pi shettire shene yamim achar kach enah zava:

Yom arbaim lazzachar veyom shemonim lannekeva ben hashshemashot lechullan. kelomar beezo meellu shettire ben hashshemashot, safek dam tame safek dam tahor. veim tire shene yamim acherim chutz mizzo, hare hi zava missafek, umevia karban veeno neechol, shekkol hattoot meviot karban veeno neechol:
Hashshotot. lattoot sheenan yodot matay yeme nidda vime ziva, kare shotot:
Ad sheattem metakkenim et hashshotot. et hattoot hallalu sherau bishat hassafek:

Bou vetakkenu et happikchot. sheroot beshaa vaddait vehen tzerichot tikkun ulefaresh yeme shimmuran vetashmishan. kegon hanach demayte babberayta, mi sheroa yom echad tame vayom echad tahor kol yameha, vetamid hi roa bayyom velo ballayla, meshammeshet shemini leyom sheraata bo reiyya rishona, shehare tehora hi, shehare beshiva laerev tavla velo tire ad teshii, hilkach meshammeshet shemini shalem layla veyom, velayla shelleacharav shehu naghe teshii. umeshammeshet arbaa lelot mittoch shemona asar yom liriyya rishona, shehare ishsha zo lo tehe zava leolam, sheenah roa shelosha retzufim. ucheshehi roa teshii, tehe shomeret asiri uteshammesh ballayla. vetire beachad asar. vetishmor shenem asar uteshammesh ballayla. hare shenayim. vetire bishlosha asar, vetishmor arbaa asar uteshammesh ballayla, hare shelosha. vetire chamishsha asar, vetishmor shishsha asar uteshammesh baerev, hare arbaa. uveshiva asar tire, vetishmor shemona asar. hare kalu shemona asar velo shimmesha ella arbaa lelot. levad shemini velelo. vetashmish acharon eno betoch shemona asar. ulemachar betisha asar keshettire, tehe techillat nidda, shehare shalmu achad asar shebben nidda lenidda, vechozeret leminyanah sheamarnu. vehachi ikka tuva shetztzerichot tikkun lime tashmishan. vechullehu mayte la babberayta baggemara befirkin:

Asham taluy. averot shechayyavin al zedonan karet veal shiggatan chattat kevua, chayyavin al lo hoda shellahen asham taluy, kegon kishne zetim, echad shel chelev veechad shel shumman, veachal echad mehen veeno yodea eze mehen achal:
Vehammashiach uvet din peturin. dichtiv bekarban tzibbur (Vayikra 4) venoda hachattat vehikrivu, en chayyavin karban ella al hoda. umashiach kevet din:
Asham vadday. chamishsha ashamot hen shebbain al havvadday, asham meilot, asham gezelot, asham nazir, asham metzora, asham shifcha charufa:
Hayyachid vehannasi vehammashiach chayyavin. shekkol ellu maase yachid hem, lo shena hedyot velo shena mashiach venasi:
Uvet din peturim. sheen lehoraat bet din esek bahem, veen asham ba al horaat bet din:

Ella sheen kohen gadol chayyav al tumat mikdash vekadashav divre rabbi shimon. taama derabbi shimon, dichtiv betumat mikdash (Bamidbar 19) veish asher yitma velo yitchatta venichreta hannefesh hahi mittoch hakkahal, mi shecheto shave lakkahal, yatza kohen gadol sheen cheto shave lakkahal. shehakkahal kol mi shennichnas mehen lammikdash shogeg, o avar avera beshogeg, chayyav al shiggat maase bilvad, vechohen mashiach eno chayyav ella al helem davar im shiggat maase, kidmuchach leel befirkin. veen halacha kerabbi shimon, ella kohen gadol mevi karban ole veyored af al tumat mikdash vekadashav:

Rabbi eliezer omer hannasi mevi sair. al tumat mikdash vekadashav, lefi shechayyavin al zedono karet, kadderech shehu mevi sair al shear mitzvot shechayyavin al zedonan karet. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer, dechevan deen chayyavin al shiggat mikdash vekadashav chattat kevua, en hannasi mevi ella chederech shehayyachid mevi:
Lulav nittal bammikdash shiva. dichtiv (Vayikra 23) usemachtem lifne Adonai‏ elohechem shivat yamim:
Uvammedina yom echad. dichtiv (sham) ulekachtem lachem bayyom harishon:
Vesheyyehe yom hanef. yom hanafat haomer:
Kullo asur. leechol min hechadash. vetama meforash beferek lulav haggazul (sukka 83 52):
Ba siman hattachton. shete searot shehu siman naarut:
Ad shello va haelyon. siman shel daddin, vehu bochal:
O choletzet o mityabbemet. mishshum digdola hi. shehassearot siman muvhak, vaalayhu samchinan:

Af al pi shei efshar. lerabbanan lavo siman haelyon belo hattachton. umikki ata siman haelyon, af al gav devadku velo ashkechu tachton, memar amrinan siman hattachton vadday ata ella shennashar, mikkol makom lerabbi meir lo choletzet velo mityabbemet. derabbi meir sevira leh efshar lavo siman elyon belo tachton, vaanan attachton samchinan, hilkach adayin ketanna hi velo choletzet velo mityabbemet. verabbi meir letaameh deamar katan uketanna lo choltzin velo mityabbemin. katan, shemma yimmatze saris. uketanna, shemma timmatze aylonit:

O choletzet o mityabbemet. vaafillu hi ketanna mityabbemet lerabbanan, delo chayshe lemiuta shemma timmatze aylonit, derov nashim enan ayloniyyot. mihu lachalitza bainan shettehe gedola afillu lerabbanan, deish ketiv bapparasha [devarim ko], umakkeshinan ishsha leish. vahalacha kachachamim:
Mippene sheamru efshar lattachton lavo vechulei. af al gav detana leh beresha hadar tanya zimna achariti, mishshum devae lemismach leh kayyotze bo vechulei‏ dedame leh:

Kohen mashiach sheavar mimmeshichuto vechulei. af al pi sheeno oved, bikdushshato hu omed. sheen ben kohen haoved lechohen sheavar, ella avoda ufar yom hakkippurim vaasirit haefa shemmakriv bechol yom kedilkamman. aval nasi kevan sheheeviruhu hare hu kehedyot:

Uvaavoda zara hayyachid vehannasi vehammashiach meviin seira. befarashat shelach lecha (Bamidbar 15) bekarban avoda zara ketiv veim nefesh achat techeta vishgaga vegomer‏ vehikriva ez, uchetiv batreh tora achat yihye lachem, hishva et kullan lekarban ze:
Shofar shennisdak vedibbeko. bedevek:

Pasul. dahava leh kishne shofarot. vehane mille nisdak learko. aval nisdak lerachbo, im nishtayyer mimmekom hannachat pe ad mekom hassedek kede shiur tekia kasher, veim lav pasul. vechamma shiur tekia, kede sheyyochazennu beyado veyerae lechan ulechan:
Nikkav usetamo. davka shessetamo bemino venishtayyer rubbo shalem velo ikkevu hannekavim shennistemu et hattekia, kasher. veim chaser echad min hattenaim hallalu, pasul:
Veim tzode lahem. orev. kemo veatta tzode et nafshi lekachtah (Shmuel 1 24):
Shenneemar elle moade Adonai. vechol makom shenneemar moed, bemoado, doche et hashshabbat:
Vetola. hakketem shemmatza:
Bechol davar shehi yechola litlot. lomar shello mimmenna haya:
Maacholet. kinna:
Ad kamma hi tola. bedam maacholet:

Ad kaggeris. aval tefe mehachi en dam maacholet kol kach gadol. uvehachi miha talya veaf al pi shello yada sheharga. verabbi chanina paleg attanna kamma deamar harga in, lo harga lo. veen halacha kerabbi chanina ben antignos:
Vetola vivnah uvevalah. hashshochvim etzlah im yesh bahen makka, lomar shekketem ze mehen haya:
Veim yesh bah makka. sheheelta kerum:
Vehi yechola lehitgalla. lehiggalot. milleshon lifne hitgalla hariv (Mishlei 17). kelomar, sheyyasir hakkerum vikallef vetitgalle hammakka veyetze mimmenna dam, tola vah:
Hare ellu chehedyot. shenneemar bannasi (sham) asher nasi yecheta, shechata keshehu nasi. vechen bakkohen hammashiach neemar veim hakkohen hammashiach yecheta (sham), shechata keshehu mashiach:
Bechol makom. bimkom yisrael:
Tehorim. shechezkatan enan middam nidda, deatznoe matznee lehu:
Bet hattumot. cheder shehannashim mishtammeshot bo bime niddutan:
Kovrin sham. lefi shaa, kede sheyyesalleku otan leachar zeman. ulefi sheen anu yodin im hesiru otan im lav, metammeim beohel:
Kol shechayyav bammaasrot mittamme tumat ochalim. deen lecha davar chayyav bemaaser sheeno ochel:
Veyesh shemmittamme tumat ochalim veeno chayyav bammaasrot. kegon basar vedagim uvetzim, sheenan giddule karka:

Hashshochet vehamekabbel vehamehallech vehazzorek. im keshehu asuk beachat mearba avodot hallalu chashav al hazzevach leechol mimmennu davar sheddarko leechol dehaynu habbasar, o lehaketir mimmennu davar sheddarko lehaketir dehaynu emurim, chutz limkomo, habbasar asur baachila, vehaochlo eno anush karet. veim chashav al hazzevach leachlo chutz lizmanno, hazzevach piggul, vehaochlo afillu vetoch zemanno anush karet, dichtiv (Vayikra 7) veim heachol yeachel mibbesar zevach shelamav bayyom hashshelishi lo yeratze hammakriv oto lo yechashev lo piggul yihye, uvimchashshev leechol mizzivcho bayyom hashshelishi hakkatuv medabber. o eno medabber ella beochel mizzivcho bayyom hashshelishi, amarta, achar shehuchshar yachazor veyifsol, bitmiyya. veod, hare hu omer lo yechashev, bemachashava hu nifsal veeno nifsal bashshelishi. umiddekaamar kera heachol yeachel, darshinan devishte achilot hakkatuv medabber, achat achilat adam dehaynu habbasar, veachat achilat mizbeach dehaynu haemurin. veal shetehen hu omer lo yechashev piggul yihye:
Uvilvad sheyyikrav hammattir. haddam shehu mattir:

Kemitzvato. [keillu haya kasher] shello yehe vo pesul acher. aval im yesh bo pesul machashava acheret, yatza mide piggul, kedimfaresh veazel. degabbe piggul ketiv lo yeratze, kedichtiv gabbe kasher, lomar lach keharetzaat kasher kach haretzaat piggul. ma haretzaat kasher lo kare la haretzaa ella vazzerika shehi sof arba avodot hammattirot, af piggul eno kavua uleolam hu taluy veomed ad sheyyizzarek haddam shehu sof kol hammattirin:
Vehaya kaasher yarim moshe yado vechulei. mishshum deayre leel bechavvanat hallev, tana nammi lehach deit bah beshaa shemmechavvenim libban laavihem shebbashshamayim hem mitgabberim:
Haish kodem laishsha. shehu mekuddash mimmenna, shehaish chayyav bechol hammitzvot vehaishsha enah chayyevet bemitzvot ase shehazzeman gerama:
Vehaishsha kodemet laish bichsut. shebboshtah merubba mibboshto shel ish:
Lekalkala. levia. ulemishkav zachur:
Haish kodem. shezzo darkah bechach veze en darko bechach:
Im enan makkirin oto. im en bet din makkirin et haed im neeman vechasher hu:
Meshallechim. bet din shebbeiro:
Acher immo. zug acher shel edim, lehaid alav lifne bet din haggadol shemmekaddeshim et hachodesh:
Mishshekkilkelu hamminin. shessachru ede sheker lehateot et hachachamim:
Kaskeset. malbush shel dag, hakkavua bo:
Senappir. kenafayim shepporeach bahen. vechol sheyyesh lo kaskeset beyadua sheyyesh lo senappir veen tzarich livdok acharav od, sheddag tahor hu:
Veyesh sheyyesh lo senappir. vehu dag tame, sheen lo kaskeset:
Yesh lo telafayim. parsotav sedukot. sheen karnayim ella livhema ulechayya tehora:
Veen lo karnayim. kegon chazir, shepparsotav sedukot, veen lo karnayim:
Kol hazzevachim shennizbechu shello lishman. kegon shennishchata ola leshem shelamim:
Kesherim. veyizrok daman veyaktir emurehen lishman. devikdushshatayhu kaymu veasur leshannoye vehu:

Ella shello alu labbealim leshem chova. vetzarich lehavi acher lechovato o lenidro veyishchatennu lishmo. deamar kera (Devarim 23) motza sefatecha tishmor veasita kaasher nadarta laAdonai‏ elohecha nedava, im nedava eno neder, veim neder eno nedava, ella hachi kaamar, im kema shennadarta asita, shennishchat leshem neder uleshem habbealim, yehe neder veyetze habbaal yede chovat nidro. veim lav, shello nishchat hazzevach leshem bealim, yehe nedava, kelomar kasher hu keillu hevio lindava, aval lo yatza yede nidro, shello ala labbealim leshem chova. vedavka karban yachid sheyyesh lo bealim, aval karbenot tzibbur shennishchatu shello lishman, alu latztzibbur leshem chova, shehashshechita moshachtan lema shehen reuyin lo. vedavka chesheshshechatan beferush shello lishman, az amrinan delo alu labbealim leshem chova. aval shechatan setam, alu labbealim lechova:

Chutz min happesach. devappesach ketiv (sham 16) veasita pesach, ad sheyyehu chol asiyyotav leshem pesach, veod ketiv (Shemot 12) vaamartem zevach pesach hu, shettehe zevicha leshem pesach, vehanehu tere kerae, chad lifsol im naasa shello leshem pesach, vechad lifsol im naasa shello leshem bealim:

Vechattat. divchattat nammi chetive tere kerae, ketiv (Vayikra 4) veshachat otah lechattat, shettehe shechita leshem chattat, uchetiv (sham) velakach hakkohen middam hachattat, ad shettehe kabbalat haddam uzerikato leshem chattat, vechipper alav hakkohen, alav velo al chavero, dehaynu shettehe leshem bealim, mechattato asher chata, shettehe leshem oto hachet. velo amaran dechattat shello lishmo pasul, ella kesheshshechato leshem kadashim acherim, aval shachat leshem chullin, kasher, velo ala labbealim leshem chova, dichtiv (sham 22) velo yechallelu et kadshe vene yisrael, kadashim mechallelin kadashim, veen chullin mechallelin kadashim:

Happesach bizmanno. pasul shello lishmo kol zeman shechitato, dehaynu mechatzot hayyom shel erev pesach ad haerev. aval kodem lachen veachar mikken, kayma lan pesach bishar yemot hashshana shelamim have, vechol dino kishlamim:

Af haasham. kedimfaresh taama veazel, hachattat baa al hachet vechulei‏ uchetiv kachattat kaasham. verabbanan savre, chattat dichtiv beh miuta, pasul. asham delo chetiv beh miuta, kasher. veim tomar, asham nammi chetiv beh asham hu, hay lo neemar ella leachar haketarat emurin, veim ba lemaet shello lishmo defasul, kodem haketarat emurin haya tzarich lechatvo. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:
Kol hazzevachim shekkibbel daman zar. sheeno chohen, pasul. dichtiv (Vayikra 22) veyinnazru mikkadshe vene yisrael velo yechallelu, limmed al hazzar sheavad, shechillel et hakkodashim:
Onen. mi shemmet lo echad min hakkerovim shehu chayyav lehitabbel alehem, kol yom hammita karuy onen, veasur leechol bakkodashim. veim avad chillel. chutz mikkohen gadol shehu makriv onen:
Tevul yom. sheen tohorato nigmeret ad sheyyaariv shimsho kedichtiv (sham) uva hashshemesh vetaher:

Umechussar begadim. kohen hedyot sheshshimmesh befachot mearbaa vegadim. vechohen gadol sheshshimmesh befachot mishshemona. ucheshem shemmechussar begadim pasul, kach meyuttar begadim pasul. vechen im haya davar chotzetz ben besaro lakketonet o lammichnasayim, pasul, derachamana amar (sham 6) yilbash al besaro, shello yehe davar chotzetz ben habbegadim livsaro. hilkach kohen bishat avoda lo haya meniach tefillin shel yad, lefi shehen chotztzim ben habbeged livsaro. aval tefillin shel rosh haya meniach, lefi shehen munnachin al searo shehu nire ben tzitz lemitznefet:

Umechussar kippurim. kegon zav vezava umetzora veyoledet shennigmera tohoratan velo heviu karbenotehem. veashkechan dechatav rachamana beyoledet (sham 12) vechipper aleha hakkohen vetahera, mikkelal shead kan temea hi. vehu haddin lechol shear temeim hatteunim karban, shehen betumatan ad sheyyaviu chapparatan leinyan achilat kadashim velavo bammikdash:

Veshello rechutz yadayim veraglayim. lefi shenneemar bekiddush yadayim veraglayim chukkat olam, veneemar bevigde chehunna chukkat olam, ma bigde chehunna im avad mechussar begadim pasal, af im avad shello rechutz yadav veraglav pasal. veseder kiddush yadayim veraglayim, lo omed velo yoshev ella mutte, umeniach yado hayemanit al gabbe raglo hayemanit veyado hassemalit al gabbe raglo hassemalit, umeshafshef raglav beyadav beshaa shehu mekaddesh. veeno rashshay lekaddesh betoch hakkiyyor atzmo, ella min hammayim sheyyotzim mimmennu, shenneemar (Shemot 30) verachatzu aharon uvanav mimmennu, velo vetocho. vechol hammemot kesherim lekiddush. vaafillu sheenan mayim chayyim:
Vearel. im avad pasal. dichtiv (bichezkel 44) kol ben nechar aral lev vaaral basar, hikkish arel leven nechar, ma ben nechar im avad pasal, af arel ken:
Yoshev. dichtiv (Devarim 18) laamod lesharet, shello yehe sherut ella meummad:

Omed al gabbe chelim. hoil veritzpat haazara mekaddeshet, uchele sharet mekaddeshin haddavar hannogea bahen, ma keli sharet tzarich shello yehe davar chotzetz beno lakkeli sharet, af ritzpa lo yehe davar chotzetz beno leven haritzpa. velo mibbaya kelim sheenan min basar devadday chaytze, ella afillu vehema shehi min basar. velo mibbaya behema sheenah min adam, ella afillu ragle chavero shehen min adam chotztzim:

Kibbel bassemol pasal. dichtiv (Vayikra 4) velakach hakkohen middam hachattat beetzbao venatan, melammed shello tehe kabbalat haddam velo netina ella beyamin. dechol makom shenneemar yad o etzba eno ella beyamin, deyalef mimmetzora dichtiv beh (sham 14) vetaval hakkohen et etzbao hayemanit:

Verabbi shimon machshir. savar mikra nidrash leacharav velo lefanav, hilkach etzba avvenatan dichtiv batreh kae, velo avvelakach dichtiv lekammeh. verabbanan savre mikra nidrash lefanav uleacharav, vechi ketiv etzba attarvayhu kae, allekicha dilfanav veannetina deacharav. vahalacha kachachamim:
Nishpach al haritzpa. shello nitkabbel haddam bichli:

Vaasafo pasul. dichtiv (sham 16) velakach middam happar, may middam happar, i salka datach vaafillu miktzat dam, veha chetiv (sham 4) veet kol dam happar yishpoch, alma tzarich sheyyekabbel kol haddam. ella kare veh velakach dam mehappar, min happar yekabbelennu velo min haaretz. sheggorin ot mitteva zo umosifin otah al teva acheret vedorshim otah:

Netano al hakkevesh shello cheneged hayesod pasul. umikkol makom nitkapperu habbealim. ella shehabbasar eno neechol. deamar rachamana gabbe dam (sham 17) vaani netattiv lachem al hammizbeach lechapper, kevan shehiggia dam lammizbeach nitkapperu habbealim:

Natan et hannittanin lematta. michut hassikra shehaya chagur lammizbeach baemtza. vehaddamim hannittanin bechamesh ammot haelyonot shehen lemala min hachut nikraim hannittanim lemala, vehannittanin bechamesh ammot tachtonot shehen lematta min hachut nikraim hannittanim lematta:
Hannittanim bifnim. sheddaman taun hazzaya al mizbach hazzahav:
Bachutz. al mizbeach hachitzon:
Pasul. veasur baachila:
Veen bo charet. haochel mibbesar hakkodashim shennifsal damo bappesulim hallalu, eno anush karet:

Hattadir mechavero hu kodem. deamar kera (Bamidbar 28) millevad olat habboker asher leolat hattamid. mikkede chetiv olat habboker, asher leolat hattamid lamma li, ella amar rachamana, hay mishshum detadir, kadem beresha:
Vechol hamekuddash mechavero vechulei. dehachi ashkechan bakkohen, dichtiv beh vekiddashto, veamrinan liftoach rishon ulevarech rishon velittol mana yafa rishon:

Par mashiach kodem. hoil umashiach mechapper veeda mitkapperet, bedin hu sheyyakdim mechapper lammitkapper. vechen hu omer (Vayikra 16) vechipper baado uvead beto, veachar kach uvead kol kehal yisrael:

Kibbel vehillech vezarak. o o katane. sheshshechato shello lishman, o kibbel haddam bammazrek, o holich haddam lammizbeach, o zarak. kol achat mearba avodot hallalu sheasa shello lishman, bappesach uvachattat pasal, uvishar zevachim, lo alu labbealim leshem chova. vaafillu asa achat mearba avodot hallalu lishman veshello lishman yachad, ben shehikdim machashevet lishman lemachashevet shello lishman, ben shehikdim machashevet shello lishman lemachashevet lishman, bechol inyan pasul:

Aval efshar shello vehilluch. hilkach la chashiva lemifsal. vachachamim omrim, af al gav deefshar shello vehilluch, machashava poselet bah, daavoda sheefshar levattelah shemah avoda, veholachat haddam avoda hi, shehare pesula bezar, dichtiv veshachat vehikrivu vene aharon hakkohanim, mikkabbala vaelach mitzvat kehunna:

Hamehallech bimkom shehu tzarich lehallech. holacha zo, machashava poselet bah. ketzad, kibbelo bachutz lehallan min hammizbeach vehichniso bifnim, shekkervo letzad hammizbeach, zehu hilluch shetztzarich lehallech umachashava poselet bo. kibbelo bifnim samuch lammizbeach vehotzio lachutz, zehu hilluch sheeno tzarich, veen machashava poselet bo. chazar vehichniso, zehu hilluch hatztzarich. veen halacha kerabbi elazar velo cherabbi shimon:
Hashshochet et hammukdashin. kol hecha denakat hay lishana mayre binkevot:
Leechol shalil. shebbemeeha:
O shilya. haor hachofe et havvalad. en machashava zo poselet et hazzevach. dishlil veshilya lav gufa dezivcha hu:
Lo figgel. hachi kaamar, hashshochet et hammukdashin leechol shelil o shilya chutz limkomo, lo fasal. veim chashav leechol mehen chutz lizmanno, lo figgel:
Chalev hammukdashin uvetze torin en chayyavin alehen mishshum piggul. im piggel bazzevach veachal mechalav shebbedaddeha, lo mechuyyav aleha mishshum piggul, delav gufa dezivcha hu:
Haroa chetem. keneged bet hatturpa. bet haerva:
Temea. deikka lememar, dam meoto makom nafal:
Al akevah. zimnin demitreme venaga beoto makom:
Veal rosh gudalah. devahade defasa mitreme gudal shebberaglah lihyot tachat oto makom vedam notef alav:
Al shokah veal parsoteha mibbifnim temea. kesheadam omed umechabber raglav veshokav zo bazo, kol ma shemmechubbar mehem zo im zo, karuy lifnim:
Mibbachutz. mikkan umikkan:
Veal hatztzedadin. achore hashshok kol gavhan keneged heakev, ulefanav kol gavhan keneged haregel, keruyim tzedadim:
Min hachagor ulematta. keneged bet hatturpa hu:
Im maggia keneged bet hatturpa. kegon shennimtza berosh bet yadah samuch layyad, sheppeamim shepposhattan mizzeroa venofel keneged matta:
Veim lav. shello keneged bet hatturpa, kegon shennimtza samuch lakketefot:
Shehu chozer. peamim sherosh hechaluk nehefach keneged paneha shel matta:
Vechen bappolyon. mitpachat shehi mitkassa bo:
Hashshochet et hazzevach. shelamim o shear hanneechalim:

Kazzayit meor haalya. ha kamashma lan deor haalya lav kealya dame, vehave mechashshev leechol davar sheddarko leechol, ulefichach pasul. dei kealya dame, have mechashshev leechol davar sheddarko lehaketir velo haya pasul, keditnan lekamman besamuch, leechol davar sheddarko leechol, lehaketir davar sheddarko lehaketir, pasul:
Veeno anush karet. haochel. vaafillu bachutz eno anush karet:
Leechol et besaro lemachar. ha lekka leokma bishlamim, ella betoda vechattat. deillu bishlamim zemanno hu. aval lizrok damo o lehaketir emurav, afillu bishlamim have lemachar chutz lizmanno:
Piggul vechayyavim alav karet. haochlo, vaafillu bizmanno anush karet:
Mehar hammishcha. har hazzetim shehu neged yerushalayim bemizrachah:
Kol haggola. bene bavel:
Kimdurat esh. shekkol echad veechad notel avuka umaalah lerosh gaggo:
Metamme lemafrea. kol tohorot shennimtzeu bammavoy. demavoy reshut hayyachid hu leinyan tuma, usefeko tame:
O ad sheat kibbud. mippene shechezkat bene yisrael bodkin mevootehen bishat kibbudehen, veim haya sham sheretz haya roe oto:
Vechen ketem shennimtza vechaluk metamme lemafrea. kol tohorot sheasta haishsha miyyom kibbus. aval otan shel kodem kibbus, lo, mippene shechezkat benot yisrael bodkot chalukehem bishat kibbusehen:
Hayyavesh metamme lemafrea. ad sheat kibbud. deikka lememar leachar kibbud miyyad nafal:

Aval hallach eno metamme lemafrea. ella ad shaa shennuchal lomar im nafal beoto yom adayin yachol lihyot achshav lach. aval ad sheat hakkibbud lizman merubbe, lo, deha lach hu, vei mehahi shatah nafal, hava mitaved yavesh. vedavka besheretz hu defaleg rabbi shimon ben lach leyavesh. aval bechetem, afillu lach metamme lemafrea ad sheat kibbus, deemar yavesh haya umayya hu denafal aleh. aval besheretz lekka lememar hachi, dei ita demayim naful aleh, immartote immartut. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Levi kodem leyisrael. dichtiv (Devarim 10) baet hahi hivdil Adonai‏ et shevet hallevi mittoch bene yisrael:
Yisrael kodem lemamzer. hay meyuchas vehay lav meyuchas:
Mamzer kodem lenatin. ze ba mittippa keshera veze ba mittippa pesula:
Natin kodem leger. ze gadal immanu bikdushsha veze lo gadal immanu bikdushsha:
Ger kodem leeved. ze lo haya bichlal arur veze haya bichlal arur:
Mamzer talmid chacham kodem lechohen gadol am haaretz. dichtiv (Mishlei 3) yekara hi mippeninim, yekara hi mikkohen gadol shennichnas lifnay velifnim:
Kohen gadol porem millematta. im met lo met shechayyav likroa alav, korea millematta bichnaf bigdo hassamuch leraglav. vehay dichtiv uvegadav lo yifrom, sheeno porem kishar kol adam:
Millemala. keneged hechaze samuch lakkatef, kishar haam:

Onen. mi shemmet lo echad mishshiva kerovim shechayyav lehitabbel alav, yom hammita kullo ben nikbar hammet ben lo nikbar, hu onen deorayta, umiyyom hammita veelach kol zeman shello nikbar hammet hu onen derabbanan, veyom hakkevura hu onen derabbanan kol oto hayyom afillu leachar kevura, umishennikbar hammet beyom rishon shel mita kol hallayla shelleacharav hu onen derabbanan:

Kohen gadol makriv onen velo ochel. min hakkadashim. shekken matzinu beaharon bayyom shemmetu nadav vaavihu amar veachalti chattat hayyom hayitav beene Adonai‏ [vayyikra 10], al haachila haya makpid, lo al hahakrava. vedavka aharon shehu kohen gadol, aval banav shehayu kohanim hedyotim hayu asurim oto hayyom ben lehakeriv ben leechol:

Av uveno vechol hakkerovim kesherim leedut hachodesh. deamar lehu rachamana lemoshe uleaharon (Shemot 12) hachodesh hazze lachem, edut zo shel chodesh tehe keshera bachem veaf al pi sheattem achim. verabbanan diflige aleh amre, hachodesh hazze lachem, edut zo tehe mesura lachem, laggedolim shebbaddor kemotchem. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Tzurot levanot. shiur hayyareach uleeze tzad karneha notot:

Kibbelan rabban gamliel. lo mippene shechashav sheefshar shetterae hayyareach shacharit bammizrach bitchillat hanetz hachamma uvo bayyom atzmo terae bammaarav im shekiat hachamma, ki ze i efshar. ella shekkibbel edutan bema sheamru sherau hayyareach bemaarav arvit, mippene sheyyada bedarche hacheshbon shehaya efshar shetterae beotah hallayla. uvema sheamru sherauha shacharit bammizrach, amar toim hem vaananim kidmut yareach nira lahem barakia. dehachi tanya babberayta [ko.], paam achat nitkashsheru shamayim beavim venirata demut levana beesrim (veshiva) [vetisha] lachodesh vechulei. verabbi yochanan ben nuri deamar ede sheker hem, haya nire lo lefi cheshbono shello haya efshar shetterae hayyareach beoto layla sheamru haedim sherau otah, veamar ede sheker hem, lefi shello haya ben hariyya uven hammolad lefi dato, kol kach zeman sheyyihye efshar shetterae bo. veal ze heshiv rabban gamliel babberayta, kach mekubbelani mibbet avi abba peamim ba baarukka ufeamim ba biktzara, kelomar shehazzeman sheyyesh ben hammolad ad shetterae hayyareach eno shave leolam, ella peamim tihye tenuat hayyareach mehira ufeamim meucheret. uchefi mehirut tenuat hayyareach beoto hazzeman, dan rabban gamliel shehaya rauy shetterae hallevana beoto hallayla, lefichach kibbel edutan:
Reinuhu bizmanno. belel sheloshim:
Uvelel ibburo. lel sheloshim veechad:

Vekibbelan rabban gamliel. lo mippene shennomar shennitrachaka hayyareach min hashshemesh belel sheloshim ad shetterae, uvelel sheloshim veechad chazra laachoreha venitkarva etzel hashshemesh ad shennitkasset, sheen hayyareach chozeret laachoreha ella osa mahalachah besibbuv begalgalla, ella sheyyada rabban gamliel becheshbono shebbeoto hallayla sheamru haedim sherauha, kevar nitrachaka hayyareach min hashshemesh ad shehaya efshar shetterae, lefichach kibbel edutan. uvema sheamru belel ibburo lo nira, efshar shehaya mippene shekkissa oto heanan o sibba acheret garma shehem lo rau otah:
Roe ani et devarecha. leabber et hachodesh:

Shave hayyovel lerosh hashshana lattekia. bifshutim. veaf al gav ditkia bayyovel lo litfilla velo lezikkaron ella lesiman shilluach avadim vachazarot sadot levaalehen, afillu hachi keen rosh hashshana bae, degamrinan bigzera shava mishshevii shevii, sheyyihyu kol tekiot shebbachodesh hashshevii shavot zo kazo. perush acher lattekia, leminyan hattekiot, velabberachot, leminyan habberachot, devae lememar malchuyot zichronot veshofarot beyom hakkippurim shel yovel kemo berosh hashshana:
Rabbi yehuda omer kulei. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda velo ketanna kamma. ella halacha ben rosh hashshana ben yom hakkippurim shel yovel, shenehem beshel zecharim kefufim:

Leechol kazzayit bachutz vechazzayit lemachar. hayenu hach daamaran, ella deresha ayre bishte avodot, sheshshachat al menat leechol kazzayit bachutz, vekibbel al menat leechol kazzayit lemachar. vechan baavoda achat, sheshshachat al menat leechol kazzayit lemachar vechazzayit bachutz:

Rabbi yehuda omer kulei. akkulla matnitin paleg. delet leh demachashevet shear pesulim motzia mide piggul, ella im ken kadam pesulo lefiggulo. uvaavoda achat nammi paleg, deit leh tefos leshon rishon. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Leechol kachatzi zayit ulehaktir kachatzi zayit. ushenehen chutz lizmanno o chutz limkomo:
Kasher sheen achila vehaketara mitztarfin. lefaslo. dehacha lekka shiura vehacha lekka shiura:
Tinoket shehevia shete searot. leachar shetem esre shana veyom echad:

Vecholetzet o mityabbemet. af al gav detana chayyevet bechol mitzvot haamurot battora, itzterich lemitne choletzet o mityabbemet, demahu detema ish ketiv bapparasha (Devarim 25), veim lo yachpotz haish, hilkach katan lo chaletz. aval ishsha delo ketiv bapparasha ella yevimto, ben gedola ben ketanna choletzet o mityabbemet, ka mashma lan dei ayytiat shete searot, in. i lo, lo. may taama, demakshinan ishsha leish:
Vechen hattinok shehevi shete searot. leachar shelosh esre shana veyom echad. vekamme shetem esre linkeva ushelosh esre lezachar, eno siman ella shuma:

Verauy lihyot ben sorer umore mishsheyyavi shete searot ad sheyyakkif zakan hattachton. aval kodem sheyyavi shete searot lav bar onshim hu. uleachar shehikkif zakan hattachton, rauy leholid, verachamana amar ben, velo harauy lihyot av:
Hattachton velo haelyon. kelomar, beezo hakkafat zakan amru, betachton shel matta, velo baelyon:

Ad sheyyirbe hashshachor. sheyyashchir oto makom searot harebe. ufesak halacha, shehabbat memaenet ad shettehe bat shetem esre shana veyom echad. uleachar zeman ze, im hevia simanim, enah yechola lemaen. veim lo hevia simanim, memaenet veholechet vaafillu ad shettehe bat esrim shana veyerau bah simane aylonit. vehane mile, keshello ba aleha leachar shehayu lah shetem esre shana veyom echad. aval im ba aleha leachar zeman ze, shuv enah yechola lemaen. veaf al pi shello niru bah simanim, chayshinan shemma hevia shete searot venashru:
Nedareha nivdakim. im yada leshem mi nadra, leshem mi hikdisha, nadra neder:
Nedareha kayyamin. vehu shehevia shete searot. vechen ben shelosh esre shana veyom echad nedarav kayyamim, davka keshehevi shete searot:

Uvodkin kol shetem esre. mahu detema hoil veamar mar sheloshim yom bashshana chashuvim shana, hecha divdaknuha sheloshim yom kammae dishtem esre velo yada lefaresh leshem mi nadra, tu lo nivdok, ulechazkah kiktanna, kamashma lan:
Kodem lazzeman hazze. kodem rosh hashshana shel shetem esre letinoket veshel shelosh esre letinok:
En nidrehen neder. diktannim hen:
Kol shechayyav bereshit haggez. rechelim veelim bilvad:
Chayyav bammattanot. hazzeroa vehallechayayim vehakkeva:
Veyesh shechayyav bammattanot. shechiyyuv hammattanot leshor veizzim uchevasim:

Veod zot hayta yerushalayim. matnitin chasure michassera vehachi katane, birushalayim hayu tokin bechol hair kol zeman shebbet din yoshvim bammikdash, shebbet din yoshvin ad shishsha shaot bayyom. uveyavne lo hayu tokin bechol hair ella bifne bet din. veod zot hayta yerushalayim yetera al yavne kulei:
Kol ir shehi roa. yerushalayim. perat layyoshevet bannachal sheaf al pi shehayta kerova lo hayu tokin bah:
Veshomaat. perat layyoshevet berosh hahar:
Ukerova. perat layyoshevet chutz lattechum:
Vichola lavo. perat lammafsik lah nahar:
Ezo hi simaneha. atztzemel kae:
Kemet. sheggadlu daddeha ad shekkefulim meat al hechaze veyerae kekemet:
Mishsheyyattu haddaddin. gedolim yoter mikkemet:
Happittomet. rosh haddad. kemo nittela pitmato [sukka 83 46]:

Al haoketz. chuddo shel dad shettinok yonek. ufittomet hayenu sevivot haoketz. vechol hassimanim hallalu keshenniru beishsha hare hi bogeret, lemar kidit leh ulemar kidit leh, veshuv en leaviha reshut bah. vahalacha kedivre kullam lehachemir. hilkach im nira bah echad min hassimanim hallalu, dayninan bah din bogeret lechumra. aval lo lekulla, sheim kiddesha et atzmah, tzericha get shemma bogeret hi. veim aviha kiddeshah, tzericha nammi get, deshemma adayin naara hi, ad sheyyihyu bah kol hassimanim hallalu kullam, veaz techashev bogeret ben lekulla ben lechumra:
Yachazir lakkasher. velo mifsil bema shennatan oto lappasul:
Netano. pasul:

Al gabbe hakkevesh shello cheneged hayesod. dehavya netina shello vimkomah. o shennatan et hannittanim lematta lemala, yachazor hakkasher vikabbel. utzericha leashmeinan bechullehu deit leh takkanta bachazara. dei ashmeinan baresha, hava amena hanach dachazu laavodat tzibbur kegon tame dachazi lechattechilla betzibbur, hilkach gabbe yachid ikka takkanta bachazara, aval semol delo chazya laavodat tzibbur ema delet leh takkanta bachazara. vei ashmeinan semol, hava amena semol it leh takkanta bachazara, shekken yesh bah hechsher beyom hakkippurim, shekkohen gadol notel et hammachta bimino veet hakkaf bismolo, aval keli chol ema lo. vei ashmeinan keli chol, mishshum dachazu lekaddeshinhu, aval hanach ema lo, tzericha:
Habbaim merkam. shehen nachrim vedaman tahor. veaf al gav derabbanan gazru al hannachrim sheyyihyu kazzavim lechol divrehem, al kitmehem lo gazru:
Merekem. ben kadesh uven shur, metargeminan ben rekem uven chaggera:
Shehen gerim. vedaman tame:
Vetoim. kelomar, lo tzenie kulle hay, veen matzniim et kitmehen, hilkach chayyshinan shemma ketamim shel ishsha nidda hen:
Habbaim mibben haggoyim tehorim. delo gazru rabbanan al kitmehen, kevan dedaman vadday tahor min hattora:

Mibben yisrael umibben hakkutim rabbi meir metamme. matnitin chassore michassera vehachi katane, mibben yisrael umibben hakkutim, temeim, dechutim gere emet hen vedaman tame. ketamim hannimtzaim beare yisrael dehaynu bemakom galuy, tehorim, delo nechshedu al kitmehen veatznoe matznee lehu. hannimtzain beare kutim, rabbi meir metamme, dechutim nechshedu al kitmehen. vachachamim metaharim, shello nechshedu al kitmehen umatznee lehu, vetalinan lehay ketem bedam chayya o behema, deillu dam ishsha nidda, lo haya nimtza bemakom galuy, deinhu nammi matzneu lehu keyisrael. uchevar nifseka hahalacha devazman hazze gazru al kutim lihyot kannachrim lechol divrehem, vechitmehen tehorim kechitme hannachrim:
Rabbi yehoshua machshir. dachashiv leh kefesach bishar yemot hashshana, hoil veen zemanno ad ben haarbayim:
Ben betera posel. hoil umiktzat hayyom rauy hava leh kefesach bizmanno. vahalacha keven betera:
Shivim ushenayim zaken. lehodiacha shebbishiva achat hayu yoshvim vechullan horu keish echad, lechach tane zaken velo tana zekenim:
Kol hazzevachim hanneechalim. aval ola lo:
Velo hosif ben azzay. al divre chachamim lifsol chutz mippesach vechattat, ella ola:
Baalil. lemala min haaretz harebe, shehakkol roim otah:
Shello baalil. lematta beshippulo shel rakia samuch laaretz, veadmumit hachamma mechassa otah veenah nikkeret kol kach:
En mechallelin. devadday rau otah birushalayim. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
En chayyavin al ase veal lo taase shebbammikdash. bet din shehoru vetau betumat mikdash vekadashav, en mechuyyavin lehavi karban tzibbur:

Al ase shebbammikdash. kegon shennitma bammikdash, shemmitzva lo latzet biktzara, veim shaha veyatza baarukka chayyav karet. uvet din shehoru lo latzet baarukka en chayyavin karban, lefi sheen al shegaga zo karban chattat, kelomar yachid shettaa veshagag bezo veyatza baarukka eno chayyav chattat kevua ella karban ole veyored:
Velo taase shebbammikdash. shello yikkanes lammikdash betuma:

Veen meviin asham taluy vechulei. shekkol davar shechayyavin al shiggato chattat kevua, meviin al lo hoda shello asham taluy. vetumat mikdash hoil veen chayyavin al shiggato chattat [kevua], en meviin al lo hoda shello asham taluy:

Al ase shebbannidda. haya meshammesh im hattehora veamra lo nitmeti atta bishat tashmish, mitzva alav lifrosh, velo yifrosh miyyad, shehayetzia hanaa hi lo keviato, ella noetz tzipparnav bakkarka umamtin ad sheyyamut haever uforesh belo koshi. vezehu ase shebbannidda. veim shaggu bet din behoraa zo vehoru sheyyifrosh miyyad, chayyavin par helem davar, lefi shehayyachid chayyav al shiggato chattat:

Hannishchatim leshem pesach. kol shear zevachim shennizbechu bearbaa asar benisan leshem pesach, pesulim, vechen shennizbechu leshem chattat bechol zeman, pesulim, ki hechi deinhu pesulim leshem acherim. ufaleg attanna kamma dematnitin deamar kol hazzevachim shennizbechu shello lishman kesherim. veamar ihu, uvilvad shello yishchatem leshem pesach velo leshem chattat:
Shimon achi azarya. nikra chen, al shem sheazarya asak bifrakmatya vehaya mesappek tzarche shimon achiv shehaya osek battora, vehitnu venehem sheyyehe chelek laazarya bischar talmudo shel shimon:
Shechatan. lishar zevachim:
Leshem gavoah mehen. kedimfaresh veazel. kesherim:
Leshem namuch mehen. leshem zevach shehu fachut mehen bikdushsha:

Pesulim. dichtiv (Vayikra 22) velo yechallelu et kadshe bene yisrael et asher yarimu laAdonai, bemuram mehem en mitchallelim, benamuch mehem mitchallelim. veen halacha kerabbi yose ven choni, velo cheshimon achi azarya:

Bechor umaasar behema. nemuchin mishshelamim, mippene shehashshelamim teunim mattan arba, kelomar shete mattanot shehen arba, usemicha unesachim, utenufat chaze veshok. ma sheen ken bivchor uvemaaser dedaman taun mattana achat, veen semicha unesachim noheget bahen, velo tenufat chaze veshok:
Mesachakim bakkuvya. atzamot shemmesachakim bahen beeravon. veamur rabbanan asmachta lo kanya, vahare hen gazlanim midderabbanan:
Umalve beribbit. lo karuy gazlan deorayta lemifseleh, deha minnafsheh yahev leh:
Mafriche yonim. hayenu keen kuvya, im tekaddemeh yonach leyoni:
Vesochare sheviit. osin sechora beferot sheviit, verachamana amar leachla velo lischora. ulefi shennechshedu kol elu laavor al dat mechamat mamon, chashadum lihyot meidim sheker al shochad:
Vehaavadim. pesulim deorayta hem, kal vachomer meishsha:

Edut sheen haishsha keshera lah. lefi sheyyesh edut shehaishsha keshera, kegon lehaid laishsha shemmet baalah lehattirah linnase lezarim, vechen lehaid al sota shennitmet shello tishte, vehanach pesulin derabbanan nammi kesherim. aval pesulin baavera min hattora lo hichshiru chachamim beedut haishsha, veaf al pi shehichshiru haeved vehaishsha shehen pesulim leedut min hattora:
